801.e: The Lord is totally permeating and pervading everywhere;
the Name of the Lord is pervading the water and the land.

801.g: ਨਿਤ ਗਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਸਾਰਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
801.t: nit gaieeaai har dhookh bisaarano ||1|| rahaau ||
801.e: So sing continuously of the Lord, the Dispeller of pain. ||1||Pause||

801.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਹੈ ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
801.t: har keeaa hai safal janam hamaaraa ||
801.e: The Lord has made my life fruitful and rewarding.
I meditate on the Lord, the Dispeller of pain.
I have met the Guru, the Giver of liberation.
The Lord has made my life's journey fruitful and rewarding.
Joining the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||
O mortal, place your hopes in the Name of the Lord,
and your love of duality shall simply vanish.
One who, in hope, remains unattached to hope,
such a humble being meets with his Lord.
And one who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name
- servant Nanak falls at his feet. ||2||1||7||4||6||7||17||

801.t: raag bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa chaupadhe ghar pehilaa
801.e: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla, Chau-Padhay, First House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
He is attached to what he sees.
How can I meet You, O Imperishable God?
Have Mercy upon me, and place me upon the Path;
let me be attached to the hem of the robe of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||
How can I cross over the poisonous world-ocean?
The True Guru is the boat to carry us across. ||1||Pause||
The wind of Maya blows and shakes us,

801.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਸੇਇ ॥
801.t: har ke bhagat sadhaa thir sei ||
801.e: but the Lord's devotees remain ever-stable.
They remain unaffected by pleasure and pain.
The Guru Himself is the Savior above their heads. ||2||
Maya, the snake, holds all in her coils.
They burn to death in egotism, like the moth lured by seeing the flame.
They make all sorts of decorations, but they do not find the Lord.

801.g: ਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
801.t: jaa hoi kirapaal taa guroo milaavai ||3||
801.e: When the Guru becomes Merciful, He leads them to meet the Lord. ||3||

801.g: ਹਉ ਫਿਰਉ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਮੈ ਇਕੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਦਸਾਇਆ ॥
801.t: hau firau udhaasee mai ik ratan dhasaiaa ||
801.e: I wander around, sad and depressed, seeking the jewel of the One Lord.
This priceless jewel is not obtained by any efforts.

801.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਲੁ ॥
801.t: har kaa ma(n)dhar tis meh laal ||
801.e: That jewel is within the body, the Temple of the Lord.

801.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਲਿਆ ਪੜਦਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਭਈ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥੪॥
801.t: gur kholiaa paRadhaa dhekh bhiee nihaal ||4||
801.e: The Guru has torn away the veil of illusion, and beholding the jewel, I am delighted. ||4||
One who has tasted it, comes to know its flavor;
he is like the mute, whose mind is filled with wonder.
I see the Lord, the source of bliss, everywhere.

801.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਆਖਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੫॥੧॥
801.t: jan naanak har gun aakh samaiaa ||5||1||
801.e: Servant Nanak speaks the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and merges in Him. ||5||1||
Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:
The Divine Guru has blessed me with total happiness.
He has linked His servant to His service.

801.g: ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਜਪਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵ ॥੧॥
801.t: bighan na laagai jap alakh abhev ||1||
801.e: No obstacles block my path, meditating on the incomprehensible, inscrutable Lord. ||1||
The soil has been sanctified, singing the Glories of His Praises.

801.g: ਦੁਰਤੁ ਗਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
801.t: dhurat giaa har naam dhiaae ||1|| rahaau ||
801.e: The sins are eradicated, meditating on the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
He Himself is pervading everywhere;

801.g: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥
801.t: aadh jugaadh jaa kaa vadd parataap ||
801.e: from the very beginning, and throughout the ages, His Glory has been radiantly manifest.
By Guru's Grace, sorrow does not touch me. ||2||

801.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਲਗੇ ਮਨਿ ਮੀਠੇ ॥
801.t: gur ke charan lage man meeThe ||
801.e: The Guru's Feet seem so sweet to my mind.
He is unobstructed, dwelling everywhere.
I found total peace, when the Guru was pleased. ||3||
The Supreme Lord God has become my Savior.
Wherever I look, I see Him there with me.
O Nanak, the Lord and Master protects and cherishes His slaves. ||4||2||
Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:
You are the treasure of peace, O my Beloved God.

802.g: ਅਗਨਤ ਗੁਣ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
802.t: aganat gun Thaakur prabh tere ||
802.e: Your Glories are uncounted, O God, my Lord and Master.

802.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
802.t: moh anaath tumaree saranaiee ||
802.e: I am an orphan, entering Your Sanctuary.

802.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
802.t: kar kirapaa har charan dhiaaiee ||1||
802.e: Have Mercy on me, O Lord, that I may meditate on Your Feet. ||1||

802.g: ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਬਸਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
802.t: dhiaa karahu basahu man aai ||
802.e: Take pity upon me, and abide within my mind;

802.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਲੀਜੈ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
802.t: moh niragun leejai laR lai || rahaau ||
802.e: I am worthless - please let me grasp hold of the hem of Your robe. ||1||Pause||

802.g: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾ ਕੈਸੀ ਭੀੜ ॥
802.t: prabh chit aavai taa kaisee bheeR ||
802.e: When God comes into my consciousness, what misfortune can strike me?

802.g: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮ ਪੀੜ ॥
802.t: har sevak naahee jam peeR ||
802.e: The Lord's servant does not suffer pain from the Messenger of Death.

802.g: ਸਰਬ ਦੂਖ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਸੇ ॥
802.t: sarab dhookh har simarat nase ||
802.e: All pains are dispelled, when one remembers the Lord in meditation;

802.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਸੈ ॥੨॥
802.t: jaa kai sa(n)g sadhaa prabh basai ||2||
802.e: God abides with him forever. ||2||

802.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
802.t: prabh kaa naam man tan aadhaar ||
802.e: The Name of God is the Support of my mind and body.

802.g: ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੋਵਤ ਤਨੁ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
802.t: bisarat naam hovat tan chhaar ||
802.e: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the body is reduced to ashes.

802.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭ ਕਾਜ ॥
802.t: prabh chit aae pooran sabh kaaj ||
802.e: When God comes into my consciousness, all my affairs are resolved.

802.g: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਸਭ ਕਾ ਮੁਹਤਾਜ ॥੩॥
802.t: har bisarat sabh kaa muhataaj ||3||
802.e: Forgetting the Lord, one becomes subservient to all. ||3||

802.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
802.t: charan kamal sa(n)g laagee preet ||
802.e: I am in love with the Lotus Feet of the Lord.

802.g: ਬਿਸਰਿ ਗਈ ਸਭ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
802.t: bisar giee sabh dhuramat reet ||
802.e: I am rid of all evil-minded ways.

802.g: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤ ॥
802.t: man tan a(n)tar har har ma(n)t ||
802.e: The Mantra of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, is deep within my mind and body.

802.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਨ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ॥੪॥੩॥
802.t: naanak bhagatan kai ghar sadhaa ana(n)dh ||4||3||
802.e: O Nanak, eternal bliss fills the home of the Lord's devotees. ||4||3||

802.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਯਾਨੜੀਏ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਗਾਵਣਾ
802.t: raag bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ghar doojaa yaanaRe'e kai ghar gaavanaa
802.e: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla, Second House, To Be Sung To The Tune Of Yaan-Ree-Ay:

802.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
802.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
802.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

802.g: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ ॥
802.t: mai man teree Tek mere piaare mai man teree Tek ||
802.e: You are the Support of my mind, O my Beloved, You are the Support of my mind.

802.g: ਅਵਰ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਬਿਰਥੀਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਾਖਨ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਏਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
802.t: avar siaanapaa biratheeaa piaare raakhan kau tum ek ||1|| rahaau ||
802.e: All other clever tricks are useless, O Beloved; You alone are my Protector. ||1||Pause||

802.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥
802.t: satigur pooraa je milai piaare so jan hot nihaalaa ||
802.e: One who meets with the Perfect True Guru, O Beloved, that humble person is enraptured.

802.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
802.t: gur kee sevaa so kare piaare jis no hoi dhiaalaa ||
802.e: He alone serves the Guru, O Beloved, unto whom the Lord becomes merciful.

802.g: ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
802.t: safal moorat gurdheau suaamee sarab kalaa bharapoore ||
802.e: Fruitful is the form of the Divine Guru, O Lord and Master; He is overflowing with all powers.

802.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰੇ ॥੧॥
802.t: naanak gur paarabraham paramesar sadhaa sadhaa hajoore ||1||
802.e: O Nanak, the Guru is the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord; He is ever-present, forever and ever. ||1||

802.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਸੋਇ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
802.t: sun sun jeevaa soi tinaa kee jin(h) apunaa prabh jaataa ||
802.e: I live by hearing, hearing of those who know their God.

802.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
802.t: har naam araadheh naam vakhaaneh har naame hee man raataa ||
802.e: They contemplate the Lord's Name, they chant the Lord's Name, and their minds are imbued with the Lord's Name.

802.g: ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਮਾਗੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਕਮਾਵਾ ॥
802.t: sevak jan kee sevaa maagai poorai karam kamaavaa ||
802.e: I am Your servant; I beg to serve Your humble servants. By the karma of perfect destiny, I do this.

802.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਦੇਖਣੁ ਪਾਵਾ ॥੨॥
802.t: naanak kee bena(n)tee suaamee tere jan dhekhan paavaa ||2||
802.e: This is Nanak's prayer: O my Lord and Master, may I obtain the Blessed Vision of Your humble servants. ||2||

802.g: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸੇ ਕਾਢੀਅਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਿਨਾ ਵਾਸੋ ॥
802.t: vaddabhaagee se kaadde'eeh piaare sa(n)tasa(n)gat jinaa vaaso ||
802.e: They are said to be very fortunate, O Beloved, who dwell in the Society of the Saints.

802.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧੀਐ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਨੈ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਗਾਸੋ ॥
802.t: a(n)mirat naam araadheeaai niramal manai hovai paragaaso ||
802.e: They contemplate the Immaculate, Ambrosial Naam, and their minds are illuminated.

802.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਚੂਕੈ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਕਾਣੇ ॥
802.t: janam maran dhukh kaaTeeaai piaare chookai jam kee kaane ||
802.e: The pains of birth and death are eradicated, O Beloved, and the fear of the Messenger of Death is ended.

802.g: ਤਿਨਾ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਣੇ ਭਾਣੇ ॥੩॥
802.t: tinaa paraapat dharasan naanak jo prabh apane bhaane ||3||
802.e: They alone obtain the Blessed Vision of this Darshan, O Nanak, who are pleasing to their God. ||3||

802.g: ਊਚ ਅਪਾਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
802.t: uooch apaar bea(n)t suaamee kaun jaanai gun tere ||
802.e: O my lofty, incomparable and infinite Lord and Master, who can know Your Glorious Virtues?

802.g: ਗਾਵਤੇ ਉਧਰਹਿ ਸੁਣਤੇ ਉਧਰਹਿ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਪਾਪ ਘਨੇਰੇ ॥
802.t: gaavate udhareh sunate udhareh binaseh paap ghanere ||
802.e: Those who sing them are saved, and those who listen to them are saved; all their sins are erased.

802.g: ਪਸੂ ਪਰੇਤ ਮੁਗਧ ਕਉ ਤਾਰੇ ਪਾਹਨ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੈ ॥
802.t: pasoo paret mugadh kau taare paahan paar utaarai ||
802.e: You save the beasts, demons and fools, and even stones are carried across.

802.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
802.t: naanak dhaas teree saranaiee sadhaa sadhaa balihaarai ||4||1||4||
802.e: Slave Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary; he is forever and ever a sacrifice to You. ||4||1||4||

802.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
802.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
802.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

802.g: ਬਿਖੈ ਬਨੁ ਫੀਕਾ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਰੀ ਸਖੀਏ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਓ ॥
802.t: bikhai ban feekaa tiaag ree sakhe'ee naam mahaa ras peeo ||
802.e: Renounce the tasteless water of corruption, O my companion, and drink in the supreme nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

802.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਰਸ ਚਾਖੇ ਬੁਡਿ ਗਈ ਸਗਲੀ ਸੁਖੀ ਨ ਹੋਵਤ ਜੀਓ ॥
802.t: bin ras chaakhe budd giee sagalee sukhee na hovat jeeo ||
802.e: Without the taste of this nectar, all have drowned, and their souls have not found happiness.

802.g: ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਨ ਸਕਤਿ ਹੀ ਕਾਈ ਸਾਧਾ ਦਾਸੀ ਥੀਓ ॥
802.t: maan mahat na sakat hee kaiee saadhaa dhaasee theeo ||
802.e: You have no honor, glory or power - become the slave of the Holy Saints.

803.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੇ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਕੀਓ ॥੧॥
803.t: naanak se dhar sobhaava(n)te jo prabh apunai keeo ||1||
803.e: O Nanak, they alone look beautiful in the Court of the Lord, whom the Lord has made His Own. ||1||

803.g: ਹਰਿਚੰਦਉਰੀ ਚਿਤ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਸਖੀਏ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
803.t: haricha(n)dhauree chit bhram sakhe'ee mirag tirasanaa dhrum chhaiaa ||
803.e: Maya is a mirage, which deludes the mind, O my companion, like the scent-crazed deer, or the transitory shade of a tree.

803.g: ਚੰਚਲਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲਤੀ ਸਖੀਏ ਅੰਤਿ ਤਜਿ ਜਾਵਤ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
803.t: cha(n)chal sa(n)g na chaalatee sakhe'ee a(n)t taj jaavat maiaa ||
803.e: Maya is fickle, and does not go with you, O my companion; in the end, it will leave you.

803.g: ਰਸਿ ਭੋਗਣ ਅਤਿ ਰੂਪ ਰਸ ਮਾਤੇ ਇਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੂਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
803.t: ras bhogan at roop ras maate in sa(n)g sookh na paiaa ||
803.e: He may enjoy pleasures and sensual delights with supremely beautiful women, but no one finds peace in this way.

803.g: ਧੰਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਸਖੀਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
803.t: dha(n)n dha(n)n har saadh jan sakhe'ee naanak jinee naam dhiaaiaa ||2||
803.e: Blessed, blessed are the humble, Holy Saints of the Lord, O my companion. O Nanak, they meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

803.g: ਜਾਇ ਬਸਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗਣੀ ਸਖੀਏ ਸੰਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥
803.t: jai basahu vaddabhaaganee sakhe'ee sa(n)taa sa(n)g samaieeaai ||
803.e: Go, O my very fortunate companion: dwell in the Company of the Saints, and merge with the Lord.

803.g: ਤਹ ਦੂਖ ਨ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਰੋਗੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
803.t: teh dhookh na bhookh na rog biaapai charan kamal liv laieeaai ||
803.e: There, neither pain nor hunger nor disease will afflict you; enshrine love for the Lord's Lotus Feet.

803.g: ਤਹ ਜਨਮ ਨ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
803.t: teh janam na maran na aavan jaanaa nihachal saranee paieeaai ||
803.e: There is no birth or death there, no coming or going in reincarnation, when you enter the Sanctuary of the Eternal Lord.

803.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਛੋਹੁ ਨ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੩॥
803.t: prem bichhoh na moh biaapai naanak har ek dhiaaieeaai ||3||
803.e: Love does not end, and attachment does not grip you, O Nanak, when you meditate on the One Lord. ||3||

803.g: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਤੜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
803.t: dhirasaT dhaar man bedhiaa piaare rataRe sahaj subhaae ||
803.e: Bestowing His Glance of Grace, my Beloved has pierced my mind, and I am intuitively attuned to His Love.

803.g: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
803.t: sej suhaavee sa(n)g mil preetam anadh ma(n)gal gun gaae ||
803.e: My bed is embellished, meeting with my Beloved; in ecstasy and bliss, I sing His Glorious Praises.

803.g: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਏ ॥
803.t: sakhee sahelee raam ra(n)g raatee man tan ichh pujaae ||
803.e: O my friends and companions, I am imbued with the Lord's Love; the desires of my mind and body are satisfied.

803.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਅਚਰਜ ਸਿਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੪॥੨॥੫॥
803.t: naanak acharaj acharaj siau miliaa kahanaa kachhoo na jaae ||4||2||5||
803.e: O Nanak, the wonder-struck soul blends with the Wonderful Lord; this state cannot be described. ||4||2||5||

803.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪
803.t: raag bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ghar chauthhaa
803.e: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla, Fourth House:

803.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
803.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
803.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

803.g: ਏਕ ਰੂਪ ਸਗਲੋ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
803.t: ek roop sagalo paasaaraa ||
803.e: The entire Universe is the form of the One Lord.

803.g: ਆਪੇ ਬਨਜੁ ਆਪਿ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
803.t: aape banaj aap biauhaaraa ||1||
803.e: He Himself is the trade, and He Himself is the trader. ||1||

803.g: ਐਸੋ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬਿਰਲੋ ਈ ਪਾਏ ॥
803.t: aaiso giaan biralo iee paae ||
803.e: How rare is that one who is blessed with such spiritual wisdom.

803.g: ਜਤ ਜਤ ਜਾਈਐ ਤਤ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
803.t: jat jat jaieeaai tat dhirasaTaae ||1|| rahaau ||
803.e: Wherever I go, there I see Him. ||1||Pause||

803.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੰਗ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਇਕ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
803.t: anik ra(n)g niragun ik ra(n)gaa ||
803.e: He manifests many forms, while still unmanifest and absolute, and yet He has One Form.

803.g: ਆਪੇ ਜਲੁ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਤਰੰਗਾ ॥੨॥
803.t: aape jal aap hee tara(n)gaa ||2||
803.e: He Himself is the water, and He Himself is the waves. ||2||

803.g: ਆਪ ਹੀ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਆਪਹਿ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
803.t: aap hee ma(n)dhar aapeh sevaa ||
803.e: He Himself is the temple, and He Himself is selfless service.

803.g: ਆਪ ਹੀ ਪੂਜਾਰੀ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੩॥
803.t: aap hee poojaaree aap hee dhevaa ||3||
803.e: He Himself is the worshipper, and He Himself is the idol. ||3||

803.g: ਆਪਹਿ ਜੋਗ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
803.t: aapeh jog aap hee jugataa ||
803.e: He Himself is the Yoga; He Himself is the Way.

803.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੬॥
803.t: naanak ke prabh sadh hee mukataa ||4||1||6||
803.e: Nanak's God is forever liberated. ||4||1||6||

803.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
803.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
803.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

803.g: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਵਨ ਆਪਿ ਸਧਰਨਾ ॥
803.t: aap upaavan aap sadharanaa ||
803.e: He Himself creates, and He Himself supports.

803.g: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਲੈਨਾ ॥੧॥
803.t: aap karaavan dhos na lainaa ||1||
803.e: He Himself causes all to act; He takes no blame Himself. ||1||

803.g: ਆਪਨ ਬਚਨੁ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
803.t: aapan bachan aap hee karanaa ||
803.e: He Himself is the teaching, and He Himself is the teacher.

803.g: ਆਪਨ ਬਿਭਉ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਜਰਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
803.t: aapan bibhau aap hee jaranaa ||1|| rahaau ||
803.e: He Himself is the splendor, and He Himself is the experiencer of it. ||1||Pause||

803.g: ਆਪ ਹੀ ਮਸਟਿ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਬੁਲਨਾ ॥
803.t: aap hee masaT aap hee bulanaa ||
803.e: He Himself is silent, and He Himself is the speaker.

803.g: ਆਪ ਹੀ ਅਛਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਛਲਨਾ ॥੨॥
803.t: aap hee achhal na jaiee chhalanaa ||2||
803.e: He Himself is undeceivable; He cannot be deceived. ||2||

803.g: ਆਪ ਹੀ ਗੁਪਤ ਆਪਿ ਪਰਗਟਨਾ ॥
803.t: aap hee gupat aap paragaTanaa ||
803.e: He Himself is hidden, and He Himself is manifest.

803.g: ਆਪ ਹੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਆਪਿ ਅਲਿਪਨਾ ॥੩॥
803.t: aap hee ghaT ghaT aap alipanaa ||3||
803.e: He Himself is in each and every heart; He Himself is unattached. ||3||

803.g: ਆਪੇ ਅਵਿਗਤੁ ਆਪ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਚਨਾ ॥
803.t: aape avigat aap sa(n)g rachanaa ||
803.e: He Himself is absolute, and He Himself is with the Universe.

803.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਜਚਨਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੭॥
803.t: kahu naanak prabh ke sabh jachanaa ||4||2||7||
803.e: Says Nanak, all are beggars of God. ||4||2||7||

803.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
803.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
803.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

803.g: ਭੂਲੇ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਜਿਨਹਿ ਬਤਾਇਆ ॥
803.t: bhoole maarag jineh bataiaa ||
803.e: He places the one who strays back on the Path;

803.g: ਐਸਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
803.t: aaisaa gur vaddabhaagee paiaa ||1||
803.e: such a Guru is found by great good fortune. ||1||

803.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਮਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਾਰੇ ॥
803.t: simar manaa raam naam chitaare ||
803.e: Meditate, contemplate the Name of the Lord, O mind.

803.g: ਬਸਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
803.t: bas rahe hiradhai gur charan piaare ||1|| rahaau ||
803.e: The Beloved Feet of the Guru abide within my heart. ||1||Pause||

804.g: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
804.t: kaam karodh lobh moh man leenaa ||
804.e: The mind is engrossed in sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment.
Breaking my bonds, the Guru has liberated me. ||2||

804.g: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਕਰਤ ਜਨਮਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਮੂਆ ॥
804.t: dhukh sukh karat janam fun mooaa ||
804.e: Experiencing pain and pleasure, one is born, only to die again.
The Lotus Feet of the Guru bring peace and shelter. ||3||
The world is drowning in the ocean of fire.
O Nanak, holding me by the arm, the True Guru has saved me. ||4||3||8||
Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

804.g: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਸਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
804.t: tan man dhan arapau sabh apanaa ||
804.e: Body, mind, wealth and everything, I surrender to my Lord.

804.g: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਮਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੧॥
804.t: kavan su mat jit har har japanaa ||1||
804.e: What is that wisdom, by which I may come to chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har? ||1||
Nurturing hope, I have come to beg from God.

804.g: ਤੁਮੑ ਪੇਖਤ ਸੋਭਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਆਗਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
804.t: tum(h) pekhat sobhaa merai aagan ||1|| rahaau ||
804.e: Gazing upon You, the courtyard of my heart is embellished. ||1||Pause||
Trying several methods, I reflect deeply upon the Lord.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, this mind is saved. ||2||
I have neither intelligence, wisdom, common sense nor cleverness.
I meet You, only if You lead me to meet You. ||3||
My eyes are content, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan.
Says Nanak, such a life is fruitful and rewarding. ||4||4||9||
Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

804.g: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
804.t: maat pitaa sut saath na maiaa ||
804.e: Mother, father, children and the wealth of Maya, will not go along with you.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all pain is dispelled. ||1||

804.g: ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਆਪੇ ॥
804.t: rav rahiaa prabh sabh meh aape ||
804.e: God Himself is pervading, and permeating all.

804.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
804.t: har jap rasanaa dhukh na viaape ||1|| rahaau ||
804.e: Chant the Name of the Lord with your tongue, and pain will not afflict you. ||1||Pause||
One who is afflicted by the terrible fire of thirst and desire,

804.g: ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਜਾਪਿਆ ॥੨॥
804.t: seetal bhe har har jas jaapiaa ||2||
804.e: becomes cool, chanting the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||
By millions of efforts, peace is not obtained;
the mind is satisfied only by singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||
Please bless me with devotion, O God, O Searcher of hearts.
This is Nanak's prayer, O Lord and Master. ||4||5||10||
Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:
By great good fortune, the Perfect Guru is found.
Meeting with the Holy Saints, meditate on the Name of the Lord. ||1||
O Supreme Lord God, I seek Your Sanctuary.

804.g: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟੈ ਭਜੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
804.t: kilabikh kaaTai bhaj gur ke charanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
804.e: Meditating on the Guru's Feet, sinful mistakes are erased. ||1||Pause||
All other rituals are just worldly affairs;
joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one is saved. ||2||
One may contemplate the Simritees, Shaastras and Vedas,
but only by chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is one saved and carried across. ||3||

804.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
804.t: jan naanak kau prabh kirapaa kareeaai ||
804.e: Have Mercy upon servant Nanak, O God,
and bless him with the dust of the feet of the Holy, that he may be emancipated. ||4||6||11||
Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

804.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਿਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਚੀਨਾ ॥
804.t: gur kaa sabadh ridhe meh cheenaa ||
804.e: I contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad within my heart;
all my hopes and desires are fulfilled. ||1||

804.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲੁ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
804.t: sa(n)t janaa kaa mukh uoojal keenaa ||
804.e: The faces of the humble Saints are radiant and bright;

804.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
804.t: kar kirapaa apunaa naam dheenaa ||1|| rahaau ||
804.e: the Lord has mercifully blessed them with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

804.g: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਤੇ ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
804.t: a(n)dh koop te kar geh leenaa ||
804.e: Holding them by the hand, He has lifted them up out of the deep, dark pit,
and their victory is celebrated throughout the world. ||2||
He elevates and exalts the lowly, and fills the empty.
They receive the supreme, sublime essence of the Ambrosial Naam. ||3||

804.g: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪਾਪ ਜਲਿ ਖੀਨਾ ॥
804.t: man tan niramal paap jal kheenaa ||
804.e: The mind and body are made immaculate and pure, and sins are burnt to ashes.
Says Nanak, God is pleased with me. ||4||7||12||
Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:
All desires are fulfilled, O my friend,

805.e: lovingly centering your consciousness on the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||1||
I am a sacrifice to those who meditate on God.

805.g: ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
805.t: jalan bujhai har har gun gaavat ||1|| rahaau ||
805.e: The fire of desire is quenched, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||
One's life become fruitful and rewarding, by great good fortune.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, enshrine love for the Lord. ||2||

805.g: ਮਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦਾ ॥ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਹੁ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥੩॥
805.t: mat pat dhan sukh sahaj ana(n)dhaa || ik nimakh na visarahu paramaana(n)dhaa ||3||
805.e: Wisdom, honor, wealth, peace and celestial bliss are attained, if one does not forget the Lord of supreme bliss, even for an instant. ||3||

805.g: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਘਨੇਰੀ ॥
805.t: har dharasan kee man piaas ghaneree ||
805.e: My mind is so very thirsty for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.
Prays Nanak, O God, I seek Your Sanctuary. ||4||8||13||
Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:
I am worthless, totally lacking all virtues.
Bless me with Your Mercy, and make me Your Own. ||1||

805.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਪਾਲਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ॥
805.t: meraa man tan har gopaal suhaiaa ||
805.e: My mind and body are embellished by the Lord, the Lord of the World.

805.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
805.t: kar kirapaa prabh ghar meh aaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
805.e: Granting His Mercy, God has come into the home of my heart. ||1||Pause||
He is the Lover and Protector of His devotees, the Destroyer of fear.
Now, I have been carried across the world-ocean. ||2||

805.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਬੇਦਿ ਲੇਖਿਆ ॥
805.t: patit paavan prabh biradh bedh lekhiaa ||
805.e: It is God's Way to purify sinners, say the Vedas.
I have seen the Supreme Lord with my eyes. ||3||
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Lord becomes manifest.
O slave Nanak, all pains are relieved. ||4||9||14||
Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:
Who can know the value of serving You, God?
God is imperishable, invisible and incomprehensible. ||1||
His Glorious Virtues are infinite; God is profound and unfathomable.
The Mansion of God, my Lord and Master, is lofty and high.
You are unlimited, O my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||
There is no other than the One Lord.
You alone know Your worship and adoration. ||2||
No one can do anything by himself, O Siblings of Destiny.

805.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
805.t: jis prabh dhevai so naam paiee ||3||
805.e: He alone obtains the Naam, the Name of the Lord, unto whom God bestows it. ||3||

805.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
805.t: kahu naanak jo jan prabh bhaiaa ||
805.e: Says Nanak, that humble being who pleases God,

805.g: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੧੫॥
805.t: gun nidhaan prabh tin hee paiaa ||4||10||15||
805.e: he alone finds God, the treasure of virtue. ||4||10||15||
Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

805.g: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਹਾਥ ਦੇ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
805.t: maat garabh meh haath dhe raakhiaa ||
805.e: Extending His Hand, the Lord protected you in your mother's womb.

805.g: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥੧॥
805.t: har ras chhodd bikhiaa fal chaakhiaa ||1||
805.e: Renouncing the sublime essence of the Lord, you have tasted the fruit of poison. ||1||
Meditate, vibrate on the Lord of the Universe, and renounce all entanglements.

805.g: ਜਬ ਜਮੁ ਆਇ ਸੰਘਾਰੈ ਮੂੜੇ ਤਬ ਤਨੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਬੇਹਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
805.t: jab jam aai sa(n)ghaarai mooRe tab tan binas jai behaal ||1|| rahaau ||
805.e: When the Messenger of Death comes to murder you, O fool, then your body will be shattered and helplessly crumble. ||1||Pause||

805.g: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਪਿਆ ॥
805.t: tan man dhan apanaa kar thaapiaa ||
805.e: You hold onto your body, mind and wealth as your own,
and you do not meditate on the Creator Lord, even for an instant. ||2||
You have fallen into the deep, dark pit of great attachment.
Caught in the illusion of Maya, you have forgotten the Supreme Lord. ||3||
By great good fortune, one sings the Kirtan of God's Praises.
In the Society of the Saints, Nanak has found God. ||4||11||16||
Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:
Mother, father, children, relatives and siblings
- O Nanak, the Supreme Lord is our help and support. ||1||
He blesses us with peace, and abundant celestial bliss.

805.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਅਨਿਕ ਗੁਣਾ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਜਾਹਿ ਨ ਗਣੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
805.t: gur pooraa pooree jaa kee baanee anik gunaa jaa ke jaeh na gane ||1|| rahaau ||
805.e: Perfect is the Bani, the Word of the Perfect Guru. His Virtues are so many, they cannot be counted. ||1||Pause||
God Himself makes all arrangements.
Meditating on God, desires are fulfilled. ||2||

805.g: ਅਰਥ ਧਰਮ ਕਾਮ ਮੋਖ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
805.t: arath dharam kaam mokh kaa dhaataa ||
805.e: He is the Giver of wealth, Dharmic faith, pleasure and liberation.

806.e: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Creator Lord, the Architect of Destiny, I am fulfilled. ||3||
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak enjoys the Lord's Love.
He has returned home, with the Perfect Guru. ||4||12||17||
Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:
All treasures come from the Perfect Divine Guru. ||1||Pause||

806.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਨਰ ਜੀਵੇ ॥
806.t: har har naam japat nar jeeve ||
806.e: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the man lives.
The faithless cynic dies in shame and misery. ||1||
The Name of the Lord has become my Protector.
The wretched, faithless cynic makes only useless efforts. ||2||
Spreading slander, many have been ruined.
Their necks, heads and feet are tied by death's noose. ||3||
Says Nanak, the humble devotees chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

806.g: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਮ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੧੮॥
806.t: taa ke nikaT na aavai jaam ||4||13||18||
806.e: The Messenger of Death does not even approach them. ||4||13||18||

806.t: raag bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ghar chauthhaa dhupadhe
806.e: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla, Fourth House, Dho-Padhay:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
What blessed destiny will lead me to meet my God?

806.g: ਪਲੁ ਪਲੁ ਨਿਮਖ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੇ ॥੧॥
806.t: pal pal nimakh sadhaa har japane ||1||
806.e: Each and every moment and instant, I continually meditate on the Lord. ||1||

806.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥
806.t: charan kamal prabh ke nit dhiaavau ||
806.e: I meditate continually on the Lotus Feet of God.

806.g: ਕਵਨ ਸੁ ਮਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
806.t: kavan su mat jit preetam paavau ||1|| rahaau ||
806.e: What wisdom will lead me to attain my Beloved? ||1||Pause||
Please, bless me with such Mercy, O my God,

806.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਬੇਰੇ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੯॥
806.t: har naanak bisar na kaahoo bere ||2||1||19||
806.e: that Nanak may never, ever forget You. ||2||1||19||
Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:
Within my heart, I meditate on the Lotus Feet of God.
Disease is gone, and I have found total peace. ||1||
The Guru relieved my sufferings, and blessed me with the gift.
My birth has been rendered fruitful, and my life is approved. ||1||Pause||
The Ambrosial Bani of God's Word is the Unspoken Speech.
Says Nanak, the spiritually wise live by meditating on God. ||2||2||20||
Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:
The Guru, the Perfect True Guru, has blessed me with peace and tranquility.

806.g: ਸੁਖ ਉਪਜੇ ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
806.t: sukh upaje baaje anahadh toore ||1|| rahaau ||
806.e: Peace and joy have welled up, and the mystical trumpets of the unstruck sound current vibrate. ||1||Pause||
Sufferings, sins and afflictions have been dispelled.
Remembering the Lord in meditation, all sinful mistakes have been erased. ||1||
Joining together, O beautiful soul-brides, celebrate and make merry.
Guru Nanak has saved my honor. ||2||3||21||
Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

806.g: ਮਮਤਾ ਮੋਹ ਧ੍ਰੋਹ ਮਦਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਬੰਧਨਿ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਅਤਿ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥
806.t: mamataa moh dhroh madh maataa ba(n)dhan baadhiaa at bikaraal ||
806.e: Intoxicated with the wine of attachment, love of worldly possessions and deceit, and bound in bondage, he is wild and hideous.

806.g: ਦਿਨੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਛਿਜਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਕਰਤ ਅਉਧ ਫਾਹੀ ਫਾਥਾ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਜਾਲ ॥੧॥
806.t: dhin dhin chhijat bikaar karat aaudh faahee faathaa jam kai jaal ||1||
806.e: Day by day, his life is winding down; practicing sin and corruption, he is trapped by the noose of Death. ||1||
I seek Your Sanctuary, O God, Merciful to the meek.

806.g: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਮ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ਉਧਰਹੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਵਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
806.t: mahaa bikham saagar at bhaaree udharahu saadhoo sa(n)g ravaalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
806.e: I have crossed over the terrible, treacherous, enormous world-ocean, with the dust of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

806.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਮਾਲ ॥
806.t: prabh sukhadhaate samarath suaamee jeeau pi(n)dd sabh tumaraa maal ||
806.e: O God, Giver of peace, All-powerful Lord and Master, my soul, body and all wealth are Yours.

806.g: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਹੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਦਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥੨॥੪॥੨੨॥
806.t: bhram ke ba(n)dhan kaaTahu paramesar naanak ke prabh sadhaa kirapaal ||2||4||22||
806.e: Please, break my bonds of doubt, O Transcendent Lord, forever Merciful God of Nanak. ||2||4||22||
Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

806.g: ਸਗਲ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਕੀਆ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਅਪਣਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿਆ ॥
806.t: sagal ana(n)dh keeaa paramesar apanaa biradh sam(h)aariaa ||
806.e: The Transcendent Lord has brought bliss to all; He has confirmed His Natural Way.

806.g: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਹੋਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ਬਿਗਸੇ ਸਭਿ ਪਰਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
806.t: saadh janaa hoe kirapaalaa bigase sabh paravaariaa ||1||
806.e: He has become Merciful to the humble, holy Saints, and all my relatives blossom forth in joy. ||1||
The True Guru Himself has resolved my affairs.

807.g: ਵਡੀ ਆਰਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਸੂਖ ਮੰਗਲ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
807.t: vaddee aarajaa har gobi(n)dh kee sookh ma(n)gal kaliaan beechaariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
807.e: He has blessed Hargobind with long life, and taken care of my comfort, happiness and well-being. ||1||Pause||

807.g: ਵਣ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਏ ਸਗਲੇ ਜੀਅ ਸਾਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
807.t: van tiran tirabhavan hariaa hoe sagale jeea saadhaariaa ||
807.e: The forests, meadows and the three worlds have blossomed forth in greenery; He gives His Support to all beings.

807.g: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਰਿਆ ॥੨॥੫॥੨੩॥
807.t: man ichhe naanak fal paae pooran ichh pujaariaa ||2||5||23||
807.e: Nanak has obtained the fruits of his mind's desires; his desires are totally fulfilled. ||2||5||23||

807.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
807.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
807.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

807.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਹੋਵਤ ਦਇਆਲੁ ॥
807.t: jis uoopar hovat dhiaal ||
807.e: One who is blessed by the Lord's Mercy,

807.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਾਟੈ ਸੋ ਕਾਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
807.t: har simarat kaaTai so kaal ||1|| rahaau ||
807.e: passes his time in contemplative meditation. ||1||Pause||

807.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਭਜੀਐ ਗੋਪਾਲੁ ॥
807.t: saadhasa(n)g bhajeeaai gopaal ||
807.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate, and vibrate upon the Lord of the Universe.

807.g: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਤੂਟੈ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
807.t: gun gaavat tooTai jam jaal ||1||
807.e: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the noose of death is cut away. ||1||

807.g: ਆਪੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
807.t: aape satigur aape pratipaal ||
807.e: He Himself is the True Guru, and He Himself is the Cherisher.

807.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਸਾਧ ਰਵਾਲ ॥੨॥੬॥੨੪॥
807.t: naanak jaachai saadh ravaal ||2||6||24||
807.e: Nanak begs for the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||2||6||24||

807.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
807.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
807.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

807.g: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਿੰਚਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
807.t: man meh si(n)chahu har har naam ||
807.e: Irrigate your mind with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

807.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਮ ॥੧॥
807.t: anadhin keeratan har gun gaam ||1||
807.e: Night and day, sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||1||

807.g: ਐਸੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
807.t: aaisee preet karahu man mere ||
807.e: Enshrine such love, O my mind,

807.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਨੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
807.t: aaTh pahar prabh jaanahu nere ||1|| rahaau ||
807.e: that twenty-four hours a day, God will seem near to you. ||1||Pause||

807.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਭਾਗ ॥
807.t: kahu naanak jaa ke niramal bhaag ||
807.e: Says Nanak, one who has such immaculate destiny

807.g: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗ ॥੨॥੭॥੨੫॥
807.t: har charanee taa kaa man laag ||2||7||25||
807.e: - his mind is attached to the Lord's Feet. ||2||7||25||

807.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
807.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
807.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

807.g: ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
807.t: rog giaa prabh aap gavaiaa ||
807.e: The disease is gone; God Himself took it away.

807.g: ਨੀਦ ਪਈ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਘਰੁ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
807.t: needh piee sukh sahaj ghar aaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
807.e: I sleep in peace; peaceful poise has come to my home. ||1||Pause||

807.g: ਰਜਿ ਰਜਿ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
807.t: raj raj bhojan khaavahu mere bhaiee ||
807.e: Eat to your fill, O my Siblings of Destiny.

807.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
807.t: a(n)mirat naam ridh maeh dhiaaiee ||1||
807.e: Meditate on the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, within your heart. ||1||

807.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥
807.t: naanak gur poore saranaiee ||
807.e: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Perfect Guru,

807.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਅਪਨੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੨॥੮॥੨੬॥
807.t: jin apane naam kee paij rakhaiee ||2||8||26||
807.e: who has preserved the honor of His Name. ||2||8||26||

807.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
807.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
807.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

807.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੇ ਅਸਥਿਰ ਘਰ ਬਾਰ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
807.t: satigur kar dheene asathir ghar baar || rahaau ||
807.e: The True Guru has protected my hearth and home, and made them permanent. ||Pause||

807.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦ ਕਰੈ ਇਨ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਨ ਕੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਹੀ ਮਾਰੈ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
807.t: jo jo ni(n)dh karai in girahan kee tis aagai hee maarai karataar ||1||
807.e: Whoever slanders these homes, is pre-destined by the Creator Lord to be destroyed. ||1||

807.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾਈ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਖੰਡ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੨॥੯॥੨੭॥
807.t: naanak dhaas taa kee saranaiee jaa ko sabadh akha(n)dd apaar ||2||9||27||
807.e: Slave Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God; the Word of His Shabad is unbreakable and infinite. ||2||9||27||

807.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
807.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
807.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

807.g: ਤਾਪ ਸੰਤਾਪ ਸਗਲੇ ਗਏ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਤੇ ਰੋਗ ॥
807.t: taap sa(n)taap sagale ge binase te rog ||
807.e: The fever and sickness are gone, and the diseases are all dispelled.

807.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਤੂ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਸੰਤਨ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
807.t: paarabraham too bakhasiaa sa(n)tan ras bhog || rahaau ||
807.e: The Supreme Lord God has forgiven you, so enjoy the happiness of the Saints. ||Pause||

807.g: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਮੰਡਲੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਆਰੋਗ ॥
807.t: sarab sukhaa teree ma(n)ddalee teraa man tan aarog ||
807.e: All joys have entered your world, and your mind and body are free of disease.

807.g: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਇਹ ਅਵਖਦ ਜੋਗ ॥੧॥
807.t: gun gaavahu nit raam ke ieh avakhadh jog ||1||
807.e: So chant continuously the Glorious Praises of the Lord; this is the only potent medicine. ||1||

807.g: ਆਇ ਬਸਹੁ ਘਰ ਦੇਸ ਮਹਿ ਇਹ ਭਲੇ ਸੰਜੋਗ ॥
807.t: aai basahu ghar dhes meh ieh bhale sa(n)jog ||
807.e: So come, and dwell in your home and native land; this is such a blessed and auspicious occasion.

807.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਲਹਿ ਗਏ ਬਿਓਗ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੨੮॥
807.t: naanak prabh suprasa(n)n bhe leh ge biog ||2||10||28||
807.e: O Nanak, God is totally pleased with you; your time of separation has come to an end. ||2||10||28||

807.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
807.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
807.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

807.g: ਕਾਹੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲਹੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
807.t: kaahoo sa(n)g na chaalahee maiaa ja(n)jaal ||
807.e: The entanglements of Maya do not go along with anyone.

807.g: ਊਠਿ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਖਿਆਲ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
807.t: uooTh sidhaare chhatrapat sa(n)tan kai khiaal || rahaau ||
807.e: Even kings and rulers must arise and depart, according to the wisdom of the Saints. ||Pause||

807.g: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਕਉ ਬਿਨਸਨਾ ਇਹ ਧੁਰ ਕੀ ਢਾਲ ॥
807.t: aha(n)budh kau binasanaa ieh dhur kee ddaal ||
807.e: Pride goes before the fall - this is a primal law.

807.g: ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ॥੧॥
807.t: bahu jonee janameh mareh bikhiaa bikaraal ||1||
807.e: Those who practice corruption and sin, are born into countless incarnations, only to die again. ||1||

807.g: ਸਤਿ ਬਚਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਕਹਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਜਪਹਿ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
807.t: sat bachan saadhoo kaheh nit japeh gupaal ||
807.e: The Holy Saints chant Words of Truth; they meditate continually on the Lord of the Universe.

807.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ਲਾਲ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੨੯॥
807.t: simar simar naanak tare har ke ra(n)g laal ||2||11||29||
807.e: Meditating, meditating in remembrance, O Nanak, those who are imbued with the color of the Lord's Love are carried across. ||2||11||29||

807.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
807.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
807.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

807.g: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਸੂਖ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨ ॥
807.t: sahaj samaadh ana(n)dh sookh poore gur dheen ||
807.e: The Perfect Guru has blessed me with celestial Samaadhi, bliss and peace.

807.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਗੁਣ ਚੀਨ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
807.t: sadhaa sahaiee sa(n)g prabh a(n)mirat gun cheen || rahaau ||
807.e: God is always my Helper and Companion; I contemplate His Ambrosial Virtues. ||Pause||

808.g: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਜਗਤ੍ਰ ਮਹਿ ਲੋਚਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਆ ॥
808.t: jai jai kaar jagatr meh locheh sabh jeeaa ||
808.e: Triumphant cheers greet me all across the world, and all beings yearn for me.

808.g: ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਛੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥
808.t: suprasa(n)n bhe satigur prabhoo kachh bighan na theeaa ||1||
808.e: The True Guru and God are totally pleased with me; no obstacle blocks my way. ||1||

808.g: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਸਭ ਦਾਸ ॥
808.t: jaa kaa a(n)g dhiaal prabh taa ke sabh dhaas ||
808.e: One who has the Merciful Lord God on his side - everyone becomes his slave.

808.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੩੦॥
808.t: sadhaa sadhaa vaddiaaieeaa naanak gur paas ||2||12||30||
808.e: Forever and ever, O Nanak, glorious greatness rests with the Guru. ||2||12||30||

808.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ
808.t: raag bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ghar panjavaa chaupadhe
808.e: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla, Fifth House, Chau-Padhay:

808.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
808.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
808.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

808.g: ਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਜਗੁ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲੂ ਘਰ ਬਾਰ ॥
808.t: mirat ma(n)ddal jag saajiaa jiau baaloo ghar baar ||
808.e: This perishable realm and world has been made like a house of sand.

808.g: ਬਿਨਸਤ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ ਜਿਉ ਕਾਗਦ ਬੂੰਦਾਰ ॥੧॥
808.t: binasat baar na laagiee jiau kaagadh boo(n)dhaar ||1||
808.e: In no time at all, it is destroyed, like the paper drenched with water. ||1||

808.g: ਸੁਨਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਤਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
808.t: sun meree manasaa manai maeh sat dhekh beechaar ||
808.e: Listen to me, people: behold, and consider this within your mind.

808.g: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਜਿ ਗਏ ਘਰ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
808.t: sidh saadhik girahee jogee taj ge ghar baar ||1|| rahaau ||
808.e: The Siddhas, the seekers, house-holders and Yogis have forsaken their homes and left. ||1||Pause||

808.g: ਜੈਸਾ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਰੈਨਿ ਕਾ ਤੈਸਾ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥
808.t: jaisaa supanaa rain kaa taisaa sa(n)saar ||
808.e: This world is like a dream in the night.

808.g: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿਮਾਨ ਸਭੁ ਬਿਨਸੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਲਗਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੨॥
808.t: dhirasaTimaan sabh binaseeaai kiaa lageh gavaar ||2||
808.e: All that is seen shall perish. Why are you attached to it, you fool? ||2||

808.g: ਕਹਾ ਸੁ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ਹੈ ਦੇਖੁ ਨੈਨ ਪਸਾਰਿ ॥
808.t: kahaa su bhaiee meet hai dhekh nain pasaar ||
808.e: Where are your brothers and friends? Open your eyes and see!

808.g: ਇਕਿ ਚਾਲੇ ਇਕਿ ਚਾਲਸਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਵਾਰ ॥੩॥
808.t: eik chaale ik chaalaseh sabh apanee vaar ||3||
808.e: Some have gone, and some will go; everyone must take his turn. ||3||

808.g: ਜਿਨ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸੇ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
808.t: jin pooraa satigur seviaa se asathir har dhuaar ||
808.e: Those who serve the Perfect True Guru, remain ever-stable at the Door of the Lord.

808.g: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਰਾਖੁ ਪੈਜ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੧॥
808.t: jan naanak har kaa dhaas hai raakh paij muraar ||4||1||31||
808.e: Servant Nanak is the Lord's slave; preserve his honor, O Lord, Destroyer of ego. ||4||1||31||

808.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
808.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
808.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

808.g: ਲੋਕਨ ਕੀਆ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਗਉ ॥
808.t: lokan keeaa vaddiaaieeaa baisa(n)tar paagau ||
808.e: The glories of the world, I cast into the fire.

808.g: ਜਿਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਪਨਾ ਤੇ ਬੋਲ ਕਰਾਗਉ ॥੧॥
808.t: jiau milai piaaraa aapanaa te bol karaagau ||1||
808.e: I chant those words, by which I may meet my Beloved. ||1||

808.g: ਜਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਇ ਤਉ ਭਗਤੀ ਲਾਗਉ ॥
808.t: jau prabh jeeau dhiaal hoi tau bhagatee laagau ||
808.e: When God becomes Merciful, then He enjoins me to His devotional service.

808.g: ਲਪਟਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਮਨੁ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਇਹ ਤਿਆਗਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
808.t: lapaT rahio man baasanaa gur mil ieh tiaagau ||1|| rahaau ||
808.e: My mind clings to worldly desires; meeting with the Guru, I have renounced them. ||1||Pause||

808.g: ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਅਤਿ ਘਨੀ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਹੋਮਾਗਉ ॥
808.t: karau benatee at ghanee ih jeeau homaagau ||
808.e: I pray with intense devotion, and offer this soul to Him.

808.g: ਅਰਥ ਆਨ ਸਭਿ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਨਿਮਖ ਸੋਹਾਗਉ ॥੨॥
808.t: arath aan sabh vaariaa pria nimakh sohaagau ||2||
808.e: I would sacrifice all other riches, for a moment's union with my Beloved. ||2||

808.g: ਪੰਚ ਸੰਗੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੇ ਦੋਖ ਅਰੁ ਰਾਗਉ ॥
808.t: pa(n)ch sa(n)g gur te chhuTe dhokh ar raagau ||
808.e: Through the Guru, I am rid of the five villains, as well as emotional love and hate.

808.g: ਰਿਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਇਆ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਜਾਗਉ ॥੩॥
808.t: ridhai pragaas pragaT bhiaa nis baasur jaagau ||3||
808.e: My heart is illumined, and the Lord has become manifest; night and day, I remain awake and aware. ||3||

808.g: ਸਰਣਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ ਆਇਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗਉ ॥
808.t: saran sohaagan aaiaa jis masatak bhaagau ||
808.e: The blessed soul-bride seeks His Sanctuary; her destiny is recorded on her forehead.

808.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲਾਗਉ ॥੪॥੨॥੩੨॥
808.t: kahu naanak tin paiaa tan man seetalaagau ||4||2||32||
808.e: Says Nanak, she obtains her Husband Lord; her body and mind are cooled and soothed. ||4||2||32||

808.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
808.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
808.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

808.g: ਲਾਲ ਰੰਗੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਲਗਾ ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ॥
808.t: laal ra(n)g tis kau lagaa jis ke vaddabhaagaa ||
808.e: One is dyed in the color of the Lord's Love, by great good fortune.

808.g: ਮੈਲਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਹ ਲਾਗੈ ਦਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
808.t: mailaa kadhe na hoviee neh laagai dhaagaa ||1||
808.e: This color is never muddied; no stain ever sticks to it. ||1||

808.g: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਈਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖ ਭਾਇ ॥
808.t: prabh paiaa sukhadhaieeaa miliaa sukh bhai ||
808.e: He finds God, the Giver of peace, with feelings of joy.

808.g: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ਭੀਤਰੇ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਨਹ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
808.t: sahaj samaanaa bheetare chhoddiaa neh jai ||1|| rahaau ||
808.e: The Celestial Lord blends into his soul, and he can never leave Him. ||1||Pause||

808.g: ਜਰਾ ਮਰਾ ਨਹ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
808.t: jaraa maraa neh viaapiee fir dhookh na paiaa ||
808.e: Old age and death cannot touch him, and he shall not suffer pain again.

808.g: ਪੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਆਘਾਨਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਮਰੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
808.t: pee a(n)mrit aaghaaniaa gur amar karaiaa ||2||
808.e: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, he is satisfied; the Guru makes him immortal. ||2||

808.g: ਸੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਾ ॥
808.t: so jaanai jin chaakhiaa har naam amolaa ||
808.e: He alone knows its taste, who tastes the Priceless Name of the Lord.

808.g: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈਐ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਾ ॥੩॥
808.t: keemat kahee na jaieeaai kiaa keh mukh bolaa ||3||
808.e: Its value cannot be estimated; what can I say with my mouth? ||3||

808.g: ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
808.t: safal dharas teraa paarabraham gun nidh teree baanee ||
808.e: Fruitful is the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Supreme Lord God. The Word of Your Bani is the treasure of virtue.

809.g: ਪਾਵਉ ਧੂਰਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੩॥੩੩॥
809.t: paavau dhoor tere dhaas kee naanak kurabaanee ||4||3||33||
809.e: Please bless me with the dust of the feet of Your slaves; Nanak is a sacrifice. ||4||3||33||

809.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
809.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
809.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

809.g: ਰਾਖਹੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
809.t: raakhahu apanee saran prabh moh kirapaa dhaare ||
809.e: Keep me under Your Protection, God; shower me with Your Mercy.

809.g: ਸੇਵਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਊ ਨੀਚੁ ਮੂਰਖਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
809.t: sevaa kachhoo na jaanuoo neech moorakhaare ||1||
809.e: I do not know how to serve You; I am just a low-life fool. ||1||

809.g: ਮਾਨੁ ਕਰਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਊਪਰੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
809.t: maan karau tudh uoopare mere preetam piaare ||
809.e: I take pride in You, O my Darling Beloved.

809.g: ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਸਦ ਭੂਲਤੇ ਤੁਮੑ ਬਖਸਨਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
809.t: ham aparaadhee sadh bhoolate tum(h) bakhasanahaare ||1|| rahaau ||
809.e: I am a sinner, continuously making mistakes; You are the Forgiving Lord. ||1||Pause||

809.g: ਹਮ ਅਵਗਨ ਕਰਹ ਅਸੰਖ ਨੀਤਿ ਤੁਮੑ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਦਾਤਾਰੇ ॥
809.t: ham avagan kareh asa(n)kh neet tum(h) niragun dhaataare ||
809.e: I make mistakes each and every day. You are the Great Giver;

809.g: ਦਾਸੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਏ ਕਰਮ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
809.t: dhaasee sa(n)gat prabhoo tiaag e karam hamaare ||2||
809.e: I am worthless. I associate with Maya, your hand-maiden, and I renounce You, God; such are my actions. ||2||

809.g: ਤੁਮੑ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ਹਮ ਅਕਿਰਤਘਨਾਰੇ ॥
809.t: tum(h) dhevahu sabh kichh dhiaa dhaar ham akirataghanaare ||
809.e: You bless me with everything, showering me with Mercy; And I am such an ungrateful wretch!

809.g: ਲਾਗਿ ਪਰੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਨ ਸਿਉ ਨਹ ਚਿਤਿ ਖਸਮਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
809.t: laag pare tere dhaan siau neh chit khasamaare ||3||
809.e: I am attached to Your gifts, but I do not even think of You, O my Lord and Master. ||3||

809.g: ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਭਵ ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
809.t: tujh te baahar kichh nahee bhav kaaTanahaare ||
809.e: There is none other than You, O Lord, Destroyer of fear.

809.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੁਰ ਲੇਹੁ ਮੁਗਧ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੪॥੩੪॥
809.t: kahu naanak saran dhiaal gur leh mugadh udhaare ||4||4||34||
809.e: Says Nanak, I have come to Your Sanctuary, O Merciful Guru; I am so foolish - please, save me! ||4||4||34||

809.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
809.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
809.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

809.g: ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਦੀਜੀਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
809.t: dhos na kaahoo dheejeeaai prabh apanaa dhiaaieeaai ||
809.e: Don't blame anyone else; meditate on your God.

809.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਘਨਾ ਮਨ ਸੋਈ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
809.t: jit seviaai sukh hoi ghanaa man soiee gaieeaai ||1||
809.e: Serving Him, great peace is obtained; O mind, sing His Praises. ||1||

809.g: ਕਹੀਐ ਕਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੁਝੁ ਬਿਨਾ ॥
809.t: kaheeaai kai piaare tujh binaa ||
809.e: O Beloved, other than You, who else should I ask?

809.g: ਤੁਮੑ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭ ਅਵਗਨ ਹਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
809.t: tum(h) dhiaal suaamee sabh avagan hamaa ||1|| rahaau ||
809.e: You are my Merciful Lord and Master; I am filled with all faults. ||1||Pause||

809.g: ਜਿਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਰਹਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਚਾਰਾ ॥
809.t: jiau tum(h) raakhahu tiau rahaa avar nahee chaaraa ||
809.e: As You keep me, I remain; there is no other way.

809.g: ਨੀਧਰਿਆ ਧਰ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਇਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
809.t: needhariaa dhar tereeaa ik naam adhaaraa ||2||
809.e: You are the Support of the unsupported; You Name is my only Support. ||2||

809.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਮੑ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਭਲਾ ਮਨਿ ਲੇਤਾ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
809.t: jo tum(h) karahu soiee bhalaa man letaa mukataa ||
809.e: One who accepts whatever You do as good - that mind is liberated.

809.g: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥੩॥
809.t: sagal samagree tereeaa sabh teree jugataa ||3||
809.e: The entire creation is Yours; all are subject to Your Ways. ||3||

809.g: ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਰਉ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
809.t: charan pakhaarau kar sevaa je Thaakur bhaavai ||
809.e: I wash Your Feet and serve You, if it pleases You, O Lord and Master.

809.g: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੫॥੩੫॥
809.t: hoh kirapaal dhiaal prabh naanak gun gaavai ||4||5||35||
809.e: Be Merciful, O God of Compassion, that Nanak may sing Your Glorious Praises. ||4||5||35||

809.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
809.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
809.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

809.g: ਮਿਰਤੁ ਹਸੈ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰੇ ਪਸੂਆ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
809.t: mrit hasai sir uoopare pasooaa nahee boojhai ||
809.e: Death hovers over his head, laughing, but the beast does not understand.

809.g: ਬਾਦ ਸਾਦ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਮਰਣਾ ਨਹੀ ਸੂਝੈ ॥੧॥
809.t: baadh saadh aha(n)kaar meh maranaa nahee soojhai ||1||
809.e: Entangled in conflict, pleasure and egotism, he does not even think of death. ||1||

809.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਆਪਨਾ ਕਾਹੇ ਫਿਰਹੁ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥
809.t: satigur sevahu aapanaa kaahe firahu abhaage ||
809.e: So serve your True Guru; why wander around miserable and unfortunate?

809.g: ਦੇਖਿ ਕਸੁੰਭਾ ਰੰਗੁਲਾ ਕਾਹੇ ਭੂਲਿ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
809.t: dhekh kasu(n)bhaa ra(n)gulaa kaahe bhool laage ||1|| rahaau ||
809.e: You gaze upon the transitory, beautiful safflower, but why do you get attached to it? ||1||Pause||

809.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਪ ਦਰਬੁ ਕੀਆ ਵਰਤਣ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
809.t: kar kar paap dharab keeaa varatan kai taiee ||
809.e: You commit sins again and again, to gather wealth to spend.

809.g: ਮਾਟੀ ਸਿਉ ਮਾਟੀ ਰਲੀ ਨਾਗਾ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
809.t: maaTee siau maaTee ralee naagaa uTh jaiee ||2||
809.e: But your dust shall mix with dust; you shall arise and depart naked. ||2||

809.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੀਐ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰੈ ਤੇ ਬੈਰ ਬਿਰੋਧੀ ॥
809.t: jaa kai keeaai sram karai te bair birodhee ||
809.e: Those for whom you work, will become your spiteful enemies.

809.g: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਭਜਿ ਜਾਹਿਗੇ ਕਾਹੇ ਜਲਹੁ ਕਰੋਧੀ ॥੩॥
809.t: a(n)t kaal bhaj jaahige kaahe jalahu karodhee ||3||
809.e: In the end, they will run away from you; why do you burn for them in anger? ||3||

809.g: ਦਾਸ ਰੇਣੁ ਸੋਈ ਹੋਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
809.t: dhaas ren soiee hoaa jis masatak karamaa ||
809.e: He alone becomes the dust of the Lord's slaves, who has such good karma upon his forehead.

809.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੰਧਨ ਛੁਟੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੩੬॥
809.t: kahu naanak ba(n)dhan chhuTe satigur kee saranaa ||4||6||36||
809.e: Says Nanak, he is released from bondage, in the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||4||6||36||

809.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
809.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
809.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

809.g: ਪਿੰਗੁਲ ਪਰਬਤ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੇ ਖਲ ਚਤੁਰ ਬਕੀਤਾ ॥
809.t: pi(n)gul parabat paar pare khal chatur bakeetaa ||
809.e: The cripple crosses over the mountain, the fool becomes a wise man,

809.g: ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੂਝਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਿ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ॥੧॥
809.t: a(n)dhule tirabhavan soojhiaa gur bheT puneetaa ||1||
809.e: and the blind man sees the three worlds, by meeting with the True Guru and being purified. ||1||

809.g: ਮਹਿਮਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ਕੀ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤਾ ॥
809.t: mahimaa saadhoo sa(n)g kee sunahu mere meetaa ||
809.e: This is the Glory of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; listen, O my friends.

809.g: ਮੈਲੁ ਖੋਈ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘ ਹਰੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਭਏ ਚੀਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
809.t: mail khoiee koT agh hare niramal bhe cheetaa ||1|| rahaau ||
809.e: Filth is washed away, millions of sins are dispelled, and the consciousness becomes immaculate and pure. ||1||Pause||

809.g: ਐਸੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਕੀਟਿ ਹਸਤੀ ਜੀਤਾ ॥
809.t: aaisee bhagat govi(n)dh kee keeT hasatee jeetaa ||
809.e: Such is devotional worship of the Lord of the Universe, that the ant can overpower the elephant.

809.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕੀਨੋ ਆਪਨੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਤਾ ॥੨॥
809.t: jo jo keeno aapano tis abhai dhaan dheetaa ||2||
809.e: Whoever the Lord makes His own, is blessed with the gift of fearlessness. ||2||

809.g: ਸਿੰਘੁ ਬਿਲਾਈ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਓ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਮੇਰੁ ਦਿਖੀਤਾ ॥
809.t: si(n)gh bilaiee hoi gio tiran mer dhikheetaa ||
809.e: The lion becomes a cat, and the mountain looks like a blade of grass.

810.g: ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਦਮ ਆਢ ਕਉ ਤੇ ਗਨੀ ਧਨੀਤਾ ॥੩॥
810.t: sram karate dham aadd kau te ganee dhaneetaa ||3||
810.e: Those who worked for half a shell, will be judged very wealthy. ||3||

810.g: ਕਵਨ ਵਡਾਈ ਕਹਿ ਸਕਉ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਨੀਤਾ ॥
810.t: kavan vaddaiee keh sakau bea(n)t guneetaa ||
810.e: What glorious greatness of Yours can I describe, O Lord of infinite excellences?

810.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰ ਸਰੀਤਾ ॥੪॥੭॥੩੭॥
810.t: kar kirapaa moh naam dheh naanak dhar sareetaa ||4||7||37||
810.e: Please bless me with Your Mercy, and grant me Your Name; O Nanak, I am lost without the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||4||7||37||

810.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
810.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
810.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

810.g: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਪਰਬਾਦ ਨੀਤ ਲੋਭ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਾਦਿ ॥
810.t: aha(n)budh parabaadh neet lobh rasanaa saadh ||
810.e: He is constantly entangled in pride, conflict, greed and tasty flavors.

810.g: ਲਪਟਿ ਕਪਟਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਬਿਖਿਆਦਿ ॥੧॥
810.t: lapaT kapaT gireh bedhiaa mithiaa bikhiaadh ||1||
810.e: He is involved in deception, fraud, household affairs and corruption. ||1||

810.g: ਐਸੀ ਪੇਖੀ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਮਹਿ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
810.t: aaisee pekhee netr meh poore gur parasaadh ||
810.e: I have seen this with my eyes, by the Grace of the Perfect Guru.

810.g: ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਖ ਧਨ ਜੋਬਨਾ ਨਾਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਦਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
810.t: raaj milakh dhan jobanaa naamai bin baadh ||1|| rahaau ||
810.e: Power, property, wealth and youth are useless, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

810.g: ਰੂਪ ਧੂਪ ਸੋਗੰਧਤਾ ਕਾਪਰ ਭੋਗਾਦਿ ॥
810.t: roop dhoop soga(n)dhataa kaapar bhogaadh ||
810.e: Beauty, incense, scented oils, beautiful clothes and foods

810.g: ਮਿਲਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਪਿਸਟ ਤਨ ਹੋਏ ਦੁਰਗਾਦਿ ॥੨॥
810.t: milat sa(n)g paapisaT tan hoe dhuragaadh ||2||
810.e: - when they come into contact with the body of the sinner, they stink. ||2||

810.g: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਮਾਨੁਖੁ ਭਇਆ ਖਿਨ ਭੰਗਨ ਦੇਹਾਦਿ ॥
810.t: firat firat maanukh bhiaa khin bha(n)gan dhehaadh ||
810.e: Wandering, wandering around, the soul is reincarnated as a human, but this body lasts only for an instant.

810.g: ਇਹ ਅਉਸਰ ਤੇ ਚੂਕਿਆ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਦਿ ॥੩॥
810.t: eeh aausar te chookiaa bahu jon bhramaadh ||3||
810.e: Losing this opportunity, he must wander again through countless incarnations. ||3||

810.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥
810.t: prabh kirapaa te gur mile har har bisamaadh ||
810.e: By God's Grace, he meets the Guru; contemplating the Lord, Har, Har, he is wonderstruck.

810.g: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨੰਦ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਾਦ ॥੪॥੮॥੩੮॥
810.t: sookh sahaj naanak ana(n)dh taa kai pooran naadh ||4||8||38||
810.e: He is blessed with peace, poise and bliss, O Nanak, through the perfect sound current of the Naad. ||4||8||38||

810.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
810.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
810.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

810.g: ਚਰਨ ਭਏ ਸੰਤ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਤਰੇ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਜੇਤ ॥
810.t: charan bhe sa(n)t bohithaa tare saagar jet ||
810.e: The feet of the Saints are the boat, to cross over the world-ocean.

810.g: ਮਾਰਗ ਪਾਏ ਉਦਿਆਨ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਸੇ ਭੇਤ ॥੧॥
810.t: maarag paae udhiaan meh gur dhase bhet ||1||
810.e: In the wilderness, the Guru places them on the Path, and reveals the secrets of the Lord's Mystery. ||1||

810.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹੇਤ ॥
810.t: har har har har har hare har har har het ||
810.e: O Lord, Har Har Har, Har Har Haray, Har Har Har, I love You.

810.g: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
810.t: uooThat baiThat sovate har har har chet ||1|| rahaau ||
810.e: While standing up, sitting down and sleeping, think of the Lord, Har Har Har. ||1||Pause||

810.g: ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਆਗੈ ਭਗੇ ਜਬ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇਤ ॥
810.t: pa(n)ch chor aagai bhage jab saadhasa(n)get ||
810.e: The five thieves run away, when one joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

810.g: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਘਣੋ ਲਾਭੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੇਤ ॥੨॥
810.t: poo(n)jee saabat ghano laabh gireh sobhaa set ||2||
810.e: His investment is intact, and he earns great profits; his household is blessed with honor. ||2||

810.g: ਨਿਹਚਲ ਆਸਣੁ ਮਿਟੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਡੋਲੇਤ ॥
810.t: nihachal aasan miTee chi(n)t naahee ddolet ||
810.e: His position is unmoving and eternal, his anxiety is ended, and he wavers no more.

810.g: ਭਰਮੁ ਭੁਲਾਵਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੇਖਤ ਨੇਤ ॥੩॥
810.t: bharam bhulaavaa miT giaa prabh pekhat net ||3||
810.e: His doubts and misgivings are dispelled, and he sees God everywhere. ||3||

810.g: ਗੁਣ ਗਭੀਰ ਗੁਨ ਨਾਇਕਾ ਗੁਣ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਕੇਤ ॥
810.t: gun gabheer gun naikaa gun kahe'eeh ket ||
810.e: The Virtues of our Virtuous Lord and Master are so profound; how many of His Glorious Virtues should I speak?

810.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰੇਤ ॥੪॥੯॥੩੯॥
810.t: naanak paiaa saadhasa(n)g har har a(n)mret ||4||9||39||
810.e: Nanak has obtained the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord, Har, Har, in the Company of the Holy. ||4||9||39||

810.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
810.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
810.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

810.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਜੋ ਜੀਵਨਾ ਤੇਤੋ ਬਿਰਥਾਰੀ ॥
810.t: bin saadhoo jo jeevanaa teto birathaaree ||
810.e: That life, which has no contact with the Holy, is useless.

810.g: ਮਿਲਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਭਿ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਮਿਟੇ ਗਤਿ ਭਈ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
810.t: milat sa(n)g sabh bhram miTe gat bhiee hamaaree ||1||
810.e: Joining their congregation, all doubts are dispelled, and I am emancipated. ||1||

810.g: ਜਾ ਦਿਨ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਾਧ ਮੋਹਿ ਉਆ ਦਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
810.t: jaa dhin bheTe saadh moh uaa dhin balihaaree ||
810.e: That day, when I meet with the Holy - I am a sacrifice to that day.

810.g: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਪਨੋ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
810.t: tan man apano jeearaa fir fir hau vaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
810.e: Again and again, I sacrifice my body, mind and soul to them. ||1||Pause||

810.g: ਏਤ ਛਡਾਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਤੇ ਇਤਨੀ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਤਾਰੀ ॥
810.t: et chhaddaiee moh te itanee dhiraRataaree ||
810.e: They have helped me renounce this ego, and implant this humility within myself.

810.g: ਸਗਲ ਰੇਨ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਬਿਨਸੀ ਅਪਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
810.t: sagal ren ih man bhiaa binasee apadhaaree ||2||
810.e: This mind has become the dust of all men's feet, and my self-conceit has been dispelled. ||2||

810.g: ਨਿੰਦ ਚਿੰਦ ਪਰ ਦੂਖਨਾ ਏ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਰੀ ॥
810.t: ni(n)dh chi(n)dh par dhookhanaa e khin meh jaaree ||
810.e: In an instant, I burnt away the ideas of slander and ill-will towards others.

810.g: ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਅਰੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਪੇਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਰਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
810.t: dhiaa miaa ar nikaT pekh naahee dhooraaree ||3||
810.e: I see close at hand, the Lord of mercy and compassion; He is not far away at all. ||3||

810.g: ਤਨ ਮਨ ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ ਅਬ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥
810.t: tan man seetal bhe ab mukate sa(n)saaree ||
810.e: My body and mind are cooled and soothed, and now, I am liberated from the world.

810.g: ਹੀਤ ਚੀਤ ਸਭ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਧਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੪੦॥
810.t: heet cheet sabh praan dhan naanak dharasaaree ||4||10||40||
810.e: Love, consciousness, the breath of life, wealth and everything, O Nanak, are in the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||4||10||40||

810.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
810.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
810.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

810.g: ਟਹਲ ਕਰਉ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਪਗ ਝਾਰਉ ਬਾਲ ॥
810.t: Tahal karau tere dhaas kee pag jhaarau baal ||
810.e: I perform service for Your slave, O Lord, and wipe his feet with my hair.

810.g: ਮਸਤਕੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਭੇਟ ਦੇਉ ਗੁਨ ਸੁਨਉ ਰਸਾਲ ॥੧॥
810.t: masatak apanaa bheT dheau gun sunau rasaal ||1||
810.e: I offer my head to him, and listen to the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the source of bliss. ||1||

810.g: ਤੁਮੑ ਮਿਲਤੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਓ ਤੁਮੑ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
810.t: tum(h) milate meraa man jeeo tum(h) milahu dhiaal ||
810.e: Meeting You, my mind is rejuvenated, so please meet me, O Merciful Lord.

810.g: ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਹੋਤ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
810.t: nis baasur man anadh hot chitavat kirapaal ||1|| rahaau ||
810.e: Night and day, my mind enjoys bliss, contemplating the Lord of Compassion. ||1||Pause||

811.g: ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਸਾਧ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਿਨੑ ਲਾਗਹੁ ਪਾਲ ॥
811.t: jagat udhaaran saadh prabh tin(h) laagahu paal ||
811.e: God's Holy people are the saviors of the world; I grab hold of the hem of their robes.

811.g: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਤਨ ਪਗ ਰਾਲ ॥੨॥
811.t: mo kau dheejai dhaan prabh sa(n)tan pag raal ||2||
811.e: Bless me, O God, with the gift of the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||2||

811.g: ਉਕਤਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਕਛੁ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਘਾਲ ॥
811.t: aukat siaanap kachh nahee naahee kachh ghaal ||
811.e: I have no skill or wisdom at all, nor any work to my credit.

811.g: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮੋਹ ਤੇ ਕਾਟਹੁ ਜਮ ਜਾਲ ॥੩॥
811.t: bhram bhai raakhahu moh te kaaTahu jam jaal ||3||
811.e: Please, protect me from doubt, fear and emotional attachment, and cut away the noose of Death from my neck. ||3||

811.g: ਬਿਨਉ ਕਰਉ ਕਰੁਣਾਪਤੇ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
811.t: binau karau karunaapate pitaa pratipaal ||
811.e: I beg of You, O Lord of Mercy, O my Father, please cherish me!

811.g: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਉ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਲ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੪੧॥
811.t: gun gaavau tere saadhasa(n)g naanak sukh saal ||4||11||41||
811.e: I sing Your Glorious Praises, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O Lord, Home of peace. ||4||11||41||

811.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
811.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
811.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

811.g: ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਸੋ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
811.t: keetaa loReh so kareh tujh bin kachh naeh ||
811.e: Whatever You wish, You do. Without You, there is nothing.

811.g: ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਛਡਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
811.t: parataap tum(h)aaraa dhekh kai jamadhoot chhadd jaeh ||1||
811.e: Gazing upon Your Glory, the Messenger of Death leaves and goes away. ||1||

811.g: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਅਹੰਮੇਵ ॥
811.t: tum(h)ree kirapaa te chhooTeeaai binasai aha(n)mev ||
811.e: By Your Grace, one is emancipated, and egotism is dispelled.

811.g: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਸਮਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
811.t: sarab kalaa samarath prabh poore gurdhev ||1|| rahaau ||
811.e: God is omnipotent, possessing all powers; He is obtained through the Perfect, Divine Guru. ||1||Pause||

811.g: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਿਆ ਨਾਮੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੂਰੁ ॥
811.t: khojat khojat khojiaa naamai bin koor ||
811.e: Searching, searching, searching - without the Naam, everything is false.

811.g: ਜੀਵਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਨਸਾ ਪੂਰੁ ॥੨॥
811.t: jeevan sukh sabh saadhasa(n)g prabh manasaa poor ||2||
811.e: All the comforts of life are found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; God is the Fulfiller of desires. ||2||

811.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਹਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸਭ ਜਾਲੀ ॥
811.t: jit jit laavahu tit tit lageh siaanap sabh jaalee ||
811.e: Whatever You attach me to, to that I am attached; I have burnt away all my cleverness.

811.g: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਤੁਮੑ ਭਰਪੂਰ ਹਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲੀ ॥੩॥
811.t: jat kat tum(h) bharapoor hahu mere dheen dhiaalee ||3||
811.e: You are permeating and pervading everywhere, O my Lord, Merciful to the meek. ||3||

811.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਮਾਗਨਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
811.t: sabh kichh tum te maaganaa vaddabhaagee paae ||
811.e: I ask for everything from You, but only the very fortunate ones obtain it.

811.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਵਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੪੨॥
811.t: naanak kee aradhaas prabh jeevaa gun gaae ||4||12||42||
811.e: This is Nanak's prayer, O God, I live by singing Your Glorious Praises. ||4||12||42||

811.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
811.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
811.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

811.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਬਾਸਬੈ ਕਲਮਲ ਸਭਿ ਨਸਨਾ ॥
811.t: saadhasa(n)gat kai baasabai kalamal sabh nasanaa ||
811.e: Dwelling in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all sins are erased.

811.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਿਆ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਗਰਭਿ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਸਨਾ ॥੧॥
811.t: prabh setee ra(n)g raatiaa taa te garabh na grasanaa ||1||
811.e: One who is attuned to the Love of God, is not cast into the womb of reincarnation. ||1||

811.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਕਹਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਸੂਚੀ ਭਈ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
811.t: naam kahat govi(n)dh kaa soochee bhiee rasanaa ||
811.e: Chanting the Name of the Lord of the Universe, the tongue becomes holy.

811.g: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
811.t: man tan niramal hoiee hai gur kaa jap japanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
811.e: The mind and body become immaculate and pure, chanting the Chant of the Guru. ||1||Pause||

811.g: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਤ ਧ੍ਰਾਪਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਰਸੁ ਲੈ ਹਸਨਾ ॥
811.t: har ras chaakhat dhraapiaa man ras lai hasanaa ||
811.e: Tasting the subtle essence of the Lord, one is satisfied; receiving this essence, the mind becomes happy.

811.g: ਬੁਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਈ ਉਲਟਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸਨਾ ॥੨॥
811.t: budh pragaas pragaT bhiee ulaT kamal bigasanaa ||2||
811.e: The intellect is brightened and illuminated; turning away from the world, the heart-lotus blossoms forth. ||2||

811.g: ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਭ ਬੂਝੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ॥
811.t: seetal saa(n)t sa(n)tokh hoi sabh boojhee tirasanaa ||
811.e: He is cooled and soothed, peaceful and content; all his thirst is quenched.

811.g: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਵਤ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਥਾਨਿ ਬਸਨਾ ॥੩॥
811.t: dheh dhis dhaavat miT ge niramal thaan basanaa ||3||
811.e: The mind's wandering in the ten directions is stopped, and one dwells in the immaculate place. ||3||

811.g: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੈ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਭਏ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭਸਨਾ ॥
811.t: raakhanahaarai raakhiaa bhe bhram bhasanaa ||
811.e: The Savior Lord saves him, and his doubts are burnt to ashes.

811.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਸਾਧ ਦਰਸਨਾ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੪੩॥
811.t: naam nidhaan naanak sukhee pekh saadh dharasanaa ||4||13||43||
811.e: Nanak is blessed with the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. He finds peace, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Saints' Darshan. ||4||13||43||

811.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
811.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
811.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

811.g: ਪਾਣੀ ਪਖਾ ਪੀਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਕੈ ਤਬ ਹੋਹਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
811.t: paanee pakhaa pees dhaas kai tab hoh nihaal ||
811.e: Carry water for the Lord's slave, wave the fan over him, and grind his corn; then, you shall be happy.

811.g: ਰਾਜ ਮਿਲਖ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੀਆ ਅਗਨੀ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਲੁ ॥੧॥
811.t: raaj milakh sikadhaareeaa aganee meh jaal ||1||
811.e: Burn in the fire your power, property and authority. ||1||

811.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਛੋਹਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਿ ॥
811.t: sa(n)t janaa kaa chhoharaa tis charanee laag ||
811.e: Grasp hold of the feet of the servant of the humble Saints.

811.g: ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਤਿਨੑ ਛੋਡਉ ਤਿਆਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
811.t: maiaadhaaree chhatrapat tin(h) chhoddau tiaag ||1|| rahaau ||
811.e: Renounce and abandon the wealthy, the regal overlords and kings. ||1||Pause||

811.g: ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਨਾ ਰੂਖਾ ਸੋ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
811.t: sa(n)tan kaa dhaanaa rookhaa so sarab nidhaan ||
811.e: The dry bread of the Saints is equal to all treasures.

811.g: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਛਤੀਹ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਤੇ ਬਿਖੂ ਸਮਾਨ ॥੨॥
811.t: gireh saakat chhateeh prakaar te bikhoo samaan ||2||
811.e: The thirty-six tasty dishes of the faithless cynic, are just like poison. ||2||

811.g: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਾ ਲੂਗਰਾ ਓਢਿ ਨਗਨ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
811.t: bhagat janaa kaa loogaraa odd nagan na hoiee ||
811.e: Wearing the old blankets of the humble devotees, one is not naked.

811.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਸਿਰਪਾਉ ਰੇਸਮੀ ਪਹਿਰਤ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥੩॥
811.t: saakat sirapaau resamee pahirat pat khoiee ||3||
811.e: But by putting on the silk clothes of the faithless cynic, one loses one's honor. ||3||

811.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਸਿਉ ਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਰਿਐ ਅਧ ਵੀਚਹੁ ਟੂਟੈ ॥
811.t: saakat siau mukh joriaai adh veechahu TooTai ||
811.e: Friendship with the faithless cynic breaks down mid-way.

811.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਇਤ ਊਤਹਿ ਛੂਟੈ ॥੪॥
811.t: har jan kee sevaa jo kare it uooteh chhooTai ||4||
811.e: But whoever serves the humble servants of the Lord, is emancipated here and hereafter. ||4||

811.g: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਹੋਆ ਆਪਿ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
811.t: sabh kichh tum(h) hee te hoaa aap banat banaiee ||
811.e: Everything comes from You, O Lord; You Yourself created the creation.

811.g: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਸਾਧ ਕਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥੫॥੧੪॥੪੪॥
811.t: dharasan bheTat saadh kaa naanak gun gaiee ||5||14||44||
811.e: Blessed with the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Holy, Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||5||14||44||

812.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
812.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
812.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

812.g: ਸ੍ਰਵਨੀ ਸੁਨਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਉ ॥
812.t: sravanee sunau har har hare Thaakur jas gaavau ||
812.e: With my ears, I listen to the Lord, Har, Har; I sing the Praises of my Lord and Master.

812.g: ਸੰਤ ਚਰਣ ਕਰ ਸੀਸੁ ਧਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥੧॥
812.t: sa(n)t charan kar sees dhar har naam dhiaavau ||1||
812.e: I place my hands and my head upon the feet of the Saints, and meditate on the Lord's Name. ||1||

812.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਇਹ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
812.t: kar kirapaa dhiaal prabh ieh nidh sidh paavau ||
812.e: Be kind to me, O Merciful God, and bless me with this wealth and success.

812.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁਕਾ ਲੈ ਮਾਥੈ ਲਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
812.t: sa(n)t janaa kee renukaa lai maathai laavau ||1|| rahaau ||
812.e: Obtaining the dust of the feet of the Saints, I apply it to my forehead. ||1||Pause||

812.g: ਨੀਚ ਤੇ ਨੀਚੁ ਅਤਿ ਨੀਚੁ ਹੋਇ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਨਉ ਬੁਲਾਵਉ ॥
812.t: neech te neech at neech hoi kar binau bulaavau ||
812.e: I am the lowest of the low, absolutely the lowest; I offer my humble prayer.

812.g: ਪਾਵ ਮਲੋਵਾ ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਵਉ ॥੨॥
812.t: paav malovaa aap tiaag sa(n)tasa(n)g samaavau ||2||
812.e: I wash their feet, and renounce my self-conceit; I merge in the Saints' Congregation. ||2||

812.g: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਨਹ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਅਨ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਧਾਵਉ ॥
812.t: saas saas neh veesarai an kateh na dhaavau ||
812.e: With each and every breath, I never forget the Lord; I never go to another.

812.g: ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਿਟਾਵਉ ॥੩॥
812.t: safal dharasan gur bheTeeaai maan moh miTaavau ||3||
812.e: Obtaining the Fruitful Vision of the Guru's Darshan, I discard my pride and attachment. ||3||

812.g: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਨਾਵਉ ॥
812.t: sat sa(n)tokh dhiaa dharam seegaar banaavau ||
812.e: I am embellished with truth, contentment, compassion and Dharmic faith.

812.g: ਸਫਲ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਉ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੪੫॥
812.t: safal suhaagan naanakaa apune prabh bhaavau ||4||15||45||
812.e: My spiritual marriage is fruitful, O Nanak; I am pleasing to my God. ||4||15||45||

812.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
812.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
812.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

812.g: ਅਟਲ ਬਚਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨਾ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥
812.t: aTal bachan saadhoo janaa sabh meh pragaTaiaa ||
812.e: The words of the Holy are eternal and unchanging; this is apparent to everyone.

812.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਹੋਆ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
812.t: jis jan hoaa saadhasa(n)g tis bheTai har raiaa ||1||
812.e: That humble being, who joins the Saadh Sangat, meets the Sovereign Lord. ||1||

812.g: ਇਹ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
812.t: eeh parateet govi(n)dh kee jap har sukh paiaa ||
812.e: This faith in the Lord of the Universe, and peace, are found by meditating on the Lord.

812.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਤਾ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
812.t: anik baataa sabh kar rahe gur ghar lai aaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
812.e: Everyone is speaking in various ways, but the Guru has brought the Lord into the home of my self. ||1||Pause||

812.g: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਕੀ ਰਾਖਤਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਹਸਾਇਆ ॥
812.t: saran pare kee raakhataa naahee sahasaiaa ||
812.e: He preserves the honor of those who seek His Sanctuary; there is no doubt about this at all.

812.g: ਕਰਮ ਭੂਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਇ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਦੁਲਭਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
812.t: karam bhoom har naam boi aausar dhulabhaiaa ||2||
812.e: In the field of actions and karma, plant the Lord's Name; this opportunity is so difficult to obtain! ||2||

812.g: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
812.t: a(n)tarajaamee aap prabh sabh kare karaiaa ||
812.e: God Himself is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; He does, and causes everything to be done.

812.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਘਣੇ ਕਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਬਿਰਦਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
812.t: patit puneet ghane kare Thaakur biradhaiaa ||3||
812.e: He purifies so many sinners; this is the natural way of our Lord and Master. ||3||

812.g: ਮਤ ਭੂਲਹੁ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਜਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
812.t: mat bhoolahu maanukh jan maiaa bharamaiaa ||
812.e: Don't be fooled, O mortal being, by the illusion of Maya.

812.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖਸੀ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪਹਿਰਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੪੬॥
812.t: naanak tis pat raakhasee jo prabh pahiraiaa ||4||16||46||
812.e: O Nanak, God saves the honor of those of whom He approves. ||4||16||46||

812.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
812.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
812.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

812.g: ਮਾਟੀ ਤੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਰਲਭ ਦੇਹ ॥
812.t: maaTee te jin saajiaa kar dhuralabh dheh ||
812.e: He fashioned you from clay, and made your priceless body.

812.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਛਿਦ੍ਰ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਢਕੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੇਹ ॥੧॥
812.t: anik chhidhr man meh ddake niramal dhirasaTeh ||1||
812.e: He covers the many faults in your mind, and makes you look immaculate and pure. ||1||

812.g: ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨੈ ਤੇ ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਏਹ ॥
812.t: kiau bisarai prabh manai te jis ke gun eh ||
812.e: So why do you forget God from your mind? He has done so many good things for you.

812.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਜਿ ਰਚੇ ਜਿ ਆਨ ਸਿਉ ਸੋ ਰਲੀਐ ਖੇਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
812.t: prabh taj rache j aan siau so raleeaai kheh ||1|| rahaau ||
812.e: One who forsakes God, and blends himself with another, in the end is blended with dust. ||1||Pause||

812.g: ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਮਤ ਬਿਲਮ ਕਰੇਹ ॥
812.t: simarahu simarahu saas saas mat bilam kareh ||
812.e: Meditate, meditate in remembrance with each and every breath - do not delay!

812.g: ਛੋਡਿ ਪ੍ਰਪੰਚੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਰਚਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਕੂੜੇ ਨੇਹ ॥੨॥
812.t: chhodd prapa(n)ch prabh siau rachahu taj kooRe neh ||2||
812.e: Renounce worldly affairs, and merge yourself into God; forsake false loves. ||2||

812.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਏਕ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਕੀਏ ਹੈ ਹੋਸੀ ਏਹ ॥
812.t: jin anik ek bahu ra(n)g ke'ee hai hosee eh ||
812.e: He is many, and He is One; He takes part in the many plays. This is as He is, and shall be.

812.g: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਤਿ ਲੇਹ ॥੩॥
812.t: kar sevaa tis paarabraham gur te mat leh ||3||
812.e: So serve that Supreme Lord God, and accept the Guru's Teachings. ||3||

812.g: ਊਚੇ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ਵਡਾ ਸਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਰਨੇਹ ॥
812.t: uooche te uoochaa vaddaa sabh sa(n)g baraneh ||
812.e: God is said to be the highest of the high, the greatest of all, our companion.

812.g: ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਕੋ ਦਾਸਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਿ ਲੇਹ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੪੭॥
812.t: dhaas dhaas ko dhaasaraa naanak kar leh ||4||17||47||
812.e: Please, let Nanak be the slave of the slave of Your slaves. ||4||17||47||

812.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
812.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
812.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

812.g: ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੀ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਅਨ ਆਸ ॥
812.t: ek Tek govi(n)dh kee tiaagee an aas ||
812.e: The Lord of the Universe is my only Support. I have renounced all other hopes.

812.g: ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਣਤਾਸ ॥੧॥
812.t: sabh uoopar samarath prabh pooran gunataas ||1||
812.e: God is All-powerful, above all; He is the perfect treasure of virtue. ||1||

812.g: ਜਨ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
812.t: jan kaa naam adhaar hai prabh saranee paeh ||
812.e: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Support of the humble servant who seeks God's Sanctuary.

812.g: ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਕਾ ਆਸਰਾ ਸੰਤਨ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
812.t: paramesar kaa aasaraa sa(n)tan man maeh ||1|| rahaau ||
812.e: In their minds, the Saints take the Support of the Transcendent Lord. ||1||Pause||

812.g: ਆਪਿ ਰਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਦੇਵਸੀ ਆਪੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੈ ॥
812.t: aap rakhai aap dhevasee aape pratipaarai ||
812.e: He Himself preserves, and He Himself gives. He Himself cherishes.

813.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧੇ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮੑਾਰੈ ॥੨॥
813.t: dheen dhiaal kirapaa nidhe saas saas sam(h)aarai ||2||
813.e: Merciful to the meek, the treasure of mercy, He remembers and protects us with each and every breath. ||2||

813.g: ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਜੋ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਾਈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
813.t: karanahaar jo kar rahiaa saiee vaddiaaiee ||
813.e: Whatever the Creator Lord does is glorious and great.

813.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਖਸਮ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
813.t: gur poorai upadhesiaa sukh khasam rajaiee ||3||
813.e: The Perfect Guru has instructed me, that peace comes by the Will of our Lord and Master. ||3||

813.g: ਚਿੰਤ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਗਣਤ ਤਜਿ ਜਨਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
813.t: chi(n)t a(n)dhesaa ganat taj jan hukam pachhaataa ||
813.e: Anxieties, worries and calculations are dismissed; the Lord's humble servant accepts the Hukam of His Command.

813.g: ਨਹ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਨਹ ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੪॥੧੮॥੪੮॥
813.t: neh binasai neh chhodd jai naanak ra(n)g raataa ||4||18||48||
813.e: He does not die, and He does not leave; Nanak is attuned to His Love. ||4||18||48||

813.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
813.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
813.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

813.g: ਮਹਾ ਤਪਤਿ ਤੇ ਭਈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਰਸਤ ਪਾਪ ਨਾਠੇ ॥
813.t: mahaa tapat te bhiee saa(n)t parasat paap naaThe ||
813.e: The great fire is put out and cooled; meeting with the Guru, sins run away.

813.g: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਿ ਗਲਤ ਥੇ ਕਾਢੇ ਦੇ ਹਾਥੇ ॥੧॥
813.t: a(n)dh koop meh galat the kaadde dhe haathe ||1||
813.e: I fell into the deep dark pit; giving me His Hand, He pulled me out. ||1||

813.g: ਓਇ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਸਾਜਨਾ ਹਮ ਉਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ ॥
813.t: oi hamaare saajanaa ham un kee ren ||
813.e: He is my friend; I am the dust of His Feet.

813.g: ਜਿਨ ਭੇਟਤ ਹੋਵਤ ਸੁਖੀ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
813.t: jin bheTat hovat sukhee jeea dhaan dhen ||1|| rahaau ||
813.e: Meeting with Him, I am at peace; He blesses me with the gift of the soul. ||1||Pause||

813.g: ਪਰਾ ਪੂਰਬਲਾ ਲੀਖਿਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਅਬ ਆਇ ॥
813.t: paraa poorabalaa leekhiaa miliaa ab aai ||
813.e: I have now received my pre-ordained destiny.

813.g: ਬਸਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾਇ ॥੨॥
813.t: basat sa(n)g har saadh kai pooran aasai ||2||
813.e: Dwelling with the Lord's Holy Saints, my hopes are fulfilled. ||2||

813.g: ਭੈ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਕ ਕੇ ਪਾਏ ਸੁਖ ਥਾਨ ॥
813.t: bhai binase tih lok ke paae sukh thaan ||
813.e: The fear of the three worlds is dispelled, and I have found my place of rest and peace.

813.g: ਦਇਆ ਕਰੀ ਸਮਰਥ ਗੁਰਿ ਬਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮ ॥੩॥
813.t: dhiaa karee samarath gur basiaa man naam ||3||
813.e: The all-powerful Guru has taken pity upon me, and the Naam has come to dwell in my mind. ||3||

813.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਤੂ ਟੇਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰ ॥
813.t: naanak kee too Tek prabh teraa aadhaar ||
813.e: O God, You are the Anchor and Support of Nanak.

813.g: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੪੯॥
813.t: karan kaaran samarath prabh har agam apaar ||4||19||49||
813.e: He is the Doer, the Cause of causes; the All-powerful Lord God is inaccessible and infinite. ||4||19||49||

813.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
813.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
813.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

813.g: ਸੋਈ ਮਲੀਨੁ ਦੀਨੁ ਹੀਨੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਿਸਰਾਨਾ ॥
