824.e: Forever and ever, chant the Name of God.

824.g: ਜਰਾ ਮਰਾ ਕਛੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਆਗੈ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
824.t: jaraa maraa kachh dhookh na biaapai aagai dharageh pooran kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
824.e: The pains of old age and death shall not afflict you, and in the Court of the Lord hereafter, your affairs shall be perfectly resolved. ||1||Pause||

824.g: ਆਪੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਪਰੀਐ ਨਿਤ ਸਰਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
824.t: aap tiaag pareeaai nit saranee gur te paieeaai eh nidhaan ||
824.e: So forsake your self-conceit, and ever seek Sanctuary. This treasure is obtained only from the Guru.

824.g: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੀ ਕਟੀਐ ਫਾਸੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਕਾ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
824.t: janam maran kee kaTeeaai faasee saachee dharageh kaa neesaan ||1||
824.e: The noose of birth and death is snapped; this is the insignia, the hallmark, of the Court of the True Lord. ||1||

824.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਮੑ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨਉ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੈ ਸਗਲ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
824.t: jo tum(h) karahu soiee bhal maanau man te chhooTai sagal gumaan ||
824.e: Whatever You do, I accept as good. I have eradicated all egotistical pride from my mind.

824.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਗਲ ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੯੯॥
824.t: kahu naanak taa kee saranaiee jaa kaa keeaa sagal jahaan ||2||13||99||
824.e: Says Nanak, I am under His protection; He created the entire Universe. ||2||13||99||

824.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
824.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
824.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

824.g: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਹੀ ॥
824.t: man tan a(n)tar prabh aahee ||
824.e: Deep within the nucleus of his mind and body, is God.

824.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਨਿਤ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਕਾ ਮੋਲੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
824.t: har gun gaavat paraupakaar nit tis rasanaa kaa mol kichh naahee ||1|| rahaau ||
824.e: He continually sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and always does good for others; his tongue is priceless. ||1||Pause||

824.g: ਕੁਲ ਸਮੂਹ ਉਧਰੇ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਹੀ ॥
824.t: kul samooh udhare khin bheetar janam janam kee mal laahee ||
824.e: All his generations are redeemed and saved in an instant, and the filth of countless incarnations is washed away.

824.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਅਨਦ ਸੇਤੀ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਬਨੁ ਗਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
824.t: simar simar suaamee prabh apanaa anadh setee bikhiaa ban gaahee ||1||
824.e: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on God, his Lord and Master, he passes blissfully through the forest of poison. ||1||

824.g: ਚਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕੇ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਪਾਏ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾਹੀ ॥
824.t: charan prabhoo ke bohith paae bhav saagar paar paraahee ||
824.e: I have obtained the boat of God's Feet, to carry me across the terrifying world-ocean.

824.g: ਸੰਤ ਸੇਵਕ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਹੈ ਤਾਹੀ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੧੦੦॥
824.t: sa(n)t sevak bhagat har taa ke naanak man laagaa hai taahee ||2||14||100||
824.e: The Saints, servants and devotees belong to the Lord; Nanak's mind is attached to Him. ||2||14||100||

824.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
824.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
824.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

824.g: ਧੀਰਉ ਦੇਖਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੈ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
824.t: dheerau dhekh tum(h)aarai ra(n)gaa ||
824.e: I am reassured, gazing upon Your wondrous play.

824.g: ਤੁਹੀ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਤੂਹੀ ਵਸਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
824.t: tuhee suaamee a(n)tarajaamee toohee vaseh saadh kai sa(n)gaa ||1|| rahaau ||
824.e: You are my Lord and Master, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; You dwell with the Holy Saints. ||1||Pause||

824.g: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਥਾਪਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਨੀਚ ਕੀਟ ਤੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਰਾਜੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
824.t: khin meh thaap nivaaje Thaakur neech keeT te kareh raaja(n)gaa ||1||
824.e: In an instant, our Lord and Master establishes and exalts. From a lowly worm, He creates a king. ||1||

824.g: ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਹੀਏ ਮੋਰੇ ਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਇਹੀ ਦਾਨੁ ਮੰਗਾ ॥੨॥੧੫॥੧੦੧॥
824.t: kabahoo na bisarai he'ee more te naanak dhaas ihee dhaan ma(n)gaa ||2||15||101||
824.e: May I never forget You from my heart; slave Nanak prays for this blessing. ||2||15||101||

824.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
824.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
824.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

824.g: ਅਚੁਤ ਪੂਜਾ ਜੋਗ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥
824.t: achut poojaa jog gopaal ||
824.e: The imperishable Lord God is worthy of worship and adoration.

824.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਰਖਉ ਹਰਿ ਆਗੈ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
824.t: man tan arap rakhau har aagai sarab jeeaa kaa hai pratipaal ||1|| rahaau ||
824.e: Dedicating my mind and body, I place them before the Lord, the Cherisher of all beings. ||1||Pause||

824.g: ਸਰਨਿ ਸਮ੍ਰਥ ਅਕਥ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਬਡੋ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
824.t: saran samrath akath sukhadhaataa kirapaa si(n)dh baddo dhiaal ||
824.e: His Sanctuary is All-powerful; He cannot be described; He is the Giver of peace, the ocean of mercy, supremely compassionate.

824.g: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਤਾਤੀ ਬਾਲ ॥੧॥
824.t: ka(n)Th lai raakhai apane kau tis no lagai na taatee baal ||1||
824.e: Holding him close in His embrace, the Lord protects and saves him, and then even the hot wind cannot touch him. ||1||

824.g: ਦਾਮੋਦਰ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਧਨ ਮਾਲ ॥
824.t: dhaamodhar dhiaal suaamee sarabas sa(n)t janaa dhan maal ||
824.e: Our Merciful Lord and Master is wealth, property and everything to His humble Saints.

824.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਚਿਕ ਦਰਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਗੈ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਰਵਾਲ ॥੨॥੧੬॥੧੦੨॥
824.t: naanak jaachik dharas prabh maagai sa(n)t janaa kee milai ravaal ||2||16||102||
824.e: Nanak, a beggar, asks for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan; please, bless him with the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||2||16||102||

824.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
824.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
824.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

824.g: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਤਨ ਭਏ ॥
824.t: simarat naam koT jatan bhe ||
824.e: Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is equal to millions of efforts.

824.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਜਮਦੂਤਨ ਕਉ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਅਹੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
824.t: saadhasa(n)g mil har gun gaae jamadhootan kau traas ahe ||1|| rahaau ||
824.e: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and the Messenger of Death will be frightened away. ||1||Pause||

824.g: ਜੇਤੇ ਪੁਨਹਚਰਨ ਸੇ ਕੀਨੑੇ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਗਹੇ ॥
824.t: jete punahacharan se keen(h)e man tan prabh ke charan gahe ||
824.e: To enshrine the Feet of God in one's mind and body, is to perform all sorts of acts of atonement.

824.g: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਨਾਠਾ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦਹੇ ॥੧॥
824.t: aavan jaan bharam bhau naaThaa janam janam ke kilavikh dhahe ||1||
824.e: Coming and going, doubt and fear have run away, and the sins of countless incarnations are burnt away. ||1||

824.g: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਹੋਇ ਭਜਹੁ ਜਗਦੀਸੈ ਏਹੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਲਹੇ ॥
824.t: nirabhau hoi bhajahu jagadheesai eh padhaarath vaddabhaag lahe ||
824.e: So become fearless, and vibrate upon the Lord of the Universe. This is true wealth, obtained only by great good fortune.

825.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਕਹੇ ॥੨॥੧੭॥੧੦੩॥
825.t: kar kirapaa pooran prabh dhaate niramal jas naanak dhaas kahe ||2||17||103||
825.e: Be merciful, O Perfect God, Great Giver, that slave Nanak may chant Your immaculate Praises. ||2||17||103||

825.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
825.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
825.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

825.g: ਸੁਲਹੀ ਤੇ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
825.t: sulahee te naarain raakh ||
825.e: The Lord saved me from Sulhi Khan.

825.g: ਸੁਲਹੀ ਕਾ ਹਾਥੁ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਸੁਲਹੀ ਹੋਇ ਮੂਆ ਨਾਪਾਕੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
825.t: sulahee kaa haath kahee na pahuchai sulahee hoi mooaa naapaak ||1|| rahaau ||
825.e: The emperor did not succeed in his plot, and he died in disgrace. ||1||Pause||

825.g: ਕਾਢਿ ਕੁਠਾਰੁ ਖਸਮਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਆ ਹੈ ਖਾਕੁ ॥
825.t: kaadd kuThaar khasam sir kaaTiaa khin meh hoi giaa hai khaak ||
825.e: The Lord and Master raised His axe, and chopped off his head; in an instant, he was reduced to dust. ||1||

825.g: ਮੰਦਾ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਪਚਿਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਦੀਨਾ ਧਾਕੁ ॥੧॥
825.t: ma(n)dhaa chitavat chitavat pachiaa jin rachiaa tin dheenaa dhaak ||1||
825.e: Plotting and planning evil, he was destroyed. The One who created him, gave him a push.

825.g: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਮੀਤ ਧਨੁ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਰਹਿਓ ਸੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਇਆ ਸਭ ਭਾਈ ਸਾਕੁ ॥
825.t: putr meet dhan kichhoo na rahio su chhodd giaa sabh bhaiee saak ||
825.e: Of his sons, friends and wealth, nothing remains; he departed, leaving behind all his brothers and relatives.

825.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਕੀਨੋ ਪੂਰਨ ਵਾਕੁ ॥੨॥੧੮॥੧੦੪॥
825.t: kahu naanak tis prabh balihaaree jin jan kaa keeno pooran vaak ||2||18||104||
825.e: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to God, who fulfilled the word of His slave. ||2||18||104||

825.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
825.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
825.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

825.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
825.t: poore gur kee pooree sev ||
825.e: Perfect is service to the Perfect Guru.

825.g: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਕੀਆ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
825.t: aape aap varatai suaamee kaaraj raas keeaa gurdhev ||1|| rahaau ||
825.e: Our Lord and Master Himself is Himself all-pervading. The Divine Guru has resolved all my affairs. ||1||Pause||

825.g: ਆਦਿ ਮਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪਨਾ ਥਾਟੁ ਬਨਾਇਓ ਆਪਿ ॥
825.t: aadh madh prabh a(n)t suaamee apanaa thaaT banaio aap ||
825.e: In the beginning, in the middle and in the end, God is our only Lord and Master. He Himself fashioned His Creation.

825.g: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਕੋ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ॥੧॥
825.t: apane sevak kee aape raakhai prabh mere ko vadd parataap ||1||
825.e: He Himself saves His servant. Great is the glorious grandeur of my God! ||1||

825.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਨੑੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਜੰਤ ॥
825.t: paarabraham paramesur satigur vas keen(h)e jin sagale ja(n)t ||
825.e: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord is the True Guru; all beings are in His power.

825.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਪਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੰਤ ॥੨॥੧੯॥੧੦੫॥
825.t: charan kamal naanak saranaiee raam naam jap niramal ma(n)t ||2||19||105||
825.e: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of His Lotus Feet, chanting the Lord's Name, the immaculate Mantra. ||2||19||105||

825.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
825.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
825.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

825.g: ਤਾਪ ਪਾਪ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੇ ਆਪ ॥
825.t: taap paap te raakhe aap ||
825.e: He Himself protects me from suffering and sin.

825.g: ਸੀਤਲ ਭਏ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਪ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
825.t: seetal bhe gur charanee laage raam naam hiradhe meh jaap ||1|| rahaau ||
825.e: Falling at the Guru's Feet, I am cooled and soothed; I meditate on the Lord's Name within my heart. ||1||Pause||

825.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਸਤ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦੀਨੇ ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ॥
825.t: kar kirapaa hasat prabh dheene jagat udhaar nav kha(n)dd prataap ||
825.e: Granting His Mercy, God has extended His Hands. He is the Emancipator of the World; His glorious radiance pervades the nine continents.

825.g: ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੁਖ ਅਨਦ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝੀ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਸਚੁ ਧ੍ਰਾਪ ॥੧॥
825.t: dhukh binase sukh anadh pravesaa tirasan bujhee man tan sach dhraap ||1||
825.e: My pain has been dispelled, and peace and pleasure have come; my desire is quenched, and my mind and body are truly satisfied. ||1||

825.g: ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਨਾਥੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਰਥਾ ਸਗਲ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕੋ ਮਾਈ ਬਾਪੁ ॥
825.t: anaath ko naath saran samarathaa sagal sirasaT ko maiee baap ||
825.e: He is the Master of the masterless, All-powerful to give Sanctuary. He is the Mother and Father of the whole Universe.

825.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਲਾਪ ॥੨॥੨੦॥੧੦੬॥
825.t: bhagat vachhal bhai bha(n)jan suaamee gun gaavat naanak aalaap ||2||20||106||
825.e: He is the Lover of His devotees, the Destroyer of fear; Nanak sings and chants the Glorious Praises of his Lord and Master. ||2||20||106||

825.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
825.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
825.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

825.g: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥
825.t: jis te upajiaa tiseh pachhaan ||
825.e: Acknowledge the One, from whom You originated.

825.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਕੁਸਲ ਖੇਮ ਹੋਏ ਕਲਿਆਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
825.t: paarabraham paramesar dhiaaiaa kusal khem hoe kaliaan ||1|| rahaau ||
825.e: Meditating on the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, I have found peace, pleasure and salvation. ||1||Pause||

825.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਬਡ ਭਾਗੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ॥
825.t: gur pooraa bheTio badd bhaagee a(n)tarajaamee sughaR sujaan ||
825.e: I met the Perfect Guru, by great good fortune, and so found the wise and all-knowing Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

825.g: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਕਰਿ ਅਪਨੇ ਬਡ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਨਿਮਾਣਿਆ ਕੋ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
825.t: haath dhei raakhe kar apane badd samarath nimaaniaa ko maan ||1||
825.e: He gave me His Hand, and making me His own, He saved me; He is absolutely all-powerful, the honor of the dishonored. ||1||

825.g: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਏ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਚਾਨਾਣੁ ॥
825.t: bhram bhai binas ge khin bheetar a(n)dhakaar pragaTe chaanaan ||
825.e: Doubt and fear have been dispelled in an instant, and in the darkness, the Divine Light shines forth.

825.g: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਆਰਾਧੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਈਐ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੨॥੨੧॥੧੦੭॥
825.t: saas saas aaraadhai naanak sadhaa sadhaa jaieeaai kurabaan ||2||21||107||
825.e: With each and every breath, Nanak worships and adores the Lord; forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him. ||2||21||107||

825.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
825.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
825.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

825.g: ਦੋਵੈ ਥਾਵ ਰਖੇ ਗੁਰ ਸੂਰੇ ॥
825.t: dhovai thaav rakhe gur soore ||
825.e: Both here and hereafter, the Mighty Guru protects me.

825.g: ਹਲਤ ਪਲਤ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਹੋਏ ਸਗਲੇ ਪੂਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
825.t: halat palat paarabraham savaare kaaraj hoe sagale poore ||1|| rahaau ||
825.e: God has embellished this world and the next for me, and all my affairs are perfectly resolved. ||1||Pause||

825.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਜਨੁ ਹੋਵਤ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰੇ ॥
825.t: har har naam japat sukh sahaje majan hovat saadhoo dhoore ||
825.e: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I have found peace and poise, bathing in the dust of the feet of the Holy.

825.g: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਥਿਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੇ ਮਿਟੇ ਬਿਸੂਰੇ ॥੧॥
825.t: aavan jaan rahe thit paiee janam maran ke miTe bisoore ||1||
825.e: Comings and goings have ceased, and I have found stability; the pains of birth and death are eradicated. ||1||

825.g: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਤਰੇ ਛੁਟੇ ਭੈ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਏਕੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥
825.t: bhram bhai tare chhuTe bhai jam ke ghaT ghaT ek rahiaa bharapoore ||
825.e: I cross over the ocean of doubt and fear, and the fear of death is gone; the One Lord is permeating and pervading in each and every heart.

826.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਹਜੂਰੇ ॥੨॥੨੨॥੧੦੮॥
826.t: naanak saran pario dhukh bha(n)jan a(n)tar baahar pekh hajoore ||2||22||108||
826.e: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Destroyer of pain; I behold His Presence deep within, and all around as well. ||2||22||108||

826.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
826.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
826.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

826.g: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਤ ਦੋਖ ਨਸੇ ॥
826.t: dharasan dhekhat dhokh nase ||
826.e: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, all pains run away.

826.g: ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
826.t: kabahu na hovahu dhirasaT agochar jeea kai sa(n)g base ||1|| rahaau ||
826.e: Please, never leave my vision, O Lord; please abide with my soul. ||1||Pause||

826.g: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
826.t: preetam praan adhaar suaamee ||
826.e: My Beloved Lord and Master is the Support of the breath of life.

826.g: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੧॥
826.t: poor rahe prabh a(n)tarajaamee ||1||
826.e: God, the Inner-knower, is all-pervading. ||1||

826.g: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮੑਾਰੀ ॥
826.t: kiaa gun tere saar sam(h)aaree ||
826.e: Which of Your Glorious Virtues should I contemplate and remember?

826.g: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਚਿਤਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
826.t: saas saas prabh tujheh chitaaree ||2||
826.e: With each and every breath, O God, I remember You. ||2||

826.g: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
826.t: kirapaa nidh prabh dheen dhiaalaa ||
826.e: God is the ocean of mercy, merciful to the meek;

826.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਕੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
826.t: jeea ja(n)t kee karahu pratipaalaa ||3||
826.e: He cherishes all beings and creatures. ||3||

826.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਪੇ ॥
826.t: aaTh pahar teraa naam jan jaape ||
826.e: Twenty-four hours a day, Your humble servant chants Your Name.

826.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ॥੪॥੨੩॥੧੦੯॥
826.t: naanak preet laiee prabh aape ||4||23||109||
826.e: You Yourself, O God, have inspired Nanak to love You. ||4||23||109||

826.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
826.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
826.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

826.g: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਚਲਤ ਗਇਆ ॥
826.t: tan dhan joban chalat giaa ||
826.e: Body, wealth and youth pass away.

826.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਭਜਨੁ ਨ ਕੀਨੋ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਨਿਸਿ ਭੋਰੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
826.t: raam naam kaa bhajan na keeno karat bikaar nis bhor bhiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
826.e: You have not meditated and vibrated upon the Lord's Name; while you commit your sins of corruption in the night, the light of day dawns upon you. ||1||Pause||

826.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਭੋਜਨ ਨਿਤ ਖਾਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਦੰਤਾ ਘਸਿ ਖੀਨ ਖਇਆ ॥
826.t: anik prakaar bhojan nit khaate mukh dha(n)taa ghas kheen khiaa ||
826.e: Continually eating all sorts of foods, the teeth in your mouth crumble, decay and fall out.

826.g: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਮੂਠਉ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਤ ਨਹ ਪਰੀ ਦਇਆ ॥੧॥
826.t: meree meree kar kar mooThau paap karat neh paree dhiaa ||1||
826.e: Living in egotism and possessiveness, you are deluded; committing sins, you have no kindness for others. ||1||

826.g: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਘੋਰ ਦੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਗਲਤੁ ਪਇਆ ॥
826.t: mahaa bikaar ghor dhukh saagar tis meh praanee galat piaa ||
826.e: The great sins are the terrible ocean of pain; the mortal is engrossed in them.

826.g: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੀ ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੨॥੨੪॥੧੧੦॥
826.t: saran pare naanak suaamee kee baeh pakar prabh kaadd liaa ||2||24||110||
826.e: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of his Lord and Master; taking him by the arm, God has lifted him up and out. ||2||24||110||

826.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
826.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
826.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

826.g: ਆਪਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਇਆ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
826.t: aapanaa prabh aaiaa cheet ||
826.e: God Himself has come into my consciousness.

826.g: ਦੁਸਮਨ ਦੁਸਟ ਰਹੇ ਝਖ ਮਾਰਤ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
826.t: dhusaman dhusaT rahe jhakh maarat kusal bhiaa mere bhaiee meet ||1|| rahaau ||
826.e: My enemies and opponents have grown weary of attacking me, and now, I have become happy, O my friends and Siblings of Destiny. ||1||Pause||

826.g: ਗਈ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਸਭ ਨਾਸੀ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
826.t: giee biaadh upaadh sabh naasee a(n)geekaar keeo karataar ||
826.e: The disease is gone, and all misfortunes have been averted; the Creator Lord has made me His own.

826.g: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੂਖ ਅਰੁ ਅਨਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਰ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
826.t: saa(n)t sookh ar anadh ghanere preetam naam ridhai ur haar ||1||
826.e: I have found peace, tranquility and total bliss, enshrining the Name of my Beloved Lord within my heart. ||1||

826.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂੰ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
826.t: jeeau pi(n)dd dhan raas prabh teree too(n) samarath suaamee meraa ||
826.e: My soul, body and wealth are all Your capital; O God, You are my All-powerful Lord and Master.

826.g: ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਚੇਰਾ ॥੨॥੨੫॥੧੧੧॥
826.t: dhaas apune kau raakhanahaaraa naanak dhaas sadhaa hai cheraa ||2||25||111||
826.e: You are the Saving Grace of Your slaves; slave Nanak is forever Your slave. ||2||25||111||

826.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
826.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
826.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

826.g: ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਹੋਆ ਕਲਿਆਣੁ ॥
826.t: gobidh simar hoaa kaliaan ||
826.e: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe, I am emancipated.

826.g: ਮਿਟੀ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਭਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਿਮਰਿਆ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
826.t: miTee upaadh bhiaa sukh saachaa a(n)tarajaamee simariaa jaan ||1|| rahaau ||
826.e: Suffering is eradicated, and true peace has come, meditating on the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||1||Pause||

826.g: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੀਏ ਸੁਖਾਲੇ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਾਚਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
826.t: jis ke jeea tin ke'ee sukhaale bhagat janaa kau saachaa taan ||
826.e: All beings belong to Him - He makes them happy. He is the true power of His humble devotees.

826.g: ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖੀ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
826.t: dhaas apune kee aape raakhee bhai bha(n)jan uoopar karate maan ||1||
826.e: He Himself saves and protects His slaves, who believe in their Creator, the Destroyer of fear. ||1||

826.g: ਭਈ ਮਿਤ੍ਰਾਈ ਮਿਟੀ ਬੁਰਾਈ ਦ੍ਰੁਸਟ ਦੂਤ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਢੇ ਛਾਣਿ ॥
826.t: bhiee mitraiee miTee buraiee dhrusaT dhoot har kaadde chhaan ||
826.e: I have found friendship, and hatred has been eradicated; the Lord has rooted out the enemies and villains.

826.g: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਹ ਵਖਾਣਿ ॥੨॥੨੬॥੧੧੨॥
826.t: sookh sahaj aana(n)dh ghanere naanak jeevai har guneh vakhaan ||2||26||112||
826.e: Nanak has been blessed with celestial peace and poise and total bliss; chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, he lives. ||2||26||112||

826.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
826.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
826.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

826.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
826.t: paarabraham prabh bhe kirapaal ||
826.e: The Supreme Lord God has become Merciful.

826.g: ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
826.t: kaaraj sagal savaare satigur jap jap saadhoo bhe nihaal ||1|| rahaau ||
826.e: The True Guru has arranged all my affairs; chanting and meditating with the Holy Saints, I have become happy. ||1||Pause||

826.g: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਦੋਖੀ ਸਗਲੇ ਭਏ ਰਵਾਲ ॥
826.t: a(n)geekaar keeaa prabh apanai dhokhee sagale bhe ravaal ||
826.e: God has made me His own, and all my enemies have been reduced to dust.

826.g: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਜਨ ਅਪਨੇ ਉਧਰਿ ਲੀਏ ਲਾਇ ਅਪਨੈ ਪਾਲ ॥੧॥
826.t: ka(n)Th lai raakhe jan apane udhar le'ee lai apanai paal ||1||
826.e: He hugs us close in His embrace, and protects His humble servants; attaching us to the hem of His robe, he saves us. ||1||

827.g: ਸਹੀ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਹੋਏ ਕਾਲ ॥
827.t: sahee salaamat mil ghar aae ni(n)dhak ke mukh hoe kaal ||
827.e: Safe and sound, we have returned home, while the slanderer's face is blackened.

827.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥੨੭॥੧੧੩॥
827.t: kahu naanak meraa satigur pooraa gur prasaadh prabh bhe nihaal ||2||27||113||
827.e: Says Nanak, my True Guru is Perfect; by the Grace of God and Guru, I am so happy. ||2||27||113||

827.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
827.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
827.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

827.g: ਮੂ ਲਾਲਨ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
827.t: moo laalan siau preet banee || rahaau ||
827.e: I have fallen in love with my Beloved Lord. ||Pause||

827.g: ਤੋਰੀ ਨ ਤੂਟੈ ਛੋਰੀ ਨ ਛੂਟੈ ਐਸੀ ਮਾਧੋ ਖਿੰਚ ਤਨੀ ॥੧॥
827.t: toree na tooTai chhoree na chhooTai aaisee maadho khi(n)ch tanee ||1||
827.e: Cutting it, it does not break, and releasing it, it does not let go. Such is the string the Lord has tied me with. ||1||

827.g: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੀ ॥੨॥
827.t: dhinas rain man maeh basat hai too kar kirapaa prabh apanee ||2||
827.e: Day and night, He dwells within my mind; please bless me with Your Mercy, O my God. ||2||

827.g: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਸਿਆਮ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਕਉ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨੀ ॥੩॥
827.t: bal bal jaau siaam su(n)dhar kau akath kathaa jaa kee baat sunee ||3||
827.e: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to my beauteous Lord; I have heard his Unspoken Speech and Story. ||3||

827.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਹੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੀ ॥੪॥੨੮॥੧੧੪॥
827.t: jan naanak dhaasan dhaas kaheeat hai moh karahu kirapaa Thaakur apunee ||4||28||114||
827.e: Servant Nanak is said to be the slave of His slaves; O my Lord and Master, please bless me with Your Mercy. ||4||28||114||

827.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
827.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
827.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

827.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਜਪਿ ਜਾਂਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥
827.t: har ke charan jap jaa(n)au kurabaan ||
827.e: I meditate on the Lord's Feet; I am a sacrifice to Them.

827.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਧਰਿ ਮਨ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
827.t: gur meraa paarabraham paramesur taa kaa hiradhai dhar man dhiaan ||1|| rahaau ||
827.e: My Guru is the Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord; I enshrine Him within my heart, and meditate on Him within my mind. ||1||Pause||

827.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਗਲ ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥
827.t: simar simar simar sukhadhaataa jaa kaa keeaa sagal jahaan ||
827.e: Meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance on the Giver of peace, who created the whole Universe.

827.g: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਵਹੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
827.t: rasanaa ravahu ek naarain saachee dharageh paavahu maan ||1||
827.e: With your tongue, savor the One Lord, and you shall be honored in the Court of the True Lord. ||1||

827.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
827.t: saadhoo sa(n)g paraapat jaa kau tin hee paiaa eh nidhaan ||
827.e: He alone obtains this treasure, who joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

827.g: ਗਾਵਉ ਗੁਣ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਜੈ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੨੯॥੧੧੫॥
827.t: gaavau gun keeratan nit suaamee kar kirapaa naanak dheejai dhaan ||2||29||115||
827.e: O Lord and Master, mercifully bless Nanak with this gift, that he may ever sing the Glorious Praises of Your Kirtan. ||2||29||115||

827.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
827.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
827.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

827.g: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣ ॥
827.t: raakh le'ee satigur kee saran ||
827.e: I have been saved, in the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

827.g: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਹੋਆ ਜਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਤਾਰਣ ਤਰਣ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
827.t: jai jai kaar hoaa jag a(n)tar paarabraham mero taaran taran ||1|| rahaau ||
827.e: I am cheered and applauded throughout the world; my Supreme Lord God carries me across. ||1||Pause||

827.g: ਬਿਸ੍ਵੰਭਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਪੋਖਣ ਭਰਣ ॥
827.t: bisavai(n)bhar pooran sukhadhaataa sagal samagree pokhan bharan ||
827.e: The Perfect Lord fills the Universe; He is the Giver of peace; He cherishes and fulfills the whole Universe.

827.g: ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਂਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ॥੧॥
827.t: thaan thana(n)tar sarab nira(n)tar bal bal jaa(n)iee har ke charan ||1||
827.e: He is completely filling all places and interspaces; I am a devoted sacrifice to the Lord's Feet. ||1||

827.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵਸਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਬ ਸਿਧਿ ਤੁਮ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣ ॥
827.t: jeea jugat vas mere suaamee sarab sidh tum kaaran karan ||
827.e: The ways of all beings are in Your Power, O my Lord and Master. All supernatural spiritual powers are Yours; You are the Creator, the Cause of causes.

827.g: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਹੀ ਡਰਣ ॥੨॥੩੦॥੧੧੬॥
827.t: aadh jugaadh prabh rakhadhaa aaiaa har simarat naanak nahee ddaran ||2||30||116||
827.e: In the beginning, and throughout the ages, God is our Savior and Protector; remembering the Lord in meditation, O Nanak, fear is eliminated. ||2||30||116||

827.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੮
827.t: raag bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa dhupadhe ghar atthvaa
827.e: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla, Dho-Padhay, Eighth House:

827.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
827.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
827.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

827.g: ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
827.t: mai naahee prabh sabh kichh teraa ||
827.e: I am nothing, God; everything is Yours.

827.g: ਈਘੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਊਘੈ ਸਰਗੁਨ ਕੇਲ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਚਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
827.t: e'eeghai niragun uooghai saragun kel karat bich suaamee meraa ||1|| rahaau ||
827.e: In this world, You are the absolute, formless Lord; in the world hereafter, You are the related Lord of form. You play it both ways, O my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

827.g: ਨਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਆਪਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਕੋ ਸਗਲ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥
827.t: nagar meh aap baahar fun aapan prabh mere ko sagal baseraa ||
827.e: You exist within the city, and beyond it as well; O my God, You are everywhere.

827.g: ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਰਾਜਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਰਾਇਆ ਕਹ ਕਹ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਹ ਕਹ ਚੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
827.t: aape hee raajan aape hee raiaa keh keh Thaakur keh keh cheraa ||1||
827.e: You Yourself are the King, and You Yourself are the subject. In one place, You are the Lord and Master, and in another place, You are the slave. ||1||

827.g: ਕਾ ਕਉ ਦੁਰਾਉ ਕਾ ਸਿਉ ਬਲਬੰਚਾ ਜਹ ਜਹ ਪੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
827.t: kaa kau dhuraau kaa siau balaba(n)chaa jeh jeh pekhau teh teh neraa ||
827.e: From whom should I hide? Whom should I try to deceive? Wherever I look, I see Him near at hand.

827.g: ਸਾਧ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਬੂੰਦ ਨਹੀ ਅਨ ਹੇਰਾ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੧੭॥
827.t: saadh moorat gur bheTio naanak mil saagar boo(n)dh nahee an heraa ||2||1||117||
827.e: I have met with Guru Nanak, the Embodiment of the Holy Saints. When the drop of water merges into the ocean, it cannot be distinguished as separate again. ||2||1||117||

827.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
827.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
827.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

828.g: ਤੁਮੑ ਸਮਰਥਾ ਕਾਰਨ ਕਰਨ ॥
828.t: tum(h) samarathaa kaaran karan ||
828.e: You are the all-powerful Cause of causes.

828.g: ਢਾਕਨ ਢਾਕਿ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਸਰਨ ਚਰਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
828.t: ddaakan ddaak gobidh gur mere moh aparaadhee saran charan ||1|| rahaau ||
828.e: Please cover my faults, Lord of the Universe, O my Guru; I am a sinner - I seek the Sanctuary of Your Feet. ||1||Pause||

828.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕੀਨੋ ਸੋ ਤੁਮੑ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਠਉਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਢੀਠ ਮੁਕਰਨ ॥
828.t: jo jo keeno so tum(h) jaanio pekhio Thaur naahee kachh ddeeTh mukaran ||
828.e: Whatever we do, You see and know; there is no way anyone can stubbornly deny this.

828.g: ਬਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮੑਰੋ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘਾ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਨ ॥੧॥
828.t: badd parataap sunio prabh tum(h)ro koT aghaa tero naam haran ||1||
828.e: Your glorious radiance is great! So I have heard, O God. Millions of sins are destroyed by Your Name. ||1||

828.g: ਹਮਰੋ ਸਹਾਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦ ਭੂਲਨ ਤੁਮੑਰੋ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਰਨ ॥
828.t: hamaro sahaau sadhaa sadh bhoolan tum(h)ro biradh patit udharan ||
828.e: It is my nature to make mistakes, forever and ever; it is Your Natural Way to save sinners.

828.g: ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੧੮॥
828.t: karunaa mai kirapaal kirapaa nidh jeevan padh naanak har dharasan ||2||2||118||
828.e: You are the embodiment of kindness, and the treasure of compassion, O Merciful Lord; through the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, Nanak has found the state of redemption in life. ||2||2||118||

828.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
828.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
828.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

828.g: ਐਸੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਰਹੁ ॥
828.t: aaisee kirapaa moh karahu ||
828.e: Bless me with such mercy, Lord,

828.g: ਸੰਤਹ ਚਰਣ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਮਾਥਾ ਨੈਨ ਦਰਸੁ ਤਨਿ ਧੂਰਿ ਪਰਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
828.t: sa(n)teh charan hamaaro maathaa nain dharas tan dhoor parahu ||1|| rahaau ||
828.e: that my forehead may touch the feet of the Saints, and my eyes may behold the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, and my body may fall at the dust of their feet. ||1||Pause||

828.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਬਾਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਮਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਧਰਹੁ ॥
828.t: gur ko sabadh merai heearai baasai har naamaa man sa(n)g dharahu ||
828.e: May the Word of the Guru's Shabad abide within my heart, and the Lord's Name be enshrined within my mind.

828.g: ਤਸਕਰ ਪੰਚ ਨਿਵਾਰਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਗਲੋ ਭਰਮਾ ਹੋਮਿ ਜਰਹੁ ॥੧॥
828.t: tasakar pa(n)ch nivaarahu Thaakur sagalo bharamaa hom jarahu ||1||
828.e: Drive out the five thieves, O my Lord and Master, and let my doubts all burn like incense. ||1||

828.g: ਜੋ ਤੁਮੑ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨੈ ਭਾਵਨੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਟਰਹੁ ॥
828.t: jo tum(h) karahu soiee bhal maanai bhaavan dhubidhaa dhoor Tarahu ||
828.e: Whatever You do, I accept as good; I have driven out the sense of duality.

828.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਦਾਤੇ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਲੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਉਧਰਹੁ ॥੨॥੩॥੧੧੯॥
828.t: naanak ke prabh tum hee dhaate sa(n)tasa(n)g le moh udharahu ||2||3||119||
828.e: You are Nanak's God, the Great Giver; in the Congregation of the Saints, emancipate me. ||2||3||119||

828.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
828.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
828.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

828.g: ਐਸੀ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਮੰਗਾ ॥
828.t: aaisee dheekhiaa jan siau ma(n)gaa ||
828.e: I ask for such advice from Your humble servants,

828.g: ਤੁਮੑਰੋ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੋ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
828.t: tum(h)ro dhiaan tum(h)aaro ra(n)gaa ||
828.e: that I may meditate on You, and love You,

828.g: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਅੰਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
828.t: tum(h)ree sevaa tum(h)aare a(n)gaa ||1|| rahaau ||
828.e: and serve You, and become part and parcel of Your Being. ||1||Pause||

828.g: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਸੰਭਾਖਨੁ ਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਊਠਨੁ ਬੈਠਨੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਾ ॥
828.t: jan kee Tahal sa(n)bhaakhan jan siau uooThan baiThan jan kai sa(n)gaa ||
828.e: I serve His humble servants, and speak with them, and abide with them.

828.g: ਜਨ ਚਰ ਰਜ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਥੈ ਲਾਗੀ ਆਸਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਨੰਤ ਤਰੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
828.t: jan char raj mukh maathai laagee aasaa pooran ana(n)t tara(n)gaa ||1||
828.e: I apply the dust of the feet of His humble servants to my face and forehead; my hopes, and the many waves of desire, are fulfilled. ||1||

828.g: ਜਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਤੀਰਥ ਕੋਟਿ ਗੰਗਾ ॥
828.t: jan paarabraham jaa kee niramal mahimaa jan ke charan teerath koT ga(n)gaa ||
828.e: Immaculate and pure are the praises of the humble servants of the Supreme Lord God; the feet of His humble servants are equal to millions of sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

828.g: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਕੀਓ ਮਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਹਰੇ ਕਲੰਗਾ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੨੦॥
828.t: jan kee dhoor keeo majan naanak janam janam ke hare kala(n)gaa ||2||4||120||
828.e: Nanak bathes in the dust of the feet of His humble servants; the sinful resides of countless incarnations have been washed away. ||2||4||120||

828.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
828.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
828.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

828.g: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਮੋਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
828.t: jiau bhaavai tiau moh pratipaal ||
828.e: If it pleases You, then cherish me.

828.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੁਮੑ ਪਿਤਾ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
828.t: paarabraham paramesar satigur ham baarik tum(h) pitaa kirapaal ||1|| rahaau ||
828.e: O Supreme Lord God, Transcendent Lord, O True Guru, I am Your child, and You are my Merciful Father. ||1||Pause||

828.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਘਾਲ ॥
828.t: moh niragun gun naahee koiee pahuch na saakau tum(h)ree ghaal ||
828.e: I am worthless; I have no virtues at all. I cannot understand Your actions.

828.g: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੁਮਰੋ ਮਾਲ ॥੧॥
828.t: tumaree gat mit tum hee jaanahu jeeau pi(n)dd sabh tumaro maal ||1||
828.e: You alone know Your state and extent. My soul, body and property are all Yours. ||1||

828.g: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਨਬੋਲਤ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਹਾਲ ॥
828.t: a(n)tarajaamee purakh suaamee anabolat hee jaanahu haal ||
828.e: You are the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, the Primal Lord and Master; You know even what is unspoken.

828.g: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੨੧॥
828.t: tan man seetal hoi hamaaro naanak prabh jeeau nadhar nihaal ||2||5||121||
828.e: My body and mind are cooled and soothed, O Nanak, by God's Glance of Grace. ||2||5||121||

828.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
828.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
828.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

828.g: ਰਾਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੈ ਸਾਥ ॥
828.t: raakh sadhaa prabh apanai saath ||
828.e: Keep me with You forever, O God.

828.g: ਤੂ ਹਮਰੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਮਨਮੋਹਨੁ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਸਗਲ ਅਕਾਥ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
828.t: too hamaro preetam manmohan tujh bin jeevan sagal akaath ||1|| rahaau ||
828.e: You are my Beloved, the Enticer of my mind; without You, my life is totally useless. ||1||Pause||

828.g: ਰੰਕ ਤੇ ਰਾਉ ਕਰਤ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਅਨਾਥ ਕੋ ਨਾਥ ॥
828.t: ra(n)k te raau karat khin bheetar prabh mero anaath ko naath ||
828.e: In an instant, You transform the beggar into a king; O my God, You are the Master of the masterless.

828.g: ਜਲਤ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਜਨ ਆਪਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦੇ ਰਾਖੇ ਹਾਥ ॥੧॥
828.t: jalat agan meh jan aap udhaare kar apune dhe raakhe haath ||1||
828.e: You save Your humble servants from the burning fire; You make them Your own, and with Your Hand, You protect them. ||1||

828.g: ਸੀਤਲ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਮਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸ੍ਰਮ ਸਗਲੇ ਲਾਥ ॥
828.t: seetal sukh paio man tirapate har simarat sram sagale laath ||
828.e: I have found peace and cool tranquility, and my mind is satisfied; meditating in remembrance on the Lord, all struggles are ended.

828.g: ਨਿਧਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਅਵਰ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸਗਲ ਅਕਾਥ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੨੨॥
828.t: nidh nidhaan naanak har sevaa avar siaanap sagal akaath ||2||6||122||
828.e: Service to the Lord, O Nanak, is the treasure of treasures; all other clever tricks are useless. ||2||6||122||

829.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
829.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
829.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

829.g: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਬਿਸਾਰਹੁ ॥
829.t: apane sevak kau kabahu na bisaarahu ||
829.e: Never forget Your servant, O Lord.

829.g: ਉਰਿ ਲਾਗਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਪੂਰਬ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਬੀਚਾਰਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
829.t: aur laagahu suaamee prabh mere poorab preet gobi(n)dh beechaarahu ||1|| rahaau ||
829.e: Hug me close in Your embrace, O God, my Lord and Master; consider my primal love for You, O Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

829.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੋ ਹਮਰੇ ਦੋਖ ਰਿਦੈ ਮਤ ਧਾਰਹੁ ॥
829.t: patit paavan prabh biradh tum(h)aaro hamare dhokh ridhai mat dhaarahu ||
829.e: It is Your Natural Way, God, to purify sinners; please do not keep my errors in Your Heart.

829.g: ਜੀਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਟਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਰਹੁ ॥੧॥
829.t: jeevan praan har dhan sukh tum hee haumai paTal kirapaa kar jaarahu ||1||
829.e: You are my life, my breath of life, O Lord, my wealth and peace; be merciful to me, and burn away the curtain of egotism. ||1||

829.g: ਜਲ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਮੀਨ ਕਤ ਜੀਵਨ ਦੂਧ ਬਿਨਾ ਰਹਨੁ ਕਤ ਬਾਰੋ ॥
829.t: jal bihoon meen kat jeevan dhoodh binaa rahan kat baaro ||
829.e: Without water, how can the fish survive? Without milk, how can the baby survive?

829.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਆਸ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲਨੑ ਕੀ ਪੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੋ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੨੩॥
829.t: jan naanak piaas charan kamalan(h) kee pekh dharas suaamee sukh saaro ||2||7||123||
829.e: Servant Nanak thirsts for the Lord's Lotus Feet; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of his Lord and Master's Darshan, he finds the essence of peace. ||2||7||123||

829.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
829.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
829.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

829.g: ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
829.t: aagai paachhai kusal bhiaa ||
829.e: Here, and hereafter, there is happiness.

829.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰੀ ਸਭ ਰਾਖੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਮਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
829.t: gur poorai pooree sabh raakhee paarabraham prabh keenee miaa ||1|| rahaau ||
829.e: The Perfect Guru has perfectly, totally saved me; the Supreme Lord God has been kind to me. ||1||Pause||

829.g: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਸਗਲਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
829.t: man tan rav rahiaa har preetam dhookh dharadh sagalaa miT giaa ||
829.e: The Lord, my Beloved, is pervading and permeating my mind and body; all my pains and sufferings are dispelled.

829.g: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਆਨਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਦੂਤ ਦੁਸਟ ਸਭਿ ਹੋਏ ਖਇਆ ॥੧॥
829.t: saa(n)t sahaj aanadh gun gaae dhoot dhusaT sabh hoe khiaa ||1||
829.e: In celestial peace, tranquility and bliss, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; my enemies and adversaries have been totally destroyed. ||1||

829.g: ਗੁਨੁ ਅਵਗੁਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
829.t: gun avagun prabh kachh na beechaario kar kirapaa apunaa kar liaa ||
829.e: God has not considered my merits and demerits; in His Mercy, He has made me His own.

829.g: ਅਤੁਲ ਬਡਾਈ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਉਚਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਜਇਆ ॥੨॥੮॥੧੨੪॥
829.t: atul baddaiee achut abinaasee naanak ucharai har kee jiaa ||2||8||124||
829.e: Unweighable is the greatness of the immovable and imperishable Lord; Nanak proclaims the victory of the Lord. ||2||8||124||

829.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
829.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
829.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

829.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਭੈ ਭਗਤੀ ਤਰਨੁ ਕੈਸੇ ॥
829.t: bin bhai bhagatee taran kaise ||
829.e: Without the Fear of God, and devotional worship, how can anyone cross over the world-ocean?

829.g: ਕਰਹੁ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਰਾਖੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਪ ਭਰੋਸੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
829.t: karahu anugrahu patit udhaaran raakh suaamee aap bharose ||1|| rahaau ||
829.e: Be kind to me, O Saving Grace of sinners; preserve my faith in You, O my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

829.g: ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਵਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਮਦ ਮਾਵਤ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਾਤਾ ਸੁਆਨ ਜੈਸੇ ॥
829.t: simaran nahee aavat firat madh maavat bikhiaa raataa suaan jaise ||
829.e: The mortal does not remember the Lord in meditation; he wanders around intoxicated by egotism; he is engrossed in corruption like a dog.

829.g: ਅਉਧ ਬਿਹਾਵਤ ਅਧਿਕ ਮੋਹਾਵਤ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਵਤ ਬੁਡੇ ਐਸੇ ॥੧॥
829.t: aaudh bihaavat adhik mohaavat paap kamaavat budde aaise ||1||
829.e: Utterly cheated, his life is slipping away; committing sins, he is sinking away. ||1||

829.g: ਸਰਨਿ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਪੁਰਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਵਣੁ ਜੈਸੇ ॥
829.t: saran dhukh bha(n)jan purakh nira(n)jan saadhoo sa(n)gat ravan jaise ||
829.e: I have come to Your Sanctuary, Destroyer of pain; O Primal Immaculate Lord, may I dwell upon You in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

829.g: ਕੇਸਵ ਕਲੇਸ ਨਾਸ ਅਘ ਖੰਡਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵਤ ਦਰਸ ਦਿਸੇ ॥੨॥੯॥੧੨੫॥
829.t: kesav kales naas agh kha(n)ddan naanak jeevat dharas dhise ||2||9||125||
829.e: O Lord of beautiful hair, Destroyer of pain, Eradicator of sins, Nanak lives, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||2||9||125||

829.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੯
829.t: raag bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa dhupadhe ghar nauvaa
829.e: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla, Dho-Padhay, Ninth House:

829.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
829.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
829.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

829.g: ਆਪਹਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ॥
829.t: aapeh mel le ||
829.e: He Himself merges us with Himself.

829.g: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਆਏ ਤਬ ਤੇ ਦੋਖ ਗਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
829.t: jab te saran tumaaree aae tab te dhokh ge ||1|| rahaau ||
829.e: When I came to Your Sanctuary, my sins vanished. ||1||Pause||

829.g: ਤਜਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਅਰੁ ਚਿੰਤ ਬਿਰਾਨੀ ਸਾਧਹ ਸਰਨ ਪਏ ॥
829.t: taj abhimaan ar chi(n)t biraanee saadheh saran pe ||
829.e: Renouncing egotistical pride and other anxieties, I have sought the Sanctuary of the Holy Saints.

829.g: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਰੋਗ ਖਏ ॥੧॥
829.t: jap jap naam tum(h)aaro preetam tan te rog khe ||1||
829.e: Chanting, meditating on Your Name, O my Beloved, disease is eradicated from my body. ||1||

829.g: ਮਹਾ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਜਾਨ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਰਾਖੇ ਧਾਰਿ ਦਏ ॥
829.t: mahaa mugadh ajaan agiaanee raakhe dhaar dhe ||
829.e: Even utterly foolish, ignorant and thoughtless persons have been saved by the Kind Lord.

829.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨ ਰਹੇ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੨੬॥
829.t: kahu naanak gur pooraa bheTio aavan jaan rahe ||2||1||126||
829.e: Says Nanak, I have met the Perfect Guru; my comings and goings have ended. ||2||1||126||

829.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
829.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
829.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

829.g: ਜੀਵਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨੀ ॥
829.t: jeevau naam sunee ||
829.e: Hearing Your Name, I live.

829.g: ਜਉ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤਬ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪੁਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
829.t: jau suprasa(n)n bhe gur poore tab meree aas punee ||1|| rahaau ||
829.e: When the Perfect Guru became pleased with me, then my hopes were fulfilled. ||1||Pause||

829.g: ਪੀਰ ਗਈ ਬਾਧੀ ਮਨਿ ਧੀਰਾ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਅਨਦ ਧੁਨੀ ॥
829.t: peer giee baadhee man dheeraa mohio anadh dhunee ||
829.e: Pain is gone, and my mind is comforted; the music of bliss fascinates me.

829.g: ਉਪਜਿਓ ਚਾਉ ਮਿਲਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਖਿਨੀ ॥੧॥
829.t: aupajio chaau milan prabh preetam rahan na jai khinee ||1||
829.e: The yearning to meet my Beloved God has welled up within me. I cannot live without Him, even for an instant. ||1||

830.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਗਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨ ਤਾਰੇ ਸਿਮਰਹਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਮੁਨੀ ॥
830.t: anik bhagat anik jan taare simareh anik munee ||
830.e: You have saved so many devotees, so many humble servants; so many silent sages contemplate You.

830.g: ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਟਿਕ ਨਿਰਧਨ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਗੁਨੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੨੭॥
830.t: a(n)dhule Tik niradhan dhan paio prabh naanak anik gunee ||2||2||127||
830.e: The support of the blind, the wealth of the poor; Nanak has found God, of endless virtues. ||2||2||127||

830.t: raag bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ghar tayrvaa paRataal
830.e: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla, Thirteenth House, Partaal:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

830.g: ਮੋਹਨ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਵੈ ਹਾਰ ਕਜਰ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਭਰਨ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
830.t: mohan needh na aavai haavai haar kajar basatr abharan keene ||
830.e: O Enticing Lord, I cannot sleep; I sigh. I am adorned with necklaces, gowns, ornaments and make-up.
I am sad, sad and depressed.
When will You come home? ||1||Pause||
I seek the Sanctuary of the happy soul-brides; I place my head upon their feet.
Unite me with my Beloved.
When will He come to my home? ||1||

830.g: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸਹੇਰੀ ਮਿਲਨ ਬਾਤ ਕਹਉ ਸਗਰੋ ਅਹੰ ਮਿਟਾਵਹੁ ਤਉ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਲਾਲਨੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
830.t: sunahu saheree milan baat kahau sagaro aha(n) miTaavahu tau ghar hee laalan paavahu ||
830.e: Listen, my companions: tell me how to meet Him. Eradicate all egotism, and then you shall find your Beloved Lord within the home of your heart.
Then, in delight, you shall sing the songs of joy and praise.
Meditate on the Lord, the embodiment of bliss.
O Nanak, I came to the Lord's Door,
and then, I found my Beloved. ||2||
The Enticing Lord has revealed His form to me,
and now, sleep seems sweet to me.
My thirst is totally quenched,
and now, I am absorbed in celestial bliss.
How sweet is the story of my Husband Lord.

830.g: ਮੋਹਨੁ ਲਾਲਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੧੨੮॥
830.t: mohan laalan paio ree || rahaau dhoojaa ||1||128||
830.e: I have found my Beloved, Enticing Lord. ||Second Pause||1||128||
Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

830.g: ਮੋਰੀ ਅਹੰ ਜਾਇ ਦਰਸਨ ਪਾਵਤ ਹੇ ॥
830.t: moree aha(n) jai dharasan paavat he ||
830.e: My ego is gone; I have obtained the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.
I am absorbed in my Lord and Master, the help and support of the Saints.
Now, I hold tight to His Feet. ||1||Pause||

830.g: ਆਹੇ ਮਨ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਚਰਨਾਵੈ ਚਰਨਾਵੈ ਉਲਝਿਓ ਅਲਿ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਕਮਲ ਜਿਉ ॥
830.t: aahe man avar na bhaavai charanaavai charanaavai ulajhio al makara(n)dh kamal jiau ||
830.e: My mind longs for Him, and does not love any other. I am totally absorbed, in love with His Lotus Feet, like the bumble bee attached to the honey of the lotus flower.

830.g: ਅਨ ਰਸ ਨਹੀ ਚਾਹੈ ਏਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹੈ ॥੧॥
830.t: an ras nahee chaahai ekai har laahai ||1||
830.e: I do not desire any other taste; I seek only the One Lord. ||1||

830.g: ਅਨ ਤੇ ਟੂਟੀਐ ਰਿਖ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੀਐ ॥
830.t: an te TooTeeaai rikh te chhooTeeaai ||
830.e: I have broken away from the others, and I have been released from the Messenger of Death.

830.g: ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਘੂਟੀਐ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਉਲਟੀਐ ॥
830.t: man har ras ghooTeeaai sa(n)g saadhoo ulaTeeaai ||
830.e: O mind, drink in the subtle essence of the Lord; join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and turn away from the world.
There is no other, none other than the Lord.
O Nanak, love the Feet, the Feet of the Lord. ||2||2||129||
Raag Bilaaval, Ninth Mehla, Dho-Padhay:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The Name of the Lord is the Dispeller of sorrow - realize this.

830.g: ਅਜਾਮਲੁ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮੁਕਤ ਭਏ ਜੀਅ ਜਾਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
830.t: ajaamal ganikaa jeh simarat mukat bhe jeea jaano ||1|| rahaau ||
830.e: Remembering Him in meditation, even Ajaamal the robber and Ganikaa the prostitute were liberated; let your soul know this. ||1||Pause||

830.g: ਗਜ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਮਿਟੀ ਛਿਨਹੂ ਮਹਿ ਜਬ ਹੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਬਖਾਨੋ ॥
830.t: gaj kee traas miTee chhinahoo meh jab hee raam bakhaano ||
830.e: The elephant's fear was taken away in an instant, as soon as he chanted the Lord's Name.

830.g: ਨਾਰਦ ਕਹਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਧ੍ਰੂਅ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਭਜਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਲਪਟਾਨੋ ॥੧॥
830.t: naaradh kahat sunat dhraooa baarik bhajan maeh lapaTaano ||1||
830.e: Listening to Naarad's teachings, the child Dhroo was absorbed in deep meditation. ||1||

830.g: ਅਚਲ ਅਮਰ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਜਗਤ ਜਾਹਿ ਹੈਰਾਨੋ ॥
830.t: achal amar nirabhai padh paio jagat jaeh hairaano ||
830.e: He obtained the immovable, eternal state of fearlessness, and all the world was amazed.

830.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ ਭਗਤ ਰਛਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਨੋ ॥੨॥੧॥
830.t: naanak kahat bhagat rachhak har nikaT taeh tum maano ||2||1||
830.e: Says Nanak, the Lord is the Saving Grace and the Protector of His devotees; believe it - He is close to you. ||2||1||
Bilaaval, Ninth Mehla:

830.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
830.t: har ke naam binaa dhukh paavai ||
830.e: Without the Name of the Lord, you shall only find pain.

830.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਹਸਾ ਨਹ ਚੂਕੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਇਹੁ ਭੇਦੁ ਬਤਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
830.t: bhagat binaa sahasaa neh chookai gur ih bhedh bataavai ||1|| rahaau ||
830.e: Without devotional worship, doubt is not dispelled; the Guru has revealed this secret. ||1||Pause||

830.g: ਕਹਾ ਭਇਓ ਤੀਰਥ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਕੀਏ ਰਾਮ ਸਰਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਵੈ ॥
830.t: kahaa bhio teerath brat ke'ee raam saran nahee aavai ||
830.e: Of what use are sacred shrines of pilgrimage, if one does not enter the Sanctuary of the Lord?

831.g: ਜੋਗ ਜਗ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਤਿਹ ਮਾਨਉ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਸੁ ਬਿਸਰਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
831.t: jog jag nihafal teh maanau jo prabh jas bisaraavai ||1||
831.e: Know that Yoga and sacrificial feasts are fruitless, if one forgets the Praises of God. ||1||

831.g: ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਦੋਨੋ ਕਉ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
831.t: maan moh dhono kau parahar gobi(n)dh ke gun gaavai ||
831.e: One who lays aside both pride and attachment, sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

831.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਹਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੨॥
831.t: kahu naanak ieh bidh ko praanee jeevan mukat kahaavai ||2||2||
831.e: Says Nanak, the mortal who does this is said to be 'jivan mukta' - liberated while yet alive. ||2||2||
Bilaaval, Ninth Mehla:

831.g: ਜਾ ਮੈ ਭਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
831.t: jaa mai bhajan raam ko naahee ||
831.e: There is no meditation on the Lord within him.

831.g: ਤਿਹ ਨਰ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਰਥੁ ਖੋਇਆ ਯਹ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
831.t: teh nar janam akaarath khoiaa yeh raakhahu man maahee ||1|| rahaau ||
831.e: That man wastes his life uselessly - keep this in mind. ||1||Pause||

831.g: ਤੀਰਥ ਕਰੈ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਫੁਨਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਨਹ ਮਨੂਆ ਬਸਿ ਜਾ ਕੋ ॥
831.t: teerath karai brat fun raakhai neh manooaa bas jaa ko ||
831.e: He bathes at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and adheres to fasts, but he has no control over his mind.

831.g: ਨਿਹਫਲ ਧਰਮੁ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹਤ ਮੈ ਯਾ ਕਉ ॥੧॥
831.t: nihafal dharam taeh tum maanahu saach kahat mai yaa kau ||1||
831.e: Know that such religion is useless to him. I speak the Truth for his sake. ||1||

831.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਪਾਹਨੁ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਭੇਦੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਤਿਹ ਪਾਨੀ ॥
831.t: jaise paahan jal meh raakhio bhedhai naeh teh paanee ||
831.e: It's like a stone, kept immersed in water; still, the water does not penetrate it.

831.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਤੁਮ ਤਾਹਿ ਪਛਾਨਹੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੀਨ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
831.t: taise hee tum taeh pachhaanahu bhagat heen jo praanee ||2||
831.e: So, understand it: that mortal being who lacks devotional worship is just like that. ||2||

831.g: ਕਲ ਮੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਤੇ ਪਾਵਤ ਗੁਰੁ ਯਹ ਭੇਦੁ ਬਤਾਵੈ ॥
831.t: kal mai mukat naam te paavat gur yeh bhedh bataavai ||
831.e: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, liberation comes from the Naam. The Guru has revealed this secret.

831.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋਈ ਨਰੁ ਗਰੂਆ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੩॥੩॥
831.t: kahu naanak soiee nar garooaa jo prabh ke gun gaavai ||3||3||
831.e: Says Nanak, he alone is a great man, who sings the Praises of God. ||3||3||

831.t: bilaaval asaTapadheeaa mahalaa pehilaa ghar dasvaa
831.e: Bilaaval, Ashtpadheeyaa, First Mehla, Tenth House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
He dwells close at hand, and sees all,
but how rare is the Gurmukh who understands this.

831.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਭੈ ਪਇਐ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
831.t: vin bhai piaai bhagat na hoiee ||
831.e: Without the Fear of God, there is no devotional worship.
Imbued with the Word of the Shabad, eternal peace is attained. ||1||
Such is the spiritual wisdom, the treasure of the Naam;

831.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
831.t: gurmukh paavas ras ras maan ||1|| rahaau ||
831.e: obtaining it, the Gurmukhs enjoy the subtle essence of this nectar. ||1||Pause||
Everyone talks about spiritual wisdom and spiritual knowledge.

831.g: ਕਥਿ ਕਥਿ ਬਾਦੁ ਕਰੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
831.t: kath kath baadh kare dhukh hoiee ||
831.e: Talking, talking, they argue, and suffer.

831.g: ਕਥਿ ਕਹਣੈ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
831.t: kath kahanai te rahai na koiee ||
831.e: No one can stop talking and discussing it.

831.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
831.t: bin ras raate mukat na hoiee ||2||
831.e: Without being imbued with the subtle essence, there is no liberation. ||2||

831.g: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
831.t: giaan dhiaan sabh gur te hoiee ||
831.e: Spiritual wisdom and meditation all come from the Guru.
Through the lifestyle of Truth, the True Lord comes to dwell in the mind.

831.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਥਨੀ ਹੈ ਪਰੁ ਰਹਤ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
831.t: manmukh kathanee hai par rahat na hoiee ||
831.e: The self-willed manmukh talks about it, but does not practice it.
Forgetting the Name, he finds no place of rest. ||3||
Maya has caught the mind in the trap of the whirlpool.

831.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਬਿਆਪਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਬਿਖੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
831.t: ghaT ghaT biaap rahio bikh naal ||
831.e: Each and every heart is trapped by this bait of poison and sin.
See that whoever has come, is subject to death.
Your affairs shall be adjusted, if you contemplate the Lord in your heart. ||4||

831.g: ਸੋ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
831.t: so giaanee jin sabadh liv laiee ||
831.e: He alone is a spiritual teacher, who lovingly focuses his consciousness on the Word of the Shabad.
The self-willed, egotistical manmukh loses his honor.
The Creator Lord Himself inspires us to His devotional worship.
He Himself blesses the Gurmukh with glorious greatness. ||5||
The life-night is dark, while the Divine Light is immaculate.
Those who lack the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are false, filthy and untouchable.
The Vedas preach sermons of devotional worship.
Listening, hearing and believing, one beholds the Divine Light. ||6||
The Shaastras and Simritees implant the Naam within.
The Gurmukh lives in peace and tranquility, doing deeds of sublime purity.
The self-willed manmukh suffers the pains of reincarnation.
His bonds are broken, enshrining the Name of the One Lord. ||7||
Believing in the Naam, one obtains true honor and adoration.
Who should I see? There is none other than the Lord.
I see, and I say, that He alone is pleasing to my mind.
Says Nanak, there is no other at all. ||8||1||

832.e: Bilaaval, First Mehla:
The human acts according to the wishes of the mind.
This mind feeds on virtue and vice.

832.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦਿ ਮਾਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
832.t: maiaa madh maate tirapat na aavai ||
832.e: Intoxicated with the wine of Maya, satisfaction never comes.
Satisfaction and liberation come, only to one whose mind is pleasing to the True Lord. ||1||

832.g: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਖੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
832.t: tan dhan kalat sabh dhekh abhimaanaa ||
832.e: Gazing upon his body, wealth, wife and all his possessions, he is proud.

832.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
832.t: bin naavai kichh sa(n)g na jaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
832.e: But without the Name of the Lord, nothing shall go along with him. ||1||Pause||

832.g: ਕੀਚਹਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਮਨ ਕੇਰੀ ॥
832.t: keecheh ras bhog khuseeaa man keree ||
832.e: He enjoys tastes, pleasures and joys in his mind.
But his wealth will pass on to other people, and his body will be reduced to ashes.
The entire expanse, like dust, shall mix with dust.
Without the Word of the Shabad, his filth is not removed. ||2||

832.g: ਗੀਤ ਰਾਗ ਘਨ ਤਾਲ ਸਿ ਕੂਰੇ ॥
832.t: geet raag ghan taal s koore ||
832.e: The various songs, tunes and rhythms are false.
Trapped by the three qualities, people come and go, far from the Lord.
In duality, the pain of their evil-mindedness does not leave them.
But the Gurmukh is emancipated by taking the medicine, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||
He may wear a clean loin-cloth, apply the ceremonial mark to his forehead, and wear a mala around his neck;
but if there is anger within him, he is merely reading his part, like an actor in a play.
Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he drinks in the wine of Maya.

832.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੪॥
832.t: bin gur bhagat naahee sukh theeaa ||4||
832.e: Without devotional worship to the Guru, there is no peace. ||4||
The human is a pig, a dog, a donkey, a cat,
a beast, a filthy, lowly wretch, an outcast,

832.g: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮੁਹੁ ਫੇਰੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਐ ॥
832.t: gur te muh fere tin(h) jon bhavaieeaai ||
832.e: if he turns his face away from the Guru. He shall wander in reincarnation.
Bound in bondage, he comes and goes. ||5||
Serving the Guru, the treasure is found.
With the Naam in the heart, one always prospers.
And in the Court of the True Lord, you shall not called to account.
One who obeys the Hukam of the Lord's Command, is approved at the Lord's Door. ||6||

832.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
832.t: satigur milai ta tis kau jaanai ||
832.e: Meeting the True Guru, one knows the Lord.
Understanding the Hukam of His Command, one acts according to His Will.
Understanding the Hukam of His Command, he dwells in the Court of the True Lord.
Through the Shabad, death and birth are ended. ||7||

832.g: ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ॥
832.t: rahai ateet jaanai sabh tis kaa ||
832.e: He remains detached, knowing that everything belongs to God.

832.g: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪੈ ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ॥
832.t: tan man arapai hai ih jis kaa ||
832.e: He dedicates his body and mind unto the One who owns them.

832.g: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
832.t: naa oh aavai naa oh jai ||
832.e: He does not come, and he does not go.
O Nanak, absorbed in Truth, he merges in the True Lord. ||8||2||

832.t: bilaaval mahalaa teejaa asaTapadhee ghar dasvaa
832.e: Bilaaval, Third Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, Tenth House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The world is like a crow; with its beak, it croaks spiritual wisdom.
But deep within there is greed, falsehood and pride.
Without the Name of the Lord, your thin outer covering shall wear off, you fool. ||1||

832.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
832.t: satigur sev naam vasai man cheet ||
832.e: Serving the True Guru, the Naam shall dwell in your conscious mind.

832.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੇਤਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰ ਝੂਠੁ ਪਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
832.t: gur bheTe har naam chetaavai bin naavai hor jhooTh pareet ||1|| rahaau ||
832.e: Meeting with the Guru, the Name of the Lord comes to mind. Without the Name, other loves are false. ||1||Pause||
So do that work, which the Guru tells you to do.
Contemplating the Word of the Shabad, you shall come to the home of celestial bliss.
Through the True Name, you shall obtain glorious greatness. ||2||
One who does not understand his own self, but still tries to instruct others,
is mentally blind, and acts in blindness.

832.g: ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਠਉਰੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
832.t: dhar ghar mahal Thaur kaise paavai ||3||
832.e: How can he ever find a home and a place of rest, in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence? ||3||
Serve the Dear Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts;

832.g: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥
832.t: ghaT ghaT a(n)tar jis kee jot samaanee ||
832.e: deep within each and every heart, His Light is shining forth.
How can anyone hide anything from Him? ||4||

833.g: ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
833.t: saachaa naam saachai sabadh jaanai ||
833.e: The True Name is known through the True Word of the Shabad.

833.g: ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਚੂਕੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੈ ॥
833.t: aapai aap milai chookai abhimaanai ||
833.e: The Lord Himself meets that one who eradicates egotistical pride.

833.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਖਾਨੈ ॥੫॥
833.t: gurmukh naam sadhaa sadhaa vakhaanai ||5||
833.e: The Gurmukh chants the Naam, forever and ever. ||5||

833.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਦੂਜੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
833.t: satigur seviaai dhoojee dhuramat jaiee ||
833.e: Serving the True Guru, duality and evil-mindedness are taken away.

833.g: ਅਉਗਣ ਕਾਟਿ ਪਾਪਾ ਮਤਿ ਖਾਈ ॥
833.t: aaugan kaaT paapaa mat khaiee ||
833.e: Guilty mistakes are erased, and the sinful intellect is cleansed.

833.g: ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੬॥
833.t: ka(n)chan kaiaa jotee jot samaiee ||6||
833.e: One's body sparkles like gold, and one's light merges into the Light. ||6||

833.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
833.t: satigur miliaai vaddee vaddiaaiee ||
833.e: Meeting with the True Guru, one is blessed with glorious greatness.

833.g: ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
833.t: dhukh kaaTai hiradhai naam vasaiee ||
833.e: Pain is taken away, and the Naam comes to dwell within the heart.

833.g: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੭॥
833.t: naam rate sadhaa sukh paiee ||7||
833.e: Imbued with the Naam, one finds eternal peace. ||7||

833.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
833.t: gurmat maaniaa karanee saar ||
833.e: Obeying the Gur's instructions, one's actions are purified.

833.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
833.t: gurmat maaniaa mokh dhuaar ||
833.e: Obeying the Guru's Instructions, one finds the state of salvation.

833.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਪਰਵਾਰੈ ਸਾਧਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੧॥੩॥
833.t: naanak gurmat maaniaa paravaarai saadhaar ||8||1||3||
833.e: O Nanak, those who follow the Guru's Teachings are saved, along with their families. ||8||1||3||

833.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੧੧
833.t: bilaaval mahalaa chauthhaa asaTapadheeaa ghar gayaarvaa
833.e: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, Eleventh House:

833.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
833.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
833.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

833.g: ਆਪੈ ਆਪੁ ਖਾਇ ਹਉ ਮੇਟੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਗੀਤ ਗਵਈਆ ॥
833.t: aapai aap khai hau meTai anadhin har ras geet gavieeaa ||
833.e: One who eliminates his self-centeredness, and eradicates his ego, night and day sings the songs of the Lord's Love.

833.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਚੈ ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਈਆ ॥੧॥
833.t: gurmukh parachai ka(n)chan kaiaa nirabhau jotee jot milieeaa ||1||
833.e: The Gurmukh is inspired, his body is golden, and his light merges into the Light of the Fearless Lord. ||1||

833.g: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਰਮਈਆ ॥
833.t: mai har har naam adhaar ramieeaa ||
833.e: I take the Support of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

833.g: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਠ ਪੜਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
833.t: khin pal reh na sakau bin naavai gurmukh har har paaTh paRieeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
833.e: I cannot live, for a moment, even for an instant, without the Name of the Lord; the Gurmukh reads the Sermon of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

833.g: ਏਕੁ ਗਿਰਹੁ ਦਸ ਦੁਆਰ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਤਸਕਰ ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਲਗਈਆ ॥
833.t: ek girahu dhas dhuaar hai jaa ke ahinis tasakar pa(n)ch chor lagieeaa ||
833.e: In the one house of the body, there are ten gates; night and day, the five thieves break in.

833.g: ਧਰਮੁ ਅਰਥੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਿਰਿ ਲੇ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਈਆ ॥੨॥
833.t: dharam arath sabh hir le jaaveh manmukh a(n)dhule khabar na pieeaa ||2||
833.e: They steal the entire wealth of one's Dharmic faith, but the blind, self-willed manmukh does not know it. ||2||

833.g: ਕੰਚਨ ਕੋਟੁ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣਕਿ ਭਰਿਆ ਜਾਗੇ ਗਿਆਨ ਤਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਈਆ ॥
833.t: ka(n)chan koT bahu maanak bhariaa jaage giaan tat liv lieeaa ||
833.e: The fortress of the body is overflowing with gold and jewels; when it is awakened by spiritual wisdom, one enshrines love for the essence of reality.

833.g: ਤਸਕਰ ਹੇਰੂ ਆਇ ਲੁਕਾਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਕੜਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੩॥
833.t: tasakar heroo aai lukaane gur kai sabadh pakaR ba(n)dh pieeaa ||3||
833.e: The thieves and robbers hide out in the body; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are arrested and locked up. ||3||

833.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੋਤੁ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਈਆ ॥
833.t: har har naam pot bohithaa khevaT sabadh gur paar la(n)ghieeaa ||
833.e: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the boat, and the Word of the Guru's Shabad is the boatman, to carry us across.

833.g: ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਚੋਰੁ ਲਗਈਆ ॥੪॥
833.t: jam jaagaatee neR na aavai naa ko tasakar chor lagieeaa ||4||
833.e: The Messenger of Death, the tax collector, does not even come close, and no thieves or robbers can plunder you. ||4||

833.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਹਤੇ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਲਹੀਆ ॥
833.t: har gun gaavai sadhaa dhin raatee mai har jas kahate a(n)t na laheeaa ||
833.e: I continuously sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, day and night; singing the Lord's Praises, I cannot find His limits.

833.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਮਿਲਉ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ਬਜਈਆ ॥੫॥
833.t: gurmukh manooaa ikat ghar aavai milau guopaal neesaan bajieeaa ||5||
833.e: The mind of the Gurmukh returns to its own home; it meets the Lord of the Universe, to the beat of the celestial drum. ||5||

833.g: ਨੈਨੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਈਆ ॥
833.t: nainee dhekh dharas man tirapatai sravan baanee gur sabadh sunieeaa ||
833.e: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan with my eyes, my mind is satisfied; with my ears, I listen to the Guru's Bani, and the Word of His Shabad.

833.g: ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਆਤਮ ਦੇਵ ਹੈ ਭੀਨੇ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਾਮ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਰਵਈਆ ॥੬॥
833.t: sun sun aatam dhev hai bheene ras ras raam gopaal ravieeaa ||6||
833.e: Listening, listening, my soul is softened, delighted by His subtle essence, chanting the Name of the Lord of the Universe. ||6||

833.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਤੁਰੀਆ ਗੁਣੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਹੀਆ ॥
833.t: trai gun maiaa moh viaape tureeaa gun hai gurmukh laheeaa ||
833.e: In the grip of the three qualities, they are engrossed in love and attachment to Maya; only as Gurmukh do they find the absolute quality, absorption in bliss.

833.g: ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਸਰਈਆ ॥੭॥
833.t: ek dhirasaT sabh sam kar jaanai nadharee aavai sabh braham pasarieeaa ||7||
833.e: With a single, impartial eye, look upon all alike, and see God pervading all. ||7||

833.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਈਆ ॥
833.t: raam naam hai jot sabaiee gurmukh aape alakh lakhieeaa ||
833.e: The Light of the Lord's Name permeates all; the Gurmukh knows the unknowable.

833.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਈਆ ॥੮॥੧॥੪॥
833.t: naanak dheen dhiaal bhe hai bhagat bhai har naam samieeaa ||8||1||4||
833.e: O Nanak, the Lord has become merciful to the meek; through loving adoration, he merges in the Lord's Name. ||8||1||4||

833.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
833.t: bilaaval mahalaa chauthhaa ||
833.e: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehla:

833.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੀਤਲ ਜਲੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸੁ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਗੰਧਈਆ ॥
833.t: har har naam seetal jal dhiaavahu har cha(n)dhan vaas suga(n)dh ga(n)dhieeaa ||
833.e: Meditate on the cool water of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. Perfume yourself with the fragrant scent of the Lord, the sandalwood tree.

834.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੈ ਹਿਰਡ ਪਲਾਸ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੁਹੀਆ ॥੧॥
834.t: mil satasa(n)gat param padh paiaa mai hiradd palaas sa(n)g har buheeaa ||1||
834.e: Joining the Society of the Saints, I have obtained the supreme status. I am just a castor-oil tree, made fragrant by their association. ||1||

834.g: ਜਪਿ ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਗੁਸਈਆ ॥
834.t: jap jaga(n)naath jagadhees gusieeaa ||
834.e: Meditate on the Lord of the Universe, the Master of the world, the Lord of creation.

834.g: ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ਉਧਾਰਿ ਸਮਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
834.t: saran pare seiee jan ubare jiau prahilaadh udhaar samieeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
834.e: Those humble beings who seek the Lord's Sanctuary are saved, like Prahlaad; they are emancipated and merge with the Lord. ||1||Pause||

834.g: ਭਾਰ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਮਹਿ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਊਤਮ ਚੰਦਨ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਸਭ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਹੁਈਆ ॥
834.t: bhaar aThaareh meh cha(n)dhan uootam cha(n)dhan nikaT sabh cha(n)dhan huieeaa ||
834.e: Of all plants, the sandalwood tree is the most sublime. Everything near the sandalwood tree becomes fragrant like sandalwood.

834.g: ਸਾਕਤ ਕੂੜੇ ਊਭ ਸੁਕ ਹੂਏ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਗਈਆ ॥੨॥
834.t: saakat kooRe uoobh suk hooe man abhimaan vichhuR dhoor gieeaa ||2||
834.e: The stubborn, false faithless cynics are dried up; their egotistical pride separates them far from the Lord. ||2||

834.g: ਹਰਿ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਬਨਈਆ ॥
834.t: har gat mit karataa aape jaanai sabh bidh har har aap banieeaa ||
834.e: Only the Creator Lord Himself knows the state and condition of everyone; the Lord Himself makes all the arrangements.

834.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਸੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਨ ਮਿਟਈਆ ॥੩॥
834.t: jis satigur bheTe su ka(n)chan hovai jo dhur likhiaa su miTai na miTieeaa ||3||
834.e: One who meets the True Guru is transformed into gold. Whatever is pre-ordained, is not erased by erasing. ||3||

834.g: ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਖੁਲੑਈਆ ॥
834.t: ratan padhaarath gurmat paavai saagar bhagat bha(n)ddaar khul(h)ieeaa ||
834.e: The treasure of jewels is found in the ocean of the Guru's Teachings. The treasure of devotional worship is opened to me.

834.g: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਇਕ ਸਰਧਾ ਉਪਜੀ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਭਈਆ ॥੪॥
834.t: gur charanee ik saradhaa upajee mai har gun kahate tirapat na bhieeaa ||4||
834.e: Focused on the Guru's Feet, faith wells up within me; chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I hunger for more. ||4||

834.g: ਪਰਮ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਏ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਤੇ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਕਹੀਆ ॥
834.t: param bairaag nit nit har dhiaae mai har gun kahate bhaavanee kaheeaa ||
834.e: I am totally detached, continually, continuously meditating on the Lord; chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I express my love for Him.

834.g: ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਰੈ ਪਰਈਆ ॥੫॥
834.t: baar baar khin khin pal kaheeaai har paar na paavai parai parieeaa ||5||
834.e: Time and time again, each and every moment and instant, I express it. I cannot find the Lord's limits; He is the farthest of the far. ||5||

834.g: ਸਾਸਤ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਪੁਕਾਰਹਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਖਟੁ ਕਰਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਈਆ ॥
834.t: saasat bedh puraan pukaareh dharam karahu khaT karam dhiraRieeaa ||
834.e: The Shaastras, the Vedas and the Puraanas advise righteous actions, and the performance of the six religious rituals.

834.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਵਿਗੂਤੇ ਲੋਭ ਲਹਰਿ ਨਾਵ ਭਾਰਿ ਬੁਡਈਆ ॥੬॥
834.t: manmukh paakha(n)dd bharam vigoote lobh lahar naav bhaar buddieeaa ||6||
834.e: The hypocritical, self-willed manmukhs are ruined by doubt; in the waves of greed, their boat is heavily loaded, and it sinks. ||6||

834.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਈਆ ॥
834.t: naam japahu naame gat paavahu simirat saasatr naam dhiraRieeaa ||
834.e: So chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and through the Naam, find emancipation. The Simritees and Shaastras recommend the Naam.

834.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਤ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਚੈ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਈਆ ॥੭॥
834.t: haumai jai ta niramal hovai gurmukh parachai param padh pieeaa ||7||
834.e: Eradicating egotism, one becomes pure. The Gurmukh is inspired, and obtains the supreme status. ||7||

834.g: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਵਰਨੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਈਆ ॥
834.t: eih jag varan roop sabh teraa jit laaveh se karam kamieeaa ||
834.e: This world, with its colors and forms, is all Yours, O Lord; as You attach us, so do we do our deeds.

834.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੰਤ ਵਜਾਏ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਰਾਹਿ ਚਲਈਆ ॥੮॥੨॥੫॥
834.t: naanak ja(n)t vajaae vaajeh jit bhaavai tit raeh chalieeaa ||8||2||5||
834.e: O Nanak, we are the instruments upon which He plays; as He wills, so is the path we take. ||8||2||5||

834.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
834.t: bilaaval mahalaa chauthhaa ||
834.e: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehla:

834.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖਈਆ ॥
834.t: gurmukh agam agochar dhiaaiaa hau bal bal satigur sat purakhieeaa ||
834.e: The Gurmukh meditates on the Inaccessible, Unfathomable Lord. I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the True Guru, the True Primal Being.

834.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਈਆ ॥੧॥
834.t: raam naam merai praan vasaae satigur paras har naam samieeaa ||1||
834.e: He has brought the Lord's Name to dwell upon my breath of life; meeting with the True Guru, I am absorbed into the Lord's Name. ||1||

834.g: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਟਿਕਈਆ ॥
834.t: jan kee Tek har naam Tikieeaa ||
834.e: The Name of the Lord is the only Support of His humble servants.

834.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਧਰ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਾਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
834.t: satigur kee dhar laagaa jaavaa gur kirapaa te har dhar laheeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
834.e: I shall live under the protection of the True Guru. By Guru's Grace, I shall attain the Court of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

834.g: ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕਰਮ ਕੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਥਿ ਮਥਿ ਤਤੁ ਕਢਈਆ ॥
834.t: eih sareer karam kee dharatee gurmukh math math tat kaddieeaa ||
834.e: This body is the field of karma; the Gurmukhs plow and work it, and harvest the essence.

834.g: ਲਾਲੁ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਭਾਂਡੈ ਭਾਉ ਪਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਅਈਆ ॥੨॥
834.t: laal javehar naam pragaasiaa bhaa(n)ddai bhaau pavai tit ieeaa ||2||
834.e: The priceless jewel of the Naam becomes manifest, and it pours into their vessels of love. ||2||

834.g: ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੀਐ ਜੋ ਜਨ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤ ਨਿਜ ਭਈਆ ॥
834.t: dhaasan dhaas dhaas hoi raheeaai jo jan raam bhagat nij bhieeaa ||
834.e: Become the slave of the slave of the slave, of that humble being who has become the devotee of the Lord.

834.g: ਮਨੁ ਬੁਧਿ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਮੈ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥਈਆ ॥੩॥
834.t: man budh arap dharau gur aagai gur parasaadhee mai akath kathieeaa ||3||
834.e: I dedicate my mind and intellect, and place them in offering before my Guru; by Guru's Grace, I speak the Unspoken. ||3||

834.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਤ ਤਿਖਈਆ ॥
834.t: manmukh maiaa moh viaape ih man tirasanaa jalat tikhieeaa ||
834.e: The self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in attachment to Maya; their minds are thirsty, burning with desire.

834.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਈਆ ॥੪॥
834.t: gurmat naam a(n)mirat jal paiaa agan bujhee gur sabadh bujhieeaa ||4||
834.e: Following the Guru's Teachings, I have obtained the Ambrosial Water of the Naam, and the fire has been put out. The Word of the Guru's Shabad has put it out. ||4||

834.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਾਚੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਤੂਰ ਵਜਈਆ ॥
834.t: eih man naachai satigur aagai anahadh sabadh dhun toor vajieeaa ||
834.e: This mind dances before the True Guru. The unstruck sound current of the Shabad resounds, vibrating the celestial melody.

835.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਰਖਿ ਰਖਿ ਚਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਲ ਪੂਰਈਆ ॥੫॥
835.t: har har usatat karai dhin raatee rakh rakh charan har taal poorieeaa ||5||
835.e: I praise the Lord, day and night, moving my feet to the beat of the drum. ||5||

835.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਾਲ ਰਸਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵਈਆ ॥
835.t: har kai ra(n)g rataa man gaavai ras rasaal ras sabadh ravieeaa ||
835.e: Imbued with the Lord's Love, my mind sings His Praise, joyfully chanting the Shabad, the source of nectar and bliss.

835.g: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਧਾਰ ਚੁਐ ਅਤਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੀਆ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥੬॥
835.t: nij ghar dhaar chuaai at niramal jin peeaa tin hee sukh laheeaa ||6||
835.e: The stream of immaculate purity flows through the home of the self within; one who drinks it in, finds peace. ||6||

835.g: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲਕ ਬਾਲੂ ਘਰ ਉਸਰਈਆ ॥
835.t: manahaTh karam karai abhimaanee jiau baalak baaloo ghar usarieeaa ||
835.e: The stubborn-minded, egotistical, proud-minded person performs rituals, but these are like sand castles built by children.

835.g: ਆਵੈ ਲਹਰਿ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਾਗਰ ਕੀ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਢਹਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੭॥
835.t: aavai lahar samu(n)dh saagar kee khin meh bhi(n)n bhi(n)n ddeh pieeaa ||7||
835.e: When the waves of the ocean come in, they crumble and dissolve in an instant. ||7||

835.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਖੇਲੁ ਖੇਲਈਆ ॥
835.t: har sar saagar har hai aape ih jag hai sabh khel khelieeaa ||
835.e: The Lord is the pool, and the Lord Himself is the ocean; this world is all a play which He has staged.

835.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਤਰੰਗ ਜਲੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਰਮਈਆ ॥੮॥੩॥੬॥
835.t: jiau jal tara(n)g jal jaleh samaaveh naanak aape aap ramieeaa ||8||3||6||
835.e: As the waves of water merge into the water again, O Nanak, so does He merge into Himself. ||8||3||6||

835.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
835.t: bilaaval mahalaa chauthhaa ||
835.e: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehla:

835.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਚੈ ਮਨਿ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਤਨਿ ਭਸਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਈਆ ॥
835.t: satigur parachai man mu(n)dhraa paiee gur kaa sabadh tan bhasam dhiraRieeaa ||
835.e: My mind wears the ear-rings of the True Guru's acquaintance; I apply the ashes of the Word of the Guru's Shabad to my body.

835.g: ਅਮਰ ਪਿੰਡ ਭਏ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੋਊ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਈਆ ॥੧॥
835.t: amar pi(n)dd bhe saadhoo sa(n)g janam maran dhouoo miT gieeaa ||1||
835.e: My body has become immortal, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Both birth and death have come to an end for me. ||1||

835.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੀਆ ॥
835.t: mere man saadhasa(n)gat mil raheeaa ||
835.e: O my mind, remain united with the Saadh Sangat.

835.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਧਸੂਦਨ ਮਾਧਉ ਮੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਣ ਪਖਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
835.t: kirapaa karahu madhasoodhan maadhau mai khin khin saadhoo charan pakhieeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
835.e: Be merciful to me, O Lord; each and every instant, let me wash the Feet of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

835.g: ਤਜੈ ਗਿਰਸਤੁ ਭਇਆ ਬਨ ਵਾਸੀ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਟਿਕੈ ਨ ਟਿਕਈਆ ॥
835.t: tajai girasat bhiaa ban vaasee ik khin manooaa Tikai na Tikieeaa ||
835.e: Forsaking family life, he wanders in the forest, but his mind does not remain at rest, even for an instant.

835.g: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਧਾਇ ਤਦੇ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਵਈਆ ॥੨॥
835.t: dhaavat dhai tadhe ghar aavai har har saadhoo saran pavieeaa ||2||
835.e: The wandering mind returns home, only when it seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's Holy people. ||2||

835.g: ਧੀਆ ਪੂਤ ਛੋਡਿ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਆਸਾ ਆਸ ਮਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਰਈਆ ॥
835.t: dheeaa poot chhodd sa(n)niaasee aasaa aas man bahut karieeaa ||
835.e: The Sannyaasi renounces his daughters and sons, but his mind still conjures up all sorts of hopes and desires.

835.g: ਆਸਾ ਆਸ ਕਰੈ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਸੁਖੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥੩॥
835.t: aasaa aas karai nahee boojhai gur kai sabadh niraas sukh laheeaa ||3||
835.e: With these hopes and desires, he still does not understand, that only through the Word of the Guru's Shabad does one become free of desires, and find peace. ||3||

835.g: ਉਪਜੀ ਤਰਕ ਦਿਗੰਬਰੁ ਹੋਆ ਮਨੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਚਲਿ ਚਲਿ ਗਵਨੁ ਕਰਈਆ ॥
835.t: aupajee tarak dhiga(n)bar hoaa man dheh dhis chal chal gavan karieeaa ||
835.e: When detachment from the world wells up within, he become a naked hermit, but still, his mind roams, wanders and rambles in the ten directions.

835.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਵਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਨਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧ ਦਇਆ ਘਰੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥੪॥
835.t: prabhavan karai boojhai nahee tirasanaa mil sa(n)g saadh dhiaa ghar laheeaa ||4||
835.e: He wanders around, but his desires are not satisfied; joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he finds the house of kindness and compassion. ||4||

835.g: ਆਸਣ ਸਿਧ ਸਿਖਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਚੇਟਕ ਚੇਟਕਈਆ ॥
835.t: aasan sidh sikheh bahutere man maageh ridh sidh cheTak cheTakieeaa ||
835.e: The Siddhas learn many Yogis postures, but their minds still yearn for riches, miraculous powers and energy.

835.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੫॥
835.t: tirapat sa(n)tokh man saa(n)t na aavai mil saadhoo tirapat har naam sidh pieeaa ||5||
835.e: Satisfaction, contentment and tranquility do not come to their minds; but meeting the Holy Saints, they are satisfied, and through the Name of the Lord, spiritual perfection is attained. ||5||

835.g: ਅੰਡਜ ਜੇਰਜ ਸੇਤਜ ਉਤਭੁਜ ਸਭਿ ਵਰਨ ਰੂਪ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਈਆ ॥
835.t: a(n)ddaj jeraj setaj utabhuj sabh varan roop jeea ja(n)t upieeaa ||
835.e: Life is born from the egg, from the womb, from sweat and from the earth; God created the beings and creatures of all colors and forms.

835.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੈ ਸੋ ਉਬਰੈ ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਸੂਦੁ ਵੈਸੁ ਚੰਡਾਲੁ ਚੰਡਈਆ ॥੬॥
835.t: saadhoo saran parai so ubarai khatree braahaman soodh vais cha(n)ddaal cha(n)ddieeaa ||6||
835.e: One who seeks the Sanctuary of the Holy is saved, whether he is a Kh'shaatriya, a Brahmin, a Soodra, a Vaishya or the most untouchable of the untouchables. ||6||

835.g: ਨਾਮਾ ਜੈਦੇਉ ਕੰਬੀਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਲੋਚਨੁ ਅਉਜਾਤਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਚਮਿਆਰੁ ਚਮਈਆ ॥
835.t: naamaa jaidheau ka(n)beer tiralochan aaujaat ravidhaas chamiaar chamieeaa ||
835.e: Naam Dayv, Jai Dayv, Kabeer, Trilochan and Ravi Daas the low-caste leather-worker,

835.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨਾ ਜਟੁ ਸੈਣੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਦਈਆ ॥੭॥
835.t: jo jo milai saadhoo jan sa(n)gat dhan dha(n)naa jaT sain miliaa har dhieeaa ||7||
835.e: blessed Dhanna and Sain; all those who joined the humble Saadh Sangat, met the Merciful Lord. ||7||

835.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਈਆ ॥
835.t: sa(n)t janaa kee har paij rakhaiee bhagat vachhal a(n)geekaar karieeaa ||
835.e: The Lord protects the honor of His humble servants; He is the Lover of His devotees - He makes them His own.

835.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਖਈਆ ॥੮॥੪॥੭॥
835.t: naanak saran pare jagajeevan har har kirapaa dhaar rakhieeaa ||8||4||7||
835.e: Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lord, the Life of the world, who has showered His Mercy upon him, and saved him. ||8||||4||7||

835.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
835.t: bilaaval mahalaa chauthhaa ||
835.e: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehla:

835.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਿਆਸ ਉਠੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਮਨਿ ਤੀਰ ਲਗਈਆ ॥
835.t: a(n)tar piaas uThee prabh keree sun gur bachan man teer lagieeaa ||
835.e: The thirst for God has welled up deep within me; hearing the Word of the Guru's Teachings, my mind is pierced by His arrow.

836.g: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋ ਪੀਰ ਪਰਈਆ ॥੧॥
836.t: man kee birathaa man hee jaanai avar k jaanai ko peer parieeaa ||1||
836.e: The pain of my mind is known only to my own mind; who can know the pain of another? ||1||

836.g: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੋਹਨਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਈਆ ॥
836.t: raam gur mohan moh man lieeaa ||
836.e: The Lord, the Guru, the Enticer, has enticed my mind.

836.g: ਹਉ ਆਕਲ ਬਿਕਲ ਭਈ ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖੇ ਹਉ ਲੋਟ ਪੋਟ ਹੋਇ ਪਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
836.t: hau aakal bikal bhiee gur dhekhe hau loT poT hoi pieeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
