836.e: I am stunned and amazed, gazing upon my Guru; I have entered the realm of wonder and bliss. ||1||Pause||

836.g: ਹਉ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਫਿਰਉ ਸਭਿ ਦੇਸ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਖਨ ਕੋ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਚਈਆ ॥
836.t: hau nirakhat firau sabh dhes dhisa(n)tar mai prabh dhekhan ko bahut man chieeaa ||
836.e: I wander around, exploring all lands and foreign countries; within my mind, I have such a great longing to see my God.

836.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਕਾਟਿ ਦੇਉ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੰਥੁ ਦਿਖਈਆ ॥੨॥
836.t: man tan kaaT dheau gur aagai jin har prabh maarag pa(n)th dhikhieeaa ||2||
836.e: I sacrifice my mind and body to the Guru, who has shown me the Way, the Path to my Lord God. ||2||

836.g: ਕੋਈ ਆਣਿ ਸਦੇਸਾ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰਾ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਈਆ ॥
836.t: koiee aan sadhesaa dhei prabh keraa ridh a(n)tar man tan meeTh lagieeaa ||
836.e: If only someone would bring me news of God; He seems so sweet to my heart, mind and body.

836.g: ਮਸਤਕੁ ਕਾਟਿ ਦੇਉ ਚਰਣਾ ਤਲਿ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਈਆ ॥੩॥
836.t: masatak kaaT dheau charanaa tal jo har prabh mele mel milieeaa ||3||
836.e: I would cut off my head and place it under the feet of that one who leads me to meet and unite with my Lord God. ||3||

836.g: ਚਲੁ ਚਲੁ ਸਖੀ ਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਰਬੋਧਹ ਗੁਣ ਕਾਮਣ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥
836.t: chal chal sakhee ham prabh parabodheh gun kaaman kar har prabh laheeaa ||
836.e: Let us go, O my companions, and understand our God; with the spell of virtue, let us obtain our Lord God.

836.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਉਆ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਰਣਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਈਆ ॥੪॥
836.t: bhagat vachhal uaa ko naam kaheeat hai saran prabhoo tis paachhai pieeaa ||4||
836.e: He is called the Lover of His devotees; let us follow in the footsteps of those who seek God's Sanctuary. ||4||

836.g: ਖਿਮਾ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਮਨਿ ਦੀਪਕ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬਲਈਆ ॥
836.t: khimaa seegaar kare prabh khuseeaa man dheepak gur giaan balieeaa ||
836.e: If the soul-bride adorns herself with compassion and forgiveness, God is pleased, and her mind is illumined with the lamp of the Guru's wisdom.

836.g: ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਭੋਗ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਮ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਜੀਉ ਕਟਿ ਕਟਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੫॥
836.t: ras ras bhog kare prabh meraa ham tis aagai jeeau kaT kaT pieeaa ||5||
836.e: With happiness and ecstasy, my God enjoys her; I offer each and every bit of my soul to Him. ||5||

836.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਹੈ ਬਨਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਤੀਚੂਰੁ ਵਡ ਗਹਨ ਗਹਨਈਆ ॥
836.t: har har haar ka(n)Th hai baniaa man moteechoor vadd gahan gahanieeaa ||
836.e: I have made the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, my necklace; my mind tinged with devotion is the intricate ornament of crowning glory.

836.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਸੇਜ ਵਿਛਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਈਆ ॥੬॥
836.t: har har saradhaa sej vichhaiee prabh chhodd na sakai bahut man bhieeaa ||6||
836.e: I have spread out my bed of faith in the Lord, Har, Har. I cannot abandon Him - my mind is filled with such a great love for Him. ||6||

836.g: ਕਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਸਭੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਫੋਕਟ ਫੋਕਟਈਆ ॥
836.t: kahai prabh avar avar kichh keejai sabh baadh seegaar fokaT fokaTieeaa ||
836.e: If God says one thing, and the soul-bride does something else, then all her decorations are useless and false.

836.g: ਕੀਓ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਮਿਲਣ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲੀਓ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਥੂਕ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੭॥
836.t: keeo seegaar milan kai taiee prabh leeo suhaagan thook mukh pieeaa ||7||
836.e: She may adorn herself to meet her Husband Lord, but still, only the virtuous soul-bride meets God, and the other's face is spat upon. ||7||

836.g: ਹਮ ਚੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਅਗਮ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਕਿਆ ਹਮ ਕਰਹ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਪਈਆ ॥
836.t: ham cheree too agam gusaiee kiaa ham kareh terai vas pieeaa ||
836.e: I am Your hand-maiden, O Inaccessible Lord of the Universe; what can I do by myself? I am under Your power.

836.g: ਦਇਆ ਦੀਨ ਕਰਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਈਆ ॥੮॥੫॥੮॥
836.t: dhiaa dheen karahu rakh levahu naanak har gur saran samieeaa ||8||5||8||
836.e: Be merciful, Lord, to the meek, and save them; Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of the Lord, and the Guru. ||8||5||8||

836.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
836.t: bilaaval mahalaa chauthhaa ||
836.e: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehla:

836.g: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਅਗਮ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਸਰਧਾ ਮਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਉਠਈਆ ॥
836.t: mai man tan prem agam Thaakur kaa khin khin saradhaa man bahut uThieeaa ||
836.e: My mind and body are filled with love for my Inaccessible Lord and Master. Each and every instant, I am filled with immense faith and devotion.

836.g: ਗੁਰ ਦੇਖੇ ਸਰਧਾ ਮਨ ਪੂਰੀ ਜਿਉ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਬੂੰਦ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੧॥
836.t: gur dhekhe saradhaa man pooree jiau chaatirak priau priau boo(n)dh mukh pieeaa ||1||
836.e: Gazing upon the Guru, my mind's faith is fulfilled, like the song-bird, which cries and cries, until the rain-drop falls into its mouth. ||1||

836.g: ਮਿਲੁ ਮਿਲੁ ਸਖੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਈਆ ॥
836.t: mil mil sakhee har kathaa sunieeaa ||
836.e: Join with me, join with me, O my companions, and teach me the Sermon of the Lord.

836.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਮੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਕਟਿ ਕਟਿ ਪਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
836.t: satigur dhiaa kare prabh mele mai tis aagai sir kaT kaT pieeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
836.e: The True Guru has mercifully united me with God. Cutting off my head, and chopping it into pieces, I offer it to Him. ||1||Pause||

836.g: ਰੋਮਿ ਰੋਮਿ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਇਕ ਬੇਦਨ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੇਖੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਪਈਆ ॥
836.t: rom rom man tan ik bedhan mai prabh dhekhe bin needh na pieeaa ||
836.e: Each and every hair on my head, and my mind and body, suffer the pains of separation; without seeing my God, I cannot sleep.

836.g: ਬੈਦਕ ਨਾਟਿਕ ਦੇਖਿ ਭੁਲਾਨੇ ਮੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪੀਰ ਲਗਈਆ ॥੨॥
836.t: baidhak naaTik dhekh bhulaane mai hiradhai man tan prem peer lagieeaa ||2||
836.e: The doctors and healers look at me, and are perplexed. Within my heart, mind and body, I feel the pain of divine love. ||2||

836.g: ਹਉ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਜਿਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਮਲੈ ਅਮਲੀ ਮਰਿ ਗਈਆ ॥
836.t: hau khin pal reh na sakau bin preetam jiau bin amalai amalee mar gieeaa ||
836.e: I cannot live for a moment, for even an instant, without my Beloved, like the opium addict who cannot live without opium.

836.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪਿਆਸ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੀ ਤਿਨੑ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਦੁਈਆ ॥੩॥
836.t: jin kau piaas hoi prabh keree tin(h) avar na bhaavai bin har ko dhuieeaa ||3||
836.e: Those who thirst for God, do not love any other. Without the Lord, there is no other at all. ||3||

836.g: ਕੋਈ ਆਨਿ ਆਨਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਘੁਮਿ ਗਈਆ ॥
836.t: koiee aan aan meraa prabhoo milaavai hau tis viTahu bal bal ghum gieeaa ||
836.e: If only someone would come and unite me with God; I am devoted, dedicated, a sacrifice to him.

836.g: ਅਨੇਕ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਜਨ ਮੇਲੇ ਜਾ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਵਈਆ ॥੪॥
836.t: anek janam ke vichhuRe jan mele jaa sat sat satigur saran pavieeaa ||4||
836.e: After being separated from the Lord for countless incarnations, I am re-united with Him, entering the Sanctuary of the True, True, True Guru. ||4||

837.g: ਸੇਜ ਏਕ ਏਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਈਆ ॥
837.t: sej ek eko prabh Thaakur mahal na paavai manmukh bharamieeaa ||
837.e: There is one bed for the soul-bride, and the same bed for God, her Lord and Master. The self-willed manmukh does not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence; she wanders around, in limbo.

837.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ ਸਰਣਿ ਜੇ ਆਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਢੀਲ ਨ ਪਈਆ ॥੫॥
837.t: gur gur karat saran je aavai prabh aai milai khin ddeel na pieeaa ||5||
837.e: Uttering, ""Guru, Guru"", she seeks His Sanctuary; so God comes to meet her, without a moment's delay. ||5||

837.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਿਆਚਾਰ ਵਧਾਏ ਮਨਿ ਪਾਖੰਡ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਪਟ ਲੋਭਈਆ ॥
837.t: kar kar kiriaachaar vadhaae man paakha(n)dd karam kapaT lobhieeaa ||
837.e: One may perform many rituals, but the mind is filled with hypocrisy, evil deeds and greed.

837.g: ਬੇਸੁਆ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਬੇਟਾ ਜਨਮਿਆ ਪਿਤਾ ਤਾਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਈਆ ॥੬॥
837.t: besuaa kai ghar beTaa janamiaa pitaa taeh kiaa naam sadhieeaa ||6||
837.e: When a son is born in the house of a prostitute, who can tell the name of his father? ||6||

837.g: ਪੂਰਬ ਜਨਮਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਆਏ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਮਈਆ ॥
837.t: poorab janam bhagat kar aae gur har har har har bhagat jamieeaa ||
837.e: Because of devotional worship in my past incarnations, I have been born into this life. The Guru has inspired me to worship the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har.

837.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਈਆ ॥੭॥
837.t: bhagat bhagat karate har paiaa jaa har har har har naam samieeaa ||7||
837.e: Worshipping, worshipping Him with devotion, I found the Lord, and then I merged into the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har. ||7||

837.g: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਣਿ ਆਣਿ ਮਹਿੰਦੀ ਪੀਸਾਈ ਆਪੇ ਘੋਲਿ ਘੋਲਿ ਅੰਗਿ ਲਈਆ ॥
837.t: prabh aan aan mahi(n)dhee peesaiee aape ghol ghol a(n)g lieeaa ||
837.e: God Himself came and ground the henna leaves into powder, and applied it to my body.

837.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਢਿ ਲਈਆ ॥੮॥੬॥੨॥੧॥੬॥੯॥
837.t: jin kau Thaakur kirapaa dhaaree baeh pakar naanak kadd lieeaa ||8||6||2||1||6||9||
837.e: Our Lord and Master showers His Mercy upon us, and grasps hold of our arms; O Nanak, He lifts us up and saves us. ||8||6||9||2||1||6||9||

837.t: raag bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa asaTapadhee ghar baarvaa
837.e: Raag Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, Twelfth House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

837.g: ਉਪਮਾ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਕਹੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਕਹੀ ॥
837.t: aupamaa jaat na kahee mere prabh kee upamaa jaat na kahee ||
837.e: I cannot express the Praises of my God; I cannot express His Praises.
I have abandoned all others, seeking His Sanctuary. ||1||Pause||
God's Lotus Feet are Infinite.
I am forever a sacrifice to Them.
My mind is in love with Them.
If I were to abandon Them, there is nowhere else I could go. ||1||
I chant the Lord's Name with my tongue.
The filth of my sins and evil mistakes is burnt off.
Climbing aboard the Boat of the Saints, I am emancipated.
I have been carried across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||
My mind is tied to the Lord with the string of love and devotion.
This is the Immaculate Way of the Saints.
They forsake sin and corruption.
They meet the Formless Lord God. ||3||
Gazing upon God, I am wonderstruck.
I taste the Perfect Flavor of Bliss.
I do not waver or wander here or there.
The Lord God, Har, Har, dwells within my consciousness. ||4||

837.g: ਤਿਨੑ ਨਾਹਿ ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥ ਨਿਤ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਣਤਾਸੁ ॥
837.t: tin(h) naeh narak nivaas || nit simar prabh gunataas ||
837.e: Those who constantly remember God, the treasure of virtue, will never go to hell.

837.g: ਤੇ ਜਮੁ ਨ ਪੇਖਹਿ ਨੈਨ ॥ ਸੁਨਿ ਮੋਹੇ ਅਨਹਤ ਬੈਨ ॥੫॥
837.t: te jam na pekheh nain || sun mohe anahat bain ||5||
837.e: Those who listen, fascinated, to the Unstruck Sound-Current of the Word, will never have to see the Messenger of Death with their eyes. ||5||
I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord, the Heroic Lord of the World.
The Merciful Lord God is under the power of His devotees.
The Vedas do not know the Mystery of the Lord.
The silent sages constantly serve Him. ||6||
He is the Destroyer of the pains and sorrows of the poor.
It is so very difficult to serve Him.

837.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
837.t: taa kee mit na jaanai koi ||
837.e: No one knows His limits.
He is pervading the water, the land and the sky. ||7||
Hundreds of thousands of times, I humbly bow to Him.
I have grown weary, and I have collapsed at God's Door.
O God, make me the dust of the feet of the Holy.
Please fulfill this, Nanak's wish. ||8||1||
Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:
God, please release me from birth and death.
I have grown weary, and collapsed at Your door.
I grasp Your Feet, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
The Love of the Lord, Har, Har, is sweet to my mind.

838.e: Be Merciful, and attach me to the hem of Your robe.
Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

838.g: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
838.t: dheenaa naath dhiaal mere suaamee dheenaa naath dhiaal ||
838.e: O Merciful Master of the meek, You are my Lord and Master, O Merciful Master of the meek.
I yearn for the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||1||Pause||
The world is a pit of poison,
filled with the utter darkness of ignorance and emotional attachment.
Please take my hand, and save me, Dear God.
Please bless me with Your Name, Lord.
Without You, God, I have no place at all.
Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You. ||2||
The human body is in the grip of greed and attachment.
Without meditating and vibrating upon the Lord, it is reduced to ashes.
The Messenger of Death is dreadful and horrible.
The recording scribes of the conscious and the unconscious, Chitr and Gupt, know all actions and karma.
Day and night, they bear witness.
Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||3||
O Lord, Destroyer of fear and egotism,
be merciful, and save the sinners.
My sins cannot even be counted.
Without the Lord, who can hide them?
I thought of Your Support, and seized it, O my Lord and Master.
Please, give Nanak Your hand and save him, Lord! ||4||
The Lord, the treasure of virtue, the Lord of the world,
cherishes and sustains every heart.
My mind is thirsty for Your Love, and the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan.
O Lord of the Universe, please fulfill my hopes.
I cannot survive, even for an instant.
By great good fortune, Nanak has found the Lord. ||5||
Without You, God, there is no other at all.
My mind loves You, as the partridge loves the moon,
as the fish loves the water,
as the bee and the lotus cannot be separated.
As the chakvi bird longs for the sun,
so does Nanak thirst for the Lord's feet. ||6||
As the young bride places the hopes of her life in her husband,
as the greedy person looks upon the gift of wealth,
as milk is joined to water,
as food is to the very hungry man,
and as the mother loves her son,
so does Nanak constantly remember the Lord in meditation. ||7||
As the moth falls into the lamp,
as the thief steals without hesitation,
as the elephant is trapped by its sexual urges,
as the sinner is caught in his sins,
as the gambler's addiction does not leave him,
so is this mind of Nanak's attached to the Lord. ||8||
As the deer loves the sound of the bell,
and as the song-bird longs for the rain,
the Lord's humble servant lives in the Society of the Saints,
lovingly meditating and vibrating upon the Lord of the Universe.
My tongue chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Please bless Nanak with the gift of the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||9||
One who sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and hears them, and writes them,
receives all fruits and rewards from the Lord.
He saves all his ancestors and generations,
and crosses over the world-ocean.
The Lord's Feet are the boat to carry him across.
Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he sings the Praises of the Lord.
The Lord protects his honor.
Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's door. ||10||2||

838.t: bilaaval mahalaa pehilaa thitee ghar dasvaa jat
838.e: Bilaaval, First Mehla, T'hitee ~ The Lunar Days, Tenth House, To The Drum-Beat Jat:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The First Day: The One Universal Creator is unique,
immortal, unborn, beyond social class or involvement.
He is inaccessible and unfathomable, with no form or feature.
Searching, searching, I have seen Him in each and every heart.

839.g: ਜੋ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
839.t: jo dhekh dhikhaavai tis kau bal jaiee ||
839.e: I am a sacrifice to one who sees, and inspires others to see Him.
By Guru's Grace, I have obtained the supreme status. ||1||
Whose Name should I chant, and meditate on, except the Lord of the Universe?

839.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਦੀਸੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
839.t: gur kai sabadh mahal ghar dheesai ||1|| rahaau ||
839.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is revealed within the home of one's own heart. ||1||Pause||
The Second Day: Those who are in love with another, come to regret and repent.
The are tied up at Death's door, and continue coming and going.

839.g: ਕਿਆ ਲੈ ਆਵਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਲੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
839.t: kiaa lai aaveh kiaa le jaeh ||
839.e: What have they brought, and what will they take with them when they go?
The Messenger of Death looms over their heads, and they endure his beating.

839.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਨ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
839.t: bin gur sabadh na chhooTas koi ||
839.e: Without the Word of the Guru's Shabad, no one finds release.
Practicing hypocrisy, no one finds liberation. ||2||
The True Lord Himself created the universe, joining the elements together.
Breaking the cosmic egg, He united, and separated.

839.g: ਧਰਤਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ ਕੀਏ ਬੈਸਣ ਕਉ ਥਾਉ ॥
839.t: dharat akaas ke'ee baisan kau thaau ||
839.e: He made the earth and the sky into places to live.
He created day and night, fear and love.
The One who created the Creation, also watches over it.
There is no other Creator Lord. ||3||
The Third Day: He created Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva,
the gods, goddesses and various manifestations.
The lights and forms cannot be counted.
The One who fashioned them, knows their value.
He evaluates them, and totally pervades them.
Who is close, and who is far away? ||4||
The Fourth Day: He created the four Vedas,
the four sources of creation, and distinct forms of speech.
He created the eighteen Puraanas, the six Shaastras and the three qualities.
He alone understands, whom the Lord causes to understand.
One who overcomes the three qualities, dwells in the fourth state.

839.g: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੫॥
839.t: pranavat naanak ham taa ke dhaasaa ||5||
839.e: Prays Nanak, I am his slave. ||5||
The Fifth Day: The five elements are demons.
The Lord Himself is unfathomable and detached.
Some are gripped by doubt, hunger, emotional attachment and desire.
Some taste the sublime essence of the Shabad, and are satisfied.

839.g: ਇਕਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਇਕਿ ਮਰਿ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
839.t: eik ra(n)g raate ik mar dhoor ||
839.e: Some are imbued with the Lord's Love, while some die, and are reduced to dust.

839.g: ਇਕਿ ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੬॥
839.t: eik dhar ghar saachai dhekh hadhoor ||6||
839.e: Some attain the Court and the Mansion of the True Lord, and behold Him, ever-present. ||6||
The false one has no honor or fame;
like the black crow, he never becomes pure.
He is like the bird, imprisoned in a cage;
he paces back and forth behind the bars, but he is not released.
He alone is emancipated, whom the Lord and Master emancipates.
He follows the Guru's Teachings, and enshrines devotional worship. ||7||
The Sixth Day: God organized the six systems of Yoga.
The unstruck sound current of the Shabad vibrates of itself.

839.g: ਜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ॥
839.t: je prabh bhaavai taa mahal bulaavai ||
839.e: If God wills it so, then one is summoned to the Mansion of His Presence.
One who is pierced through by the Shabad, obtains honor.

839.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਸ ਖਪਹਿ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
839.t: kar kar ves khapeh jal jaaveh ||
839.e: Those who wear religious robes burn, and are ruined.
Through Truth, the truthful ones merge into the True Lord. ||8||
The Seventh Day: When the body is imbued with Truth and contentment,
the seven seas within are filled with the Immaculate Water.
Bathing in good conduct, and contemplating the True Lord within the heart,

839.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
839.t: gur kai sabadh paavai sabh paar ||
839.e: one obtains the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and carries everyone across.
With the True Lord in the mind, and the True Lord lovingly on one's lips,
one is blessed with the banner of Truth, and meets with no obstructions. ||9||
The Eighth Day: The eight miraculous powers come when one subdues his own mind,
and contemplates the True Lord through pure actions.
Forget the three qualities of wind, water and fire,
and concentrate on the pure True Name.

839.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਰਹਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
839.t: tis meh manooaa rahiaa liv lai ||
839.e: That human who remains lovingly focused on the Lord,
prays Nanak, shall not be consumed by death. ||10||

839.g: ਨਾਉ ਨਉਮੀ ਨਵੇ ਨਾਥ ਨਵ ਖੰਡਾ ॥ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਨਾਥੁ ਮਹਾ ਬਲਵੰਡਾ ॥
839.t: naau naumee nave naath nav kha(n)ddaa || ghaT ghaT naath mahaa balava(n)ddaa ||
839.e: The Ninth Day: The Name is the supreme almighty Master of the nine masters of Yoga, the nine realms of the earth, and each and every heart.

840.e: This whole world is the child of Maya.
I bow in submission to God, my Protector from the very beginning of time.
He was in the beginning, He has been throughout the ages, He is now, and He shall always be.
He is unlimited, and capable of doing everything. ||11||
The Tenth Day: Meditate on the Naam, give to charity, and purify yourself.
Night and day, bathe in spiritual wisdom and the Glorious Virtues of the True Lord.

840.g: ਸਚਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
840.t: sach mail na laagai bhram bhau bhaagai ||
840.e: Truth cannot be polluted; doubt and fear run away from it.
The flimsy thread breaks in an instant.
Know that the world is just like this thread.
Your consciousness shall become steady and stable, enjoying the Love of the True Lord. ||12||
The Eleventh Day: Enshrine the One Lord within your heart.
Eradicate cruelty, egotism and emotional attachment.
Earn the fruitful rewards, by observing the fast of knowing your own self.
One who is engrossed in hypocrisy, does not see the true essence.
The Lord is immaculate, self-sustaining and unattached.
The Pure, True Lord cannot be polluted. ||13||
Wherever I look, I see the One Lord there.
He created the other beings, of many and various kinds.
Eating only fruits, one loses the fruits of life.
Eating only delicacies of various sorts, one loses the true taste.
In fraud and greed, people are engrossed and entangled.
The Gurmukh is emancipated, practicing Truth. ||14||
The Twelfth Day: One whose mind is not attached to the twelve signs,
remains awake day and night, and never sleeps.
He remains awake and aware, lovingly centered on the Lord.

840.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥
840.t: gur parachai tis kaal na khai ||
840.e: With faith in the Guru, he is not consumed by death.
Those who become detached, and conquer the five enemies
- prays Nanak, they are lovingly absorbed in the Lord. ||15||
The Twelfth Day: Know, and practice, compassion and charity.
Bring your out-going mind back home.
Observe the fast of remaining free of desire.
Chant the unchanted Chant of the Naam with your mouth.
Know that the One Lord is contained in the three worlds.
Purity and self-discipline are all contained in knowing the Truth. ||16||
The Thirteenth Day: He is like a tree on the sea-shore.
But his roots can become immortal, if his mind is attuned to the Lord's Love.

840.g: ਡਰ ਡਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਬੂਡੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
840.t: ddar ddar marai na booddai koi ||
840.e: Then, he will not die of fear or anxiety, and he will never drown.
Without the Fear of God, he drowns and dies, and loses his honor.

840.g: ਡਰ ਮਹਿ ਘਰੁ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਡਰੁ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
840.t: ddar meh ghar ghar meh ddar jaanai ||
840.e: With the Fear of God in his heart, and his heart in the Fear of God, he knows God.
He sits on the throne, and becomes pleasing to the Mind of the True Lord. ||17||
The Fourteenth Day: One who enters into the fourth state,
overcomes time, and the three qualities of raajas, taamas and satva.
Then the sun enters into the house of the moon,
and one knows the value of the technology of Yoga.

840.g: ਚਉਦਸਿ ਭਵਨ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਸਮਾਏ ॥ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਰਹਿਆ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥੧੮॥
840.t: chaudhas bhavan paataal samaae || kha(n)dd brahama(n)dd rahiaa liv laae ||18||
840.e: He remains lovingly focused on God, who is permeating the fourteen worlds, the nether regions of the underworld, the galaxies and solar systems. ||18||
Amaavas - The Night of the New Moon: The moon is hidden in the sky.
O wise one, understand and contemplate the Word of the Shabad.
The moon in the sky illuminates the three worlds.
Creating the creation, the Creator beholds it.

840.g: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
840.t: gur te dheesai so tis hee maeh ||
840.e: One who sees, through the Guru, merges into Him.
The self-willed manmukhs are deluded, coming and going in reincarnation. ||19||

840.g: ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਥਾਪਿ ਥਿਰੁ ਥਾਨਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
840.t: ghar dhar thaap thir thaan suhaavai ||
840.e: One who establishes his home within his own heart, obtains the most beautiful, permanent place.
One comes to understand his own self, when he finds the True Guru.
Wherever there is hope, there is destruction and desolation.
The bowl of duality and selfishness breaks.

840.g: ਮਮਤਾ ਜਾਲ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਉਦਾਸਾ ॥ ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੨੦॥੧॥
840.t: mamataa jaal te rahai udhaasaa || pranavat naanak ham taa ke dhaasaa ||20||1||
840.e: Prays Nanak, I am the slave of that one, who remains detached amidst the traps of attachment. ||20||1||

841.t: bilaaval mahalaa teejaa vaar sat ghar dasvaa
841.e: Bilaaval, Third Mehla, The Seven Days, Tenth House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

841.g: ਆਦਿਤ ਵਾਰਿ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
841.t: aadhit vaar aadh purakh hai soiee ||
841.e: Sunday: He, the Lord, is the Primal Being.
He Himself is the Pervading Lord; there is no other at all.
Through and through, He is woven into the fabric of the world.
Whatever the Creator Himself does, that alone happens.
Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one is forever in peace.
But how rare is the one, who, as Gurmukh, understands this. ||1||
Within my heart, I chant the Chant of the Lord, the treasure of virtue.

841.g: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਪਗਿ ਲਗਿ ਧਿਆਵਉ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
841.t: har agam agochar apara(n)par suaamee jan pag lag dhiaavau hoi dhaasan dhaasaa ||1|| rahaau ||
841.e: The Lord, my Lord and Master, is inaccessible, unfathomable and unlimited. Grasping the feet of the Lord's humble servants, I meditate on Him, and become the slave of His slaves. ||1||Pause||
Monday: The True Lord is permeating and pervading.

841.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
841.t: tis kee keemat kahee na jai ||
841.e: His value cannot be described.

841.g: ਆਖਿ ਆਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਭਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
841.t: aakh aakh rahe sabh liv lai ||
841.e: Talking and speaking about Him, all keep themselves lovingly focused on Him.
Devotion falls into the laps of those whom He so blesses.
He is inaccessible and unfathomable; He cannot be seen.

841.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
841.t: gur kai sabadh har rahiaa samai ||2||
841.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is seen to be permeating and pervading everywhere. ||2||
Tuesday: The Lord created love and attachment to Maya.
He Himself has enjoined each and every being to their tasks.
He alone understands, whom the Lord causes to understand.

841.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਦਰੁ ਘਰੁ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
841.t: gur kai sabadh dhar ghar soojhai ||
841.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one understands his heart and home.
He worships the Lord in loving devotion.
His egotism and self-conceit are burnt away by the Shabad. ||3||
Wednesday: He Himself bestows sublime understanding.
The Gurmukh does good deeds, and contemplates the Word of the Shabad.
Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind become pure and immaculate.

841.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
841.t: har gun gaavai haumai mal khoi ||
841.e: He sings the Glorious Glorious Praises of the Lord, and washes off the filth of egotism.
In the Court of the True Lord, he obtains lasting glory.
Imbued with the Naam, he is embellished with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||4||
The profit of the Naam is obtained through the Door of the Guru.
The Great Giver Himself gives it.

841.g: ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
841.t: jo dhevai tis kau bal jaieeaai ||
841.e: I am a sacrifice to the One who gives it.
By Guru's Grace, self-conceit is eradicated.
O Nanak, enshrine the Naam within your heart.
I celebrate the victory of the Lord, the Great Giver. ||5||
Thursday: The fifty-two warriors were deluded by doubt.
All the goblins and demons are attached to duality.
God Himself created them, and sees each one distinct.
O Creator Lord, You are the Support of all.
The beings and creatures are under Your protection.
He alone meets You, whom You Yourself meet. ||6||
Friday: God is permeating and pervading everywhere.
He Himself created all, and appraises the value of all.
One who become Gurmukh, contemplates the Lord.
He practices truth and self-restraint.

841.g: ਵਰਤੁ ਨੇਮੁ ਨਿਤਾਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਪੂਜਾ ॥ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਸਭੁ ਭਾਉ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੭॥
841.t: varat nem nitaaprat poojaa || bin boojhe sabh bhaau hai dhoojaa ||7||
841.e: Without genuine understanding, all fasts, religious rituals and daily worship services lead only to the love of duality. ||7||
Saturday: Contemplating good omens and the Shaastras,
in egotism and self-conceit, the world wanders in delusion.
The blind, self-willed manmukh in engrossed in the love of duality.
Bound and gagged at death's door, he is beaten and punished.
By Guru's Grace, one finds lasting peace.
He practices Truth, and lovingly focuses on the Truth. ||8||
Those who serve the True Guru are very fortunate.
Conquering their ego, they embrace love for the True Lord.
They are automatically imbued with Your Love, O Lord.

842.e: You are the Giver of peace; You merge them into Yourself.
Everything comes from the One and only Lord; there is no other at all.
The Gurmukh realizes this, and understands. ||9||
The fifteen lunar days, the seven days of the week,
the months, seasons, days and nights, come over and over again;
so the world goes on.
Coming and going were created by the Creator Lord.
The True Lord remains steady and stable, by His almighty power.

842.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧੦॥੧॥
842.t: naanak gurmukh boojhai ko sabadh veechaar ||10||1||
842.e: O Nanak, how rare is that Gurmukh who understands, and contemplates the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||10||1||
Bilaaval, Third Mehla:
The Primal Lord Himself formed the Universe.
The beings and creatures are engrossed in emotional attachment to Maya.
In the love of duality, they are attached to the illusory material world.
The unfortunate ones die, and continue to come and go.
Meeting with the True Guru, understanding is obtained.
Then, the illusion of the material world is shattered, and one merges in Truth. ||1||
One who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead

842.g: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
842.t: taa kai man vasiaa prabh ek ||1|| rahaau ||
842.e: - the One God abides within his mind. ||1||Pause||
He created the Universe, and He Himself beholds all.
No one can erase Your record, Lord.

842.g: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
842.t: sidh saadhik je ko kahai kahaae ||
842.e: If someone calls himself a Siddha or a seeker,
he is deluded by doubt, and will continue coming and going.
That humble being alone understands, who serves the True Guru.
Conquering his ego, he finds the Lord's Door. ||2||
From the One Lord, all others were formed.
The One Lord is pervading everywhere; there is no other at all.
Renouncing duality, one comes to know the One Lord.

842.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੈ ॥
842.t: gur kai sabadh har dhar neesaanai ||
842.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one knows the Lord's Door, and His Banner.
Meeting the True Guru, one finds the One Lord.
Duality is subdued within. ||3||
One who belongs to the All-powerful Lord and Master

842.g: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
842.t: tis no maar na saakai koi ||
842.e: no one can destroy him.
The Lord's servant remains under His protection;
The Lord Himself forgives him, and blesses him with glorious greatness.
There is none higher than Him.

842.g: ਕਉਣੁ ਡਰੈ ਡਰੁ ਕਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥
842.t: kaun ddarai ddar kis kaa hoi ||4||
842.e: Why should he be afraid? What should he ever fear? ||4||
Through the Guru's Teachings, peace and tranquility abide within the body.

842.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਿੑ ਫਿਰਿ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਪੀਰ ॥
842.t: sabadh cheeni(h) fir lagai na peer ||
842.e: Remember the Word of the Shabad, and you shall never suffer pain.

842.g: ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਨਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
842.t: aavai na jai naa dhukh paae ||
842.e: You shall not have to come or go, or suffer in sorrow.
Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you shall merge in celestial peace.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh beholds Him ever-present, close at hand.
My God is always fully pervading everywhere. ||5||
Some are selfless servants, while others wander, deluded by doubt.
The Lord Himself does, and causes everything to be done.
The One Lord is all-pervading; there is no other at all.

842.g: ਮਨਿ ਰੋਸੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਜੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
842.t: man ros keejai je dhoojaa hoi ||
842.e: The mortal might complain, if there were any other.
Serve the True Guru; this is the most excellent action.
In the Court of the True Lord, you shall be judged true. ||6||
All the lunar days, and the days of the week are beautiful, when one contemplates the Shabad.
If one serves the True Guru, he obtains the fruits of his rewards.
The omens and days all come and go.

842.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
842.t: gur sabadh nihachal sadhaa sach samaeh ||
842.e: But the Word of the Guru's Shabad is eternal and unchanging. Through it, one merges in the True Lord.

842.g: ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰ ਤਾ ਜਾ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
842.t: thitee vaar taa jaa sach raate ||
842.e: The days are auspicious, when one is imbued with Truth.
Without the Name, all the false ones wander deluded. ||7||
The self-willed manmukhs die, and dead, they fall into the most evil state.
They do not remember the One Lord; they are deluded by duality.
The human body is unconscious, ignorant and blind.
Without the Word of the Shabad, how can anyone cross over?
The Creator Himself creates.
He Himself contemplates the Guru's Word. ||8||
The religious fanatics wear all sorts of religious robes.
They roll around and wander around, like the false dice on the board.
They find no peace, here or hereafter.

843.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਏ ਅਪਣਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
843.t: manmukh mue apanaa janam khoi ||
843.e: The self-willed manmukhs waste away their lives, and die.

843.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
843.t: satigur seve bharam chukaae ||
843.e: Serving the True Guru, doubt is driven away.

843.g: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੯॥
843.t: ghar hee a(n)dhar sach mahal paae ||9||
843.e: Deep within the home of the heart, one finds the Mansion of the True Lord's Presence. ||9||

843.g: ਆਪੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
843.t: aape pooraa kare su hoi ||
843.e: Whatever the Perfect Lord does, that alone happens.

843.g: ਏਹਿ ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰ ਦੂਜਾ ਦੋਇ ॥
843.t: eh thitee vaar dhoojaa dhoi ||
843.e: Concern with these omens and days leads only to duality.

843.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਅੰਧੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
843.t: satigur baajhahu a(n)dh gubaar ||
843.e: Without the True Guru, there is only pitch darkness.

843.g: ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
843.t: thitee vaar seveh mugadh gavaar ||
843.e: Only idiots and fools worry about these omens and days.

843.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
843.t: naanak gurmukh boojhai sojhee pai ||
843.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh obtains understanding and realization;

843.g: ਇਕਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧੦॥੨॥
843.t: eikat naam sadhaa rahiaa samai ||10||2||
843.e: he remains forever merged in the Name of the One Lord. ||10||2||

843.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਛੰਤ ਦਖਣੀ
843.t: bilaaval mahalaa pehilaa chha(n)t dhakhanee
843.e: Bilaaval, First Mehla, Chhant, Dakhnee:

843.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
843.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
843.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

843.g: ਮੁੰਧ ਨਵੇਲੜੀਆ ਗੋਇਲਿ ਆਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
843.t: mu(n)dh navelaReeaa goil aaiee raam ||
843.e: The young, innocent soul-bride has come to the pasture lands of the world.

843.g: ਮਟੁਕੀ ਡਾਰਿ ਧਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
843.t: maTukee ddaar dharee har liv laiee raam ||
843.e: Laying aside her pitcher of worldly concern, she lovingly attunes herself to her Lord.

843.g: ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੀ ਗੋਇਲਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੀਆ ॥
843.t: liv lai har siau rahee goil sahaj sabadh seegaareeaa ||
843.e: She remains lovingly absorbed in the pasture of the Lord, automatically embellished with the Word of the Shabad.

843.g: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੀਆ ॥
843.t: kar joR gur peh kar bina(n)tee milahu saach piaareeaa ||
843.e: With her palms pressed together, she prays to the Guru, to unite her with her True Beloved Lord.

843.g: ਧਨ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
843.t: dhan bhai bhagatee dhekh preetam kaam karodh nivaariaa ||
843.e: Seeing His bride's loving devotion, the Beloved Lord eradicates unfulfilled sexual desire and unresolved anger.

843.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁੰਧ ਨਵੇਲ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਾਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
843.t: naanak mu(n)dh navel su(n)dhar dhekh pir saadhaariaa ||1||
843.e: O Nanak, the young, innocent bride is so beautiful; seeing her Husband Lord, she is comforted. ||1||

843.g: ਸਚਿ ਨਵੇਲੜੀਏ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਬਾਲੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
843.t: sach navelaRe'e joban baalee raam ||
843.e: Truthfully, O young soul-bride, your youth keeps you innocent.

843.g: ਆਉ ਨ ਜਾਉ ਕਹੀ ਅਪਨੇ ਸਹ ਨਾਲੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
843.t: aau na jaau kahee apane seh naalee raam ||
843.e: Do not come and go anywhere; stay with your Husband Lord.

843.g: ਨਾਹ ਅਪਨੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਦਾਸੀ ਮੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
843.t: naeh apane sa(n)g dhaasee mai bhagat har kee bhaave ||
843.e: I will stay with my Husband Lord; I am His hand-maiden. Devotional worship to the Lord is pleasing to me.

843.g: ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਥੀਐ ਸਹਜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਏ ॥
843.t: agaadh bodh akath katheeaai sahaj prabh gun gaave ||
843.e: I know the unknowable, and speak the unspoken; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Celestial Lord God.

843.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਾਲ ਰਸੀਆ ਰਵੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੀਆ ॥
843.t: raam naam rasaal raseeaa ravai saach piaareeaa ||
843.e: She who chants and savors the taste of the Lord's Name is loved by the True Lord.

843.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਦੀਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਕੀਆ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਆ ॥੨॥
843.t: gur sabadh dheeaa dhaan keeaa naanakaa veechaareeaa ||2||
843.e: The Guru grants her the gift of the Shabad; O Nanak, she contemplates and reflects upon it. ||2||

843.g: ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਮੋਹਿਅੜੀ ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੂਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
843.t: sreedhar mohiaRee pir sa(n)g sootee raam ||
843.e: She who is fascinated by the Supreme Lord, sleeps with her Husband Lord.

843.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਚਲੋ ਸਾਚਿ ਸੰਗੂਤੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
843.t: gur kai bhai chalo saach sa(n)gootee raam ||
843.e: She walks in harmony with the Guru's Will, attuned to the Lord.

843.g: ਧਨ ਸਾਚਿ ਸੰਗੂਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੂਤੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀਆ ॥
843.t: dhan saach sa(n)gootee har sa(n)g sootee sa(n)g sakhee saheleeaa ||
843.e: The soul-bride is attuned to the Truth, and sleeps with the Lord, along with her companions and sister soul-brides.

843.g: ਇਕ ਭਾਇ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਮ ਮੇਲੀਆ ॥
843.t: eik bhai ik man naam vasiaa satiguroo ham meleeaa ||
843.e: Loving the One Lord, with one-pointed mind, the Naam dwells within; I am united with the True Guru.

843.g: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਚਸਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ॥
843.t: dhin rain ghaRee na chasaa visarai saas saas nira(n)jano ||
843.e: Day and night, with each and every breath, I do not forget the Immaculate Lord, for a moment, even for an instant.

843.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਇ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਭਉ ਭੰਜਨੋ ॥੩॥
843.t: sabadh jot jagai dheepak naanakaa bhau bha(n)jano ||3||
843.e: So light the lamp of the Shabad, O Nanak, and burn away your fear. ||3||

843.g: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਇੜੀਏ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
843.t: jot sabaiRe'e tirabhavan saare raam ||
843.e: O soul-bride, the Lord's Light pervades all the three worlds.

843.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
843.t: ghaT ghaT rav rahiaa alakh apaare raam ||
843.e: He is pervading each and every heart, the Invisible and Infinite Lord.

843.g: ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਆਪੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ॥
843.t: alakh apaar apaar saachaa aap maar milaieeaai ||
843.e: He is Invisible and Infinite, Infinite and True; subduing his self-conceit, one meets Him.

843.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਲੋਭੁ ਜਾਲਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਈਐ ॥
843.t: haumai mamataa lobh jaalahu sabadh mail chukaieeaai ||
843.e: So burn away your egotistical pride, attachment and greed, with the Word of the Shabad; wash away your filth.

843.g: ਦਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਕਰੀ ਭਾਣੈ ਤਾਰਿ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
843.t: dhar jai dharasan karee bhaanai taar taaranahaariaa ||
843.e: When you go to the Lord's Door, you shall receive the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; by His Will, the Savior will carry you across and save you.

843.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
843.t: har naam a(n)mrit chaakh tirapatee naanakaa ur dhaariaa ||4||1||
843.e: Tasting the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name, the soul-bride is satisfied; O Nanak, she enshrines Him in her heart. ||4||1||

843.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
843.t: bilaaval mahalaa pehilaa ||
843.e: Bilaaval, First Mehla:

843.g: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ਘਣਾ ਸਾਚਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
843.t: mai man chaau ghanaa saach vigaasee raam ||
843.e: My mind is filled with such a great joy; I have blossomed forth in Truth.

843.g: ਮੋਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
843.t: mohee prem pire prabh abinaasee raam ||
843.e: I am enticed by the love of my Husband Lord, the Eternal, Imperishable Lord God.

843.g: ਅਵਿਗਤੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਥੁ ਨਾਥਹ ਤਿਸੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ॥
843.t: avigato har naath naatheh tisai bhaavai so theeaai ||
843.e: The Lord is everlasting, the Master of masters. Whatever He wills, happens.

843.g: ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤੂੰ ਜੀਐ ॥
843.t: kirapaal sadhaa dhiaal dhaataa jeeaa a(n)dhar too(n) jeeaai ||
843.e: O Great Giver, You are always kind and compassionate. You infuse life into all living beings.

844.g: ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਪੂਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸਿ ਰਹੇ ॥
844.t: mai avar giaan na dhiaan poojaa har naam a(n)tar vas rahe ||
844.e: I have no other spiritual wisdom, meditation or worship; the Name of the Lord alone dwells deep within me.

844.g: ਭੇਖੁ ਭਵਨੀ ਹਠੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਗਹਿ ਰਹੇ ॥੧॥
844.t: bhekh bhavanee haTh na jaanaa naanakaa sach geh rahe ||1||
844.e: I know nothing about religious robes, pilgrimages or stubborn fanaticism; O Nanak, I hold tight to the Truth. ||1||

844.g: ਭਿੰਨੜੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਭਲੀ ਦਿਨਸ ਸੁਹਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
844.t: bhi(n)naRee rain bhalee dhinas suhaae raam ||
844.e: The night is beautiful, drenched with dew, and the day is delightful,

844.g: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਤੜੀਏ ਪਿਰਮੁ ਜਗਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
844.t: nij ghar sootaRe'e piram jagaae raam ||
844.e: when her Husband Lord wakes the sleeping soul-bride, in the home of the self.

844.g: ਨਵ ਹਾਣਿ ਨਵ ਧਨ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਾਗੀ ਆਪਣੇ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਣੀਆ ॥
844.t: nav haan nav dhan sabadh jaagee aapane pir bhaaneeaa ||
844.e: The young bride has awakened to the Word of the Shabad; she is pleasing to her Husband Lord.

844.g: ਤਜਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਪਟੁ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਲੋਕਾਣੀਆ ॥
844.t: taj kooR kapaT subhaau dhoojaa chaakaree lokaaneeaa ||
844.e: So renounce falsehood, fraud, love of duality and working for people.

844.g: ਮੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਹਾਰੁ ਕੰਠੇ ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣਿਆ ॥
844.t: mai naam har kaa haar ka(n)The saach sabadh neesaaniaa ||
844.e: The Name of the Lord is my necklace, and I am anointed with the True Shabad.

844.g: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
844.t: kar joR naanak saach maagai nadhar kar tudh bhaaniaa ||2||
844.e: With his palms pressed together, Nanak begs for the gift of the True Name; please, bless me with Your Grace, through the pleasure of Your Will. ||2||

844.g: ਜਾਗੁ ਸਲੋਨੜੀਏ ਬੋਲੈ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
844.t: jaag salonaRe'e bolai gurbaanee raam ||
844.e: Awake, O bride of splendored eyes, and chant the Word of the Guru's Bani.

844.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿਅੜੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
844.t: jin sun ma(n)niaRee akath kahaanee raam ||
844.e: Listen, and place your faith in the Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

844.g: ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝਏ ॥
844.t: akath kahaanee padh nirabaanee ko viralaa gurmukh boojhe ||
844.e: The Unspoken Speech, the state of Nirvaanaa - how rare is the Gurmukh who understands this.

844.g: ਓਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਸੋਝੀ ਸੂਝਏ ॥
844.t: oh sabadh samaae aap gavaae tirabhavan sojhee soojhe ||
844.e: Merging in the Word of the Shabad, self-conceit is eradicated, and the three worlds are revealed to her understanding.

844.g: ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
844.t: rahai ateet apara(n)par raataa saach man gun saariaa ||
844.e: Remaining detached, with infinity infusing, the true mind cherishes the virtues of the Lord.

844.g: ਓਹੁ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਠਾਈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
844.t: oh poor rahiaa sarab Thaiee naanakaa ur dhaariaa ||3||
844.e: He is fully pervading and permeating all places; Nanak has enshrined Him within his heart. ||3||

844.g: ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਇੜੀਏ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਨੇਹੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
844.t: mahal bulaiRe'e bhagat sanehee raam ||
844.e: The Lord is calling you to the Mansion of His Presence; O soul-bride, He is the Lover of His devotees.

844.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਰਹਸੀ ਸੀਝਸਿ ਦੇਹੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
844.t: gurmat man rahasee seejhas dhehee raam ||
844.e: Following the Guru's Teachings, your mind shall be delighted, and your body shall be fulfilled.

844.g: ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਰੀਝੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੀਝੈ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਲੋਕ ਨਾਥੁ ਪਛਾਣਏ ॥
844.t: man maar reejhai sabadh seejhai trai lok naath pachhaane ||
844.e: Conquer and subdue your mind, and love the Word of the Shabad; reform yourself, and realize the Lord of the three worlds.

844.g: ਮਨੁ ਡੀਗਿ ਡੋਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਕਤ ਹੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਣਏ ॥
844.t: man ddeeg ddol na jai kat hee aapanaa pir jaane ||
844.e: Her mind shall not waver or wander anywhere else, when she comes to know her Husband Lord.

844.g: ਮੈ ਆਧਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਖਸਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੈ ਤਾਣੁ ਤਕੀਆ ਤੇਰਓ ॥
844.t: mai aadhaar teraa too khasam meraa mai taan takeeaa tero ||
844.e: You are my only Support, You are my Lord and Master. You are my strength and anchor.

844.g: ਸਾਚਿ ਸੂਚਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਝਗਰੁ ਨਿਬੇਰਓ ॥੪॥੨॥
844.t: saach soochaa sadhaa naanak gur sabadh jhagar nibero ||4||2||
844.e: She is forever truthful and pure, O Nanak; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, conflicts are resolved. ||4||2||

844.g: ਛੰਤ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਮੰਗਲ
844.t: chha(n)t bilaaval mahalaa chauthhaa ma(n)gal
844.e: Chhant, Bilaaval, Fourth Mehla, Mangal ~ The Song Of Joy:

844.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
844.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
844.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

844.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੇਜੈ ਆਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
844.t: meraa har prabh sejai aaiaa man sukh samaanaa raam ||
844.e: My Lord God has come to my bed, and my mind is merged with the Lord.

844.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
844.t: gur tuThai har prabh paiaa ra(n)g raleeaa maanaa raam ||
844.e: As it pleases the Guru, I have found the Lord God, and I revel and delight in His Love.

844.g: ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਮਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
844.t: vaddabhaageeaa sohaaganee har masatak maanaa raam ||
844.e: Very fortunate are those happy soul-brides, who have the jewel of the Naam upon their foreheads.

844.g: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਹਾਗੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
844.t: har prabh har sohaag hai naanak man bhaanaa raam ||1||
844.e: The Lord, the Lord God, is Nanak's Husband Lord, pleasing to his mind. ||1||

844.g: ਨਿੰਮਾਣਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
844.t: ni(n)maaniaa har maan hai har prabh har aapai raam ||
844.e: The Lord is the honor of the dishonored. The Lord, the Lord God is Himself by Himself.

844.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
844.t: gurmukh aap gavaiaa nit har har jaapai raam ||
844.e: The Gurmukh eradicates self-conceit, and constantly chants the Name of the Lord.

844.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਪੈ ਰਾਮ ॥
844.t: mere har prabh bhaavai so karai har ra(n)g har raapai raam ||
844.e: My Lord God does whatever He pleases; the Lord imbues mortal beings with the color of His Love.

844.g: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
844.t: jan naanak sahaj milaiaa har ras har dhraapai raam ||2||
844.e: Servant Nanak is easily merged into the Celestial Lord. He is satisfied with the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||

844.g: ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਵਣ ਵੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
844.t: maanas janam har paieeaai har raavan veraa raam ||
844.e: The Lord is found only through this human incarnation. This is the time to contemplate the Lord.

844.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ਘਣੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
844.t: gurmukh mil sohaaganee ra(n)g hoi ghaneraa raam ||
844.e: As Gurmukhs, the happy soul-brides meet Him, and their love for Him is abundant.

844.g: ਜਿਨ ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਭਾਗੁ ਮੰਦੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
844.t: jin maanas janam na paiaa tin(h) bhaag ma(n)dheraa raam ||
844.e: Those who have not attained human incarnation, are cursed by evil destiny.

844.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
844.t: har har har har raakh prabh naanak jan teraa raam ||3||
844.e: O Lord, God, Har, Har, Har, Har, save Nanak; he is Your humble servant. ||3||

844.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਭੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
844.t: gur har prabh agam dhiraRaiaa man tan ra(n)g bheenaa raam ||
844.e: The Guru has implanted within me the Name of the Inaccessible Lord God; my mind and body are drenched with the Lord's Love.

845.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
845.t: bhagat vachhal har naam hai gurmukh har leenaa raam ||
845.e: The Name of the Lord is the Lover of His devotees; the Gurmukhs attain the Lord.

845.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਜੀਵਦੇ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
845.t: bin har naam na jeevadhe jiau jal bin meenaa raam ||
845.e: Without the Name of the Lord, they cannot even live, like the fish without water.

845.g: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
845.t: safal janam har paiaa naanak prabh keenaa raam ||4||1||3||
845.e: Finding the Lord, my life has become fruitful; O Nanak, the Lord God has fulfilled me. ||4||1||3||

845.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
845.t: bilaaval mahalaa chauthhaa salok ||
845.e: Bilaaval, Fourth Mehla, Shalok:

845.g: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੁ ॥
845.t: har prabh sajan loR lahu man vasai vaddabhaag ||
845.e: Seek out the Lord God, your only true Friend. He shall dwell in your mind, by great good fortune.

845.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਵੇਖਾਲਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੧॥
845.t: gur poorai vekhaaliaa naanak har liv laag ||1||
845.e: The True Guru shall reveal Him to you; O Nanak, lovingly focus yourself on the Lord. ||1||

845.g: ਛੰਤ ॥
845.t: chha(n)t ||
845.e: Chhant:

845.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਵਣਿ ਆਈਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਝਾਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
845.t: meraa har prabh raavan aaieeaa haumai bikh jhaage raam ||
845.e: The soul-bride has come to ravish and enjoy her Lord God, after eradicating the poison of egotism.

845.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
845.t: gurmat aap miTaiaa har har liv laage raam ||
845.e: Following the Guru's Teachings, she has eliminated her self-conceit; she is lovingly attuned to her Lord, Har, Har.

845.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਾਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
845.t: a(n)tar kamal paragaasiaa gur giaanee jaage raam ||
845.e: Her heart-lotus deep within has blossomed forth, and through the Guru, spiritual wisdom has been awakened within her.

845.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਪੂਰੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
845.t: jan naanak har prabh paiaa poorai vaddabhaage raam ||1||
845.e: Servant Nanak has found the Lord God, by perfect, great good fortune. ||1||

845.g: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਧਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
845.t: har prabh har man bhaiaa har naam vadhaiee raam ||
845.e: The Lord, the Lord God, is pleasing to her mind; the Lord's Name resounds within her.

845.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
845.t: gur poorai prabh paiaa har har liv laiee raam ||
845.e: Through the Perfect Guru, God is obtained; she is lovingly focused on the Lord, Har, Har.

845.g: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਕਟਿਆ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਰਗਟਿਆਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
845.t: agiaan a(n)dheraa kaTiaa jot paragaTiaaiee raam ||
845.e: The darkness of ignorance is dispelled, and the Divine Light radiantly shines forth.

845.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
845.t: jan naanak naam adhaar hai har naam samaiee raam ||2||
845.e: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is Nanak's only Support; he merges into the Lord's Name. ||2||

845.g: ਧਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪਿਆਰੈ ਰਾਵੀਆ ਜਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
845.t: dhan har prabh piaarai raaveeaa jaa(n) har prabh bhaiee raam ||
845.e: The soul-bride is ravished and enjoyed by her Beloved Lord God, when the Lord God is pleased with her.

845.g: ਅਖੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕਸਾਈਆ ਜਿਉ ਬਿਲਕ ਮਸਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
845.t: akhee prem kasaieeaa jiau bilak masaiee raam ||
845.e: My eyes are drawn to His Love, like the cat to the mouse.

845.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਆਘਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
845.t: gur poorai har meliaa har ras aaghaiee raam ||
845.e: The Perfect Guru has united me with the Lord; I am satisfied by the subtle essence of the Lord.

845.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
845.t: jan naanak naam vigasiaa har har liv laiee raam ||3||
845.e: Servant Nanak blossoms forth in the Naam, the Name of the Lord; he is lovingly attuned to the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

845.g: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
845.t: ham moorakh mugadh milaiaa har kirapaa dhaaree raam ||
845.e: I am a fool and an idiot, but the Lord showered me with His Mercy, and united me with Himself.

845.g: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
845.t: dhan dha(n)n guroo saabaas hai jin haumai maaree raam ||
845.e: Blessed, blessed is the most wonderful Guru, who has conquered egotism.

845.g: ਜਿਨੑ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
845.t: jin(h) vaddabhaageeaa vaddabhaag hai har har ur dhaaree raam ||
845.e: Very fortunate, of blessed destiny are those, who enshrine the Lord, Har, Har, in their hearts.

845.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਨਾਮੇ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੨॥੪॥
845.t: jan naanak naam salaeh too naame balihaaree raam ||4||2||4||
845.e: O servant Nanak, praise the Naam, and be a sacrifice to the Naam. ||4||2||4||

845.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ
845.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa chha(n)t
845.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla, Chhant:

845.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
845.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
845.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

845.g: ਮੰਗਲ ਸਾਜੁ ਭਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਗਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
845.t: ma(n)gal saaj bhiaa prabh apanaa gaiaa raam ||
845.e: The time of rejoicing has come; I sing of my Lord God.

845.g: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਵਰੁ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਚਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
845.t: abinaasee var suniaa man upajiaa chaiaa raam ||
845.e: I have heard of my Imperishable Husband Lord, and happiness fills my mind.

845.g: ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗੈ ਕਬ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਤੇ ॥
845.t: man preet laagai vaddai bhaagai kab mileeaai pooran pate ||
845.e: My mind is in love with Him; when shall I realize my great good fortune, and meet with my Perfect Husband?

845.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਮਾਈਐ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਦੇਹੁ ਸਖੀਏ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਤੇ ॥
845.t: sahaje samaieeaai govi(n)dh paieeaai dheh sakhe'ee moh mate ||
845.e: If only I could meet the Lord of the Universe, and be automatically absorbed into Him; tell me how, O my companions!

845.g: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਠਾਢੀ ਕਰਉ ਸੇਵਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਵਨ ਜੁਗਤੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
845.t: dhin rain Thaaddee karau sevaa prabh kavan jugatee paiaa ||
845.e: Day and night, I stand and serve my God; how can I attain Him?

845.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੈਹੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
845.t: binava(n)t naanak karahu kirapaa laih moh laR laiaa ||1||
845.e: Prays Nanak, have mercy on me, and attach me to the hem of Your robe, O Lord. ||1||

845.g: ਭਇਆ ਸਮਾਹੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਵਿਸਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
845.t: bhiaa samaahaRaa har ratan visaahaa raam ||
845.e: Joy has come! I have purchased the jewel of the Lord.

845.g: ਖੋਜੀ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਧਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਪਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
845.t: khojee khoj ladhaa har sa(n)tan paahaa raam ||
845.e: Searching, the seeker has found the Lord with the Saints.

845.g: ਮਿਲੇ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰੇ ਕਥਹਿ ਅਕਥ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥
845.t: mile sa(n)t piaare dhiaa dhaare katheh akath beechaaro ||
845.e: I have met the Beloved Saints, and they have blessed me with their kindness; I contemplate the Unspoken Speech of the Lord.

845.g: ਇਕ ਚਿਤਿ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
845.t: eik chit ik man dhiaai suaamee lai preet piaaro ||
845.e: With my consciousness centered, and my mind one-pointed, I meditate on my Lord and Master, with love and affection.

845.g: ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
845.t: kar joR prabh peh kar bina(n)tee milai har jas laahaa ||
845.e: With my palms pressed together, I pray unto God, to bless me with the profit of the Lord's Praise.

845.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹਾ ॥੨॥
845.t: binava(n)t naanak dhaas teraa meraa prabh agam athaahaa ||2||
845.e: Prays Nanak, I am Your slave. My God is inaccessible and unfathomable. ||2||

846.g: ਸਾਹਾ ਅਟਲੁ ਗਣਿਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੰਜੋਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
846.t: saahaa aTal ganiaa pooran sa(n)jogo raam ||
846.e: The date for my wedding is set, and cannot be changed; my union with the Lord is perfect.

846.g: ਸੁਖਹ ਸਮੂਹ ਭਇਆ ਗਇਆ ਵਿਜੋਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
846.t: sukheh samooh bhiaa giaa vijogo raam ||
846.e: I am totally at peace, and my separation from Him has ended.

846.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਆਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਏ ਬਣੇ ਅਚਰਜ ਜਾਞੀਆਂ ॥
846.t: mil sa(n)t aae prabh dhiaae bane acharaj jaan(j)eeaa(n) ||
846.e: The Saints meet and come together, and meditate on God; they form a wondrous wedding party.

846.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਹੋਏ ਸਹਜਿ ਢੋਏ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਉਪਜੀ ਮਾਞੀਆ ॥
846.t: mil ikatr hoe sahaj ddoe man preet upajee maan(j)eeaa ||
846.e: Gathering together, they arrive with poise and grace, and love fills the minds of the bride's family.

846.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗੋ ॥
846.t: mil jot jotee ot potee har naam sabh ras bhogo ||
846.e: Her light blends with His Light, through and through, and everyone enjoys the Nectar of the Lord's Name.

846.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਸੰਤਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਜੋਗੋ ॥੩॥
846.t: binava(n)t naanak sabh sa(n)t melee prabh karan kaaran jogo ||3||
846.e: Prays Nanak, the Saints have totally united me with God, the All-powerful Cause of causes. ||3||

846.g: ਭਵਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵੜਾ ਧਰਤਿ ਸਭਾਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
846.t: bhavan suhaavaRaa dharat sabhaagee raam ||
846.e: Beautiful is my home, and beauteous is the earth.

846.g: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਅੜਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
846.t: prabh ghar aaiaRaa gur charanee laagee raam ||
846.e: God has entered the home of my heart; I touch the Guru's feet.

846.g: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਜਾਗੀ ਸਗਲ ਇਛਾ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ॥
846.t: gur charan laagee sahaj jaagee sagal ichhaa pu(n)neeaa ||
846.e: Grasping the Guru's feet, I awake in peace and poise. All my desires are fulfilled.

846.g: ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪੂਰੀ ਸੰਤ ਧੂਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਕੰਤ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥
846.t: meree aas pooree sa(n)t dhooree har mile ka(n)t vichhu(n)niaa ||
846.e: My hopes are fulfilled, through the dust of the feet of the Saints. After such a long separation, I have met my Husband Lord.

846.g: ਆਨੰਦ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਵਜਹਿ ਵਾਜੇ ਅਹੰ ਮਤਿ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
846.t: aana(n)dh anadhin vajeh vaaje aha(n) mat man kee tiaagee ||
846.e: Night and day, the sounds of ecstasy resound and resonate; I have forsaken my stubborn-minded intellect.

846.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
846.t: binava(n)t naanak saran suaamee sa(n)tasa(n)g liv laagee ||4||1||
846.e: Prays Nanak, I seek the Sanctuary of my Lord and Master; in the Society of the Saints, I am lovingly attuned to Him. ||4||1||

846.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
846.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
846.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

846.g: ਭਾਗ ਸੁਲਖਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
846.t: bhaag sulakhanaa har ka(n)t hamaaraa raam ||
846.e: By blessed destiny, I have found my Husband Lord.

846.g: ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਜਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਧੁਨਿ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
846.t: anahadh baajitraa tis dhun dharabaaraa raam ||
846.e: The unstruck sound current vibrates and resounds in the Court of the Lord.

846.g: ਆਨੰਦ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਵਜਹਿ ਵਾਜੇ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਉਮਾਹਾ ॥
846.t: aana(n)dh anadhin vajeh vaaje dhinas rain umaahaa ||
846.e: Night and day, the sounds of ecstasy resound and resonate; day and night, I am enraptured.

846.g: ਤਹ ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਨ ਦੂਖੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਤਾਹਾ ॥
846.t: teh rog sog na dhookh biaapai janam maran na taahaa ||
846.e: Disease, sorrow and suffering do not afflict anyone there; there is no birth or death there.

846.g: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਸੁਧਾ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
846.t: ridh sidh sudhaa ras a(n)mrit bhagat bhare bha(n)ddaaraa ||
846.e: There are treasures overflowing there - wealth, miraculous powers, ambrosial nectar and devotional worship.

846.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ਵੰਞਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
846.t: binava(n)t naanak balihaar va(n)n(j)aa paarabraham praan adhaaraa ||1||
846.e: Prays Nanak, I am a sacrifice, devoted to the Supreme Lord God, the Support of the breath of life. ||1||

846.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਖੀਅ ਸਹੇਲੜੀਹੋ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਹ ਰਾਮ ॥
846.t: sun sakheea sahelaReeho mil ma(n)gal gaaveh raam ||
846.e: Listen, O my companions, and sister soul-brides, let's join together and sing the songs of joy.

846.g: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਰਾਵਹ ਰਾਮ ॥
846.t: man tan prem kare tis prabh kau raaveh raam ||
846.e: Loving our God with mind and body, let's ravish and enjoy Him.

846.g: ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਰਾਵਹ ਤਿਸੈ ਭਾਵਹ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਪਲਕ ਨ ਤਿਆਗੀਐ ॥
846.t: kar prem raaveh tisai bhaaveh ik nimakh palak na tiaageeaai ||
846.e: Lovingly enjoying Him, we become pleasing to Him; let's not reject Him, for a moment, even for an instant.

846.g: ਗਹਿ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਈਐ ਨਹ ਲਜਾਈਐ ਚਰਨ ਰਜ ਮਨੁ ਪਾਗੀਐ ॥
846.t: geh ka(n)Th laieeaai neh lajaieeaai charan raj man paageeaai ||
846.e: Let's hug Him close in our embrace, and not feel shy; let's bathe our minds in the dust of His feet.

846.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਪਾਇ ਮੋਹਹ ਅਨਤ ਕਤਹੂ ਨ ਧਾਵਹ ॥
846.t: bhagat Thagauree pai moheh anat katahoo na dhaaveh ||
846.e: With the intoxicating drug of devotional worship, let's entice Him, and not wander anywhere else.

846.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਅਮਰ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਵਹ ॥੨॥
846.t: binava(n)t naanak mil sa(n)g saajan amar padhavee paaveh ||2||
846.e: Prays Nanak, meeting with our True Friend, we attain the immortal status. ||2||

846.g: ਬਿਸਮਨ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਈ ਪੇਖਿ ਗੁਣ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
846.t: bisaman bisam bhiee pekh gun abinaasee raam ||
846.e: I am wonder-struck and amazed, gazing upon the Glories of my Imperishable Lord.

846.g: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਗਹੀ ਕਟਿ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
846.t: kar geh bhujaa gahee kaT jam kee faasee raam ||
846.e: He took my hand, and held my arm, and cut away the noose of Death.

846.g: ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੀਨੑੀ ਦਾਸਿ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਅੰਕੁਰਿ ਉਦੋਤੁ ਜਣਾਇਆ ॥
846.t: geh bhujaa leen(h)ee dhaas keen(h)ee a(n)kur udhot janaiaa ||
846.e: Holding me by the arm, He made me His slave; the branch has sprouted in abundance.

846.g: ਮਲਨ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਨਾਠੇ ਦਿਵਸ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਆਇਆ ॥
846.t: malan moh bikaar naaThe dhivas niramal aaiaa ||
846.e: Pollution, attachment and corruption have run away; the immaculate day has dawned.

846.g: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਸੀ ॥
846.t: dhirasaT dhaaree man piaaree mahaa dhuramat naasee ||
846.e: Casting His Glance of Grace, the Lord loves me with His Mind; my immense evil-mindedness is dispelled.

846.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲੇ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
846.t: binava(n)t naanak bhiee niramal prabh mile abinaasee ||3||
846.e: Prays Nanak, I have become immaculate and pure; I have met the Imperishable Lord God. ||3||

846.g: ਸੂਰਜ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਲ ਕਾ ਜਲੁ ਹੂਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
846.t: sooraj kiran mile jal kaa jal hooaa raam ||
846.e: The rays of light merge with the sun, and water merges with water.

846.g: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਲੀ ਸੰਪੂਰਨੁ ਥੀਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
846.t: jotee jot ralee sa(n)pooran theeaa raam ||
846.e: One's light blends with the Light, and one becomes totally perfect.

846.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਦੀਸੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਏਕੁ ਏਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥
846.t: braham dheesai braham suneeaai ek ek vakhaaneeaai ||
846.e: I see God, hear God, and speak of the One and only God.

846.g: ਆਤਮ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਕਰਣਹਾਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
846.t: aatam pasaaraa karanahaaraa prabh binaa nahee jaaneeaai ||
846.e: The soul is the Creator of the expanse of creation. Without God, I know no other at all.

846.g: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
846.t: aap karataa aap bhugataa aap kaaran keeaa ||
846.e: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer. He created the Creation.

846.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ॥੪॥੨॥
846.t: binava(n)t naanak seiee jaaneh jin(h)ee har ras peeaa ||4||2||
846.e: Prays Nanak, they alone know this, who drink in the subtle essence of the Lord. ||4||2||

847.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ
847.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa chha(n)t
847.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla, Chhant:

847.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
847.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
847.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

847.g: ਸਖੀ ਆਉ ਸਖੀ ਵਸਿ ਆਉ ਸਖੀ ਅਸੀ ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਹ ॥
847.t: sakhee aau sakhee vas aau sakhee asee pir kaa ma(n)gal gaaveh ||
847.e: Come, O my sisters, come, O my companions, and let us remain under the Lord's control. Let's sing the Songs of Bliss of our Husband Lord.

847.g: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਸਖੀ ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਸਖੀ ਮਤੁ ਆਪਣੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਭਾਵਹ ॥
847.t: taj maan sakhee taj maan sakhee mat aapane preetam bhaaveh ||
847.e: Renounce your pride, O my companions, renounce your egotistical pride, O my sisters, so that you may become pleasing to your Beloved.

847.g: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ॥
847.t: taj maan moh bikaar dhoojaa sev ek nira(n)jano ||
847.e: Renounce pride, emotional attachment, corruption and duality, and serve the One Immaculate Lord.

847.g: ਲਗੁ ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਗਲ ਦੁਰਤ ਬਿਖੰਡਨੋ ॥
847.t: lag charan saran dhiaal preetam sagal dhurat bikha(n)ddano ||
847.e: Hold tight to the Sanctuary of the Feet of the Merciful Lord, your Beloved, the Destroyer of all sins.

847.g: ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸੀ ਤਜਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਬਿਧੀ ਨ ਧਾਵਾ ॥
847.t: hoi dhaas dhaasee taj udhaasee bahuR bidhee na dhaavaa ||
847.e: Be the slave of His slaves, forsake sorrow and sadness, and do not bother with other devices.

847.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਕਰਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤਾਮਿ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਵਾ ॥੧॥
847.t: naanak pia(n)pai karahu kirapaa taam ma(n)gal gaavaa ||1||
847.e: Prays Nanak, O Lord, please bless me with Your Mercy, that I may sing Your songs of bliss. ||1||

847.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਟੋਹਨੀ ॥
847.t: a(n)mrit pria kaa naam mai a(n)dhule Tohanee ||
847.e: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of my Beloved, is like a cane to a blind man.

847.g: ਓਹ ਜੋਹੈ ਬਹੁ ਪਰਕਾਰ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਮੋਹਨੀ ॥
847.t: oh johai bahu parakaar su(n)dhar mohanee ||
847.e: Maya seduces in so many ways, like a beautiful enticing woman.

847.g: ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮਹਾ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰਿ ਚੰਚਲਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਵ ਦਿਖਾਵਏ ॥
847.t: mohanee mahaa bachitr cha(n)chal anik bhaav dhikhaave ||
847.e: This enticer is so incredibly beautiful and clever; she entices with countless suggestive gestures.

847.g: ਹੋਇ ਢੀਠ ਮੀਠੀ ਮਨਹਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਣ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
847.t: hoi ddeeTh meeThee maneh laagai naam lain na aave ||
847.e: Maya is stubborn and persistent; she seems so sweet to the mind, and then he does not chant the Naam.

847.g: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਬਨਹਿ ਤੀਰੈ ਬਰਤ ਪੂਜਾ ਬਾਟ ਘਾਟੈ ਜੋਹਨੀ ॥
847.t: gireh baneh teerai barat poojaa baaT ghaaTai johanee ||
847.e: At home, in the forest, on the banks of sacred rivers, fasting, worshipping, on the roads and on the shore, she is spying.

847.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਮੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਟੋਹਨੀ ॥੨॥
847.t: naanak pia(n)pai dhiaa dhaarahu mai naam a(n)dhule Tohanee ||2||
847.e: Prays Nanak, please bless me with Your Kindness, Lord; I am blind, and Your Name is my cane. ||2||

847.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਅਨਾਥ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਨਾਥ ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਰਖਹੁ ॥
847.t: moh anaath pria naath jiau jaanahu tiau rakhahu ||
847.e: I am helpless and masterless; You, O my Beloved, are my Lord and Master. As it pleases You, so do You protect me.

847.g: ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਰੀਝਾਵਉ ਕਹਿ ਮੁਖਹੁ ॥
847.t: chaturaiee moh naeh reejhaavau keh mukhahu ||
847.e: I have no wisdom or cleverness; what face should I put on to please You?

847.g: ਨਹ ਚਤੁਰਿ ਸੁਘਰਿ ਸੁਜਾਨ ਬੇਤੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨਿ ਗੁਨੁ ਨਹੀ ॥
847.t: neh chatur sughar sujaan betee moh niragun gun nahee ||
847.e: I am not clever, skillful or wise; I am worthless, without any virtue at all.

847.g: ਨਹ ਰੂਪ ਧੂਪ ਨ ਨੈਣ ਬੰਕੇ ਜਹ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਹ ਰਖੁ ਤੁਹੀ ॥
847.t: neh roop dhoop na nain ba(n)ke jeh bhaavai teh rakh tuhee ||
847.e: I have no beauty or pleasing smell, no beautiful eyes. As it pleases You, please preserve me, O Lord.

847.g: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਜਇਅੰਪਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਰੁਣਾਪਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਕਿਨਿ ਲਖਹੁ ॥
847.t: jai jai jia(n)peh sagal jaa kau karunaapat gat kin lakhahu ||
847.e: His victory is celebrated by all; how can I know the state of the Lord of Mercy?

847.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਸੇਵ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਮੋਹਿ ਰਖਹੁ ॥੩॥
847.t: naanak pia(n)pai sev sevak jiau jaanahu tiau moh rakhahu ||3||
847.e: Prays Nanak, I am the servant of Your servants; as it pleases You, please preserve me. ||3||

847.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਤੁਮ ਨੀਰ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਸਰੈ ॥
847.t: moh machhulee tum neer tujh bin kiau sarai ||
847.e: I am the fish, and You are the water; without You, what can I do?

847.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਤੁਮੑ ਬੂੰਦ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਉ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਰੈ ॥
847.t: moh chaatirak tum(h) boo(n)dh tirapatau mukh parai ||
847.e: I am the rainbird, and You are the rain-drop; when it falls into my mouth, I am satisfied.

847.g: ਮੁਖਿ ਪਰੈ ਹਰੈ ਪਿਆਸ ਮੇਰੀ ਜੀਅ ਹੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤੇ ॥
847.t: mukh parai harai piaas meree jeea heeaa praanapate ||
847.e: When it falls into my mouth, my thirst is quenched; You are the Lord of my soul, my heart, my breath of life.

847.g: ਲਾਡਿਲੇ ਲਾਡ ਲਡਾਇ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਮਿਲੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਗਤੇ ॥
847.t: laaddile laadd laddai sabh meh mil hamaaree hoi gate ||
847.e: Touch me, and caress me, O Lord, You are in all; let me meet You, so that I may be emancipated.

847.g: ਚੀਤਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਮਿਟੁ ਅੰਧਾਰੇ ਜਿਉ ਆਸ ਚਕਵੀ ਦਿਨੁ ਚਰੈ ॥
847.t: cheet chitavau miT a(n)dhaare jiau aas chakavee dhin charai ||
847.e: In my consciousness I remember You, and the darkness is dispelled, like the chakvi duck, which longs to see the dawn.

847.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਮਛੁਲੀ ਨੀਰੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ॥੪॥
847.t: naanak pia(n)pai pria sa(n)g melee machhulee neer na veesarai ||4||
847.e: Prays Nanak, O my Beloved, please unite me with Yourself; the fish never forgets the water. ||4||

847.g: ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਭਾਗ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਪਿਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
847.t: dhan dha(n)n hamaare bhaag ghar aaiaa pir meraa ||
847.e: Blessed, blessed is my destiny; my Husband Lord has come into my home.

847.g: ਸੋਹੇ ਬੰਕ ਦੁਆਰ ਸਗਲਾ ਬਨੁ ਹਰਾ ॥
847.t: sohe ba(n)k dhuaar sagalaa ban haraa ||
847.e: The gate of my mansion is so beautiful, and all my gardens are so green and alive.

847.g: ਹਰ ਹਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖਹ ਗਾਮੀ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸੁ ਘਣਾ ॥
847.t: har haraa suaamee sukheh gaamee anadh ma(n)gal ras ghanaa ||
847.e: My peace-giving Lord and Master has rejuvenated me, and blessed me with great joy, bliss and love.

847.g: ਨਵਲ ਨਵਤਨ ਨਾਹੁ ਬਾਲਾ ਕਵਨ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਨ ਭਣਾ ॥
847.t: naval navatan naahu baalaa kavan rasanaa gun bhanaa ||
847.e: My Young Husband Lord is eternally young, and His body is forever youthful; what tongue can I use to chant His Glorious Praises?

847.g: ਮੇਰੀ ਸੇਜ ਸੋਹੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਸਗਲ ਸਹਸਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਰਾ ॥
847.t: meree sej sohee dhekh mohee sagal sahasaa dhukh haraa ||
847.e: My bed is beautiful; gazing upon Him, I am fascinated, and all my doubts and pains are dispelled.

847.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪਇਅੰਪੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਾ ॥੫॥੧॥੩॥
847.t: naanak pia(n)pai meree aas pooree mile suaamee apara(n)paraa ||5||1||3||
847.e: Prays Nanak, my hopes are fulfilled; my Lord and Master is unlimited. ||5||1||3||

847.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ ਮੰਗਲ
847.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa chha(n)t ma(n)gal
847.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla, Chhant, Mangal ~ The Song Of Joy:

847.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
847.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
847.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

847.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
847.t: salok ||
847.e: Shalok:

847.g: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਪੀਉ ॥
847.t: su(n)dhar saa(n)t dhiaal prabh sarab sukhaa nidh peeau ||
847.e: God is beautiful, tranquil and merciful; He is the treasure of absolute peace, my Husband Lord.

848.g: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭੇਟਿਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੀ ਹੋਤ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
848.t: sukh saagar prabh bheTiaai naanak sukhee hot ih jeeau ||1||
848.e: Meeting with God, the Ocean of Peace, O Nanak, this soul becomes happy. ||1||

848.g: ਛੰਤ ॥
848.t: chha(n)t ||
848.e: Chhant:

848.g: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਬ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
848.t: sukh saagar prabh paieeaai jab hovai bhaago raam ||
848.e: One finds God, the Ocean of Peace, when destiny is activated.

848.g: ਮਾਨਨਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਵਞਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
848.t: maanan maan van(j)aieeaai har charanee laago raam ||
848.e: Abandoning the distinctions of honor and dishonor, grasp the Feet of the Lord.

848.g: ਛੋਡਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਚਾਤੁਰੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਤਿਆਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
848.t: chhodd siaanap chaaturee dhuramat budh tiaago raam ||
848.e: Renounce cleverness and trickery, and forsake your evil-minded intellect.

848.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਉ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਹਾਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
848.t: naanak pau saranaiee raam rai thir hoi suhaago raam ||1||
848.e: O Nanak, seek the Sanctuary of the Sovereign Lord, Your King, and your marriage will be permanent and stable. ||1||

848.g: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਜਿ ਕਤ ਲਾਗੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
848.t: so prabh taj kat laageeaai jis bin mar jaieeaai raam ||
848.e: Why forsake God, and attach yourself to another? Without the Lord, you cannot even live.

848.g: ਲਾਜ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮਤੀ ਦੁਰਜਨ ਬਿਰਮਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
848.t: laaj na aavai agiaan matee dhurajan biramaieeaai raam ||
848.e: The ignorant fool does not feel any shame; the evil man wanders around deluded.

848.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਹੁ ਕਤ ਠਹਰਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
848.t: patit paavan prabh tiaag kare kahu kat Thaharaieeaai raam ||
848.e: God is the Purifier of sinners; if he forsakes God, tell me, where he can find a place of rest?

848.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਕੀ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
848.t: naanak bhagat bhaau kar dhiaal kee jeevan padh paieeaai raam ||2||
848.e: O Nanak, by loving devotional worship of the Merciful Lord, he attains the state of eternal life. ||2||

848.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੋਪਾਲੁ ਨ ਉਚਰਹਿ ਬਲਿ ਗਈਏ ਦੁਹਚਾਰਣਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
848.t: sree gopaal na uchareh bal gie'ee dhuhachaaran rasanaa raam ||
848.e: May that vicious tongue that does not chant the Name of the Great Lord of the World, be burnt.

848.g: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਨਹ ਸੇਵਹੀ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਕ ਗ੍ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
848.t: prabh bhagat vachhal neh sevahee kaiaa kaak grasanaa raam ||
848.e: One who does not serve God, the Lover of His devotees, shall have his body eaten by crows.

848.g: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਦੂਖ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਬਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
848.t: bhram mohee dhookh na jaanahee koT jonee basanaa raam ||
848.e: Enticed by doubt, he does not understand the pain it brings; he wanders through millions of incarnations.

848.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਜਿ ਚਾਹਨਾ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਮ ਭਸਮਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
848.t: naanak bin har avar j chaahanaa bisaTaa kiram bhasamaa raam ||3||
848.e: O Nanak, if you desire anything other than the Lord, you shall be consumed, like a maggot in manure. ||3||

848.g: ਲਾਇ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਸੰਗੇ ਹੋਇ ਮਿਲੁ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
848.t: lai birahu bhagava(n)t sa(n)ge hoi mil bairaagan raam ||
848.e: Embrace love for the Lord God, and in detachment, unite with Him.

848.g: ਚੰਦਨ ਚੀਰ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਰਸਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਤਿਆਗਨਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
848.t: cha(n)dhan cheer suga(n)dh rasaa haumai bikh tiaagan raam ||
848.e: Give up your sandalwood oil, expensive clothes, perfumes, tasty flavors and the poison of egotism.

848.g: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਨਹ ਡੋਲੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਾਗਨਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
848.t: e'eet uoot neh ddoleeaai har sevaa jaagan raam ||
848.e: Do not waver this way or that, but remain wakeful in the service of the Lord.

848.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਾ ਅਟਲ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
848.t: naanak jin prabh paiaa aapanaa saa aTal suhaagan raam ||4||1||4||
848.e: O Nanak, she who has obtained her God, is a happy soul-bride forever. ||4||1||4||

848.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
848.t: bilaaval mahalaa panjavaa ||
848.e: Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

848.g: ਹਰਿ ਖੋਜਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
848.t: har khojahu vaddabhaageeho mil saadhoo sa(n)ge raam ||
848.e: Seek the Lord, O fortunate ones, and join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

848.g: ਗੁਨ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਸਦ ਗਾਈਅਹਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
848.t: gun govidh sadh gaie'eeh paarabraham kai ra(n)ge raam ||
848.e: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe forever, imbued with the Love of the Supreme Lord God.

848.g: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਫਲ ਮੰਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
848.t: so prabh sadh hee seveeaai paie'eeh fal ma(n)ge raam ||
848.e: Serving God forever, you shall obtain the fruitful rewards you desire.

848.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਪਿ ਅਨਤ ਤਰੰਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
848.t: naanak prabh saranaagatee jap anat tara(n)ge raam ||1||
848.e: O Nanak, seek the Sanctuary of God; meditate on the Lord, and ride the many waves of the mind. ||1||

848.g: ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
848.t: eik til prabhoo na veesarai jin sabh kichh dheenaa raam ||
848.e: I shall not forget God, even for an instant; He has blessed me with everything.

848.g: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮੇਲਾਵੜਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਚੀਨੑਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
848.t: vaddabhaagee melaavaRaa gurmukh pir cheen(h)aa raam ||
848.e: By great good fortune, I have met Him; as Gurmukh, I contemplate my Husband Lord.

848.g: ਬਾਹ ਪਕੜਿ ਤਮ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਲੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
848.t: baeh pakaR tam te kaaddiaa kar apunaa leenaa raam ||
848.e: Holding me by the arm, He has lifted me up and pulled me out of the darkness, and made me His own.

848.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵੈ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
848.t: naam japat naanak jeevai seetal man seenaa raam ||2||
848.e: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Nanak lives; his mind and heart are cooled and soothed. ||2||

848.g: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਹਿ ਸਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
848.t: kiaa gun tere keh sakau prabh a(n)tarajaamee raam ||
848.e: What virtues of Yours can I speak, O God, O Searcher of hearts?

848.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੈ ਭਏ ਪਾਰਗਰਾਮੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
848.t: simar simar naarainai bhe paaragaraamee raam ||
848.e: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Lord, I have crossed over to the other shore.

848.g: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੇ ਸਭ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਮੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
848.t: gun gaavat govi(n)dh ke sabh ichh pujaamee raam ||
848.e: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, all my desires are fulfilled.

848.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰੇ ਸਭਹੂ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
848.t: naanak udhare jap hare sabhahoo kaa suaamee raam ||3||
848.e: Nanak is saved, meditating on the Lord, the Lord and Master of all. ||3||

848.g: ਰਸ ਭਿੰਨਿਅੜੇ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਰਾਮ ਸੰਗੇ ਸੇ ਲੋਇਣ ਨੀਕੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
848.t: ras bhi(n)niaRe apune raam sa(n)ge se loin neeke raam ||
848.e: Sublime are those eyes, which are drenched with the Love of the Lord.

848.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੇਖਤ ਇਛਾ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਜੀ ਕੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
848.t: prabh pekhat ichhaa pu(n)neeaa mil saajan jee ke raam ||
848.e: Gazing upon God, my desires are fulfilled; I have met the Lord, the Friend of my soul.

848.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਸ ਫੀਕੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
848.t: a(n)mirat ras har paiaa bikhiaa ras feeke raam ||
848.e: I have obtained the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Love, and now the taste of corruption is insipid and tasteless to me.

848.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਲੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮੀਕੇ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੨॥੫॥੯॥
848.t: naanak jal jaleh samaiaa jotee jot meeke raam ||4||2||5||9||
848.e: O Nanak, as water mingles with water, my light has merged into the Light. ||4||2||5||9||

849.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪
849.t: bilaaval kee vaar mahalaa chauthhaa
849.e: Vaar Of Bilaaval, Fourth Mehla:

849.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
849.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
849.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

849.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
849.t: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
849.e: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

849.g: ਹਰਿ ਉਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗਾਵਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਦੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਰਾਗੁ ॥
849.t: har utam har prabh gaaviaa kar naadh bilaaval raag ||
849.e: I sing of the sublime Lord, the Lord God, in the melody of Raag Bilaaval.

849.g: ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
849.t: aupadhes guroo sun ma(n)niaa dhur masatak pooraa bhaag ||
849.e: Hearing the Guru's Teachings, I obey them; this is the pre-ordained destiny written upon my forehead.

849.g: ਸਭ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
849.t: sabh dhinas rain gun ucharai har har har ur liv laag ||
849.e: All day and night, I chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har; within my heart, I am lovingly attuned to Him.

849.g: ਸਭੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਖਿੜਿਆ ਹਰਿਆ ਬਾਗੁ ॥
849.t: sabh tan man hariaa hoiaa man khiRiaa hariaa baag ||
849.e: My body and mind are totally rejuvenated, and the garden of my mind has blossomed forth in lush abundance.

849.g: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਚਰਾਗੁ ॥
849.t: agiaan a(n)dheraa miT giaa gur chaanan giaan charaag ||
849.e: The darkness of ignorance has been dispelled, with the light of the lamp of the Guru's wisdom. Servant Nanak lives by beholding the Lord.

849.g: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਘੜੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੧॥
849.t: jan naanak jeevai dhekh har ik nimakh ghaRee mukh laag ||1||
849.e: Let me behold Your face, for a moment, even an instant! ||1||

849.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
849.e: Third Mehla:

849.g: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਕੀਜੀਐ ਜਬ ਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
849.t: bilaaval tab hee keejeeaai jab mukh hovai naam ||
849.e: Be happy and sing in Bilaaval, when the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is in your mouth.

849.g: ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਜਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
849.t: raag naadh sabadh sohane jaa laagai sahaj dhiaan ||
849.e: The melody and music, and the Word of the Shabad are beautiful, when one focuses his meditation on the celestial Lord.

849.g: ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਛੋਡਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਤਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
849.t: raag naadh chhodd har seveeaai taa dharageh paieeaai maan ||
849.e: So leave behind the melody and music, and serve the Lord; then, you shall obtain honor in the Court of the Lord.

849.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
849.t: naanak gurmukh braham beechaareeaai chookai man abhimaan ||2||
849.e: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, contemplate God, and rid your mind of egotistical pride. ||2||

849.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
849.t: pauRee ||
849.e: Pauree:

849.g: ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
849.t: too har prabh aap aga(n)m hai sabh tudh upaiaa ||
849.e: O Lord God, You Yourself are inaccessible; You formed everything.

849.g: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
849.t: too aape aap varatadhaa sabh jagat sabaiaa ||
849.e: You Yourself are totally permeating and pervading the entire universe.
