860.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਓਹੁ ਊਤਮੁ ਸੰਤੁ ਭਇਓ ਬਡ ਬਡਨਾ ॥
860.t: sabadh pachhaan raam ras paavahu oh uootam sa(n)t bhio badd baddanaa ||
860.e: One who realizes the Word of the Shabad, obtains the sublime essence of the Lord; such a Saint is lofty and sublime, the greatest of the great.

860.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਧਾਈ ਓਹੁ ਘਟੈ ਨ ਕਿਸੈ ਕੀ ਘਟਾਈ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਤਿਲਨਾ ॥੩॥
860.t: tis jan kee vaddiaaiee har aap vadhaiee oh ghaTai na kisai kee ghaTaiee ik til til tilanaa ||3||
860.e: The Lord Himself magnifies the glory of that humble servant. No one can lessen or decrease that glory, not even a bit. ||3||

861.g: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੋ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ ਨਿਤ ਕਰ ਜੁਰਨਾ ॥
861.t: jis te sukh paaveh man mere so sadhaa dhiaai nit kar juranaa ||
861.e: He shall give you peace, O my mind; meditate forever, every day on Him, with your palms pressed together.

861.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਕੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਿਤ ਬਸਹਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਚਰਨਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
861.t: jan naanak kau har dhaan ik dheejai nit baseh ridhai haree moh charanaa ||4||3||
861.e: Please bless servant Nanak with this one gift, O Lord, that Your feet may dwell within my heart forever. ||4||3||

861.g: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
861.t: go(n)dd mahalaa chauthhaa ||
861.e: Gond, Fourth Mehla:

861.g: ਜਿਤਨੇ ਸਾਹ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਉਮਰਾਵ ਸਿਕਦਾਰ ਚਉਧਰੀ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਝੂਠੁ ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
861.t: jitane saeh paatisaeh umaraav sikadhaar chaudharee sabh mithiaa jhooTh bhaau dhoojaa jaan ||
861.e: All the kings, emperors, nobles, lords and chiefs are false and transitory, engrossed in duality - know this well.

861.g: ਹਰਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
861.t: har abinaasee sadhaa thir nihachal tis mere man bhaj paravaan ||1||
861.e: The eternal Lord is permanent and unchanging; meditate on Him, O my mind, and you shall be approved. ||1||

861.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੀ ਭਜੁ ਸਦਾ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
861.t: mere man naam haree bhaj sadhaa dheebaan ||
861.e: O my mind, vibrate, and meditate on the Lord's Name, which shall be your defender forever.

861.g: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਦਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
861.t: jo har mahal paavai gur bachanee tis jevadd avar naahee kisai dhaa taan ||1|| rahaau ||
861.e: One who obtains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, through the Word of the Guru's Teachings - no one else's power is as great as his. ||1||Pause||

861.g: ਜਿਤਨੇ ਧਨਵੰਤ ਕੁਲਵੰਤ ਮਿਲਖਵੰਤ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕਚਾਣੁ ॥
861.t: jitane dhanava(n)t kulava(n)t milakhava(n)t dheeseh man mere sabh binas jaeh jiau ra(n)g kasu(n)bh kachaan ||
861.e: All the wealthy, high class property owners which you see, O my mind, shall vanish, like the fading color of the safflower.

861.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਤੂ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
861.t: har sat nira(n)jan sadhaa sev man mere jit har dharageh paaveh too maan ||2||
861.e: Serve the True, Immaculate Lord forever, O my mind, and you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

861.g: ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਸੂਦ ਵੈਸ ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਆਸ੍ਰਮ ਹਹਿ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
861.t: braahaman khatree soodh vais chaar varan chaar aasram heh jo har dhiaavai so paradhaan ||
861.e: There are four castes: Brahmin, Kh'shaatriya, Soodra and Vaishya, and there are four stages of life. One who meditates on the Lord, is the most distinguished and renowned.

861.g: ਜਿਉ ਚੰਦਨ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਿਰਡੁ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਤਿਉ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
861.t: jiau cha(n)dhan nikaT vasai hiradd bapuRaa tiau satasa(n)gat mil patit paravaan ||3||
861.e: The poor castor oil plant, growing near the sandalwood tree, becomes fragrant; in the same way, the sinner, associating with the Saints, becomes acceptable and approved. ||3||

861.g: ਓਹੁ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਸੂਚਾ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥
861.t: oh sabh te uoochaa sabh te soochaa jaa kai hiradhai vasiaa bhagavaan ||
861.e: He, within whose heart the Lord abides, is the highest of all, and the purest of all.

861.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਲੈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਸੇਵਕਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੪॥
861.t: jan naanak tis ke charan pakhaalai jo har jan neech jaat sevakaan ||4||4||
861.e: Servant Nanak washes the feet of that humble servant of the Lord; he may be from a low class family, but he is now the Lord's servant. ||4||4||

861.g: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
861.t: go(n)dd mahalaa chauthhaa ||
861.e: Gond, Fourth Mehla:

861.g: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਭਤੈ ਵਰਤੈ ਜੇਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਤੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਕਰਈਐ ॥
861.t: har a(n)tarajaamee sabhatai varatai jehaa har karaae tehaa ko karieeaai ||
861.e: The Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is all-pervading. As the Lord causes them to act, so do they act.

861.g: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੋ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਰਖਿ ਲਈਐ ॥੧॥
861.t: so aaisaa har sev sadhaa man mere jo tudhano sabh dhoo rakh lieeaai ||1||
861.e: So serve forever such a Lord, O my mind, who will protect you from everything. ||1||

861.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਪੜਈਐ ॥
861.t: mere man har jap har nit paRieeaai ||
861.e: O my mind, meditate on the Lord, and read about the Lord every day.

861.g: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਤਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਾਇਤੁ ਕੜਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
861.t: har bin ko maar jeevaal na saakai taa mere man kait kaRieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
861.e: Other than the Lord, no one can kill you or save you; so why do you worry, O my mind? ||1||Pause||

861.g: ਹਰਿ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰਈਐ ॥
861.t: har parapa(n)ch keeaa sabh karatai vich aape aapanee jot dharieeaai ||
861.e: The Creator created the entire universe, and infused His Light into it.

861.g: ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਬੁਲਾਏ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਦਿਖਈਐ ॥੨॥
861.t: har eko bolai har ek bulaae gur poorai har ek dhikhieeaai ||2||
861.e: The One Lord speaks, and the One Lord causes all to speak.The Perfect Guru has revealed the One Lord. ||2||

861.g: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ਕਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਮਨ ਕਿਆ ਚੋਰਈਐ ॥
861.t: har a(n)tar naale baahar naale kahu tis paasahu man kiaa chorieeaai ||
861.e: The Lord is with you, inside and out; tell me, O mind, how can You hide anything from Him?

861.g: ਨਿਹਕਪਟ ਸੇਵਾ ਕੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੀ ਤਾਂ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਈਐ ॥੩॥
861.t: nihakapaT sevaa keejai har keree taa(n) mere man sarab sukh pieeaai ||3||
861.e: Serve the Lord open-heartedly, and then, O my mind, you shall find total peace. ||3||

861.g: ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਵਸਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੋ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਵਡਾ ਸੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਅਈਐ ॥
861.t: jis dhai vas sabh kichh so sabh dhoo vaddaa so mere man sadhaa dhieeaai ||
861.e: Everything is under His control; He is the greatest of all. O my mind, meditate forever on Him.

861.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ਹੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਤੁਧੁ ਲਏ ਛਡਈਐ ॥੪॥੫॥
861.t: jan naanak so har naal hai terai har sadhaa dhiaai too tudh le chhaddieeaai ||4||5||
861.e: O Servant Nanak, that Lord is always with you. Meditate forever on your Lord, and He shall emancipate you. ||4||5||

861.g: ਗੋਂਡ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
861.t: go(n)dd mahalaa chauthhaa ||
861.e: Gond, Fourth Mehla:

861.g: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਤਪਤੈ ਜਿਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾਵੰਤੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨੀਰ ॥੧॥
861.t: har dharasan kau meraa man bahu tapatai jiau tirakhaava(n)t bin neer ||1||
861.e: My mind yearns so deeply for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, like the thirsty man without water. ||1||

861.g: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਲਗੋ ਹਰਿ ਤੀਰ ॥
861.t: merai man prem lago har teer ||
861.e: My mind is pierced through by the arrow of the Lord's Love.

861.g: ਹਮਰੀ ਬੇਦਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਪੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
861.t: hamaree bedhan har prabh jaanai mere man a(n)tar kee peer ||1|| rahaau ||
861.e: The Lord God knows my anguish, and the pain deep within my mind. ||1||Pause||

861.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕੀ ਕੋਈ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਭਾਈ ਸੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੀਰ ॥੨॥
861.t: mere har preetam kee koiee baat sunaavai so bhaiee so meraa beer ||2||
861.e: Whoever tells me the Stories of my Beloved Lord is my Sibling of Destiny, and my friend. ||2||

862.g: ਮਿਲੁ ਮਿਲੁ ਸਖੀ ਗੁਣ ਕਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਲੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਧੀਰ ॥੩॥
862.t: mil mil sakhee gun kahu mere prabh ke le satigur kee mat dheer ||3||
862.e: Come, and join together, O my companions; let's sing the Glorious Praises of my God, and follow the comforting advice of the True Guru.. ||3||

862.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਸ ਪੁਜਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਰੀਰ ॥੪॥੬॥
862.t: jan naanak kee har aas pujaavahu har dharasan saa(n)t sareer ||4||6||
862.e: Please fulfill the hopes of servant Nanak, O Lord; his body finds peace and tranquility in the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||4||6||
First set of six. ||

862.t: raag go(n)dd mahalaa panjavaa chaupadhe ghar pehilaa
862.e: Raag Gond, Fifth Mehla, Chau-Padhay, First House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
He is the Creator of all, He is the Enjoyer of all. ||1||Pause||
The Creator listens, and the Creator sees.
The Creator is unseen, and the Creator is seen.
The Creator forms, and the Creator destroys.
The Creator touches, and the Creator is detached. ||1||
The Creator is the One who speaks, and the Creator is the One who understands.
The Creator comes, and the Creator also goes.
The Creator is absolute and without qualities; the Creator is related, with the most excellent qualities.
By Guru's Grace, Nanak looks upon all the same. ||2||1||
Gond, Fifth Mehla:

862.g: ਫਾਕਿਓ ਮੀਨ ਕਪਿਕ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਤੂ ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਕਸੁੰਭਾਇਲੇ ॥
862.t: faakio meen kapik kee niaaiee too urajh rahio kasu(n)bhaile ||
862.e: You are caught, like the fish and the monkey; you are entangled in the transitory world.

862.g: ਪਗ ਧਾਰਹਿ ਸਾਸੁ ਲੇਖੈ ਲੈ ਤਉ ਉਧਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਲੇ ॥੧॥
862.t: pag dhaareh saas lekhai lai tau udhareh har gun gaile ||1||
862.e: Your foot-steps and your breaths are numbered; only by singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord will you be saved. ||1||
O mind, reform yourself, and forsake your aimless wandering.

862.g: ਅਪਨੇ ਰਹਨ ਕਉ ਠਉਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਕਾਏ ਪਰ ਕੈ ਜਾਇਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
862.t: apane rahan kau Thaur na paaveh kaae par kai jaile ||1|| rahaau ||
862.e: You have found no place of rest for yourself; so why do you try to teach others? ||1||Pause||

862.g: ਜਿਉ ਮੈਗਲੁ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਰਸਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਰਿਓ ਤੂ ਲਾਗਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਕੁਟੰਬਾਇਲੇ ॥
862.t: jiau maigal i(n)dhree ras prerio too laag pario kuTa(n)baile ||
862.e: Like the elephant, driven by sexual desire, you are attached to your family.

862.g: ਜਿਉ ਪੰਖੀ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਹੋਇ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਿਛੁਰੈ ਥਿਰੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਲੇ ॥੨॥
862.t: jiau pa(n)khee ikatr hoi fir bichhurai thir sa(n)gat har har dhiaaile ||2||
862.e: People are like birds that come together, and fly apart again; you shall become stable and steady, only when you meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, in the Company of the Holy. ||2||

862.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਮੀਨੁ ਰਸਨ ਸਾਦਿ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਓਹੁ ਮੂਠੌ ਮੂੜ ਲੋਭਾਇਲੇ ॥
862.t: jaise meen rasan saadh binasio oh mooThau mooR lobhaile ||
862.e: Like the fish, which perishes because of its desire to taste, the fool is ruined by his greed.

862.g: ਤੂ ਹੋਆ ਪੰਚ ਵਾਸਿ ਵੈਰੀ ਕੈ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਪਰੁ ਸਰਨਾਇਲੇ ॥੩॥
862.t: too hoaa pa(n)ch vaas vairee kai chhooTeh par saranaile ||3||
862.e: You have fallen under the power of the five thieves; escape is only possible in the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||3||

862.g: ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਮੑਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤਾਇਲੇ ॥
862.t: hoh kirapaal dheen dhukh bha(n)jan sabh tum(h)re jeea ja(n)taile ||
862.e: Be Merciful to me, O Destroyer of the pains of the meek; all beings and creatures belong to You.

862.g: ਪਾਵਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਾ ਮਿਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਇਲੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
862.t: paavau dhaan sadhaa dharas pekhaa mil naanak dhaas dhasaile ||4||2||
862.e: May I obtain the gift of always seeing the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; meeting with You, Nanak is the slave of Your slaves. ||4||2||

862.t: raag go(n)dd mahalaa panjavaa chaupadhe ghar doojaa
862.e: Raag Gond, Fifth Mehla, Chau-Padhay, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
He fashioned the soul and the breath of life,
and infused His Light into the dust;

862.g: ਬਰਤਨ ਕਉ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਭੋਜਨ ਭੋਗਾਇ ॥
862.t: baratan kau sabh kichh bhojan bhogai ||
862.e: He exalted you and gave you everything to use, and food to eat and enjoy

862.g: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਜਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਕਤ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
862.t: so prabh taj mooRe kat jai ||1||
862.e: - how can you forsake that God, you fool! Where else will you go? ||1||
Commit yourself to the service of the Transcendent Lord.

862.g: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੁਝੈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
862.t: gur te sujhai nira(n)jan dhev ||1|| rahaau ||
862.e: Through the Guru, one understands the Immaculate, Divine Lord. ||1||Pause||
He created plays and dramas of all sorts;
He creates and destroys in an instant;

862.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
862.t: jaa kee gat mit kahee na jai ||
862.e: His state and condition cannot be described.

862.g: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੨॥
862.t: so prabh man mere sadhaa dhiaai ||2||
862.e: Meditate forever on that God, O my mind. ||2||
The unchanging Lord does not come or go.

862.g: ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਨਾ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕੇਤਕ ਗਨੀ ॥
862.t: bea(n)t gunaa taa ke ketak ganee ||
862.e: His Glorious Virtues are infinite; how many of them can I count?

863.g: ਲਾਲ ਨਾਮ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
863.t: laal naam jaa kai bhare bha(n)ddaar ||
863.e: His treasure is overflowing with the rubies of the Name.
He gives Support to all hearts. ||3||

863.g: ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਹੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
863.t: sat purakh jaa ko hai naau ||
863.e: The Name is the True Primal Being;

863.g: ਮਿਟਹਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘ ਨਿਮਖ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਉ ॥
863.t: miTeh koT agh nimakh jas gaau ||
863.e: millions of sins are washed away in an instant, singing His Praises.
The Lord God is your best friend, your playmate from earliest childhood.
He is the Support of the breath of life; O Nanak, He is love, He is consciousness. ||4||1||3||
Gond, Fifth Mehla:
I trade in the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

863.g: ਨਾਮੋੁ ਹੀ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
863.t: naamuo hee is man kaa adhaar ||
863.e: The Naam is the Support of the mind.
My consciousness takes to the Shelter of the Naam.
Chanting the Naam, millions of sins are erased. ||1||
The Lord has blessed me with the wealth of the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.

863.g: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਇਸਟੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
863.t: man kaa isaT gur sa(n)g dhiaan ||1|| rahaau ||
863.e: The wish of my mind is to meditate on the Naam, in association with the Guru. ||1||Pause||
The Naam is the wealth of my soul.
Wherever I go, the Naam is with me.
The Naam is sweet to my mind.

863.g: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੨॥
863.t: jal thal sabh meh naamo ddeeThaa ||2||
863.e: In the water, on the land, and everywhere, I see the Naam. ||2||
Through the Naam, one's face becomes radiant in the Court of the Lord.
Through the Naam, all one's generations are saved.
Through the Naam, my affairs are resolved.
My mind is accustomed to the Naam. ||3||
Through the Naam, I have become fearless.
Through the Naam, my comings and goings have ceased.
The Perfect Guru has united me with the Lord, the treasure of virtue.
Says Nanak, I dwell in celestial peace. ||4||2||4||
Gond, Fifth Mehla:
He grants honor to the dishonored,
and gives gifts to all the hungry;
he protects those in the terrible womb.
So humbly bow forever to that Lord and Master. ||1||
Meditate on such a God in your mind.

863.g: ਘਟਿ ਅਵਘਟਿ ਜਤ ਕਤਹਿ ਸਹਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
863.t: ghaT avaghaT jat kateh sahai ||1|| rahaau ||
863.e: He shall be your help and support everywhere, in good times and bad. ||1||Pause||

863.g: ਰੰਕੁ ਰਾਉ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥
863.t: ra(n)k raau jaa kai ek samaan ||
863.e: The beggar and the king are all the same to Him.
He sustains and fulfills both the ant and the elephant.
He does not consult or seek anyone's advice.

863.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਆਪਹਿ ਕਰੈ ॥੨॥
863.t: jo kichh karai su aapeh karai ||2||
863.e: Whatever He does, He does Himself. ||2||

863.g: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
863.t: jaa kaa a(n)t na jaanas koi ||
863.e: No one knows His limit.
He Himself is the Immaculate Lord.
He Himself is formed, and He Himself is formless.

863.g: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਘਟਿ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
863.t: ghaT ghaT ghaT sabh ghaT aadhaar ||3||
863.e: In the heart, in each and every heart, He is the Support of all hearts. ||3||
Through the Love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the devotees become His Beloveds.
Singing the Praises of the Creator, the Saints are forever in bliss.
Through the Love of the Naam, the Lord's humble servants remain satisfied.
Nanak falls at the feet of those humble servants of the Lord. ||4||3||5||
Gond, Fifth Mehla:

863.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ॥
863.t: jaa kai sa(n)g ih man niramal ||
863.e: Associating with them, this mind becomes immaculate and pure.

863.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ॥
863.t: jaa kai sa(n)g har har simaran ||
863.e: Associating with them, one meditates in remembrance on the Lord, Har, Har.

863.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਹੋਹਿ ਨਾਸ ॥
863.t: jaa kai sa(n)g kilabikh hoh naas ||
863.e: Associating with them, all the sins are erased.
Associating with them, the heart is illumined. ||1||

863.g: ਸੇ ਸੰਤਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
863.t: se sa(n)tan har ke mere meet ||
863.e: Those Saints of the Lord are my friends.

863.g: ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
863.t: keval naam gaieeaai jaa kai neet ||1|| rahaau ||
863.e: It is their custom to sing only the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

863.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮੰਤ੍ਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
863.t: jaa kai ma(n)tr har har man vasai ||
863.e: By their mantra, the Lord, Har, Har, dwells in the mind.

863.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਨਸੈ ॥
863.t: jaa kai upadhes bharam bhau nasai ||
863.e: By their teachings, doubt and fear are dispelled.
By their kirtan, they become immaculate and sublime.
The world longs for the dust of their feet. ||2||

863.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰ ॥
863.t: koT patit jaa kai sa(n)g udhaar ||
863.e: Millions of sinners are saved by associating with them.

863.g: ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
863.t: ek nira(n)kaar jaa kai naam adhaar ||
863.e: They have the Support of the Name of the One Formless Lord.
He knows the secrets of all beings;
He is the treasure of mercy, the divine immaculate Lord. ||3||
When the Supreme Lord God becomes merciful,
then one meets the Merciful Holy Guru.

864.e: Day and night, Nanak meditates on the Naam.
Through the Lord's Name, he is blessed with peace, poise and bliss. ||4||4||6||
Gond, Fifth Mehla:

864.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
864.t: gur kee moorat man meh dhiaan ||
864.e: Meditate on the image of the Guru within your mind;

864.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨ ॥
864.t: gur kai sabadh ma(n)tr man maan ||
864.e: let your mind accept the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and His Mantra.

864.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਲੈ ਧਾਰਉ ॥
864.t: gur ke charan ridhai lai dhaarau ||
864.e: Enshrine the Guru's feet within your heart.
Bow in humility forever before the Guru, the Supreme Lord God. ||1||
Let no one wander in doubt in the world.

864.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
864.t: gur bin koi na utaras paar ||1|| rahaau ||
864.e: Without the Guru, no one can cross over. ||1||Pause||
The Guru shows the Path to those who have wandered off.
He leads them to renounce others, and attaches them to devotional worship of the Lord.
He obliterates the fear of birth and death.
The glorious greatness of the Perfect Guru is endless. ||2||
By Guru's Grace, the inverted heart-lotus blossoms forth,
and the Light shines forth in the darkness.

864.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
864.t: jin keeaa so gur te jaaniaa ||
864.e: Through the Guru, know the One who created you.

864.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਮੁਗਧ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੩॥
864.t: gur kirapaa te mugadh man maaniaa ||3||
864.e: By the Guru's Mercy, the foolish mind comes to believe. ||3||
The Guru is the Creator; the Guru has the power to do everything.
The Guru is the Transcendent Lord; He is, and always shall be.
Says Nanak, God has inspired me to know this.

864.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ॥੪॥੫॥੭॥
864.t: bin gur mukat na paieeaai bhaiee ||4||5||7||
864.e: Without the Guru, liberation is not obtained, O Siblings of Destiny. ||4||5||7||
Gond, Fifth Mehla:

864.g: ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਮੋਰ ॥
864.t: guroo guroo gur kar man mor ||
864.e: Chant Guru, Guru, Guru, O my mind.
I have no other than the Guru.

864.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਰਹਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
864.t: gur kee Tek rahahu dhin raat ||
864.e: I lean upon the Support of the Guru, day and night.

864.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੧॥
864.t: jaa kee koi na meTai dhaat ||1||
864.e: No one can decrease His bounty. ||1||
Know that the Guru and the Transcendent Lord are One.

864.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
864.t: jo tis bhaavai so paravaan ||1|| rahaau ||
864.e: Whatever pleases Him is acceptable and approved. ||1||Pause||

864.g: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
864.t: gur charanee jaa kaa man laagai ||
864.e: One whose mind is attached to the Guru's feet

864.g: ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
864.t: dhookh dharadh bhram taa kaa bhaagai ||
864.e: his pains, sufferings and doubts run away.
Serving the Guru, honor is obtained.
I am forever a sacrifice to the Guru. ||2||
Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan, I am exalted.

864.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲ ॥
864.t: gur ke sevak kee pooran ghaal ||
864.e: The work of the Guru's servant is perfect.

864.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
864.t: gur ke sevak kau dhukh na biaapai ||
864.e: Pain does not afflict the Guru's servant.

864.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੩॥
864.t: gur kaa sevak dheh dhis jaapai ||3||
864.e: The Guru's servant is famous in the ten directions. ||3||

864.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
864.t: gur kee mahimaa kathan na jai ||
864.e: The Guru's glory cannot be described.
The Guru remains absorbed in the Supreme Lord God.

864.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਭਾਗ ॥
864.t: kahu naanak jaa ke poore bhaag ||
864.e: Says Nanak, one who is blessed with perfect destiny

864.g: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗ ॥੪॥੬॥੮॥
864.t: gur charanee taa kaa man laag ||4||6||8||
864.e: - his mind is attached to the Guru's feet. ||4||6||8||
Gond, Fifth Mehla:
I worship and adore my Guru; the Guru is the Lord of the Universe.
My Guru is the Supreme Lord God; the Guru is the Lord God.
My Guru is divine, invisible and mysterious.
I serve at the Guru's feet, which are worshipped by all. ||1||

864.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਥਾਉ ॥
864.t: gur bin avar naahee mai thaau ||
864.e: Without the Guru, I have no other place at all.

864.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਪਉ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
864.t: anadhin japau guroo gur naau ||1|| rahaau ||
864.e: Night and day, I chant the Name of Guru, Guru. ||1||Pause||

864.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
864.t: gur meraa giaan gur ridhai dhiaan ||
864.e: The Guru is my spiritual wisdom, the Guru is the meditation within my heart.
The Guru is the Lord of the World, the Primal Being, the Lord God.

864.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਰਹਉ ਕਰ ਜੋਰਿ ॥
864.t: gur kee saran rahau kar jor ||
864.e: With my palms pressed together, I remain in the Guru's Sanctuary.
Without the Guru, I have no other at all. ||2||
The Guru is the boat to cross over the terrifying world-ocean.
Serving the Guru, one is released from the Messenger of Death.
In the darkness, the Guru's Mantra shines forth.
With the Guru, all are saved. ||3||
The Perfect Guru is found, by great good fortune.

864.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
864.t: gur kee sevaa dhookh na laagee ||
864.e: Serving the Guru, pain does not afflict anyone.

864.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
864.t: gur kaa sabadh na meTai koi ||
864.e: No one can erase the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
Nanak is the Guru; Nanak is the Lord Himself. ||4||7||9||

865.e: Gond, Fifth Mehla:
Deal and trade only with the Lord, Raam, Raam.
The Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam, is the Support of the breath of life.
Sing the Kirtan of the Praises of the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.
The Lord is ever-present, all-pervading. ||1||
Joining the humble Saints, chant the Lord's Name.

865.g: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
865.t: sabh te niramal pooran kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
865.e: This is the most immaculate and perfect occupation of all. ||1||Pause||
Gather the treasure, the wealth of the Lord, Raam, Raam.
Let your sustenance be the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.
Never forget the Lord, Raam, Raam.
In His Mercy, the Guru has revealed this to me. ||2||
The Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam, is always our help and support.
Embrace love for the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.
Through the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam, I have become immaculate.
The sins of countless incarnations have been taken away. ||3||
Uttering the Lord's Name, birth and death are finished.
Repeating the Lord's Name, one crosses over the terrifying world-ocean.
The Luminous Lord is the highest of all.
Night and day, servant Nanak meditates on Him. ||4||8||10||
Gond, Fifth Mehla:
My Lord and Master has held back the five demons.
He conquered them, and scared them away from the Lord's slave.

865.g: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਗਤ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
865.t: gobi(n)dh bhagat kaa mahal na paiaa ||
865.e: They cannot find the mansion of the Lord's devotee.
Joining together, the Lord's humble servants sing the songs of joy. ||1||
The five demons are the rulers of the whole world,
but they are just water-carriers for the Lord's devotee. ||1||Pause||
They collect taxes from the world,
but they bow in subservience to God's devotees.
They plunder and dishonor the faithless cynics,

865.g: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਪਗ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵਹਿ ॥੨॥
865.t: saadh janaa pag mal mal dhoveh ||2||
865.e: but they massage and wash the feet of the Holy. ||2||
The One Mother gave birth to the five sons,
and began the play of the created world.

865.g: ਤੀਨਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਚਿ ਰਸੇ ॥
865.t: teen gunaa kai sa(n)g rach rase ||
865.e: With the three qualities joined together, they celebrate.

865.g: ਇਨ ਕਉ ਛੋਡਿ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਨ ਬਸੇ ॥੩॥
865.t: ein kau chhodd uoopar jan base ||3||
865.e: Renouncing these three qualities, the Lord's humble servants rise above them. ||3||
In His Mercy, He saves His humble servants.

865.g: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਸੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਰਖੇ ਹਟਾਇ ॥
865.t: jis ke se tin rakhe haTai ||
865.e: They belong to Him, and so He saves them by driving out the five.
Says Nanak, devotion to God is noble and sublime.
Without devotion, all just waste away uselessly. ||4||9||11||
Gond, Fifth Mehla:
Suffering and troubles are eradicated by the Lord's Name.
Pain is dispelled, and peace takes its place.
Meditating, chanting the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, I am satisfied.
By the Grace of the Saints, I have received all fruitful rewards. ||1||
Meditating on the Lord, His humble servant is carried across,

865.g: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
865.t: janam janam ke paap hare ||1|| rahaau ||
865.e: and the sins of countless incarnations are taken away. ||1||Pause||

865.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
865.t: gur ke charan ridhai ur dhaare ||
865.e: I have enshrined the Guru's feet within my heart,
and crossed over the ocean of fire.
All the painful diseases of birth and death have been eradicated.
I am attached to God in celestial Samaadhi. ||2||
In all places and interspaces, the One, our Lord and Master is contained.
He is the Inner-knower of all hearts.

865.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
865.t: kar kirapaa jaa kau mat dhei ||
865.e: One whom the Lord blesses with understanding,

865.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਲੇਇ ॥੩॥
865.t: aaTh pahar prabh kaa naau lei ||3||
865.e: chants the Name of God, twenty-four hours a day. ||3||

865.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
865.t: jaa kai a(n)tar vasai prabh aap ||
865.e: Deep within, God Himself abides;
within his heart, the Divine Light shines forth.
With loving devotion, sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.
Meditate on the Supreme Lord God, O Nanak, and you shall be saved. ||4||10||12||
Gond, Fifth Mehla:

866.e: Bow in humility to the lotus feet of the Guru.

866.g: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
866.t: kaam karodh is tan te maar ||
866.e: Eliminate sexual desire and anger from this body.
Be the dust of all,

866.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਚੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
866.t: ghaT ghaT ramieeaa sabh meh cheenaa ||1||
866.e: and see the Lord in each and every heart, in all. ||1||
In this way, dwell upon the Lord of the World, the Lord of the Universe.

866.g: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
866.t: tan dhan prabh kaa prabh kee ji(n)dh ||1|| rahaau ||
866.e: My body and wealth belong to God; my soul belongs to God. ||1||Pause||

866.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
866.t: aaTh pahar har ke gun gaau ||
866.e: Twenty-four hours a day, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
This is the purpose of human life.
Renounce your egotistical pride, and know that God is with you.

866.g: ਸਾਧ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੨॥
866.t: saadh prasaadh har siau man ra(n)g ||2||
866.e: By the Grace of the Holy, let your mind be imbued with the Lord's Love. ||2||

866.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂੰ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
866.t: jin too(n) keeaa tis kau jaan ||
866.e: Know the One who created you,
and in the world hereafter you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord.
Your mind and body will be immaculate and blissful;
chant the Name of the Lord of the Universe with your tongue. ||3||
Grant Your Kind Mercy, O my Lord, Merciful to the meek.
My mind begs for the dust of the feet of the Holy.
Be merciful, and bless me with this gift,
that Nanak may live, chanting God's Name. ||4||11||13||
Gond, Fifth Mehla:
My incense and lamps are my service to the Lord.
Time and time again, I humbly bow to the Creator.

866.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੀ ਸਭ ਤਿਆਗਿ ॥
866.t: prabh kee saran gahee sabh tiaag ||
866.e: I have renounced everything, and grasped the Sanctuary of God.
By great good fortune, the Guru has become pleased and satisfied with me. ||1||
Twenty-four hours a day, I sing of the Lord of the Universe.

866.g: ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
866.t: tan dhan prabh kaa prabh kee ji(n)dh ||1|| rahaau ||
866.e: My body and wealth belong to God; my soul belongs to God. ||1||Pause||
Chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I am in bliss.
The Supreme Lord God is the Perfect Forgiver.
Granting His Mercy, He has linked His humble servants to His service.
He has rid me of the pains of birth and death, and merged me with Himself. ||2||
This is the essence of karma, righteous conduct and spiritual wisdom,
to chant the Lord's Name in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
God's Feet are the boat to cross over the world-ocean.
God, the Inner-knower, is the Cause of causes. ||3||
Showering His Mercy, He Himself has saved me.
The five hideous demons have run away.
Do not lose your life in the gamble.
The Creator Lord has taken Nanak's side. ||4||12||14||
Gond, Fifth Mehla:
In His Mercy, He has blessed me with peace and bliss.
The Divine Guru has saved His child.
God is kind and compassionate; He is the Lord of the Universe.
He forgives all beings and creatures. ||1||
I seek Your Sanctuary, O God, O Merciful to the meek.
Meditating on the Supreme Lord God, I am forever in ecstasy. ||1||Pause||
There is no other like the Merciful Lord God.
He is contained deep within each and every heart.

866.g: ਅਪਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਾ ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥
866.t: apane dhaas kaa halat palat savaarai ||
866.e: He embellishes His slave, here and hereafter.
It is Your nature, God, to purify sinners. ||2||
Meditation on the Lord of the Universe is the medicine to cure millions of illnesses.
My Tantra and Mantra is to meditate, to vibrate upon the Lord God.
Illnesses and pains are dispelled, meditating on God.
The fruits of the mind's desires are fulfilled. ||3||
He is the Cause of causes, the All-powerful Merciful Lord.
Contemplating Him is the greatest of all treasures.
God Himself has forgiven Nanak;
forever and ever, he chants the Name of the One Lord. ||4||13||15||
Gond, Fifth Mehla:

866.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
866.t: har har naam japahu mere meet ||
866.e: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my friend.

867.e: Your consciousness shall become immaculate and pure.

867.g: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਮਿਟੈ ਬਲਾਇ ॥
867.t: man tan kee sabh miTai balai ||
867.e: All the misfortunes of your mind and body shall be taken away,
and all your pain and darkness will be dispelled. ||1||
Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, cross over the world-ocean.

867.g: ਵਡ ਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
867.t: vadd bhaagee paieeaai purakh apaar ||1|| rahaau ||
867.e: By great good fortune, one attains the Infinite Lord, the Primal Being. ||1||Pause||

867.g: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥ ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥
867.t: jo jan karai keeratan gopaal || tis kau poh na sakai jamakaal ||
867.e: The Messenger of Death cannot even touch that humble being, who sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

867.g: ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਪਨਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
867.t: jag meh aaiaa so paravaan || gurmukh apanaa khasam pachhaan ||2||
867.e: The Gurmukh realizes his Lord and Master; his coming into this world is approved. ||2||
He sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, by the Grace of the Saints;
his sexual desire, anger and madness are eradicated.
He knows the Lord God to be ever-present.
This is the Perfect Teaching of the Perfect Guru. ||3||
He earns the treasure of the Lord's wealth.
Meeting with the True Guru, all his affairs are resolved.

867.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਗਾ ॥
867.t: har ke naam ra(n)g sa(n)g jaagaa ||
867.e: He is awake and aware in the Love of the Lord's Name;
O Nanak, his mind is attached to the Lord's Feet. ||4||14||16||
Gond, Fifth Mehla:
The Lord's Feet are the boat to cross over the terrifying world-ocean.
Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he does not die again.

867.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਮਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮ ਪੰਥ ॥
867.t: har gun ramat naahee jam pa(n)th ||
867.e: Chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, he does not have to walk on the Path of Death.
Contemplating the Supreme Lord, the five demons are conquered. ||1||
I have entered Your Sanctuary, O Perfect Lord and Master.

867.g: ਜੰਤ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਦੀਜਹਿ ਹਾਥ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
867.t: ja(n)t apane kau dheejeh haath ||1|| rahaau ||
867.e: Please give Your hand to Your creatures. ||1||Pause||
The Simritees, Shaastras, Vedas and Puraanas
expound upon the Supreme Lord God.
The Yogis, celibates, Vaishnavs and followers of Ram Das
cannot find the limits of the Eternal Lord God. ||2||
Shiva and the gods lament and moan,
but they do not understand even a tiny bit of the unseen and unknown Lord.
One whom the Lord Himself blesses with loving devotional worship,
is very rare in this world. ||3||
I am worthless, with absolutely no virtue at all;
all treasures are in Your Glance of Grace.
Nanak, the meek, desires only to serve You.
Please be merciful, and grant him this blessing, O Divine Guru. ||4||15||17||
Gond, Fifth Mehla:
One who is cursed by the Saints, is thrown down on the ground.

867.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਅਕਾਸ ਤੇ ਟਾਰਉ ॥
867.t: sa(n)t kaa ni(n)dhak akaas te Taarau ||
867.e: The slanderer of the Saints is thrown down from the skies.

867.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਉ ਅਪਨੇ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
867.t: sa(n)t kau raakhau apane jeea naal ||
867.e: I hold the Saints close to my soul.
The Saints are saved instantaneously. ||1||
He alone is a Saint, who is pleasing to the Lord.

867.g: ਸੰਤ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੈ ਏਕੈ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
867.t: sa(n)t gobi(n)dh kai ekai kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
867.e: The Saints, and God, have only one job to do. ||1||Pause||

867.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਊਪਰਿ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਾਥ ॥
867.t: sa(n)t kai uoopar dhei prabh haath ||
867.e: God gives His hand to shelter the Saints.

867.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਸੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
867.t: sa(n)t kai sa(n)g basai dhin raat ||
867.e: He dwells with His Saints, day and night.
With each and every breath, He cherishes His Saints.

867.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਰਾਜ ਤੇ ਟਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
867.t: sa(n)t kaa dhokhee raaj te Taal ||2||
867.e: He takes the power away from the enemies of the Saints. ||2||

867.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
867.t: sa(n)t kee ni(n)dhaa karahu na koi ||
867.e: Let no one slander the Saints.

867.g: ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਪਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
867.t: jo ni(n)dhai tis kaa patan hoi ||
867.e: Whoever slanders them, will be destroyed.
One who is protected by the Creator Lord,
cannot be harmed, no matter how much the whole world may try. ||3||
I place my faith in my God.

867.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
867.t: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh tis kee raas ||
867.e: My soul and body all belong to Him.
This is the faith which inspires Nanak:
the self-willed manmukhs will fail, while the Gurmukhs will always win. ||4||16||18||
Gond, Fifth Mehla:
The Name of the Immaculate Lord is the Ambrosial Water.
Chanting it with the tongue, sins are washed away. ||1||Pause||

868.e: The Lord abides in everyone.
The Lord illumines each and every heart.
Chanting the Lord's Name, one does not fall into hell.
Serving the Lord, all fruitful rewards are obtained. ||1||
Within my mind is the Support of the Lord.
The Lord is the boat to cross over the world-ocean.
Chant the Lord's Name, and the Messenger of Death will run away.
The Lord breaks the teeth of Maya, the witch. ||2||
The Lord is forever and ever the Forgiver.
The Lord blesses us with peace and bliss.
The Lord has revealed His glory.
The Lord is the mother and father of His Saint. ||3||
The Lord, the Lord, is in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
Time and time again, I sing the Lord's Praises.
Meeting with the Guru, I have attained the incomprehensible object.
Slave Nanak has grasped the Support of the Lord. ||4||17||19||
Gond, Fifth Mehla:
One who is protected by the Protector Lord

868.g: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਅੰਗੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
868.t: tis kaa a(n)g kare nira(n)kaar ||1|| rahaau ||
868.e: - the Formless Lord is on his side. ||1||Pause||

868.g: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
868.t: maat garabh meh agan na johai ||
868.e: In the mother's womb, the fire does not touch him.

868.g: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ॥
868.t: kaam karodh lobh moh na pohai ||
868.e: Sexual desire, anger, greed and emotional attachment do not affect him.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, he meditates on the Formless Lord.
Dust is thrown into the faces of the slanderers. ||1||
The Lord's protective spell is the armor of His slave.
The wicked, evil demons cannot even touch him.

868.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਗਰਬੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਜਾਇ ॥
868.t: jo jo garab kare so jai ||
868.e: Whoever indulges in egotistical pride, shall waste away to ruin.
God is the Sanctuary of His humble slave. ||2||

868.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
868.t: jo jo saran piaa har rai ||
868.e: Whoever enters the Sanctuary of the Sovereign Lord

868.g: ਸੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਅਪਣੈ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
868.t: so dhaas rakhiaa apanai ka(n)Th lai ||
868.e: - He saves that slave, hugging him close in His embrace.
Whoever takes great pride in himself,

868.g: ਓਹੁ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰੁਲਤਾ ਖਾਕੂ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
868.t: oh khin meh rulataa khaakoo naal ||3||
868.e: in an instant, shall be like dust mixing with dust. ||3||
The True Lord is, and shall always be.
Forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him.
Granting His Mercy, He saves His slaves.
God is the Support of Nanak's breath of life. ||4||18||20||
Gond, Fifth Mehla:

868.g: ਅਚਰਜ ਕਥਾ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੂਪ ॥ ਪ੍ਰਾਤਮਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
868.t: acharaj kathaa mahaa anoop || praatamaa paarabraham kaa roop || rahaau ||
868.e: Wondrous and beautiful is the description of the beauty of the Supreme Soul, the Supreme Lord God. ||Pause||

868.g: ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਬੂਢਾ ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਬਾਲਾ ॥
868.t: naa ih booddaa naa ih baalaa ||
868.e: He is not old; He is not young.

868.g: ਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਮ ਜਾਲਾ ॥
868.t: naa is dhookh nahee jam jaalaa ||
868.e: He is not in pain; He is not caught in Death's noose.

868.g: ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
868.t: naa ih binasai naa ih jai ||
868.e: He does not die; He does not go away.
In the beginning, and throughout the ages, He is permeating everywhere. ||1||

868.g: ਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਉਸਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਇਸੁ ਸੀਤੁ ॥
868.t: naa is usan nahee is seet ||
868.e: He is not hot; He is not cold.

868.g: ਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
868.t: naa is dhusaman naa is meet ||
868.e: He has no enemy; He has no friend.

868.g: ਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਹਰਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਇਸੁ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
868.t: naa is harakh nahee is sog ||
868.e: He is not happy; He is not sad.

868.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਇਸ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਕਰਨੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
868.t: sabh kichh is kaa ih karanai jog ||2||
868.e: Everything belongs to Him; He can do anything. ||2||

868.g: ਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਬਾਪੁ ਨਹੀ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
868.t: naa is baap nahee is maiaa ||
868.e: He has no father; He has no mother.
He is beyond the beyond, and has always been so.

868.g: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਕਾ ਇਸੁ ਲੇਪੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
868.t: paap pu(n)n kaa is lep na laagai ||
868.e: He is not affected by virtue or vice.

868.g: ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜਾਗੈ ॥੩॥
868.t: ghaT ghaT a(n)tar sadh hee jaagai ||3||
868.e: Deep within each and every heart, He is always awake and aware. ||3||
From the three qualities, the one mechanism of Maya was produced.

868.g: ਮਹਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
868.t: mahaa maiaa taa kee hai chhaiaa ||
868.e: The great Maya is only His shadow.
He is undeceivable, impenetrable, unfathomable and merciful.
He is merciful to the meek, forever compassionate.

868.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
868.t: taa kee gat mit kachhoo na pai ||
868.e: His state and limits cannot ever be known.

868.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੨੧॥
868.t: naanak taa kai bal bal jai ||4||19||21||
868.e: Nanak is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to Him. ||4||19||21||

869.e: Gond, Fifth Mehla:
I am a sacrifice to the Saints.

869.g: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥
869.t: sa(n)tan kai sa(n)g raam gun gaau ||
869.e: Associating with the Saints, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
By the Grace of the Saints, all the sins are taken away.
By great good fortune, one finds the Sanctuary of the Saints. ||1||

869.g: ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਕਛੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ॥
869.t: raam japat kachh bighan na viaapai ||
869.e: Meditating on the Lord, no obstacles will block your way.

869.g: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
869.t: gur prasaadh apunaa prabh jaapai ||1|| rahaau ||
869.e: By Guru's Grace, meditate on God. ||1||Pause||
When the Supreme Lord God becomes merciful,
he makes me the dust of the feet of the Holy.

869.g: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
869.t: kaam karodh is tan te jai ||
869.e: Sexual desire and anger leave his body,
and the Lord, the jewel, comes to dwell in his mind. ||2||
Fruitful and approved is the life of one
who knows the Supreme Lord God to be close.
One who is committed to loving devotional worship of God, and the Kirtan of His Praises,
awakens from the sleep of countless incarnations. ||3||
The Lord's Lotus Feet are the Support of His humble servant.
To chant the Praises of the Lord of the Universe is the true trade.
Please fulfill the hopes of Your humble slave.
Nanak finds peace in the dust of the feet of the humble. ||4||20||22||6||28||

869.t: raag go(n)dd asaTapadheeaa mahalaa panjavaa ghar doojaa
869.e: Raag Gond, Ashtpadheeyaa, Fifth Mehla, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Humbly bow to the Perfect Divine Guru.

869.g: ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਸਫਲ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
869.t: safal moorat safal jaa kee sev ||
869.e: Fruitful is His image, and fruitful is service to Him.
He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, the Architect of Destiny.
Twenty-four hours a day, he remains imbued with the love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
The Guru is the Lord of the Universe, the Guru is the Lord of the World.
He is the Saving Grace of His slaves. ||1||Pause||
He satisfies the kings, emperors and nobles.
He destroys the egotistical villains.
He puts illness into the mouths of the slanderers.

869.g: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
869.t: jai jai kaar karai sabh log ||2||
869.e: All the people celebrate His victory. ||2||
Supreme bliss fills the minds of the Saints.
The Saints meditate on the Divine Guru, the Lord God.
The faces of His companions become radiant and bright.
The slanderers lose all places of rest. ||3||
With each and every breath, the Lord's humble slaves praise Him.
The Supreme Lord God and the Guru are care-free.

869.g: ਸਗਲ ਭੈ ਮਿਟੇ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ॥
869.t: sagal bhai miTe jaa kee saran ||
869.e: All fears are eradicated, in His Sanctuary.
Smashing all the slanderers, the Lord knocks them to the ground. ||4||

869.g: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
869.t: jan kee ni(n)dhaa karai na koi ||
869.e: Let no one slander the Lord's humble servants.
Whoever does so, will be miserable.
Twenty-four hours a day, the Lord's humble servant meditates on Him alone.

869.g: ਜਮੂਆ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੫॥
869.t: jamooaa taa kai nikaT na jaae ||5||
869.e: The Messenger of Death does not even approach him. ||5||
The Lord's humble servant has no vengeance. The slanderer is egotistical.
The Lord's humble servant wishes well, while the slanderer dwells on evil.
The Sikh of the Guru meditates on the True Guru.
The Lord's humble servants are saved, while the slanderer is cast into hell. ||6||
Listen, O my beloved friends and companions:
these words shall be true in the Court of the Lord.
As you plant, so shall you harvest.
The proud, egotistical person will surely be uprooted. ||7||
O True Guru, You are the Support of the unsupported.
Be merciful, and save Your humble servant.
Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru;
remembering Him in meditation, my honor has been saved. ||8||1||29||

870.e: Raag Gond, The Word Of The Devotees.
Kabeer Jee, First House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
When you meet a Saint, talk to him and listen.
Meeting with an unsaintly person, just remain silent. ||1||
O father, if I speak, what words should I utter?

870.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
870.t: jaise raam naam rav raheeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
870.e: Speak such words, by which you may remain absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
Speaking with the Saints, one becomes generous.
To speak with a fool is to babble uselessly. ||2||
By speaking and only speaking, corruption only increases.
If I do not speak, what can the poor wretch do? ||3||
Says Kabeer, the empty pitcher makes noise,

870.g: ਭਰਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ॥੪॥੧॥
870.t: bhariaa hoi su kabahu na ddolai ||4||1||
870.e: but that which is full makes no sound. ||4||1||
Gond:

870.g: ਨਰੂ ਮਰੈ ਨਰੁ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
870.t: naroo marai nar kaam na aavai ||
870.e: When a man dies, he is of no use to anyone.
But when an animal dies, it is used in ten ways. ||1||

870.g: ਅਪਨੇ ਕਰਮ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮੈ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
870.t: apane karam kee gat mai kiaa jaanau ||
870.e: What do I know, about the state of my karma?

870.g: ਮੈ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨਉ ਬਾਬਾ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
870.t: mai kiaa jaanau baabaa re ||1|| rahaau ||
870.e: What do I know, O Baba? ||1||Pause||

870.g: ਹਾਡ ਜਲੇ ਜੈਸੇ ਲਕਰੀ ਕਾ ਤੂਲਾ ॥
870.t: haadd jale jaise lakaree kaa toolaa ||
870.e: His bones burn, like a bundle of logs;

870.g: ਕੇਸ ਜਲੇ ਜੈਸੇ ਘਾਸ ਕਾ ਪੂਲਾ ॥੨॥
870.t: kes jale jaise ghaas kaa poolaa ||2||
870.e: his hair burns like a bale of hay. ||2||

870.g: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਨਰੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
870.t: kahu kabeer tab hee nar jaagai ||
870.e: Says Kabeer, the man wakes up,

870.g: ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡੰਡੁ ਮੂੰਡ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੩॥੨॥
870.t: jam kaa dda(n)dd moo(n)dd meh laagai ||3||2||
870.e: only when the Messenger of Death hits him over the head with his club. ||3||2||
Gond:

870.g: ਆਕਾਸਿ ਗਗਨੁ ਪਾਤਾਲਿ ਗਗਨੁ ਹੈ ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਗਗਨੁ ਰਹਾਇਲੇ ॥
870.t: aakaas gagan paataal gagan hai chahu dhis gagan rahaile ||
870.e: The Celestial Lord is in the Akaashic ethers of the skies, the Celestial Lord is in the nether regions of the underworld; in the four directions, the Celestial Lord is pervading.

870.g: ਆਨਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੁ ਘਟੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਗਗਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇਲੇ ॥੧॥
870.t: aanadh mool sadhaa purakhotam ghaT binasai gagan na jaile ||1||
870.e: The Supreme Lord God is forever the source of bliss. When the vessel of the body perishes, the Celestial Lord does not perish. ||1||
I have become sad,

870.g: ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਆਇ ਕਹਾ ਗਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
870.t: eih jeeau aai kahaa gio ||1|| rahaau ||
870.e: wondering where the soul comes from, and where it goes. ||1||Pause||

870.g: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਤਤੁ ਕਹਾ ਤੇ ਕੀਨੁ ਰੇ ॥
870.t: pa(n)ch tat mil kaiaa keen(h)ee tat kahaa te keen re ||
870.e: The body is formed from the union of the five tatvas; but where were the five tatvas created?

870.g: ਕਰਮ ਬਧ ਤੁਮ ਜੀਉ ਕਹਤ ਹੌ ਕਰਮਹਿ ਕਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਦੀਨੁ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
870.t: karam badh tum jeeau kahat hau karameh kin jeeau dheen re ||2||
870.e: You say that the soul is tied to its karma, but who gave karma to the body? ||2||

870.g: ਹਰਿ ਮਹਿ ਤਨੁ ਹੈ ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹੈ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਇ ਰੇ ॥
870.t: har meh tan hai tan meh har hai sarab nira(n)tar soi re ||
870.e: The body is contained in the Lord, and the Lord is contained in the body. He is permeating within all.

870.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਰੇ ॥੩॥੩॥
870.t: keh kabeer raam naam na chhoddau sahaje hoi su hoi re ||3||3||
870.e: Says Kabeer, I shall not renounce the Lord's Name. I shall accept whatever happens. ||3||3||

870.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੋਂਡ ਬਾਣੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੨
870.t: raag go(n)dd baanee kabeer jeeau kee ghar doojaa
870.e: Raag Gond, The Word Of Kabeer Jee, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
They tied my arms, bundled me up, and threw me before an elephant.
The elephant driver struck him on the head, and infuriated him.
But the elephant ran away, trumpeting,
"I am a sacrifice to this image of the Lord."||1||
O my Lord and Master, You are my strength.
The Qazi shouted at the driver to drive the elephant on. ||1||Pause||
He yelled out, ""O driver, I shall cut you into pieces.
Hit him, and drive him on!""
But the elephant did not move; instead, he began to meditate.
The Lord God abides within his mind. ||2||
What sin has this Saint committed,
that you have made him into a bundle and thrown him before the elephant?
Lifting up the bundle, the elephant bows down before it.
The Qazi could not understand it; he was blind. ||3||
Three times, he tried to do it.

871.e: Even then, his hardened mind was not satisfied.
Says Kabeer, such is my Lord and Master.

871.g: ਚਉਥੇ ਪਦ ਮਹਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
871.t: chauthe padh meh jan kee ji(n)dh ||4||1||4||
871.e: The soul of His humble servant dwells in the fourth state. ||4||1||4||
Gond:

871.g: ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਾਨਸੁ ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਦੇਉ ॥
871.t: naa ih maanas naa ih dheau ||
871.e: It is not human, and it is not a god.
It is not called celibate, or a worshipper of Shiva.
It is not a Yogi, and it is not a hermit.

871.g: ਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਇ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਪੂਤਾ ॥੧॥
871.t: naa is mai na kaahoo pootaa ||1||
871.e: It is not a mother, or anyone's son. ||1||
Then what is it, which dwells in this temple of the body?

871.g: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
871.t: taa kaa a(n)t na kouoo paiee ||1|| rahaau ||
871.e: No one can find its limits. ||1||Pause||
It is not a house-holder, and it is not a renouncer of the world.

871.g: ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਰਾਜ ਨ ਭੀਖ ਮੰਗਾਸੀ ॥
871.t: naa ih raaj na bheekh ma(n)gaasee ||
871.e: It is not a king, and it is not a beggar.

871.g: ਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਨ ਰਕਤੂ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
871.t: naa is pi(n)dd na rakatoo raatee ||
871.e: It has no body, no drop of blood.

871.g: ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਨੁ ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਖਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
871.t: naa ih brahaman naa ih khaatee ||2||
871.e: It is not a Brahmin, and it is not a Kh'shaatriya. ||2||
It is not called a man of austere self-discipline, or a Shaykh.

871.g: ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਨ ਮਰਤਾ ਦੇਖੁ ॥
871.t: naa ih jeevai na marataa dhekh ||
871.e: It does not live, and it is not seen to die.

871.g: ਇਸੁ ਮਰਤੇ ਕਉ ਜੇ ਕੋਊ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
871.t: eis marate kau je kouoo rovai ||
871.e: If someone cries over its death,
that person loses his honor. ||3||
By Guru's Grace, I have found the Path.
Birth and death have both been erased.

871.g: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਅੰਸੁ ॥
871.t: kahu kabeer ih raam kee a(n)s ||
871.e: Says Kabeer, this is formed of the same essence as the Lord.

871.g: ਜਸ ਕਾਗਦ ਪਰ ਮਿਟੈ ਨ ਮੰਸੁ ॥੪॥੨॥੫॥
871.t: jas kaagadh par miTai na ma(n)s ||4||2||5||
871.e: It is like the ink on the paper which cannot be erased. ||4||2||5||
Gond:
The threads are broken, and the starch has run out.
Bare reeds glisten at the front door.
The poor brushes are scattered in pieces.
Death has entered this shaven head. ||1||
This shaven-headed mendicant has wasted all his wealth.

871.g: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਨਾਕ ਸਰ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
871.t: aavat jaat naak sar hoiee ||1|| rahaau ||
871.e: All this coming and going has irritated him. ||1||Pause||
He has given up all talk of his weaving equipment.

871.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਵਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
871.t: raam naam vaa kaa man raataa ||
871.e: His mind is attuned to the Lord's Name.
His daughters and sons have nothing to eat,
while the shaven-headed mendicants night and day eat their fill. ||2||

871.g: ਇਕ ਦੁਇ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਇਕ ਦੁਇ ਬਾਟ ॥
871.t: eik dhui ma(n)dhar ik dhui baaT ||
871.e: One or two are in the house, and one or two more are on the way.

871.g: ਹਮ ਕਉ ਸਾਥਰੁ ਉਨ ਕਉ ਖਾਟ ॥
871.t: ham kau saathar un kau khaaT ||
871.e: We sleep on the floor, while they sleep in the beds.
They rub their bare heads, and carry prayer-books in their waist-bands.

871.g: ਹਮ ਕਉ ਚਾਬਨੁ ਉਨ ਕਉ ਰੋਟੀ ॥੩॥
871.t: ham kau chaaban un kau roTee ||3||
871.e: We get dry grains, while they get loaves of bread. ||3||
He will become one of these shaven-headed mendicants.
They are the support of the drowning.
Listen, O blind and unguided Loi:
Kabeer has taken shelter with these shaven-headed mendicants. ||4||3||6||
Gond:

871.g: ਖਸਮੁ ਮਰੈ ਤਉ ਨਾਰਿ ਨ ਰੋਵੈ ॥
871.t: khasam marai tau naar na rovai ||
871.e: When her husband dies, the woman does not cry.
Someone else becomes her protector.
When this protector dies,
he falls into the world of hell hereafter, for the sexual pleasures he enjoyed in this world. ||1||
The world loves only the one bride, Maya.

871.g: ਸਗਲੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਕੀ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
871.t: sagale jeea ja(n)t kee naaree ||1|| rahaau ||
871.e: She is the wife of all beings and creatures. ||1||Pause||
With her necklace around her neck, this bride looks beautiful.
She is poison to the Saint, but the world is delighted with her.
Adorning herself, she sits like a prostitute.
Cursed by the Saints, she wanders around like a wretch. ||2||
She runs around, chasing after the Saints.
She is afraid of being beaten by those blessed with the Guru's Grace.
She is the body, the breath of life, of the faithless cynics.

871.g: ਹਮ ਕਉ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਪਰੈ ਤ੍ਰਖਿ ਡਾਇਣਿ ॥੩॥
871.t: ham kau dhirasaT parai trakh ddain ||3||
871.e: She appears to me like a blood-thirsty witch. ||3||

871.g: ਹਮ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਬਹੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਭੇਉ ॥
871.t: ham tis kaa bahu jaaniaa bheau ||
871.e: I know her secrets well
in His Mercy, the Divine Guru met me.
Says Kabeer, now I have thrown her out.
She clings to the skirt of the world. ||4||4||7||

872.e: Gond:

872.g: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰੇ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
872.t: gireh sobhaa jaa kai re naeh ||
872.e: When someone's household has no glory,
the guests who come there depart still hungry.
Deep within, there is no contentment.
Without his bride, the wealth of Maya, he suffers in pain. ||1||

872.g: ਧਨੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਨਿ ਮਹਾ ਪਵੀਤ ॥ ਤਪੇ ਤਪੀਸਰ ਡੋਲੈ ਚੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
872.t: dhan sohaagan mahaa paveet || tape tapeesar ddolai cheet ||1|| rahaau ||
872.e: So praise this bride, which can shake the consciousness of even the most dedicated ascetics and sages. ||1||Pause||
This bride is the daughter of a wretched miser.
Abandoning the Lord's servant, she sleeps with the world.
Standing at the door of the holy man,
she says, ""I have come to your sanctuary; now save me!""||2||
This bride is so beautiful.
The bells on her ankles make soft music.

872.g: ਜਉ ਲਗੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤਊ ਲਗੁ ਸੰਗੇ ॥
872.t: jau lag praan tuoo lag sa(n)ge ||
872.e: As long as there is the breath of life in the man, she remains attached to him.

872.g: ਨਾਹਿ ਤ ਚਲੀ ਬੇਗਿ ਉਠਿ ਨੰਗੇ ॥੩॥
872.t: naeh ta chalee beg uTh na(n)ge ||3||
872.e: But when it is no more, she quickly gets up and departs, bare-footed. ||3||
This bride has conquered the three worlds.

872.g: ਦਸ ਅਠ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਤੀਰਥ ਰਸ ਕੀਆ ॥
872.t: dhas aTh puraan teerath ras keeaa ||
872.e: The eighteen Puraanas and the sacred shrines of pilgrimage love her as well.
She pierced the hearts of Brahma, Shiva and Vishnu.
She destroyed the great emperors and kings of the world. ||4||
This bride has no restraint or limits.
She is in collusion with the five thieving passions.
When the clay pot of these five passions bursts,
then, says Kabeer, by Guru's Mercy, one is released. ||5||5||8||
Gond:

872.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਿ ਬਲਹਰ ਨਾ ਠਾਹਰੈ ॥
872.t: jaise ma(n)dhar meh balahar naa Thaaharai ||
872.e: As the house will not stand when the supporting beams are removed from within it,
just so, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, how can anyone be carried across?
Without the pitcher, the water is not contained;
just so, without the Holy Saint, the mortal departs in misery. ||1||

872.g: ਜਾਰਉ ਤਿਸੈ ਜੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤੈ ॥
872.t: jaarau tisai ju raam na chetai ||
872.e: One who does not remember the Lord - let him burn;

872.g: ਤਨ ਮਨ ਰਮਤ ਰਹੈ ਮਹਿ ਖੇਤੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
872.t: tan man ramat rahai meh khetai ||1|| rahaau ||
872.e: his body and mind have remained absorbed in this field of the world. ||1||Pause||

872.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਹਲਹਰ ਬਿਨਾ ਜਿਮੀ ਨਹੀ ਬੋਈਐ ॥
872.t: jaise halahar binaa jimee nahee boieeaai ||
872.e: Without a farmer, the land is not planted;
without a thread, how can the beads be strung?
Without a loop, how can the knot be tied?
Just so, without the Holy Saint, the mortal departs in misery. ||2||

872.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਲੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
872.t: jaise maat pitaa bin baal na hoiee ||
872.e: Without a mother or father there is no child;
just so, without water, how can the clothes be washed?
Without a horse, how can there be a rider?
Without the Holy Saint, one cannot reach the Court of the Lord. ||3||

872.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਜੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਲੀਜੈ ਫੇਰੀ ॥
872.t: jaise baaje bin nahee leejai feree ||
872.e: Just as without music, there is no dancing,
the bride rejected by her husband is dishonored.
Says Kabeer, do this one thing:
become Gurmukh, and you shall never die again. ||4||6||9||
Gond:

872.g: ਕੂਟਨੁ ਸੋਇ ਜੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਕੂਟੈ ॥
872.t: kooTan soi ju man kau kooTai ||
872.e: He alone is a pimp, who pounds down his mind.

872.g: ਮਨ ਕੂਟੈ ਤਉ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੈ ॥
872.t: man kooTai tau jam te chhooTai ||
872.e: Pounding down his mind, he escapes from the Messenger of Death.
Pounding and beating his mind, he puts it to the test;
such a pimp attains total liberation. ||1||
Who is called a pimp in this world?

872.g: ਸਗਲ ਬੋਲਨ ਕੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
872.t: sagal bolan ke maeh beechaar ||1|| rahaau ||
872.e: In all speech, one must carefully consider. ||1||Pause||

872.g: ਨਾਚਨੁ ਸੋਇ ਜੁ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਨਾਚੈ ॥
872.t: naachan soi ju man siau naachai ||
872.e: He alone is a dancer, who dances with his mind.
The Lord is not satisfied with falsehood; He is pleased only with Truth.
So play the beat of the drum in the mind.
The Lord is the Protector of the dancer with such a mind. ||2||
She alone is a street-dancer, who cleanses her body-street,
and educates the five passions.
She who embraces devotional worship for the Lord
- I accept such a street-dancer as my Guru. ||3||

872.g: ਤਸਕਰੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਿ ਤਾਤਿ ਨ ਕਰੈ ॥
872.t: tasakar soi j taat na karai ||
872.e: He alone is a thief, who is above envy,
and who uses his sense organs to chant the Lord's Name.
Says Kabeer, these are the qualities of the one
I know as my Blessed Divine Guru, who is the most beautiful and wise. ||4||7||10||

873.e: Gond:
Blessed is the Lord of the World. Blessed is the Divine Guru.
Blessed is that grain, by which the heart-lotus of the hungry blossoms forth.

873.g: ਧਨੁ ਓਇ ਸੰਤ ਜਿਨ ਐਸੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
873.t: dhan oi sa(n)t jin aaisee jaanee ||
873.e: Blessed are those Saints, who know this.
Meeting with them, one meets the Lord, the Sustainer of the World. ||1||
This grain comes from the Primal Lord God.

873.g: ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਨ ਕੈ ਸਾਦਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
873.t: japeeaai naam a(n)n kai saadh ||1|| rahaau ||
873.e: One chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, only when he tastes this grain. ||1||Pause||
Meditate on the Naam, and meditate on this grain.
Mixed with water, its taste becomes sublime.
One who abstains from this grain,
loses his honor in the three worlds. ||2||
One who discards this grain, is practicing hypocrisy.
She is neither a happy soul-bride, nor a widow.
Those who claim in this world that they live on milk alone,
secretly eat whole loads of food. ||3||
Without this grain, time does not pass in peace.
Forsaking this grain, one does not meet the Lord of the World.
Says Kabeer, this I know:
blessed is that grain, which brings faith in the Lord and Master to the mind. ||4||8||11||

873.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੋਂਡ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੧
873.t: raag go(n)dd baanee naamadheau jee kee ghar pehilaa
873.e: Raag Gond, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee, First House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The ritual sacrifice of horses,
giving one's weight in gold to charities,
and ceremonial cleansing baths -||1||

873.g: ਤਉ ਨ ਪੁਜਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
873.t: tau na pujeh har keerat naamaa ||
873.e: These are not equal to singing the Praises of the Lord's Name.

873.g: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਭਜੁ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਆਲਸੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
873.t: apune raameh bhaj re man aalaseeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
873.e: Meditate on your Lord, you lazy man! ||1||Pause||
Offering sweet rice at Gaya,
living on the river banks at Benares,
reciting the four Vedas by heart;||2||
Completing all religious rituals,
restraining sexual passion by the spiritual wisdom given by the Guru,
and performing the six rituals;||3||
Expounding on Shiva and Shakti
O man, renounce and abandon all these things.
Meditate, meditate in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe.
Meditate, O Naam Dayv, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||4||1||
Gond:
The deer is lured by the sound of the hunter's bell;

873.g: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤਜੇ ਵਾ ਕੋ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੧॥
873.t: praan taje vaa ko dhiaan na jaae ||1||
873.e: it loses its life, but it cannot stop thinking about it. ||1||
In the same way, I look upon my Lord.

873.g: ਰਾਮੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਫੇਰਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
873.t: raam chhodd chit anat na ferau ||1|| rahaau ||
873.e: I will not abandon my Lord, and turn my thoughts to another. ||1||Pause||
As the fisherman looks upon the fish,
and the goldsmith looks upon the gold he fashions;||2||
As the man driven by sex looks upon another man's wife,
and the gambler looks upon the throwing of the dice -||3||

873.g: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਰਾਮਾ ॥
873.t: jeh jeh dhekhau teh teh raamaa ||
873.e: In the same way, wherever Naam Dayv looks, he sees the Lord.

873.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
873.t: har ke charan nit dhiaavai naamaa ||4||2||
873.e: Naam Dayv meditates continuously on the Feet of the Lord. ||4||2||
Gond:

873.g: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਤਾਰਿ ਲੇ ਰਾਮਾ ਤਾਰਿ ਲੇ ॥
873.t: mo kau taar le raamaa taar le ||
873.e: Carry me across, O Lord, carry me across.

873.g: ਮੈ ਅਜਾਨੁ ਜਨੁ ਤਰਿਬੇ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ਬਾਪ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ਬਾਹ ਦੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
873.t: mai ajaan jan taribe na jaanau baap beeThulaa baeh dhe ||1|| rahaau ||
873.e: I am ignorant, and I do not know how to swim. O my Beloved Father, please give me Your arm. ||1||Pause||

873.g: ਨਰ ਤੇ ਸੁਰ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਤ ਨਿਮਖ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਖਲਾਈ ॥
873.t: nar te sur hoi jaat nimakh mai satigur budh sikhalaiee ||
873.e: I have been transformed from a mortal being into an angel, in an instant; the True Guru has taught me this.

873.g: ਨਰ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿ ਸੁਰਗ ਕਉ ਜੀਤਿਓ ਸੋ ਅਵਖਧ ਮੈ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
873.t: nar te upaj surag kau jeetio so avakhadh mai paiee ||1||
873.e: Born of human flesh, I have conquered the heavens; such is the medicine I was given. ||1||

873.g: ਜਹਾ ਜਹਾ ਧੂਅ ਨਾਰਦੁ ਟੇਕੇ ਨੈਕੁ ਟਿਕਾਵਹੁ ਮੋਹਿ ॥
873.t: jahaa jahaa dhooa naaradh Teke naik Tikaavahu moh ||
873.e: Please place me where You placed Dhroo and Naarad, O my Master.

873.g: ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਵਿਲੰਬਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜਨ ਉਧਰੇ ਨਾਮੇ ਕੀ ਨਿਜ ਮਤਿ ਏਹ ॥੨॥੩॥
873.t: tere naam avila(n)b bahut jan udhare naame kee nij mat eh ||2||3||
873.e: With the Support of Your Name, so many have been saved; this is Naam Dayv's understanding. ||2||3||

874.e: Gond:
I am restless and unhappy.
Without her calf, the cow is lonely. ||1||
Without water, the fish writhes in pain.

874.g: ਐਸੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਪੁਰੋ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
874.t: aaise raam naamaa bin baapuro naamaa ||1|| rahaau ||
874.e: So is poor Naam Dayv without the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||
Like the cow's calf, which, when let loose,
sucks at her udders and drinks her milk -||2||
So has Naam Dayv found the Lord.
Meeting the Guru, I have seen the Unseen Lord. ||3||
As the man driven by sex wants another man's wife,
so does Naam Dayv love the Lord. ||4||
As the earth burns in the dazzling sunlight,

874.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਪੁਰੋ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੫॥੪॥
874.t: taise raam naamaa bin baapuro naamaa ||5||4||
874.e: so does poor Naam Dayv burn without the Lord's Name. ||5||4||

874.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੋਂਡ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੨
874.t: raag go(n)dd baanee naamadheau jeeau kee ghar doojaa
874.e: Raag Gond, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

874.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਮਿਟੇ ਸਭਿ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
874.t: har har karat miTe sabh bharamaa ||
874.e: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, all doubts are dispelled.

874.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਊਤਮ ਧਰਮਾ ॥
874.t: har ko naam lai uootam dharamaa ||
874.e: Chanting the Name of the Lord is the highest religion.

874.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਜਾਤਿ ਕੁਲ ਹਰੀ ॥
874.t: har har karat jaat kul haree ||
874.e: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, erases social classes and ancestral pedigrees.
The Lord is the walking stick of the blind. ||1||
I bow to the Lord, I humbly bow to the Lord.

874.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਨਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਮਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
874.t: har har karat nahee dhukh jameh ||1|| rahaau ||
874.e: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, you will not be tormented by the Messenger of Death. ||1||Pause||
The Lord took the life of Harnaakhash,
and gave Ajaamal a place in heaven.
Teaching a parrot to speak the Lord's Name, Ganika the prostitute was saved.
That Lord is the light of my eyes. ||2||
Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Pootna was saved,
even though she was a deceitful child-killer.
Contemplating the Lord, Dropadi was saved.
Gautam's wife, turned to stone, was saved. ||3||
The Lord, who killed Kaysee and Kans,
gave the gift of life to Kali.
Prays Naam Dayv, such is my Lord;
meditating on Him, fear and suffering are dispelled. ||4||1||5||
Gond:
One who chases after the god Bhairau, evil spirits and the goddess of smallpox,
is riding on a donkey, kicking up the dust. ||1||
I take only the Name of the One Lord.
I have given away all other gods in exchange for Him. ||1||Pause||

874.g: ਸਿਵ ਸਿਵ ਕਰਤੇ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
874.t: siv siv karate jo nar dhiaavai ||
874.e: That man who chants ""Shiva, Shiva"", and meditates on him,
is riding on a bull, shaking a tambourine. ||2||
One who worships the Great Goddess Maya
will be reincarnated as a woman, and not a man. ||3||
You are called the Primal Goddess.
At the time of liberation, where will you hide then? ||4||
Follow the Guru's Teachings, and hold tight to the Lord's Name, O friend.
Thus prays Naam Dayv, and so says the Gita as well. ||5||2||6||
Bilaaval Gond:

874.g: ਆਜੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਬੀਠਲੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਮੂਰਖ ਕੋ ਸਮਝਾਊ ਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
874.t: aaj naame beeThal dhekhiaa moorakh ko samajhaauoo re || rahaau ||
874.e: Today, Naam Dayv saw the Lord, and so I will instruct the ignorant. ||Pause||

874.g: ਪਾਂਡੇ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਗਾਇਤ੍ਰੀ ਲੋਧੇ ਕਾ ਖੇਤੁ ਖਾਤੀ ਥੀ ॥
874.t: paa(n)dde tumaree gaitree lodhe kaa khet khaatee thee ||
874.e: O Pandit, O religious scholar, your Gayatri was grazing in the fields.

874.g: ਲੈ ਕਰਿ ਠੇਗਾ ਟਗਰੀ ਤੋਰੀ ਲਾਂਗਤ ਲਾਂਗਤ ਜਾਤੀ ਥੀ ॥੧॥
874.t: lai kar Thegaa Tagaree toree laa(n)gat laa(n)gat jaatee thee ||1||
874.e: Taking a stick, the farmer broke its leg, and now it walks with a limp. ||1||

874.g: ਪਾਂਡੇ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਮਹਾਦੇਉ ਧਉਲੇ ਬਲਦ ਚੜਿਆ ਆਵਤੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਥਾ ॥
874.t: paa(n)dde tumaraa mahaadheau dhaule baladh chaRiaa aavat dhekhiaa thaa ||
874.e: O Pandit, I saw your great god Shiva, riding along on a white bull.

874.g: ਮੋਦੀ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਖਾਣਾ ਪਾਕਾ ਵਾ ਕਾ ਲੜਕਾ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਥਾ ॥੨॥
874.t: modhee ke ghar khaanaa paakaa vaa kaa laRakaa maariaa thaa ||2||
874.e: In the merchant's house, a banquet was prepared for him - he killed the merchant's son. ||2||

875.g: ਪਾਂਡੇ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਰਾਮਚੰਦੁ ਸੋ ਭੀ ਆਵਤੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਥਾ ॥
875.t: paa(n)dde tumaraa raamacha(n)dh so bhee aavat dhekhiaa thaa ||
875.e: O Pandit, I saw your Raam Chand coming too

875.g: ਰਾਵਨ ਸੇਤੀ ਸਰਬਰ ਹੋਈ ਘਰ ਕੀ ਜੋਇ ਗਵਾਈ ਥੀ ॥੩॥
875.t: raavan setee sarabar hoiee ghar kee joi gavaiee thee ||3||
875.e: ; he lost his wife, fighting a war against Raawan. ||3||
The Hindu is sightless; the Muslim has only one eye.
The spiritual teacher is wiser than both of them.
The Hindu worships at the temple, the Muslim at the mosque.

875.g: ਨਾਮੇ ਸੋਈ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਜਹ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਨ ਮਸੀਤਿ ॥੪॥੩॥੭॥
875.t: naame soiee seviaa jeh dhehuraa na maseet ||4||3||7||
875.e: Naam Dayv serves that Lord, who is not limited to either the temple or the mosque. ||4||3||7||

875.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੋਂਡ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੨
875.t: raag go(n)dd baanee ravidhaas jeeau kee ghar doojaa
875.e: Raag Gond, The Word Of Ravi Daas Jee, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Meditate on the Lord Mukanday, the Liberator, O people of the world.
Without Mukanday, the body shall be reduced to ashes.
Mukanday is the Giver of liberation.
Mukanday is my father and mother. ||1||
Meditate on Mukanday in life, and meditate on Mukanday in death.

875.g: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
875.t: taa ke sevak kau sadhaa ana(n)dhe ||1|| rahaau ||
875.e: His servant is blissful forever. ||1||Pause||
The Lord, Mukanday, is my breath of life.
Meditating on Mukanday, one's forehead will bear the Lord's insignia of approval.
The renunciate serves Mukanday.
Mukanday is the wealth of the poor and forlorn. ||2||
When the One Liberator does me a favor,
then what can the world do to me?
Erasing my social status, I have entered His Court.
You, Mukanday, are potent throughout the four ages. ||3||
Spiritual wisdom has welled up, and I have been enlightened.
In His Mercy, the Lord has made this worm His slave.
Says Ravi Daas, now my thirst is quenched;
I meditate on Mukanday the Liberator, and I serve Him. ||4||1||
Gond:
Someone may bathe at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage,
and worship the twelve Shiva-lingam stones,
and dig wells and pools,
but if he indulges in slander, then all of this is useless. ||1||
How can the slanderer of the Holy Saints be saved?

875.g: ਸਰਪਰ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਨਰਕ ਹੀ ਪਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
875.t: sarapar jaanahu narak hee parai ||1|| rahaau ||
875.e: Know for certain, that he shall go to hell. ||1||Pause||
Someone may bathe at Kuruk-shaytra during a solar eclipse,
and give his decorated wife in offering,
and listen to all the Simritees,
but if he indulges in slander, these are of no account. ||2||
Someone may give countless feasts,
and donate land, and build splendid buildings;
he may neglect his own affairs to work for others,
but if he indulges in slander, he shall wander in countless incarnations. ||3||
Why do you indulge in slander, O people of the world?
The emptiness of the slanderer is soon exposed.
I have thought, and determined the fate of the slanderer.

875.t: kahu ravidhaas paapee narak sidhaariaa ||4||2||11||7||2||49|| joR ||
875.e: Says Ravi Daas, he is a sinner; he shall go to hell. ||4||2||11||7||2||49|| Total||

876.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ
876.t: raamakalee mahalaa pehilaa ghar pehilaa chaupadhe
876.e: Raamkalee, First Mehla, First House, Chau-Padhay:

876.g: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
876.t: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
876.e: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

876.g: ਕੋਈ ਪੜਤਾ ਸਹਸਾਕਿਰਤਾ ਕੋਈ ਪੜੈ ਪੁਰਾਨਾ ॥
876.t: koiee paRataa sahasaakirataa koiee paRai puraanaa ||
876.e: Some read the Sanskrit scriptures, and some read the Puraanas.

876.g: ਕੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਜਪਮਾਲੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥
876.t: koiee naam japai japamaalee laagai tisai dhiaanaa ||
876.e: Some meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and chant it on their malas, focusing on it in meditation.

876.g: ਅਬ ਹੀ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
876.t: ab hee kab hee kichhoo na jaanaa teraa eko naam pachhaanaa ||1||
876.e: I know nothing, now or ever; I recognize only Your One Name, Lord. ||1||

876.g: ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਹਰੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਵਨ ਗਤੇ ॥
876.t: n jaanaa hare meree kavan gate ||
876.e: I do not know, Lord, what my condition shall be.

876.g: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਲਾਜ ਪਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
876.t: ham moorakh agiaan saran prabh teree kar kirapaa raakhahu meree laaj pate ||1|| rahaau ||
876.e: I am foolish and ignorant; I seek Your Sanctuary, God. Please, save my honor and my self-respect. ||1||Pause||

876.g: ਕਬਹੂ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਊਭਿ ਚੜਤੁ ਹੈ ਕਬਹੂ ਜਾਇ ਪਇਆਲੇ ॥
876.t: kabahoo jeeaRaa uoobh chaRat hai kabahoo jai piaale ||
876.e: Sometimes, the soul soars high in the heavens, and sometimes it falls to the depths of the nether regions.

876.g: ਲੋਭੀ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਤੁ ਹੈ ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਭਾਲੇ ॥੨॥
876.t: lobhee jeeaRaa thir na rahat hai chaare ku(n)ddaa bhaale ||2||
876.e: The greedy soul does not remain stable; it searches in the four directions. ||2||

876.g: ਮਰਣੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਆਏ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸਾਜਹਿ ਮਾਈ ॥
876.t: maran likhai ma(n)ddal meh aae jeevan saajeh maiee ||
876.e: With death pre-ordained, the soul comes into the world, gathering the riches of life.

876.g: ਏਕਿ ਚਲੇ ਹਮ ਦੇਖਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਭਾਹਿ ਬਲੰਤੀ ਆਈ ॥੩॥
876.t: ek chale ham dhekheh suaamee bhaeh bala(n)tee aaiee ||3||
876.e: I see that some have already gone, O my Lord and Master; the burning fire is coming closer! ||3||

876.g: ਨ ਕਿਸੀ ਕਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਨ ਕਿਸੀ ਕਾ ਭਾਈ ਨਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਈ ॥
876.t: n kisee kaa meet na kisee kaa bhaiee naa kisai baap na maiee ||
876.e: No one has any friend, and no one has any brother; no one has any father or mother.

876.g: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇ ਤੂ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
876.t: pranavat naanak je too dheveh a(n)te hoi sakhaiee ||4||1||
876.e: Prays Nanak, if You bless me with Your Name, it shall be my help and support in the end. ||4||1||

876.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
876.t: raamakalee mahalaa pehilaa ||
876.e: Raamkalee, First Mehla:

876.g: ਸਰਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਪਸਰਿ ਰਹੀ ॥
876.t: sarab jot teree pasar rahee ||
876.e: Your Light is prevailing everywhere.

876.g: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਨਰਹਰੀ ॥੧॥
876.t: jeh jeh dhekhaa teh naraharee ||1||
876.e: Wherever I look, there I see the Lord. ||1||

876.g: ਜੀਵਨ ਤਲਬ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
876.t: jeevan talab nivaar suaamee ||
876.e: Please rid me of the desire to live, O my Lord and Master.

876.g: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਗਾਡਿਆ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਉਤਰਉ ਪਾਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
876.t: a(n)dh koop maiaa man gaaddiaa kiau kar utarau paar suaamee ||1|| rahaau ||
876.e: My mind is entangled in the deep dark pit of Maya. How can I cross over, O Lord and Master? ||1||Pause||

876.g: ਜਹ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬਸਿਆ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
876.t: jeh bheetar ghaT bheetar basiaa baahar kaahe naahee ||
876.e: He dwells deep within, inside the heart; how can He not be outside as well?

876.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਦਾ ਚਿੰਤ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
876.t: tin kee saar kare nit saahib sadhaa chi(n)t man maahee ||2||
876.e: Our Lord and Master always takes care of us, and keeps us in His thoughts. ||2||

876.g: ਆਪੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
876.t: aape neRai aape dhoor ||
876.e: He Himself is near at hand, and He is far away.

876.g: ਆਪੇ ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
876.t: aape sarab rahiaa bharapoor ||
876.e: He Himself is all-pervading, permeating everywhere.

876.g: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
876.t: satagur milai a(n)dheraa jai ||
876.e: Meeting the True Guru, the darkness is dispelled.

877.e: Wherever I look, there I see Him pervading. ||3||

877.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਸਾ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਨੈਣੀ ਲਾਗਸਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
877.t: a(n)tar sahasaa baahar maiaa nainee laagas baanee ||
877.e: There is doubt within me, and Maya is outside; it hits me in the eyes like an arrow.

877.g: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਪਰਤਾਪਹਿਗਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
877.t: pranavat naanak dhaasan dhaasaa parataapahigaa praanee ||4||2||
877.e: Prays Nanak, the slave of the Lord's slaves: such a mortal suffers terribly. ||4||2||
Raamkalee, First Mehla:

877.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਰਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਕਵਨੁ ਦਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਦਰਾ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਦਰੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਲਹੈ ॥
877.t: jit dhar vaseh kavan dhar kaheeaai dharaa bheetar dhar kavan lahai ||
877.e: Where is that door, where You live, O Lord? What is that door called? Among all doors, who can find that door?

877.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਦਰ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਫਿਰਾ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਕੋਈ ਆਇ ਕਹੈ ॥੧॥
877.t: jis dhar kaaran firaa udhaasee so dhar koiee aai kahai ||1||
877.e: For the sake of that door, I wander around sadly, detached from the world; if only someone would come and tell me about that door. ||1||
How can I cross over the world-ocean?
While I am living, I cannot be dead. ||1||Pause||

877.g: ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਵਾਜਾ ਰੋਹੁ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਆਸਾ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਦੁਇ ਪਟ ਜੜੇ ॥
877.t: dhukh dharavaajaa roh rakhavaalaa aasaa a(n)dhesaa dhui paT jaRe ||
877.e: Pain is the door, and anger is the guard; hope and anxiety are the two shutters.

877.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਜਲੁ ਖਾਈ ਪਾਣੀ ਘਰੁ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਸਤ ਕੈ ਆਸਣਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਰਹੈ ॥੨॥
877.t: maiaa jal khaiee paanee ghar baadhiaa sat kai aasan purakh rahai ||2||
877.e: Maya is the water in the moat; in the middle of this moat, he has built his home. The Primal Lord sits in the Seat of Truth. ||2||

877.g: ਕਿੰਤੇ ਨਾਮਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਤੁਮ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਹਰੇ ॥
877.t: ki(n)te naamaa a(n)t na jaaniaa tum sar naahee avar hare ||
877.e: You have so many Names, Lord, I do not know their limit. There is no other equal to You.

877.g: ਊਚਾ ਨਹੀ ਕਹਣਾ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੩॥
877.t: uoochaa nahee kahanaa man meh rahanaa aape jaanai aap kare ||3||
877.e: Do not speak out loud - remain in your mind. The Lord Himself knows, and He Himself acts. ||3||

877.g: ਜਬ ਆਸਾ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਕਹੈ ॥
877.t: jab aasaa a(n)dhesaa tab hee kiau kar ek kahai ||
877.e: As long as there is hope, there is anxiety; so how can anyone speak of the One Lord?

877.g: ਆਸਾ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੁ ਮਿਲੈ ॥੪॥
877.t: aasaa bheetar rahai niraasaa tau naanak ek milai ||4||
877.e: In the midst of hope, remain untouched by hope; then, O Nanak, you shall meet the One Lord. ||4||
In this way, you shall cross over the world-ocean.
This is the way to remain dead while yet alive. ||1||Second Pause||3||
Raamkalee, First Mehla:

877.g: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਖੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਬਾਜੈ ਲੋਕੁ ਸੁਣੇ ॥
877.t: surat sabadh saakhee meree si(n)n(g)ee baajai lok sune ||
877.e: Awareness of the Shabad and the Teachings is my horn; the people hear the sound of its vibrations.

877.g: ਪਤੁ ਝੋਲੀ ਮੰਗਣ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੜੇ ॥੧॥
877.t: pat jholee ma(n)gan kai taiee bheekhiaa naam paRe ||1||
877.e: Honor is my begging-bowl, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the charity I receive. ||1||
O Baba, Gorakh is the Lord of the Universe; He is always awake and aware.

877.g: ਗੋਰਖੁ ਸੋ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੋਇ ਉਠਾਲੀ ਕਰਤੇ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
877.t: gorakh so jin goi uThaalee karate baar na laagai ||1|| rahaau ||
877.e: He alone is Gorakh, who sustains the earth; He created it in an instant. ||1||Pause||

877.g: ਪਾਣੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਪਵਣਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਏ ॥
877.t: paanee praan pavan ba(n)dh raakhe cha(n)dh sooraj mukh dhe'ee ||
877.e: Binding together water and air, He infused the breath of life into the body, and made the lamps of the sun and the moon.

877.g: ਮਰਣ ਜੀਵਣ ਕਉ ਧਰਤੀ ਦੀਨੀ ਏਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਸਰੇ ॥੨॥
877.t: maran jeevan kau dharatee dheenee ete gun visare ||2||
877.e: To die and to live, He gave us the earth, but we have forgotten these blessings. ||2||

877.g: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਅਰੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੰਗਮ ਪੀਰ ਪੁਰਸ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ॥
877.t: sidh saadhik ar jogee ja(n)gam peer puras bahutere ||
877.e: There are so many Siddhas, seekers, Yogis, wandering pilgrims, spiritual teachers and good people.

877.g: ਜੇ ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਾ ਤ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਆਖਾ ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੇ ॥੩॥
877.t: je tin milaa ta keerat aakhaa taa man sev kare ||3||
877.e: If I meet them, I chant the Lord's Praises, and then, my mind serves Him. ||3||

877.g: ਕਾਗਦੁ ਲੂਣੁ ਰਹੈ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੰਗੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਕਮਲੁ ਰਹੈ ॥
877.t: kaagadh loon rahai ghirat sa(n)ge paanee kamal rahai ||
877.e: Paper and salt, protected by ghee, remain untouched by water, as the lotus remains unaffected in water.

877.g: ਐਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਜਮੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੈ ॥੪॥੪॥
877.t: aaise bhagat mileh jan naanak tin jam kiaa karai ||4||4||
877.e: Those who meet with such devotees, O servant Nanak - what can death do to them? ||4||4||
Raamkalee, First Mehla:
Listen, Machhindra, to what Nanak says.
One who subdues the five passions does not waver.
One who practices Yoga in such a way,
saves himself, and saves all his generations. ||1||
He alone is a hermit, who attains such understanding.
Day and night, he remains absorbed in deepest Samaadhi. ||1||Pause||
He begs for loving devotion to the Lord, and lives in the Fear of God.
He is satisfied, with the priceless gift of contentment.
Becoming the embodiment of meditation, he attains the true Yogic posture.
He focuses his consciousness in the deep trance of the True Name. ||2||
Nanak chants the Ambrosial Bani.
Listen, O Machhindra: this is the insignia of the true hermit.
One who, in the midst of hope, remains untouched by hope,
shall truly find the Creator Lord. ||3||
Prays Nanak, I share the mysterious secrets of God.
The Guru and His disciple are joined together!
One who eats this food, this medicine of the Teachings,

878.e: has the wisdom of the six Shaastras. ||4||5||
Raamkalee, First Mehla:

878.g: ਹਮ ਡੋਲਤ ਬੇੜੀ ਪਾਪ ਭਰੀ ਹੈ ਪਵਣੁ ਲਗੈ ਮਤੁ ਜਾਈ ॥
878.t: ham ddolat beRee paap bharee hai pavan lagai mat jaiee ||
878.e: My boat is wobbly and unsteady; it is filled with sins. The wind is rising - what if it tips over?

878.g: ਸਨਮੁਖ ਸਿਧ ਭੇਟਣ ਕਉ ਆਏ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਦੇਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
