878.t: sanamukh sidh bheTan kau aae nihachau dheh vaddiaaiee ||1||
878.e: As sunmukh, I have turned to the Guru; O my Perfect Master; please be sure to bless me with Your glorious greatness. ||1||
O Guru, my Saving Grace, please carry me across the world-ocean.

878.g: ਦੇਹਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ਹਉ ਤੁਝ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
878.t: dheh bhagat pooran avinaasee hau tujh kau balihaariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
878.e: Bless me with devotion to the perfect, imperishable Lord God; I am a sacrifice to You. ||1||Pause||

878.g: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਜੋਗੀ ਅਰੁ ਜੰਗਮ ਏਕੁ ਸਿਧੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
878.t: sidh saadhik jogee ar ja(n)gam ek sidh jinee dhiaaiaa ||
878.e: He alone is a Siddha, a seeker, a Yogi, a wandering pilgrim, who meditates on the One Perfect Lord.

878.g: ਪਰਸਤ ਪੈਰ ਸਿਝਤ ਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਖਰੁ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
878.t: parasat pair sijhat te suaamee akhar jin kau aaiaa ||2||
878.e: Touching the feet of the Lord Master, they are emancipated; they come to receive the Word of the Teachings. ||2||

878.g: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
878.t: jap tap sa(n)jam karam na jaanaa naam japee prabh teraa ||
878.e: I know nothing of charity, meditation, self-discipline or religious rituals; I only chant Your Name, God.

878.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥੩॥੬॥
878.t: gur paramesar naanak bheTio saachai sabadh niberaa ||3||6||
878.e: Nanak has met the Guru, the Transcendent Lord God; through the True Word of His Shabad, he is set free. ||3||6||
Raamkalee, First Mehla:
Focus your consciousness in deep absorption on the Lord.
Make your body a raft, to cross over.
Deep within is the fire of desire; keep it in check.
Day and night, that lamp shall burn unceasingly. ||1||
Float such a lamp upon the water;

878.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਦੀਵੈ ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
878.t: jit dheevai sabh sojhee pai ||1|| rahaau ||
878.e: this lamp will bring total understanding. ||1||Pause||
This understanding is good clay;
a lamp made of such clay is acceptable to the Lord.
So shape this lamp on the wheel of good actions.
In this world and in the next, this lamp shall be with you. ||2||
When He Himself grants His Grace,
then, as Gurmukh, one may understand Him.
Within the heart, this lamp is permanently lit.
It is not extinguished by water or wind.
Such a lamp will carry you across the water. ||3||
Wind does not shake it, or put it out.
Its light reveals the Divine Throne.
The Kh'shaatriyas, Brahmins, Soodras and Vaishyas
cannot find its value, even by thousands of calculations.
If any of them lights such a lamp,
O Nanak, he is emancipated. ||4||7||
Raamkalee, First Mehla:
To place one's faith in Your Name, Lord, is true worship.
With an offering of Truth, one obtains a place to sit.
If a prayer is offered with truth and contentment,
the Lord will hear it, and call him in to sit by Him. ||1||
O Nanak, no one returns empty-handed;
such is the Court of the True Lord. ||1||Pause||
The treasure I seek is the gift of Your Grace.
Please bless this humble beggar - this is what I seek.
Please, pour Your Love into the cup of my heart.
This is Your pre-determined value. ||2||

878.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
878.t: jin kichh keeaa so kichh karai ||
878.e: The One who created everything, does everything.
He Himself appraises His own value.
The Sovereign Lord King becomes manifest to the Gurmukh.

878.g: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
878.t: naa ko aavai naa ko jai ||3||
878.e: He does not come, and He does not go. ||3||

878.g: ਲੋਕੁ ਧਿਕਾਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨ ਮਾਗਤ ਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
878.t: lok dhikaar kahai ma(n)gat jan maagat maan na paiaa ||
878.e: People curse at the beggar; by begging, he does not receive honor.

878.g: ਸਹ ਕੀਆ ਗਲਾ ਦਰ ਕੀਆ ਬਾਤਾ ਤੈ ਤਾ ਕਹਣੁ ਕਹਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੮॥
878.t: seh keeaa galaa dhar keeaa baataa tai taa kahan kahaiaa ||4||8||
878.e: O Lord, You inspire me to speak Your Words, and tell the Story of Your Court. ||4||8||
Raamkalee, First Mehla:

878.g: ਸਾਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਬੂੰਦ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਬੁਝੈ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
878.t: saagar meh boo(n)dh boo(n)dh meh saagar kavan bujhai bidh jaanai ||
878.e: The drop is in the ocean, and the ocean is in the drop. Who understands, and knows this?

878.g: ਉਤਭੁਜ ਚਲਤ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਿ ਚੀਨੈ ਆਪੇ ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੧॥
878.t: autabhuj chalat aap kar cheenai aape tat pachhaanai ||1||
878.e: He Himself creates the wondrous play of the world. He Himself contemplates it, and understands its true essence. ||1||

879.e: How rare are those who contemplate this spiritual wisdom.

879.g: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
879.t: tis te mukat param gat hoiee ||1|| rahaau ||
879.e: Through this, the supreme state of liberation is attained. ||1||Pause||

879.g: ਦਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰੈਣਿ ਰੈਣਿ ਮਹਿ ਦਿਨੀਅਰੁ ਉਸਨ ਸੀਤ ਬਿਧਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
879.t: dhin meh rain rain meh dhineear usan seet bidh soiee ||
879.e: The night is in the day, and the day is in the night. The same is true of hot and cold.

879.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਮਝ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
879.t: taa kee gat mit avar na jaanai gur bin samajh na hoiee ||2||
879.e: No one else knows His state and extent; without the Guru, this is not understood. ||2||

879.g: ਪੁਰਖ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਰਿ ਨਾਰਿ ਮਹਿ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
879.t: purakh meh naar naar meh purakhaa boojhahu braham giaanee ||
879.e: The female is in the male, and the male is in the female. Understand this, O God-realized being!

879.g: ਧੁਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
879.t: dhun meh dhiaan dhiaan meh jaaniaa gurmukh akath kahaanee ||3||
879.e: The meditation is in the music, and knowledge is in meditation. Become Gurmukh, and speak the Unspoken Speech. ||3||

879.g: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਪੰਚ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਈ ॥
879.t: man meh jot jot meh manooaa pa(n)ch mile gur bhaiee ||
879.e: The Light is in the mind, and the mind is in the Light. The Guru brings the five senses together, like brothers.

879.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜਿਨ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੪॥੯॥
879.t: naanak tin kai sadh balihaaree jin ek sabadh liv laiee ||4||9||
879.e: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to those who enshrine love for the One Word of the Shabad. ||4||9||
Raamkalee, First Mehla:
When the Lord God showered His Mercy,
egotism was eradicated from within me.

879.g: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕਿ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
879.t: so sevak raam piaaree || jo gur sabadhee beechaaree ||1||
879.e: That humble servant who contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad, is very dear to the Lord. ||1||

879.g: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
879.t: so har jan har prabh bhaavai ||
879.e: That humble servant of the Lord is pleasing to his Lord God;

879.g: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਲਾਜ ਛੋਡਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
879.t: ahinis bhagat kare dhin raatee laaj chhodd har ke gun gaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
879.e: day and night, he performs devotional worship, day and night. Disregarding his own honor, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
The unstruck melody of the sound current resonates and resounds;
my mind is appeased by the subtle essence of the Lord.
Through the Perfect Guru, I am absorbed in Truth.
Through the Guru, I have found the Lord, the Primal Being. ||2||
Gurbani is the sound current of the Naad, the Vedas, everything.
My mind is attuned to the Lord of the Universe.
He is my sacred shrine of pilgrimage, fasting and austere self-discipline.
The Lord saves, and carries across, those who meet with the Guru. ||3||
One whose self-conceit is gone, sees his fears run away.
That servant grasps the Guru's feet.
The Guru, the True Guru, has expelled my doubts.
Says Nanak, I have merged into the Word of the Shabad. ||4||10||
Raamkalee, First Mehla:
He runs around, begging for clothes and food.
He burns with hunger and corruption, and will suffer in the world hereafter.

879.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਲੀਨੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
879.t: gurmat nahee leenee dhuramat pat khoiee ||
879.e: He does not follow the Guru's Teachings; through his evil-mindedness, he loses his honor.
Only through the Guru's Teachings will such a person become devoted. ||1||
The way of the Yogi is to dwell in the celestial home of bliss.

879.g: ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਏਕੋ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਭਾਇ ਸਬਦਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
879.t: ek dhirasaT eko kar dhekhiaa bheekhiaa bhai sabadh tirapataasai ||1|| rahaau ||
879.e: He looks impartially, equally upon all. He receives the charity of the Lord's Love, and the Word of the Shabad, and so he is satisfied. ||1||Pause||
The five bulls, the senses, pull the wagon of the body around.
By the Lord's power, one's honor is preserved.
But when the axle breaks, the wagon falls and crashes.
It falls apart, like a pile of logs. ||2||
Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad, Yogi.

879.g: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੋਗ ਬਿਓਗੀ ॥
879.t: dhukh sukh sam karanaa sog biogee ||
879.e: Look upon pain and pleasure as one and the same, sorrow and separation.
Let your food be contemplative meditation upon the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
Your wall shall be permanent, by meditating on the Formless Lord. ||3||
Wear the loin-cloth of poise, and be free of entanglements.
The Guru's Word shall release you from sexual desire and anger.

879.g: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
879.t: man meh mu(n)dhraa har gur saranaa ||
879.e: In your mind, let your ear-rings be the Sanctuary of the Guru, the Lord.
O Nanak, worshipping the Lord in deep devotion, the humble are carried across. ||4||11||

880.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Raamkalee, Third Mehla, First House:
In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, everyone spoke the Truth.
In each and every home, devotional worship was performed by the people, according to the Guru's Teachings.
In that Golden Age, Dharma had four feet.
How rare are those people who, as Gurmukh, contemplate this and understand. ||1||
In all four ages, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is glory and greatness.

880.g: ਜਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
880.t: j naam laagai so mukat hovai gur bin naam na paavai koiee ||1|| rahaau ||
880.e: One who holds tight to the Naam is liberated; without the Guru, no one obtains the Naam. ||1||Pause||
In the Silver Age of Traytaa Yuga, one leg was removed.
Hypocrisy became prevalent, and people thought that the Lord was far away.
The Gurmukhs still understood and realized;
the Naam abided deep within them, and they were at peace. ||2||
In the Brass Age of Dwaapur Yuga, duality and double-mindedness arose.
Deluded by doubt, they knew duality.
In this Brass Age, Dharma was left with only two feet.
Those who became Gurmukh implanted the Naam deep within. ||3||
In the Iron Age of Kali Yuga, Dharma was left with only one power.

880.g: ਇਕ ਪੈਰਿ ਚਲੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਏ ॥
880.t: eik pair chalai maiaa moh vadhaae ||
880.e: It walks on just one foot; love and emotional attachment to Maya have increased.
Love and emotional attachment to Maya bring total darkness.
If someone meets the True Guru, he is saved, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||

880.g: ਸਭ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥
880.t: sabh jug meh saachaa eko soiee ||
880.e: Throughout the ages, there is only the One True Lord.

880.g: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
880.t: sabh meh sach dhoojaa nahee koiee ||
880.e: Among all, is the True Lord; there is no other at all.
Praising the True Lord, true peace is attained.
How rare are those, who as Gurmukh, chant the Naam. ||5||

880.g: ਸਭ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਊਤਮੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
880.t: sabh jug meh naam uootam hoiee ||
880.e: Throughout all the ages, the Naam is the ultimate, the most sublime.
How rare are those, who as Gurmukh, understand this.

880.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਭਗਤੁ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
880.t: har naam dhiaae bhagat jan soiee ||
880.e: One who meditates on the Lord's Name is a humble devotee.

880.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥੧॥
880.t: naanak jug jug naam vaddiaaiee hoiee ||6||1||
880.e: O Nanak, in each and every age, the Naam is glory and greatness. ||6||1||
Raamkalee, Fourth Mehla, First House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

880.g: ਜੇ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
880.t: je vadd bhaag hoveh vaddabhaagee taa har har naam dhiaavai ||
880.e: If someone is very fortunate, and is blessed with great high destiny, then he meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

880.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
880.t: naam japat naame sukh paavai har naame naam samaavai ||1||
880.e: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he finds peace, and merges in the Naam. ||1||
O mortal, as Gurmukh, worship the Lord in devotion forever.

880.g: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
880.t: hiradhai pragaas hovai liv laagai gurmat har har naam samaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
880.e: Your heart shall be illumined; through the Guru's Teachings, lovingly attune yourself to the Lord. You shall merge in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

880.g: ਹੀਰਾ ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਮਾਣਕ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਗਰ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
880.t: heeraa ratan javehar maanak bahu saagar bharapoor keeaa ||
880.e: The Great Giver is filled with diamonds, emeralds, rubies and pearls;

880.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਵਡ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਡ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਢਿ ਕਢਿ ਲੀਆ ॥੨॥
880.t: jis vadd bhaag hovai vadd masatak tin gurmat kadd kadd leeaa ||2||
880.e: one who has good fortune and great destiny inscribed upon his forehead, digs them out, by following the Guru's Teachings. ||2||

880.g: ਰਤਨੁ ਜਵੇਹਰੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਤਲੀ ਦਿਖਲਾਇਆ ॥
880.t: ratan javehar laal har naamaa gur kaadd talee dhikhalaiaa ||
880.e: The Lord's Name is the jewel, the emerald, the ruby; digging it out, the Guru has placed it in your palm.

880.g: ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨਹੀ ਲੀਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਓਲੈ ਲਾਖੁ ਛਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
880.t: bhaagaheen manmukh nahee leeaa tiran olai laakh chhapaiaa ||3||
880.e: The unfortunate, self-willed manmukh does not obtain it; this priceless jewel remains hidden behind a curtain of straw. ||3||

880.g: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥
880.t: masatak bhaag hovai dhur likhiaa taa satagur sevaa laae ||
880.e: If such pre-ordained destiny is written upon one's forehead, then the True Guru enjoins him to serve Him.

880.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਪਾਵੈ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥
880.t: naanak ratan javehar paavai dhan dhan gurmat har paae ||4||1||
880.e: O Nanak, then he obtains the jewel, the gem; blessed, blessed is that one who follows the Guru's Teachings, and finds the Lord. ||4||1||
Raamkalee, Fourth Mehla:

880.g: ਰਾਮ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਇਆ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨੀਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਇ ॥
880.t: raam janaa mil bhiaa ana(n)dhaa har neekee kathaa sunai ||
880.e: Meeting with the humble servants of the Lord, I am in ecstasy; they preach the sublime sermon of the Lord.

880.g: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ ਸਭ ਨੀਕਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
880.t: dhuramat mail giee sabh neekal satasa(n)gat mil budh pai ||1||
880.e: The filth of evil-mindedness is totally washed away; joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, one is blessed with understanding. ||1||

881.g: ਰਾਮ ਜਨ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਬੋਲਾਇ ॥
881.t: raam jan gurmat raam bolai ||
881.e: O humble servant of the Lord, follow the Guru's Teachings, and chant the Name of the Lord.

881.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸੁਣੈ ਕਹੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਤ ਸੋਹਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
881.t: jo jo sunai kahai so mukataa raam japat sohai ||1|| rahaau ||
881.e: Whoever hears and speaks it is liberated; chanting the Lord's Name, one is embellished with beauty. ||1||Pause||

881.g: ਜੇ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਜਨਾ ਭੇਟਾਇ ॥
881.t: je vadd bhaag hoveh mukh masatak har raam janaa bheTai ||
881.e: If someone has supremely high destiny written on his forehead, the Lord leads him to meet the humble servants of the Lord.

881.g: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਦੇਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਭੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
881.t: dharasan sa(n)t dheh kar kirapaa sabh dhaaladh dhukh leh jai ||2||
881.e: Be merciful, and grant me the Blessed Vision of the Saints' Darshan, which shall rid me of all poverty and pain. ||2||

881.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗ ਰਾਮ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਨ ਸੁਖਾਇ ॥
881.t: har ke log raam jan neeke bhaagaheen na sukhai ||
881.e: The Lord's people are good and sublime; the unfortunate ones do not like them at all.

881.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਮ ਕਹਹਿ ਜਨ ਊਚੇ ਨਰ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਡੰਸੁ ਲਗਾਇ ॥੩॥
881.t: jiau jiau raam kaheh jan uooche nar ni(n)dhak dda(n)s lagai ||3||
881.e: The more the Lord's exalted servants speak of Him, the more the slanderers attack and sting them. ||3||

881.g: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਨਰ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਜਿਨ ਜਨ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸਖਾ ਸਖਾਇ ॥
881.t: dhirag dhirag nar ni(n)dhak jin jan nahee bhaae har ke sakhaa sakhai ||
881.e: Cursed, cursed are the slanderers who do not like the humble, the friends and companions of the Lord.

881.g: ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚੋਰ ਵੇਮੁਖ ਮੁਖ ਕਾਲੇ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਨ ਭਾਇ ॥੪॥
881.t: se har ke chor vemukh mukh kaale jin gur kee paij na bhai ||4||
881.e: Those who do not like the honor and glory of the Guru are faithless, black-faced thieves, who have turned their backs on the Lord. ||4||

881.g: ਦਇਆ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹਮ ਦੀਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
881.t: dhiaa dhiaa kar raakhahu har jeeau ham dheen teree saranai ||
881.e: Have mercy, have mercy, please save me, Dear Lord. I am meek and humble - I seek Your protection.

881.g: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੁਮ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੫॥੨॥
881.t: ham baarik tum pitaa prabh mere jan naanak bakhas milai ||5||2||
881.e: I am Your child, and You are my father, God. Please forgive servant Nanak and merge him with Yourself. ||5||2||

881.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
881.t: raamakalee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
881.e: Raamkalee, Fourth Mehla:

881.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸਖਾ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ ਤਿਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਹਾਥੁ ਵਤਾਵੈ ॥
881.t: har ke sakhaa saadh jan neeke tin uoopar haath vataavai ||
881.e: The friends of the Lord, the humble, Holy Saints are sublime; the Lord spreads out His protecting hands above them.

881.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੇਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਏ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
881.t: gurmukh saadh seiee prabh bhaae kar kirapaa aap milaavai ||1||
881.e: The Gurmukhs are the Holy Saints, pleasing to God; in His mercy, He blends them with Himself. ||1||

881.g: ਰਾਮ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
881.t: raam mo kau har jan mel man bhaavai ||
881.e: O Lord, my mind longs to meet with the humble servants of the Lord.

881.g: ਅਮਿਉ ਅਮਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹੈ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
881.t: amiau amiau har ras hai meeThaa mil sa(n)t janaa mukh paavai ||1|| rahaau ||
881.e: The sweet, subtle essence of the Lord is immortalizing ambrosia. Meeting the Saints, I drink it in. ||1||Pause||

881.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗ ਰਾਮ ਜਨ ਊਤਮ ਮਿਲਿ ਊਤਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
881.t: har ke log raam jan uootam mil uootam padhavee paavai ||
881.e: The Lord's people are the most lofty and exalted. Meeting with them, the most exalted status is obtained.

881.g: ਹਮ ਹੋਵਤ ਚੇਰੀ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਖੁਸੀ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
881.t: ham hovat cheree dhaas dhaasan kee meraa Thaakur khusee karaavai ||2||
881.e: I am the slave of the slave of the Lord's slaves; my Lord and Master is pleased with me. ||2||

881.g: ਸੇਵਕ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਰਿਦ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਵੈ ॥
881.t: sevak jan seveh se vaddabhaagee ridh man tan preet lagaavai ||
881.e: The humble servant serves; one who enshrines love for the Lord in his heart, mind and body is very fortunate.

881.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਤਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਕੂੜੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
881.t: bin preetee kareh bahu baataa kooR bol kooRo fal paavai ||3||
881.e: One who talks too much without love, speaks falsely, and obtains only false rewards. ||3||

881.g: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਧਾਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਪਗੀ ਲੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
881.t: mo kau dhaar kirapaa jagajeevan dhaate har sa(n)t pagee le paavai ||
881.e: Take pity on me, O Lord of the World, O Great Giver; let me fall at the feet of the Saints.

881.g: ਹਉ ਕਾਟਉ ਕਾਟਿ ਬਾਢਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਉ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤੁ ਚੜਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੪॥੩॥
881.t: hau kaaTau kaaT baadd sir raakhau jit naanak sa(n)t chaR aavai ||4||3||
881.e: I would cut off my head, and cut it into pieces, O Nanak, and set it down for the Saints to walk upon. ||4||3||

881.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
881.t: raamakalee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
881.e: Raamkalee, Fourth Mehla:

881.g: ਜੇ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਵਡ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਮਿਲਦਿਆ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
881.t: je vadd bhaag hoveh vadd mere jan miladhiaa ddil na laieeaai ||
881.e: If I am blessed with supreme high destiny, I will meet the humble servants of the Lord, without delay.

881.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੁੰਟ ਸਰ ਨੀਕੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਤਿਤੁ ਨਾਵਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
881.t: har jan a(n)mirat ku(n)T sar neeke vaddabhaagee tit naavaieeaai ||1||
881.e: The Lord's humble servants are pools of ambrosial nectar; by great good fortune, one bathes in them. ||1||

881.g: ਰਾਮ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
881.t: raam mo kau har jan kaarai laieeaai ||
881.e: O Lord, let me work for the humble servants of the Lord.

881.g: ਹਉ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਖਾ ਪੀਸਉ ਸੰਤ ਆਗੈ ਪਗ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੂਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
881.t: hau paanee pakhaa peesau sa(n)t aagai pag mal mal dhoor mukh laieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
881.e: I carry water, wave the fan and grind the corn for them; I massage and wash their feet. I apply the dust of their feet to my forehead. ||1||Pause||

881.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇ ਵਡ ਊਚੇ ਜੋ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ॥
881.t: har jan vadde vadde vadd uooche jo satagur mel milaieeaai ||
881.e: The Lord's humble servants are great, very great, the greatest and most exalted; they lead us to meet the True Guru.

881.g: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੨॥
881.t: satagur jevadd avar na koiee mil satagur purakh dhiaaieeaai ||2||
881.e: No one else is as great as the True Guru; meeting the True Guru, I meditate on the Lord, the Primal Being. ||2||

881.g: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਲਾਜ ਰਖਾਈਐ ॥
881.t: satagur saran pare tin paiaa mere Thaakur laaj rakhaieeaai ||
881.e: Those who seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru find the Lord. My Lord and Master saves their honor.

881.g: ਇਕਿ ਅਪਣੈ ਸੁਆਇ ਆਇ ਬਹਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਜਿਉ ਬਗੁਲ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
881.t: eik apanai suaai aai baheh gur aagai jiau bagul samaadh lagaieeaai ||3||
881.e: Some come for their own purposes, and sit before the Guru; they pretend to be in Samaadhi, like storks with their eyes closed. ||3||

881.g: ਬਗੁਲਾ ਕਾਗ ਨੀਚ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਾਇ ਕਰੰਗ ਬਿਖੂ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
881.t: bagulaa kaag neech kee sa(n)gat jai kara(n)g bikhoo mukh laieeaai ||
881.e: Associating with the wretched and the lowly, like the stork and the crow, is like feeding on a carcass of poison.

881.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੰਸੁ ਕਰਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੪॥
881.t: naanak mel mel prabh sa(n)gat mil sa(n)gat ha(n)s karaieeaai ||4||4||
881.e: Nanak: O God, unite me with the Sangat, the Congregation. United with the Sangat, I will become a swan. ||4||4||

882.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
882.t: raamakalee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
882.e: Raamkalee, Fourth Mehla:

882.g: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
882.t: satagur dhiaa karahu har melahu mere preetam praan har raiaa ||
882.e: O True Guru, please have compassion, and unite me with the Lord. My Sovereign Lord is the Beloved of my breath of life.

882.g: ਹਮ ਚੇਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਲਗਹ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੰਥੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
882.t: ham cheree hoi lageh gur charanee jin har prabh maarag pa(n)th dhikhaiaa ||1||
882.e: I am a slave; I fall at the Guru's feet. He has shown me the Path, the Way to my Lord God. ||1||

882.g: ਰਾਮ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
882.t: raam mai har har naam man bhaiaa ||
882.e: The Name of my Lord, Har, Har, is pleasing to my mind.

882.g: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਬੇਲੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਖਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
882.t: mai har bin avar na koiee belee meraa pitaa maataa har sakhaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
882.e: I have no friend except the Lord; the Lord is my father, my mother, my companion. ||1||Pause||

882.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਨ ਰਹਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਮਰਹਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
882.t: mere ik khin praan na raheh bin preetam bin dhekhe mareh meree maiaa ||
882.e: My breath of life will not survive for an instant, without my Beloved; unless I see Him, I will die, O my mother!

882.g: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਏ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
882.t: dhan dhan vadd bhaag gur saranee aae har gur mil dharasan paiaa ||2||
882.e: Blessed, blessed is my great, high destiny, that I have come to the Guru's Sanctuary. Meeting with the Guru, I have obtained the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||2||

882.g: ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸੂਝੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਉ ਜਪਾਇਆ ॥
882.t: mai avar na koiee soojhai boojhai man har jap japau japaiaa ||
882.e: I do not know or understand any other within my mind; I meditate and chant the Lord's Chant.

882.g: ਨਾਮਹੀਣ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਨਕਟੇ ਤਿਨ ਘਸਿ ਘਸਿ ਨਕ ਵਢਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
882.t: naamaheen fireh se nakaTe tin ghas ghas nak vaddaiaa ||3||
882.e: Those who lack the Naam, wander in shame; their noses are chopped off, bit by bit. ||3||

882.g: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਜੀਵਾਲਿ ਲੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
882.t: mo kau jagajeevan jeevaal lai suaamee ridh a(n)tar naam vasaiaa ||
882.e: O Life of the World, rejuvenate me! O my Lord and Master, enshrine Your Name deep within my heart.

882.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥
882.t: naanak guroo guroo hai pooraa mil satigur naam dhiaaiaa ||4||5||
882.e: O Nanak, perfect is the Guru, the Guru. Meeting the True Guru, I meditate on the Naam. ||4||5||

882.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
882.t: raamakalee mahalaa chauthhaa ||
882.e: Raamkalee, Fourth Mehla:

882.g: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਵਡਾ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
882.t: satagur dhaataa vaddaa vadd purakh hai jit miliaai har ur dhaare ||
882.e: The True Guru, the Great Giver, is the Great, Primal Being; meeting Him, the Lord is enshrined within the heart.

882.g: ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
882.t: jeea dhaan gur poorai dheeaa har a(n)mirat naam samaare ||1||
882.e: The Perfect Guru has granted me the life of the soul; I meditate in remembrance on the Ambrosial Name of the Lord. ||1||

882.g: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
882.t: raam gur har har naam ka(n)Th dhaare ||
882.e: O Lord, the Guru has implanted the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within my heart.

882.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣੀ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
882.t: gurmukh kathaa sunee man bhaiee dhan dhan vadd bhaag hamaare ||1|| rahaau ||
882.e: As Gurmukh, I have heard His sermon, which pleases my mind; blessed, blessed is my great destiny. ||1||Pause||

882.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪਾਰੇ ॥
882.t: koT koT tetees dhiaaveh taa kaa a(n)t na paaveh paare ||
882.e: Millions, three hundred thirty millions of gods meditate on Him, but they cannot find His end or limitation.

882.g: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਾਮ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਹਾਥੁ ਪਸਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
882.t: hiradhai kaam kaamanee maageh ridh maageh haath pasaare ||2||
882.e: With sexual urges in their hearts, they beg for beautiful women; stretching out their hands, they beg for riches. ||2||

882.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਜਪਿ ਜਪੁ ਵਡਾ ਵਡੇਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਖਉ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
882.t: har jas jap jap vaddaa vadderaa gurmukh rakhau ur dhaare ||
882.e: One who chants the Praises of the Lord is the greatest of the great; the Gurmukh keeps the Lord clasped to his heart.

882.g: ਜੇ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
882.t: je vadd bhaag hoveh taa japeeaai har bhaujal paar utaare ||3||
882.e: If one is blessed with high destiny, he meditates on the Lord, who carries him across the terrifying world-ocean. ||3||

882.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਕੰਠਿ ਜਨ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
882.t: har jan nikaT nikaT har jan hai har raakhai ka(n)Th jan dhaare ||
882.e: The Lord is close to His humble servant, and His humble servant is close to the Lord; He keeps His humble servant clasped to His Heart.

882.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੮॥
882.t: naanak pitaa maataa hai har prabh ham baarik har pratipaare ||4||6||18||
882.e: O Nanak, the Lord God is our father and mother. I am His child; the Lord cherishes me. ||4||6||18||

882.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧
882.t: raag raamakalee mahalaa panjavaa ghar pehilaa
882.e: Raag Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla, First House:

882.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
882.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
882.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

882.g: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਦੀਨ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਣੁ ਅਵਗਣੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਹੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
882.t: kirapaa karahu dheen ke dhaate meraa gun avagan na beechaarahu koiee ||
882.e: Have mercy on me, O Generous Giver, Lord of the meek; please do not consider my merits and demerits.

882.g: ਮਾਟੀ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਧੋਪੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮਾਣਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਏਹੀ ॥੧॥
882.t: maaTee kaa kiaa dhopai suaamee maanas kee gat ehee ||1||
882.e: How can dust be washed? O my Lord and Master, such is the state of mankind. ||1||

882.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
882.t: mere man satigur sev sukh hoiee ||
882.e: O my mind, serve the True Guru, and be at peace.

882.g: ਜੋ ਇਛਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
882.t: jo ichhahu soiee fal paavahu fir dhookh na viaapai koiee ||1|| rahaau ||
882.e: Whatever you desire, you shall receive that reward, and you shall not be afflicted by pain any longer. ||1||Pause||

882.g: ਕਾਚੇ ਭਾਡੇ ਸਾਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
882.t: kaache bhaadde saaj nivaaje a(n)tar jot samaiee ||
882.e: He creates and adorns the earthen vessels; He infuses His Light within them.

882.g: ਜੈਸਾ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਹਮ ਤੈਸੀ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
882.t: jaisaa likhat likhiaa dhur karatai ham taisee kirat kamaiee ||2||
882.e: As is the destiny pre-ordained by the Creator, so are the deeds we do. ||2||

882.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਥਾਪਿ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਏਹੋ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
882.t: man tan thaap keeaa sabh apanaa eho aavan jaanaa ||
882.e: He believes the mind and body are all his own; this is the cause of his coming and going.

882.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਸੋ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਅੰਧੁ ਲਪਟਾਣਾ ॥੩॥
882.t: jin dheeaa so chit na aavai moh a(n)dh lapaTaanaa ||3||
882.e: He does not think of the One who gave him these; he is blind, entangled in emotional attachment. ||3||

883.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
883.t: jin keeaa soiee prabh jaanai har kaa mahal apaaraa ||
883.e: One who knows that God created him, reaches the Incomparable Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

883.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
883.t: bhagat karee har ke gun gaavaa naanak dhaas tumaaraa ||4||1||
883.e: Worshipping the Lord, I sing His Glorious Praises. Nanak is Your slave. ||4||1||

883.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
883.t: raamakalee mahalaa panjavaa ||
883.e: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:

883.g: ਪਵਹੁ ਚਰਣਾ ਤਲਿ ਊਪਰਿ ਆਵਹੁ ਐਸੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ॥
883.t: pavahu charanaa tal uoopar aavahu aaisee sev kamaavahu ||
883.e: Place yourself beneath all men's feet, and you will be uplifted; serve Him in this way.

883.g: ਆਪਸ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਭ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਤਉ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
883.t: aapas te uoopar sabh jaanahu tau dharageh sukh paavahu ||1||
883.e: Know that all are above you, and you shall find peace in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

883.g: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਐਸੀ ਕਥਹੁ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥ ਸੁਰ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਖਿਨੁ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
883.t: sa(n)tahu aaisee kathahu kahaanee || sur pavitr nar dhev pavitraa khin bolahu gurmukh baanee ||1|| rahaau ||
883.e: O Saints, speak that speech which purifies the gods and sanctifies the divine beings. As Gurmukh, chant the Word of His Bani, even for an instant. ||1||Pause||

883.g: ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸਹੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਕਹਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
883.t: parapa(n)ch chhodd sahaj ghar baisahu jhooThaa kahahu na koiee ||
883.e: Renounce your fraudulent plans, and dwell in the celestial palace; do not call anyone else false.

883.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਨਵੈ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਤਤੁ ਬਿਲੋਈ ॥੨॥
883.t: satigur milahu navai nidh paavahu in bidh tat biloiee ||2||
883.e: Meeting with the True Guru, you shall receive the nine treasures; in this way, you shall find the essence of reality. ||2||

883.g: ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
883.t: bharam chukaavahu gurmukh liv laavahu aatam cheenahu bhaiee ||
883.e: Eradicate doubt, and as Gurmukh, enshrine love for the Lord; understand your own soul, O Siblings of Destiny.

883.g: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਾਜਰੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੁਰਾਈ ॥੩॥
883.t: nikaT kar jaanahu sadhaa prabh haajar kis siau karahu buraiee ||3||
883.e: Know that God is near at hand, and ever-present. How could you try to hurt anyone else? ||3||

883.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
883.t: satigur miliaai maarag mukataa sahaje mile suaamee ||
883.e: Meeting with the True Guru, your path shall be clear, and you shall easily meet your Lord and Master.

883.g: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜਿਨੀ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
883.t: dhan dhan se jan jinee kal meh har paiaa jan naanak sadh kurabaanee ||4||2||
883.e: Blessed, blessed are those humble beings, who, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, find the Lord. Nanak is forever a sacrifice to them. ||4||2||

883.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
883.t: raamakalee mahalaa panjavaa ||
883.e: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:

883.g: ਆਵਤ ਹਰਖ ਨ ਜਾਵਤ ਦੂਖਾ ਨਹ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮਨ ਰੋਗਨੀ ॥
883.t: aavat harakh na jaavat dhookhaa neh biaapai man roganee ||
883.e: Coming does not please me, and going does not bring me pain, and so my mind is not afflicted by disease.

883.g: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਉ ਉਤਰੀ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਓਗਨੀ ॥੧॥
883.t: sadhaa ana(n)dh gur pooraa paiaa tau utaree sagal bioganee ||1||
883.e: I am in bliss forever, for I have found the Perfect Guru; my separation from the Lord is totally ended. ||1||

883.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਹੈ ਮਨੁ ਜੋਗਨੀ ॥
883.t: eeh bidh hai man joganee ||
883.e: This is how I have joined my mind to the Lord.

883.g: ਮੋਹੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਲੋਗੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
883.t: moh sog rog log na biaapai teh har har har ras bhoganee ||1|| rahaau ||
883.e: Attachment, sorrow, disease and public opinion do not affect me, and so, I enjoy the subtle essence of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

883.g: ਸੁਰਗ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਮਿਰਤ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਪਇਆਲ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਅਲੋਗਨੀ ॥
883.t: surag pavitraa mirat pavitraa piaal pavitr aloganee ||
883.e: I am pure in the heavenly realm, pure on this earth, and pure in the nether regions of the underworld. I remain apart from the people of the world.

883.g: ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਭੁੰਚੈ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨੀ ॥੨॥
883.t: aagiaakaaree sadhaa sukh bhu(n)chai jat kat pekhau har gunee ||2||
883.e: Obedient to the Lord, I enjoy peace forever; wherever I look, I see the Lord of glorious virtues. ||2||

883.g: ਨਹ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਜਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਵਨਾ ਤਹ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੇਦਨੀ ॥
883.t: neh siv sakatee jal nahee pavanaa teh akaar nahee medhanee ||
883.e: There is no Shiva or Shakti, no energy or matter, no water or wind, no world of form there,

883.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜੋਗ ਕਾ ਤਹਾ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ਜਹ ਅਵਿਗਤ ਨਾਥੁ ਅਗਮ ਧਨੀ ॥੩॥
883.t: satigur jog kaa tahaa nivaasaa jeh avigat naath agam dhanee ||3||
883.e: where the True Guru, the Yogi, dwells, where the Imperishable Lord God, the Unapproachable Master abides. ||3||

883.g: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਗਨੀ ॥
883.t: tan man har kaa dhan sabh har kaa har ke gun hau kiaa ganee ||
883.e: Body and mind belong to the Lord; all wealth belongs to the Lord; what glorious virtues of the Lord can I describe?

883.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਈ ਹੈ ਅੰਭੈ ਅੰਭੁ ਮਿਲੋਗਨੀ ॥੪॥੩॥
883.t: kahu naanak ham tum gur khoiee hai a(n)bhai a(n)bh miloganee ||4||3||
883.e: Says Nanak, the Guru has destroyed my sense of 'mine and yours'. Like water with water, I am blended with God. ||4||3||

883.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
883.t: raamakalee mahalaa panjavaa ||
883.e: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:

883.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਰਹਤ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
883.t: trai gun rahat rahai niraaree saadhik sidh na jaanai ||
883.e: It is beyond the three qualities; it remains untouched. The seekers and Siddhas do not know it.

883.g: ਰਤਨ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੰਪੂਰਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਖਜਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
883.t: ratan koThaRee a(n)mirat sa(n)pooran satigur kai khajaanai ||1||
883.e: There is a chamber filled with jewels, overflowing with Ambrosial Nectar, in the Guru's Treasury. ||1||

883.g: ਅਚਰਜੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
883.t: acharaj kichh kahan na jaiee ||
883.e: This thing is wonderful and amazing! It cannot be described.

883.g: ਬਸਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
883.t: basat agochar bhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
883.e: It is an unfathomable object, O Siblings of Destiny! ||1||Pause||

883.g: ਮੋਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗਾ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
883.t: mol naahee kachh karanai jogaa kiaa ko kahai sunaavai ||
883.e: Its value cannot be estimated at all; what can anyone say about it?

883.g: ਕਥਨ ਕਹਣ ਕਉ ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੋ ਪੇਖੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਣਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
883.t: kathan kahan kau sojhee naahee jo pekhai tis ban aavai ||2||
883.e: By speaking and describing it, it cannot be understood; only one who sees it realizes it. ||2||

883.g: ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਬੇਚਾਰਾ ॥
883.t: soiee jaanai karanaihaaraa keetaa kiaa bechaaraa ||
883.e: Only the Creator Lord knows it; what can any poor creature do?

883.g: ਆਪਣੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਪੂਰ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
883.t: aapanee gat mit aape jaanai har aape poor bha(n)ddaaraa ||3||
883.e: Only He Himself knows His own state and extent. The Lord Himself is the treasure overflowing. ||3||

883.g: ਐਸਾ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਈ ॥
883.t: aaisaa ras a(n)mrit man chaakhiaa tirapat rahe aaghaiee ||
883.e: Tasting such Ambrosial Nectar, the mind remains satisfied and satiated.

883.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
883.t: kahu naanak meree aasaa pooree satigur kee saranaiee ||4||4||
883.e: Says Nanak, my hopes are fulfilled; I have found the Guru's Sanctuary. ||4||4||

884.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
884.t: raamakalee mahalaa panjavaa ||
884.e: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:

884.g: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਬੈਰੀ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਾਧੇ ॥
884.t: a(n)geekaar keeaa prabh apanai bairee sagale saadhe ||
884.e: God has made me His own, and vanquished all my enemies.

884.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਬੈਰੀ ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਲੂਟਿਆ ਤੇ ਬੈਰੀ ਲੈ ਬਾਧੇ ॥੧॥
884.t: jin bairee hai ih jag looTiaa te bairee lai baadhe ||1||
884.e: Those enemies who have plundered this world, have all been placed in bondage. ||1||

884.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
884.t: satigur paramesar meraa ||
884.e: The True Guru is my Transcendent Lord.

884.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਰਾਜ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਮਾਣੀ ਨਾਉ ਜਪੀ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
884.t: anik raaj bhog ras maanee naau japee bharavaasaa teraa ||1|| rahaau ||
884.e: I enjoy countless pleasures of power and tasty delights, chanting Your Name, and placing my faith in You. ||1||Pause||

884.g: ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਸਿ ਦੂਜੀ ਬਾਤਾ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਰਖਵਾਰਾ ॥
884.t: cheet na aavas dhoojee baataa sir uoopar rakhavaaraa ||
884.e: I do not think of any other at all. The Lord is my protector, above my head.

884.g: ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਰਹਤ ਹੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਇਕ ਨਾਮ ਕੈ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
884.t: beparavaahu rahat hai suaamee ik naam kai aadhaaraa ||2||
884.e: I am carefree and independent, when I have the Support of Your Name, O my Lord and Master. ||2||

884.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਊਨ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
884.t: pooran hoi milio sukhadhaiee uoon na kaiee baataa ||
884.e: I have become perfect, meeting with the Giver of peace, and now, I lack nothing at all.

884.g: ਤਤੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
884.t: tat saar param padh paiaa chhodd na katahoo jaataa ||3||
884.e: I have obtained the essence of excellence, the supreme status; I shall not forsake it to go anywhere else. ||3||

884.g: ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਜੈਸਾ ਤੂ ਹੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
884.t: baran na saakau jaisaa too hai saache alakh apaaraa ||
884.e: I cannot describe how You are, O True Lord, unseen, infinite,

884.g: ਅਤੁਲ ਅਥਾਹ ਅਡੋਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
884.t: atul athaeh addol suaamee naanak khasam hamaaraa ||4||5||
884.e: immeasurable, unfathomable and unmoving Lord. O Nanak, He is my Lord and Master. ||4||5||

884.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
884.t: raamakalee mahalaa panjavaa ||
884.e: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:

884.g: ਤੂ ਦਾਨਾ ਤੂ ਅਬਿਚਲੁ ਤੂਹੀ ਤੂ ਜਾਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਾਤੀ ॥
884.t: too dhaanaa too abichal toohee too jaat meree paatee ||
884.e: You are wise; You are eternal and unchanging. You are my social class and honor.

884.g: ਤੂ ਅਡੋਲੁ ਕਦੇ ਡੋਲਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਾ ਹਮ ਕੈਸੀ ਤਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
884.t: too addol kadhe ddoleh naahee taa ham kaisee taatee ||1||
884.e: You are unmoving - You never move at all. How can I be worried? ||1||

884.g: ਏਕੈ ਏਕੈ ਏਕ ਤੂਹੀ ॥
884.t: ekai ekai ek toohee ||
884.e: You alone are the One and only Lord;

884.g: ਏਕੈ ਏਕੈ ਤੂ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
884.t: ekai ekai too raiaa ||
884.e: You alone are the king.

884.g: ਤਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
884.t: tau kirapaa te sukh paiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
884.e: By Your Grace, I have found peace. ||1||Pause||

884.g: ਤੂ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹਮ ਹੰਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਤੁਮ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਣਕ ਲਾਲਾ ॥
884.t: too saagar ham ha(n)s tumaare tum meh maanak laalaa ||
884.e: You are the ocean, and I am Your swan; the pearls and rubies are in You.

884.g: ਤੁਮ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਸੰਕ ਨ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਹਮ ਭੁੰਚਹ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
884.t: tum dhevahu til sa(n)k na maanahu ham bhu(n)cheh sadhaa nihaalaa ||2||
884.e: You give, and You do not hesitate for an instant; I receive, forever enraptured. ||2||

884.g: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੁਮ ਪਿਤਾ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਤੁਮ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਖੀਰਾ ॥
884.t: ham baarik tum pitaa hamaare tum mukh dhevahu kheeraa ||
884.e: I am Your child, and You are my father; You place the milk in my mouth.

884.g: ਹਮ ਖੇਲਹ ਸਭਿ ਲਾਡ ਲਡਾਵਹ ਤੁਮ ਸਦ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥੩॥
884.t: ham kheleh sabh laadd laddaaveh tum sadh gunee gaheeraa ||3||
884.e: I play with You, and You caress me in every way. You are forever the ocean of excellence. ||3||

884.g: ਤੁਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਸੰਪੂਰਨ ਹਮ ਭੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਘਾਏ ॥
884.t: tum pooran poor rahe sa(n)pooran ham bhee sa(n)g aghaae ||
884.e: You are perfect, perfectly all-pervading; I am fulfilled with You as well.

884.g: ਮਿਲਤ ਮਿਲਤ ਮਿਲਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੪॥੬॥
884.t: milat milat milat mil rahiaa naanak kahan na jaae ||4||6||
884.e: I am merged, merged, merged and remain merged; O Nanak, I cannot describe it! ||4||6||

884.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
884.t: raamakalee mahalaa panjavaa ||
884.e: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:

884.g: ਕਰ ਕਰਿ ਤਾਲ ਪਖਾਵਜੁ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਮਾਥੈ ਵਜਹਿ ਰਬਾਬਾ ॥
884.t: kar kar taal pakhaavaj nainahu maathai vajeh rabaabaa ||
884.e: Make your hands the cymbals, your eyes the tambourines, and your forehead the guitar you play.

884.g: ਕਰਨਹੁ ਮਧੁ ਬਾਸੁਰੀ ਬਾਜੈ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਧੁਨਿ ਆਗਾਜਾ ॥
884.t: karanahu madh baasuree baajai jihavaa dhun aagaajaa ||
884.e: Let the sweet flute music resound in your ears, and with your tongue, vibrate this song.

884.g: ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਨਾਚੈ ਆਣੇ ਘੂਘਰ ਸਾਜਾ ॥੧॥
884.t: nirat kare kar manooaa naachai aane ghooghar saajaa ||1||
884.e: Move your mind like the rhythmic hand-motions; do the dance, and shake your ankle bracelets. ||1||

884.g: ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਨਿਰਤਿਕਾਰੀ ॥
884.t: raam ko niratikaaree ||
884.e: This is the rhythmic dance of the Lord.

884.g: ਪੇਖੈ ਪੇਖਨਹਾਰੁ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਜੇਤਾ ਸਾਜੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
884.t: pekhai pekhanahaar dhiaalaa jetaa saaj seegaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
884.e: The Merciful Audience, the Lord, sees all your make-up and decorations. ||1||Pause||

884.g: ਆਖਾਰ ਮੰਡਲੀ ਧਰਣਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਊਪਰਿ ਗਗਨੁ ਚੰਦੋਆ ॥
884.t: aakhaar ma(n)ddalee dharan sabaiee uoopar gagan cha(n)dhoaa ||
884.e: The whole earth is the stage, with the canopy of the sky overhead.

884.g: ਪਵਨੁ ਵਿਚੋਲਾ ਕਰਤ ਇਕੇਲਾ ਜਲ ਤੇ ਓਪਤਿ ਹੋਆ ॥
884.t: pavan vicholaa karat ikelaa jal te opat hoaa ||
884.e: The wind is the director; people are born of water.

884.g: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੁਤਰਾ ਕੀਨਾ ਕਿਰਤ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਆ ॥੨॥
884.t: pa(n)ch tat kar putaraa keenaa kirat milaavaa hoaa ||2||
884.e: From the five elements, the puppet was created with its actions. ||2||

884.g: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਜਰੇ ਚਰਾਗਾ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
884.t: cha(n)dh sooraj dhui jare charaagaa chahu ku(n)T bheetar raakhe ||
884.e: The sun and the moon are the two lamps which shine, with the four corners of the world placed between them.

884.g: ਦਸ ਪਾਤਉ ਪੰਚ ਸੰਗੀਤਾ ਏਕੈ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਾਥੇ ॥
884.t: dhas paatau pa(n)ch sa(n)geetaa ekai bheetar saathe ||
884.e: The ten senses are the dancing girls, and the five passions are the chorus; they sit together within the one body.

884.g: ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਹੋਇ ਭਾਵ ਦਿਖਾਵਹਿ ਸਭਹੁ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ਭਾਖੇ ॥੩॥
884.t: bhi(n)n bhi(n)n hoi bhaav dhikhaaveh sabhahu niraaree bhaakhe ||3||
884.e: They all put on their own shows, and speak in different languages. ||3||

884.g: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਾਜੈ ਤੂਰਾ ॥
884.t: ghar ghar nirat hovai dhin raatee ghaT ghaT vaajai tooraa ||
884.e: In each and every home there is dancing, day and night; in each and every home, the bugles blow.

884.g: ਏਕਿ ਨਚਾਵਹਿ ਏਕਿ ਭਵਾਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਆਇ ਜਾਇ ਹੋਇ ਧੂਰਾ ॥
884.t: ek nachaaveh ek bhavaaveh ik aai jai hoi dhooraa ||
884.e: Some are made to dance, and some are whirled around; some come and some go, and some are reduced to dust.

884.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਨਾਚੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੪॥੭॥
884.t: kahu naanak so bahur na naachai jis gur bheTai pooraa ||4||7||
884.e: Says Nanak, one who meets with the True Guru, does not have to dance the dance of reincarnation again. ||4||7||

885.e: Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:

885.g: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਏਕ ਧੁਨਿ ਏਕੈ ਏਕੈ ਰਾਗੁ ਅਲਾਪੈ ॥
885.t: oa(n)kaar ek dhun ekai ekai raag alaapai ||
885.e: He sings the song of the One Universal Creator; he sings the tune of the One Lord.

885.g: ਏਕਾ ਦੇਸੀ ਏਕੁ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਏਕੋ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
885.t: ekaa dhesee ek dhikhaavai eko rahiaa biaapai ||
885.e: He lives in the land of the One Lord, shows the way to the One Lord, and remains attuned to the One Lord.

885.g: ਏਕਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਏਕਾ ਹੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਏਕੋ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੧॥
885.t: ekaa surat ekaa hee sevaa eko gur te jaapai ||1||
885.e: He centers his consciousness on the One Lord, and serves only the One Lord, who is known through the Guru. ||1||
Blessed and good is such a kirtanee, who sings such Praises.
He sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord,

885.g: ਛੋਡਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਧੰਧ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
885.t: chhodd maiaa ke dha(n)dh suaau ||1|| rahaau ||
885.e: and renounces the entanglements and pursuits of Maya. ||1||Pause||

885.g: ਪੰਚ ਬਜਿਤ੍ਰ ਕਰੇ ਸੰਤੋਖਾ ਸਾਤ ਸੁਰਾ ਲੈ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
885.t: pa(n)ch bajitr kare sa(n)tokhaa saat suraa lai chaalai ||
885.e: He makes the five virtues, like contentment, his musical instruments, and plays the seven notes of the love of the Lord.

885.g: ਬਾਜਾ ਮਾਣੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਤਜਿ ਤਾਨਾ ਪਾਉ ਨ ਬੀਗਾ ਘਾਲੈ ॥
885.t: baajaa maan taan taj taanaa paau na beegaa ghaalai ||
885.e: The notes he plays are the renunciation of pride and power; his feet keep the beat on the straight path.

885.g: ਫੇਰੀ ਫੇਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੰਧਿ ਪਾਲੈ ॥੨॥
885.t: feree fer na hovai kab hee ek sabadh ba(n)dh paalai ||2||
885.e: He does not enter the cycle of reincarnation ever again; he keeps the One Word of the Shabad tied to the hem of his robe. ||2||
To play like Naarad, is to know that the Lord is ever-present.
The tinkling of the ankle bells is the shedding of sorrows and worries.
The dramatic gestures of acting are celestial bliss.
Such a dancer is not reincarnated again. ||3||

885.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਅਪਨੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ॥ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧਿ ਏਹੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
885.t: je ko apane Thaakur bhaavai || koT madh eh keeratan gaavai ||
885.e: If anyone, out of millions of people, becomes pleasing to his Lord and Master, he sings the Lord's Praises in this way.
I have taken the Support of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
Says Nanak, the Kirtan of the One Lord's Praises are sung there. ||4||8||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:

885.g: ਕੋਈ ਬੋਲੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਕੋਈ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
885.t: koiee bolai raam raam koiee khudhai ||
885.e: Some call Him, 'Raam, Raam', and some call Him, 'Khudaa-i'.
Some serve Him as 'Gusain', others as 'Allaah'. ||1||
He is the Cause of causes, the Generous Lord.
He showers His Grace and Mercy upon us. ||1||Pause||

885.g: ਕੋਈ ਨਾਵੈ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਕੋਈ ਹਜ ਜਾਇ ॥
885.t: koiee naavai teerath koiee haj jai ||
885.e: Some bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and some make the pilgrimage to Mecca.|

885.g: ਕੋਈ ਕਰੈ ਪੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ਸਿਰੁ ਨਿਵਾਇ ॥੨॥
885.t: koiee karai poojaa koiee sir nivai ||2||
885.e: Some perform devotional worship services, and some bow their heads in prayer. ||2||
Some read the Vedas, and some the Koran.
Some wear blue robes, and some wear white. ||3||

885.g: ਕੋਈ ਕਹੈ ਤੁਰਕੁ ਕੋਈ ਕਹੈ ਹਿੰਦੂ ॥
885.t: koiee kahai turak koiee kahai hi(n)dhoo ||
885.e: Some call themselves Muslim, and some call themselves Hindu.
Some yearn for paradise, and others long for heaven. ||4||
Says Nanak, one who realizes the Hukam of God's Will,

885.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਭੇਦੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੫॥੯॥
885.t: prabh saahib kaa tin bhedh jaataa ||5||9||
885.e: knows the secrets of his Lord and Master. ||5||9||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:
The wind (the final breath) merges into the wind.
The light of the soul blends into the Light of the Creator.
The body's dust becomes one with the earthly dust.
What support is there for the one who is lamenting? ||1||
Who has died? O, who has died?

885.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਉ ਚਲਤੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
885.t: braham giaanee mil karahu beechaaraa ih tau chalat bhiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
885.e: O God-realized beings, meet together and consider this. What a wondrous thing has happened! ||1||Pause||
No one knows what happens after death.
The one who is lamenting will also arise and depart.
Mortal beings are bound by the bonds of doubt and attachment.
When life becomes a dream, the blind man (in the attachment of the illusionary world of desires) babbles and grieves in vain. ||2||
The Creator Lord created this creation.
It comes and goes, subject to the Will of the Infinite Lord.

885.g: ਨਹ ਕੋ ਮੂਆ ਨ ਮਰਣੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
885.t: neh ko mooaa na maranai jog ||
885.e: No one dies; no one is capable of dying.
The soul does not perish; it is imperishable. ||3||

885.g: ਜੋ ਇਹੁ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਸੋ ਇਹੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
885.t: jo ih jaanahu so ih naeh ||
885.e: What one perceives this(live soul) to be, it actually is not
I am a sacrifice to the one who knows this.
Says Nanak, the Guru has dispelled my doubt.

885.g: ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
885.t: naa koiee marai na aavai jaiaa ||4||10||
885.e: No one dies; no one comes or goes. ||4||10||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:
Meditate on the Lord of the Universe, the Beloved Lord of the World.

885.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਤੂ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਖਾਈ ਮਹਾ ਕਾਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
885.t: raam naam simar too jeeveh fir na khaiee mahaa kaal ||1|| rahaau ||
885.e: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord's Name, you shall live, and the Great Death shall not consume you ever again. ||1||Pause||

885.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
885.t: koT janam bhram bhram bhram aaio ||
885.e: Through millions of incarnations, you have come, wandering, wandering, wandering.

886.e: By the highest destiny, you found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||
Without the Perfect Guru, no one is saved.
This is what Baba Nanak says, after deep reflection. ||2||11||

886.t: raag raamakalee mahalaa panjavaa ghar doojaa
886.e: Raag Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The four Vedas proclaim it, but you don't believe them.
The six Shaastras also say one thing.
The eighteen Puraanas all speak of the One God.

886.g: ਤਾ ਭੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਲਹਿਆ ॥੧॥
886.t: taa bhee jogee bhedh na lahiaa ||1||
886.e: Even so, Yogi, you do not understand this mystery. ||1||
The celestial harp plays the incomparable melody,
but in your intoxication, you do not hear it, O Yogi. ||1||Pause||
In the first age, the Golden Age, the village of truth was inhabited.
In the Silver Age of Traytaa Yuga, things began to decline.
In the Brass Age of Dwaapur Yuga, half of it was gone.
Now, only one leg of Truth remains, and the One Lord is revealed. ||2||
The beads are strung upon the one thread.

886.g: ਗਾਠੀ ਭਿਨਿ ਭਿਨਿ ਭਿਨਿ ਭਿਨਿ ਤਣੀਏ ॥
886.t: gaaThee bhin bhin bhin bhin tane'ee ||
886.e: By means of many, various, diverse knots, they are tied, and kept separate on the string.
The beads of the mala are lovingly chanted upon in many ways.
When the thread is pulled out, the beads come together in one place. ||3||

886.g: ਚਹੁ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੈ ਮਟੁ ਹੈ ਕੀਆ ॥
886.t: chahu meh ekai maT hai keeaa ||
886.e: Throughout the four ages, the One Lord made the body His temple.
It is a treacherous place, with several windows.
Searching and searching, one comes to the Lord's door.

886.g: ਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋਗੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
886.t: taa naanak jogee mahal ghar paiaa ||4||
886.e: Then, O Nanak, the Yogi attains a home in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||4||
Thus, the celestial harp plays the incomparable melody;

886.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਮੀਠੀ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੧੨॥
886.t: sun jogee kai man meeThee laagai ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||1||12||
886.e: hearing it, the Yogi's mind finds it sweet. ||1||Second Pause||1||12||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:
The body is a patch-work of threads.
The muscles are stitched together with the needles of the bones.
The Lord has erected a pillar of water.
O Yogi, why are you so proud? ||1||
Meditate on your Lord Master, day and night.
The patched coat of the body shall last for only a few days. ||1||Pause||
Smearing ashes on your body, you sit in a deep meditative trance.
You wear the ear-rings of 'mine and yours'.
You beg for bread, but you are not satisfied.

886.g: ਨਾਥੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਲਾਜ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
886.t: naath chhodd jaacheh laaj na aavai ||2||
886.e: Abandoning your Lord Master, you beg from others; you should feel ashamed. ||2||
Your consciousness is restless, Yogi, as you sit in your Yogic postures.
You blow your horn, but still feel sad.

886.g: ਗੁਰ ਗੋਰਖ ਕੀ ਤੈ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
886.t: gur gorakh kee tai boojh na paiee ||
886.e: You do not understand Gorakh, your guru.
Again and again, Yogi, you come and go. ||3||
He, unto whom the Master shows Mercy
unto Him, the Guru, the Lord of the World, I offer my prayer.
One who has the Name as his patched coat, and the Name as his robe,
O servant Nanak, such a Yogi is steady and stable. ||4||
One who meditates on the Master in this way, night and day,

886.g: ਹੁਣਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਸਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੨॥੧੩॥
886.t: hun paiaa gur gosaiee ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||2||13||
886.e: finds the Guru, the Lord of the World, in this life. ||1||Second Pause||2||13||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:
He is the Creator, the Cause of causes;
I do not see any other at all.
My Lord and Master is wise and all-knowing.
Meeting with the Gurmukh, I enjoy His Love. ||1||
Such is the sweet, subtle essence of the Lord.
How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, taste it. ||1||Pause||
The Light of the Ambrosial Name of the Lord is immaculate and pure.

887.e: Drinking it in, one becomes immortal and free of desire.
The body and mind are cooled and soothed, and the fire is extinguished.
Such a being is the embodiment of bliss, famous throughout the world. ||2||

887.g: ਕਿਆ ਦੇਵਉ ਜਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
887.t: kiaa dhevau jaa sabh kichh teraa ||
887.e: What can I offer You, Lord? Everything belongs to You.
I am forever a sacrifice to You, hundreds of thousands of times.

887.g: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦੇ ਸਾਜਿਆ ॥
887.t: tan man jeeau pi(n)dd dhe saajiaa ||
887.e: You blessed me, and fashioned my body, mind and soul.
By Guru's Grace, this lowly being was exalted. ||3||
Opening the door, You summoned me to the Mansion of Your Presence.
As You are, so You have revealed Yourself to me.
Says Nanak, the screen is totally torn away;

887.g: ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਵੂਠਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੪॥
887.t: hau teraa too mai man vooThaa ||4||3||14||
887.e: I am Yours, and You are enshrined within my mind. ||4||3||14||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:
He has linked His servant to His service.
The Divine Guru has poured the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, into his mouth.
He has subdued all his anxiety.

887.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
887.t: tis gur kau hau sadh balihaaree ||1||
887.e: I am forever a sacrifice to that Guru. ||1||
The True Guru has perfectly resolved my affairs.
The True Guru vibrates the unstruck melody of the sound current. ||1||Pause||
His Glory is profound and unfathomable.
One whom He blesses with patience becomes blissful.
One whose bonds are shattered by the Sovereign Lord

887.g: ਸੋ ਨਰੁ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
887.t: so nar bahur na jonee pai ||2||
887.e: is not cast into the womb of reincarnation again. ||2||
One who is illuminated by the Lord's radiance within,
is not touched by pain and sorrow.
He holds in his robe the gems and jewels.

887.g: ਸਗਲ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਓਹੁ ਜਨੁ ਲੈ ਤਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
887.t: sagal kuTa(n)b oh jan lai tariaa ||3||
887.e: That humble being is saved, along with all his generations. ||3||

887.g: ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
887.t: naa kichh bharam na dhubidhaa dhoojaa ||
887.e: He has no doubt, double-mindedness or duality at all.
He worships and adores the One Immaculate Lord alone.
Wherever I look, I see the Merciful Lord.
Says Nanak, I have found God, the source of nectar. ||4||4||15||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:
My self-conceit has been eliminated from my body.
The Will of God is dear to me.

887.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
887.t: jo kichh karai su man merai meeThaa ||
887.e: Whatever He does, seems sweet to my mind.
And then, these eyes behold the wondrous Lord. ||1||

887.g: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਜਾਨੀ ਰੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਗਈ ਬਲਾਇ ॥
887.t: ab moh jaanee re meree giee balai ||
887.e: Now, I have become wise and my demons are gone.

887.g: ਬੁਝਿ ਗਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਮਮਤਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਲੀਓ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
887.t: bujh giee tirasan nivaaree mamataa gur poorai leeo samajhai ||1|| rahaau ||
887.e: My thirst is quenched, and my attachment is dispelled. The Perfect Guru has instructed me. ||1||Pause||
In His Mercy, the Guru has kept me under His protection.
The Guru has attached me to the Lord's Feet.
When the mind is totally held in check,
one sees the Guru and the Supreme Lord God as one and the same. ||2||

887.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕੀਨੋ ਹਮ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ॥
887.t: jo jo keeno ham tis ke dhaas ||
887.e: Whoever You have created, I am his slave.
My God dwells in all.
I have no enemies, no adversaries.
I walk arm in arm, like brothers, with all. ||3||

887.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਏ ਸੂਖਾ ॥
887.t: jaa kau gur har dhe'ee sookhaa ||
887.e: One whom the Guru, the Lord, blesses with peace,

887.g: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਲਾਗਹਿ ਦੂਖਾ ॥
887.t: taa kau bahur na laageh dhookhaa ||
887.e: does not suffer in pain any longer.
He Himself cherishes all.
Nanak is imbued with the love of the Lord of the World. ||4||5||16||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:
You read the scriptures, and the commentaries,
but the Perfect Lord does not dwell in your heart.
You preach to others to have faith,
but you do not practice what you preach. ||1||
O Pandit, O religious scholar, contemplate the Vedas.

887.g: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
887.t: man kaa karodh nivaar pa(n)ddit ||1|| rahaau ||
887.e: Eradicate anger from your mind, O Pandit. ||1||Pause||
You place your stone god before yourself,

888.e: but your mind wanders in the ten directions.
You apply a ceremonial tilak mark to its forehead, and fall at its feet.
You try to appease the people, and act blindly. ||2||
You perform the six religious rituals, and sit wearing your loin-cloth.
In the homes of the wealthy, you read the prayer book.
You chant on your mala, and beg for money.

888.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਤਰਿਓ ਮੀਤ ॥੩॥
888.t: eeh bidh koi na tario meet ||3||
888.e: No one has ever been saved in this way, friend. ||3||
He alone is a Pandit, who lives the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

888.g: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਕੀ ਓਸੁ ਉਤਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
888.t: trai gun kee os utaree mai ||
888.e: Maya, of the three qualities, leaves him.
The four Vedas are completely contained within the Lord's Name.
Nanak seeks His Sanctuary. ||4||6||17||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:
Millions of troubles do not come near him;

888.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਹੈ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਚੇਰਿ ॥
888.t: anik maiaa hai taa kee cher ||
888.e: the many manifestations of Maya are his hand-maidens;
countless sins are his water-carriers;
he is blessed with the Grace of the Creator Lord. ||1||
One who has the Lord God as his help and support

888.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਉਆ ਕੈ ਸਰੰਜਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
888.t: anik jatan uaa kai sara(n)jaam ||1|| rahaau ||
888.e: - all his efforts are fulfilled. ||1||Pause||
He is protected by the Creator Lord; what harm can anyone do to him?
Even an ant can conquer the whole world.

888.g: ਬੇਅੰਤ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੇਤਕ ਬਰਨ ॥
888.t: bea(n)t mahimaa taa kee ketak baran ||
888.e: His glory is endless; how can I describe it?

888.g: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ॥੨॥
888.t: bal bal jaieeaai taa ke charan ||2||
888.e: I am a sacrifice, a devoted sacrifice, to His feet. ||2||

888.g: ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਕੀਆ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
888.t: tin hee keeaa jap tap dhiaan ||
888.e: He alone performs worship, austerities and meditation;
he alone is a giver to various charities;
he alone is approved in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga,
whom the Lord Master blesses with honor. ||3||
Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I am enlightened.
I have found celestial peace, and my hopes are fulfilled.
The Perfect True Guru has blessed me with faith.
Nanak is the slave of His slaves. ||4||7||18||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:
Don't blame others, O people;
as you plant, so shall you harvest.
By your actions, you have bound yourself.
You come and go, entangled in Maya. ||1||
Such is the understanding of the Saintly people.

888.g: ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਇਆ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
888.t: paragaas bhiaa poore gur bachanee ||1|| rahaau ||
888.e: You shall be enlightened, through the Word of the Perfect Guru. ||1||Pause||
Body, wealth, spouse and ostentatious displays are false.
Horses and elephants will pass away.
Power, pleasures and beauty are all false.
Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, everything is reduced to dust. ||2||
The egotistical people are deluded by useless doubt.
Of all this expanse, nothing shall go along with you.
Through pleasure and pain, the body is growing old.
Doing these things, the faithless cynics are passing their lives. ||3||

888.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕਲਿ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
888.t: har kaa naam a(n)mrit kal maeh ||
888.e: The Name of the Lord is Ambrosial Nectar in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.
This treasure is obtained from the Holy.
O Nanak, whoever pleases the Guru,

888.g: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੯॥
888.t: ghaT ghaT ramieeaa tin hee ddeeThaa ||4||8||19||
888.e: the Lord of the Universe, beholds the Lord in each and every heart. ||4||8||19||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:
The Panch Shabad, the five primal sounds, echo the perfect sound current of the Naad.
The wondrous, amazing unstruck melody vibrates.
The Saintly people play there with the Lord.
They remain totally detached, absorbed in the Supreme Lord God. ||1||
It is the realm of celestial peace and bliss.

888.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਬੈਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਤਹ ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਨਹੀ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
888.t: saadhasa(n)g bais gun gaaveh teh rog sog nahee janam maran ||1|| rahaau ||
888.e: The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, sits and sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. There is no disease or sorrow there, no birth or death. ||1||Pause||
There, they meditate only on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
How rare are those who find this place of rest.
The love of God is their food, and the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise is their support.

889.e: They obtain a permanent seat in the infinite. ||2||

889.g: ਡਿਗਿ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ਕਤਹੂ ਨ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
889.t: ddig na ddolai katahoo na dhaavai ||
889.e: No one falls there, or wavers, or goes anywhere.

889.g: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕੋ ਇਹੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
889.t: gur prasaadh ko ih mahal paavai ||
889.e: By Guru's Grace, some find this mansion.

889.g: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਮੋਹ ਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਲ ॥
889.t: bhram bhai moh na maiaa jaal ||
889.e: They are not touched by doubt, fear, attachment or the traps of Maya.
They enter the deepest state of Samaadhi, through the kind mercy of God. ||3||
He has no end or limitation.
He Himself is unmanifest, and He Himself is manifest.

889.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਦੁ ॥
889.t: jaa kai a(n)tar har har suaadh ||
889.e: One who enjoys the taste of the Lord, Har, Har, deep within himself,
O Nanak, his wondrous state cannot be described. ||4||9||20||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:
Meeting with the Sangat, the Congregation, the Supreme Lord God has come into my consciousness.
In the Sangat, my mind has found contentment.
I touch my forehead to the feet of the Saints.
Countless times, I humbly bow to the Saints. ||1||
This mind is a sacrifice to the Saints;

889.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਖੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
889.t: jaa kee oT gahee sukh paiaa raakhe kirapaa dhaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
889.e: holding tight to their support, I have found peace, and in their mercy, they have protected me. ||1||Pause||
I wash the feet of the Saints, and drink in that water.
Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of the Saints' Darshan, I live.
My mind rests its hopes in the Saints.
The Saints are my immaculate wealth. ||2||
The Saints have covered my faults.

889.g: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਕੜਦਾ ॥
889.t: sa(n)t prasaadh moh kabahoo na kaRadhaa ||
889.e: By the Grace of the Saints, I am no longer tormented.
The Merciful Lord has blessed me with the Saints' Congregation.
The Compassionate Saints have become my help and support. ||3||
My consciousness, intellect and wisdom have been enlightened.
The Lord is profound, unfathomable, infinite, the treasure of virtue.
He cherishes all beings and creatures.
Nanak is enraptured, seeing the Saints. ||4||10||21||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:

889.g: ਤੇਰੈ ਕਾਜਿ ਨ ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
889.t: terai kaaj na girahu raaj maal ||
889.e: Your home, power and wealth will be of no use to you.
Your corrupt worldly entanglements will be of no use to you.
Know that all your dear friends are fake.

889.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਚਲੈ ॥੧॥
889.t: har har naam sa(n)g terai chalai ||1||
889.e: Only the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, will go along with you. ||1||

889.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਲੇ ਮੀਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਲਾਜ ਰਹੈ ॥
889.t: raam naam gun gai le meetaa har simarat teree laaj rahai ||
889.e: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name, O friend; remembering the Lord in meditation, your honor shall be saved.

889.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਜਮੁ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਕਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
889.t: har simarat jam kachh na kahai ||1|| rahaau ||
889.e: Remembering the Lord in meditation, the Messenger of Death will not touch you. ||1||Pause||
Without the Lord, all pursuits are useless.
Gold, silver and wealth are just dust.

889.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਜਾਪਿ ਮਨ ਸੁਖਾ ॥
889.t: gur kaa sabadh jaap man sukhaa ||
889.e: Chanting the Word of the Guru's Shabad, your mind shall be at peace.
Here and hereafter, your face shall be radiant and bright. ||2||
Even the greatest of the great worked and worked until they were exhausted.

889.g: ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਨ ਕੀਏ ਕਾਜ ਮਾਇਆ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
889.t: kin hee na ke'ee kaaj maiaa poore ||
889.e: None of them ever accomplished the tasks of Maya.

889.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਜਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
889.t: har har naam japai jan koi ||
889.e: Any humble being who chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,
will have all his hopes fulfilled. ||3||
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the anchor and support of the Lord's devotees.
The Saints are victorious in this priceless human life.
Whatever the Lord's Saint does, is approved and accepted.
Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to him. ||4||11||22||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:
You gather wealth by exploiting people.
It is of no use to you; it was meant for others.
You practice egotism, and act like a blind man.

889.g: ਜਮ ਕੀ ਜੇਵੜੀ ਤੂ ਆਗੈ ਬੰਧ ॥੧॥
889.t: jam kee jevaRee too aagai ba(n)dh ||1||
889.e: In the world hereafter, you shall be tied to the leash of the Messenger of Death. ||1||
Give up your envy of others, you fool!
You only live here for a night, you fool!

889.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਤੈ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਨਾ ॥
889.t: maiaa ke maate tai uTh chalanaa ||
889.e: You are intoxicated with Maya, but you must soon arise and depart.

889.g: ਰਾਚਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਤੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਪਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
889.t: raach rahio too sa(n)g supanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
889.e: You are totally involved in the dream. ||1||Pause||
In his childhood, the child is blind.
In the fullness of youth, he is involved in foul-smelling sins.

890.e: In the third stage of life, he gathers the wealth of Maya.
And when he grows old, he must leave all this; he departs regretting and repenting. ||2||
After a very long time, one obtains this precious human body, so difficult to obtain.
Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, it is reduced to dust.
Worse than a beast, a demon or an idiot,

890.g: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹ ਸਿਰੀ ॥੩॥
890.t: tiseh na boojhai jin eh siree ||3||
890.e: is that one who does not understand who created him. ||3||
Listen, O Creator Lord, Lord of the Universe, Lord of the World,
Merciful to the meek, forever compassionate
If You emancipate the human, then his bonds are broken.
O Nanak, the people of world are blind; please, Lord, forgive them, and unite them with Yourself. ||4||12||23||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:
Joining the elements together, the robe of the body is fashioned.
The ignorant fool is engrossed in it.
He cherishes it, and constantly takes care of it.
But at the very last moment, he must arise and depart. ||1||
Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, everything is false, O mortal.

890.g: ਗੋਵਿਦ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੂਠੁ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
890.t: govidh bhajan bin avar sa(n)g raate te sabh maiaa mooTh paraanee ||1|| rahaau ||
890.e: Those who do not vibrate and meditate on the Lord of the Universe, but instead are imbued with other things, - all those mortals are plundered by Maya. ||1||Pause||
Bathing at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, filth is not washed off.
Religious rituals are all just egotistical displays.
By pleasing and appeasing people, no one is saved.
Without the Naam, they shall depart weeping. ||2||

890.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਟੂਟਸਿ ਪਟਲ ॥
890.t: bin har naam na TooTas paTal ||
890.e: Without the Lord's Name, the screen is not torn away.
I have studied all the Shaastras and Simritees.

890.g: ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਜਪਾਏ ॥
890.t: so naam japai jis aap japaae ||
890.e: He alone chants the Naam, whom the Lord Himself inspires to chant.
He obtains all fruits and rewards, and merges in peace. ||3||
O Savior Lord, please save me!
All peace and comforts are in Your Hand, God.
Whatever you attach me to, to that I am attached, O my Lord and Master.
O Nanak, the Lord is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||4||13||24||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:

890.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
890.t: jo kichh karai soiee sukh jaanaa ||
890.e: Whatever He does makes me happy.
The ignorant mind is encouraged, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
Now, it does not waver at all; it has become stable and steady.
Receiving Truth, it is merged in the True Lord. ||1||
Pain is gone, and all illness is gone.

890.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਨੀ ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
890.t: prabh kee aagiaa man meh maanee mahaa purakh kaa sa(n)g bhiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
890.e: I have accepted the Will of God in my mind, associating with the Great Person, the Guru. ||1||Pause||
All is pure; all is immaculate.
Whatever exists is good.
Wherever He keeps me, that is the place of liberation for me.
Whatever He makes me chant, is His Name. ||2||

890.g: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਜਹ ਸਾਧ ਪਗ ਧਰਹਿ ॥
890.t: aThasaTh teerath jeh saadh pag dhareh ||
890.e: That is the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, where the Holy place their feet,
and that is heaven, where the Naam is chanted.
All bliss comes, when one obtains the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.

890.g: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣਾ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
890.t: raam gunaa nit nit har gaieeaai ||3||
890.e: I sing continuously, continually, the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||
The Lord Himself is pervading in each and every heart.
The glory of the Merciful Lord is radiant and manifest.
The shutters are opened, and doubts have run away.
Nanak has met with the Perfect Guru. ||4||14||25||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:
Millions of meditations and austerities rest in him,
along with wealth, wisdom, miraculous spiritual powers and angelic spiritual insight.
He enjoys the various shows and forms, pleasures and delicacies;
the Naam, the Name of the Lord, dwells within the heart of the Gurmukh. ||1||
Such is the glorious greatness of the Name of the Lord.
Its value cannot be described. ||1||Pause||
He alone is brave, patient and perfectly wise;

891.e: he is intuitively in Samaadhi, profound and unfathomable.

891.g: ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਕਾਮ ॥
891.t: sadhaa mukat taa ke poore kaam ||
891.e: He is liberated forever and all his affairs are perfectly resolved;

891.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥੨॥
891.t: jaa kai ridhai vasai har naam ||2||
891.e: the Lord's Name abides within his heart. ||2||
He is totally peaceful, blissful and healthy;
he looks upon all impartially, and is perfectly detached.

891.g: ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਡੋਲੈ ਕਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
891.t: aai na jai ddolai kat naahee ||
891.e: He does not come and go, and he never wavers;

891.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੩॥
891.t: jaa kai naam basai man maahee ||3||
891.e: the Naam abides in his mind. ||3||
God is Merciful to the meek; He is the Lord of the World, the Lord of the Universe.
The Gurmukh meditates on Him, and his worries are gone.
The Guru has blessed Nanak with the Naam;

891.g: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੨੬॥
891.t: sa(n)tan kee Tahal sa(n)t kaa kaam ||4||15||26||
891.e: he serves the Saints, and works for the Saints. ||4||15||26||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:
Sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and the Beej Mantra, the Seed Mantra.
Even the homeless find a home in the world hereafter.
Fall at the feet of the Perfect Guru;
you have slept for so many incarnations - wake up! ||1||
Chant the Chant of the Lord's Name, Har, Har.

891.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਾਸੈ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
891.t: gur kirapaa te hiradhai vaasai bhaujal paar paralaa ||1|| rahaau ||
891.e: By Guru's Grace, it shall be enshrined within your heart, and you shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||
Meditate on the eternal treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O mind,
and then, the screen of Maya shall be torn away.

891.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਉ ॥
891.t: gur kaa sabadh a(n)mirat ras peeau ||
891.e: Drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Guru's Shabad,
and then your soul shall be rendered immaculate and pure. ||2||
Searching, searching, searching, I have realized
that without devotional worship of the Lord, no one is saved.

891.g: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
891.t: so har bhajan saadh kai sa(n)g ||
891.e: So vibrate, and meditate on that Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;

891.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੩॥
891.t: man tan raapai har kai ra(n)g ||3||
891.e: your mind and body shall be imbued with love for the Lord. ||3||
Renounce all your cleverness and trickery.

891.g: ਮਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
891.t: man bin har naavai jai na kaiee ||
891.e: O mind, without the Lord's Name, there is no place of rest.
The Lord of the Universe, the Lord of the World, has taken pity on me.
Nanak seeks the protection and support of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||16||27||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:

891.g: ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗ ਕੇਲ ॥
891.t: sa(n)t kai sa(n)g raam ra(n)g kel ||
891.e: In the Saints' Congregation, play joyfully with the Lord,

891.g: ਆਗੈ ਜਮ ਸਿਉ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਲ ॥
891.t: aagai jam siau hoi na mel ||
891.e: and you will not have to meet the Messenger of Death hereafter.
Your egotistical intellect shall be dispelled,
and your evil-mindedness will be totally taken away. ||1||
Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name, O Pandit.

891.g: ਕਰਮ ਕਾਂਡ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਕਾਜੈ ਕੁਸਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
891.t: karam kaa(n)dd aha(n)kaar na kaajai kusal setee ghar jaeh pa(n)ddit ||1|| rahaau ||
891.e: Religious rituals and egotism are of no use at all. You shall go home with happiness, O Pandit. ||1||Pause||

891.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਜਸੁ ਨਿਧਿ ਲੀਆ ਲਾਭ ॥
891.t: har kaa jas nidh leeaa laabh ||
891.e: I have earned the profit, the wealth of the Lord's praise.
All my hopes have been fulfilled.

891.g: ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਠਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
891.t: dhukh naaThaa sukh ghar meh aaiaa ||
891.e: Pain has left me, and peace has come to my home.
By the Grace of the Saints, my heart-lotus blossoms forth. ||2||
One who is blessed with the gift of the jewel of the Name,
obtains all treasures.
His mind becomes content, finding the Perfect Lord.
Why should he ever go begging again? ||3||
Hearing the Lord's sermon, he becomes pure and holy.
Chanting it with his tongue, he finds the way to salvation.
He alone is approved, who enshrines the Lord within his heart.
Nanak: such a humble being is exalted, O Siblings of Destiny. ||4||17||28||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:

891.g: ਗਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਪਕਰੀ ਨ ਆਈ ਹਾਥਿ ॥
891.t: gahu kar pakaree na aaiee haath ||
891.e: No matter how hard you try to grab it, it does not come into your hands.
No matter how much you may love it, it does not go along with you.
Says Nanak, when you abandon it,
then it comes and falls at your feet. ||1||
Listen, O Saints: this is the pure philosophy.

891.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਈ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਤ ਉਧਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
891.t: raam naam bin gat nahee kaiee gur pooraa bheTat udhaar ||1|| rahaau ||
891.e: Without the Lord's Name, there is no salvation. Meeting with the Perfect Guru, one is saved. ||1||Pause||

892.g: ਜਬ ਉਸ ਕਉ ਕੋਈ ਦੇਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
892.t: jab us kau koiee dhevai maan ||
892.e: When someone tries to appease her,
then she takes pride in herself.

892.g: ਜਬ ਉਸ ਕਉ ਕੋਈ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਹਰੈ ॥
892.t: jab us kau koiee man paraharai ||
892.e: But when someone puts her out of his thoughts,
then she serves him like a slave. ||2||
She seems to please, but in the end, she deceives.

892.g: ਇਕਤੁ ਠਉਰ ਓਹ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
892.t: eikat Thaur oh kahee na samaavai ||
892.e: She does not remain in any one place.
She has bewitched a great many worlds.
The Lord's humble servants cut her apart into pieces. ||3||
Whoever begs from her remains hungry.

892.g: ਇਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਚੈ ਸੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਲਹੈ ॥
892.t: eis sa(n)g raachai su kachhoo na lahai ||
892.e: Whoever is infatuated with her obtains nothing.
But one who renounces her, and joins the Society of the Saints,
by great good fortune, O Nanak, is saved. ||4||18||29||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:
See the Lord, the Universal Soul, in all.
The One God is perfect, and all-pervading.
Know that the priceless jewel is within your own heart.
Realize that your essence is within your own self. ||1||
Drink in the Ambrosial Nectar, by the Grace of the Saints.

892.g: ਵਡੇ ਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੁਆਦੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
892.t: vadde bhaag hoveh tau paieeaai bin jihavaa kiaa jaanai suaadh ||1|| rahaau ||
892.e: One who is blessed with high destiny, obtains it. Without a tongue, how can one know the taste? ||1||Pause||

892.g: ਅਠ ਦਸ ਬੇਦ ਸੁਨੇ ਕਹ ਡੋਰਾ ॥
892.t: aTh dhas bedh sune keh ddoraa ||
892.e: How can a deaf person listen to the eighteen Puraanas and the Vedas?
The blind man cannot see even a million lights.
The beast loves grass, and remains attached to it.

892.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਹੀ ਬੁਝਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਬੁਝੈ ॥੨॥
892.t: jis nahee bujhaavai so kit bidh bujhai ||2||
892.e: One who has not been taught - how can he understand? ||2||
God, the Knower, knows all.
He is with His devotees, through and through.
Those who sing God's Praises with joy and delight,

892.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ॥੩॥੧੯॥੩੦॥
892.t: naanak tin jam neR na aaveh ||3||19||30||
892.e: O Nanak - the Messenger of Death does not even approach them. ||3||19||30||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:
Blessing me with His Name, He has purified and sanctified me.

892.g: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਇਹ ਬਿਤੁ ॥
892.t: har dhan raas niraas ieh bit ||
892.e: The Lord's wealth is my capital. False hope has left me; this is my wealth.
Breaking my bonds, the Lord has linked me to His service.

892.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥
892.t: har har bhagat raam gun gaae ||1||
892.e: I am a devotee of the Lord, Har, Har; I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||
The unstruck sound current vibrates and resounds.

892.g: ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਅਪਨੈ ਗੁਰਦੇਵਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
892.t: rasak rasak gun gaaveh har jan apanai gurdhev nivaajaa ||1|| rahaau ||
892.e: The Lord's humble servants sing His Glorious Praises with love and delight; they are honored by the Divine Guru. ||1||Pause||
My pre-ordained destiny has been activated;
I have awakened from the sleep of countless incarnations.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, my aversion is gone.

892.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੨॥
892.t: man tan raato har kai ra(n)g ||2||
892.e: My mind and body are imbued with love for the Lord. ||2||
The Merciful Savior Lord has saved me.

892.g: ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਘਾਲ ॥
892.t: naa kichh sevaa naa kichh ghaal ||
892.e: I have no service or work to my credit.
In His Mercy, God has taken pity on me;
He lifted me up and pulled me out, when I was suffering in pain. ||3||

892.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਚਾਉ ॥
892.t: sun sun upajio man meh chaau ||
892.e: Listening, listening to His Praises, joy has welled up within my mind.

892.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
892.t: aaTh pahar har ke gun gaau ||
892.e: Twenty-four hours a day, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
Singing, singing His Praises, I have obtained the supreme status.
By Guru's Grace, Nanak is lovingly focused on the Lord. ||4||20||31||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:
In exchange for a shell, he gives up a jewel.
He tries to get what he must give up.
He collects those things which are worthless.
Enticed by Maya, he takes the crooked path. ||1||
You unfortunate man - have you no shame?

892.g: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
892.t: sukh saagar pooran paramesar har na chetio man maahee ||1|| rahaau ||
892.e: You do not remember in your mind the ocean of peace, the perfect Transcendent Lord God. ||1||Pause||
Nectar seems bitter to you, and poison is sweet.
Such is your condition, you faithless cynic, which I have seen with my own eyes.
You are fond of falsehood, fraud and egotism.

893.e: If you hear the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you feel like you have been stung by a scorpion. ||2||
You continually yearn for Maya,
